chapters.title: Chapter 351 Meeting I
paragraphs: "Is that true, Mom? Can Big Sis Ying and I really join the Blazing Phoenix Sect?" Chu Qing asked with an excited expression, especially since she had wanted to join the sect for a long time, but their parents never gave them permission to do so, and they only gave permission to their sister.

Chu Ying was also taken aback by their mother's decision, prompting her to glance at Zhang Fei, who was smiling at them. "If you permit us to join the Phoenix Blazing Sect, then Qing'er and I will join, Mom. Moreover, Big Sis Lingxue, Ziqin, and Wu'er are also in the sect, so the two of us won't have any trouble adapting to the environment there."

"That's right, the two of you can join the Blazing Phoenix Sect, but you guys must always listen to Lingxue's words." Chu Ying and Chu Qing were even more excited to hear Liu Qingyu's answer. "Zhang Fei told me that he will take us to the higher realms in the future, and you two are not used to public life, especially since we forbid you from joining any sect.
That's why I made this decision, and I hope you guys can get used to your new life in the sect, so you will be ready to face possibly harsher situations in the future."
"Yay!" Chu Qing jumped in joy before running towards Zhang Fei, and she immediately sat on his lap before kissing his lips repeatedly, causing Liu Qingyu and the others to laugh at her antics.
Liu Qingyu then spoke to Zhang Lingxue. "I entrust my two daughters to you, and you can punish them if they cause trouble in your sect."
"You don't need to worry about them, especially since they are my sisters, so I will definitely protect them well." Zhang Lingxue then turned to Zhang Fei. "Are we going into seclusion today?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei then lowered Chu Qing from his lap before standing up. "However, I will take you guys somewhere before we enter into seclusion, especially since the situation in this realm might become chaotic soon."
"Eh?" Not only Zhang Lingxue was surprised by Zhang Fei's words, but the Liu Sisters and the others were also surprised, and they looked at him with questioning looks.

Zhang Fei then explained to them all the information he had gotten from his three slaves, including the information he had gotten from Pang Zhen before. However, they were shocked after hearing the overall strength of the cultivators in the Northern Region, and Zhang Lingxue felt that the combined strength of the cultivators in the Central Region would not be that great either.

"The situation might be safer and more under control with all of the Pang Clan's vassals gone, but I'm sure that Pang De won't just sit back and let their plans fall apart; he might be planning something to restart everything.

Unfortunately, that guy was really cautious, and he didn't tell the details of his plans to others, including his son, so I had a hard time getting information about it, so I have to do something to prevent chaos while we are in seclusion, and my best option is the Moon Fox Race, especially since they are powerful with many cultivators at the Sovereign Realm within their race."

"I think you are right if you want to meet the Moon Fox Race." Zhang Lingxue said that while nodding. "However, they almost never interfere with the affairs of the outside world, especially since they are very selfish and only care about their own race, so I'm not sure if they will agree to help us."

Zhang Fei did not deny Zhang Lingxue's words, especially since he himself was also selfish. However, his wives and families were living in the Sky Jade Realm now, so he couldn't turn a blind eye to the possibility of chaos in this realm, which would only cause them suffering. "They may feel safe in their sub-realm for now, but it's connected to this place, and they can't stay there forever.

If the ancestors of those clans come out of their seclusion and cause chaos, their race will be affected by the consequences, and it will be too late for them if they have already taken over this place, let alone if they manage to bring those demons back here.
That's why I wanted to meet and talk to them, so we're heading there right now, but we need to gather a lot of people first, including your clan members."
"Where did you get the idea about this, Fei'er?" Liu Hua suddenly asked Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei directly answered Liu Hua's question. "Shen Xueyi thought about gathering all the clan and sect leaders, but all of them are still in the demon cave to stabilize the seal on the demon portal, so we can't disturb them for now.

Even so, we can't stay still and wait for chaos to happen, and I think every clan and sect must have caretakers while their leaders are away, so I want to bring them there to meet and discuss with the moon foxes."

They nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei before Zhang Lingxue spoke again. "You're right about that, Fei'er. Like my clan, my mother and sister-in-law handle all the clan's affairs while my father and big brother are away, and other clans also have some people taking care of their affairs, so we can meet them.
Moreover, we can also discuss this matter with those in the demon cave via voice transmission, so we won't disturb them too much."
"So, husband, who will you bring to meet them?" This time, it was Shen Yu who asked Zhang Fei.

"Qingyu will represent the Chu Clan, and Hua'er will represent the Liu Clan. I'll also take your mother, grandmother, and great-grandmother. Aside from them, I want to invite Aunt Huan'er to represent the Ye Clan and Xing Mei to represent the Gu Clan.

As for the Zhao Clan, I will release Ziqin from the training space after we gather them all, especially since there are no more members left from her clan, and Zhao Liang is still in the demon cave." Zhang Fei then turned to look outside before asking them. "Who is the right person to represent the Heavenly Sword Sect?"
Liu Qingyu immediately told him. "Since Ba Jiawen is in the demon cave, we can take Yang Ye or Su Qingshi with us, especially since they are his two deputies."

"In that case, we will go to that sect now, and we will take one of them with us." Zhang Fei first opened a portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect before asking Zhang Lingxue to enter it, and he asked her to talk to her clan members as well as with other clans.
In addition, he asked Liu Hua to meet Yan Huan'er and Xing Mei, and he then took Liu Qingyu with him to the Heavenly Sword Sect, especially since she was more familiar with them.

A while later, they had already arrived at the Heavenly Sword Sect, and Liu Qingyu's status as the mistress of the Chu Clan allowed them to enter the sect easily, so one of the guards immediately took them away to the guest hall before calling Yang Ye and Su Qingshi to meet them.

Zhang Fei and Liu Qingyu did not have to wait too long because Yang Ye and Su Qingshi had known about their arrival since the second entered their sect, but he was a little surprised because Qin Zheng was with them.
"Are you Zhang Fei?" Su Qingshi asked him.
Zhang Fei nodded to Su Qingshi. "Yes, I am."

The two of them immediately sat down in the empty seats with Qin Zheng standing behind them, and Su Qingshi then spoke to Zhang Fei again. "I've heard about you from Zheng'er, and I have to thank you for giving her those healing pills.
Thanks to them, Little Qianzhi is much healthier now, so she doesn't have to keep worrying about her daughter, and she was able to focus on her cultivation, which was far behind."

Zhang Fei was a little surprised by Su Qingshi's words, but he also felt relieved because Qin Zheng didn't tell her about the other pills. "Senior, you don't need to thank me; I gave those pills to Senior Sister Qin to repay Zhu Yan, especially since she has helped me so much in my restaurant."

"I see." Su Qingshi nodded in understanding, but she was also impressed with Zhang Fei. "Anyway, Lian'er is my disciple beside Zheng'er, and I heard that she has already chosen you to be her husband, so I hope you will treat her better and don't disappoint her like Gu Zhan did."

"Senior, you don't need to worry about Lian'er; I will always treat her well and fairly." Since he didn't have much time, Zhang Fei immediately shifted their conversation. "Anyway, we came here because we wanted to invite one of you to join us, and I will take us to the Central Region to discuss serious matters."

The two people exchanged glances for a moment, and Yang Ye immediately asked Zhang Fei. "What kind of serious matter are you talking about, Kid? While our sect master is away, we can't leave this sect if there's nothing urgent, so please explain everything before we make a decision."

Instead, Liu Qingyu, who was the one to explain the situation to Yang Ye and Su Qingshi in as much detail as possible, including about the situation in the southern and eastern regions, shocked both of them.

They then looked at Zhang Fei with suspicious eyes, especially since they had heard about his actions at the Yin-Yang Pavilion from their representatives who attended his wedding with Shen Yu, and they thought that he was the one who did all that.
Yang Ye finally accepted it. "All right, we agree with you, and Qingshi will go with you to the central region, especially since I have to receive guests who will come from far away."
After that, Zhang Fei Liu Qingyu immediately said goodbye to Yang Ye, and Su Qingshi followed them to the Chu Clan, but she also brought Qin Zheng to join them.

When they arrived at the Chu Clan, Liu Hua was already waiting for them, along with the other two women. However, after she saw Zhang Fei, Xing Mei's expression turned unpleasant, especially since he snatched Ye Lian from the late Gu Zhan, and his contract beast was also the one who killed her son.

However, Zhang Fei did not care about her, and he immediately opened a portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect. Unlike Xing Mei and Yan Huan'er, who looked shocked to see it, Su Qingshi was no longer surprised, especially since Qin Zheng had already told her about some of his abilities. "Let's go in; we will immediately arrive at the Central Region."
"Your abilities are truly terrifying, kid." Su Qingshi spoke as she looked toward the Blazing Phoenix Sect, which was not far from their location.

"Usually, it would take us four to five days to arrive at this region, depending on the quality of our flying artifact, but you were able to bring us all here in just the blink of an eye, and I thought you were the only cultivator in this realm who could do it."

"You are right, Senior Qingshi." Yan Huan'er said with a slight nod. "Fei'er is indeed extraordinary, and he has many strange abilities. However, I have not witnessed many of his abilities in person, and I have only heard about them from Lian'er."

"Yeah." Su Qingshi replied with a nod of approval. "This kid caused chaos in the Desolate Sect some time ago, and he even captured Ba Shuxiang and Chi Zhongguo because they collaborated with Pang Liyuan."

Hearing that, Zhang Fei glanced at Qin Zheng, especially since only she knew about it, and she returned the glance with an apologetic look, causing him to sigh softly. However, he immediately ignored it and spoke to them.
"We will wait for the others to arrive, and I will take you to the entrance area to Moon Fox's sub realm to meet up with them, especially since we need their help to deal with those heretics."

"The moon fox?" Su Qingshi turned to Zhang Fei in surprise, especially since she originally thought that they would only talk to members of other clans and sects. "Do you also know members of that race?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to Su Qingshi. "I know some of them, and our relationship is pretty good."
Unlike them, Xing Mei kept looking at Zhang Fei from behind, and both of her hands clenched tightly as her anger began to take over her feelings, making her eager to take revenge for her son's death.

Yan Huan'er, who realized that, immediately grabbed Xing Mei's hand to stop her, especially since Ye Lian had told her that her future son-in-law was very cruel, and she would suffer a terrible fate if she attacked him. 'Stop it, Sister Mei. I know how you feel, but you will never be able to defeat him, and you will be the one who suffers if you attack him.'

Zhang Fei himself noticed the change in Xing Mei's attitude, and he was already prepared to retaliate against her if she attacked him. Fortunately, Yan Huan'er stopped her first, so he did not attack her.

Two people were standing on the sea's surface, and Shen Xueyi immediately transformed into her sea serpent form before bringing Zhang Fei [1] to dive into it, especially since they wanted to meet Shen Huang and Shen Xinya.

At first, Shen Xueyi was surprised by Zhang Fei [1]'s decision to gather so many people, but she immediately agreed to his wishes, especially since the situation in their realm would become uncontrollable if those evil ancestors came out of their seclusions.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 Meeting II
paragraphs: "Hmm?" Shen Huang and Shen Xinya, who were cultivating in their sea serpent form, were surprised by their arrival, so they immediately returned to their human form. "Why did you bring him here, Xueyi?"

"Grandmother, we came here to pick you two up, and he will send you two to the central region to join the others." Both women were surprised by her answer, and Shen Xueyi immediately explained to them Zhang Fei [1]'s plans to meet the moon fox race.

"The overall strength of those heretics is far greater than we all imagined before, and their ancestors' cultivation should have reached the sovereign realm by now. Moreover, they have been in seclusion for so long, and they have been continuously absorbing the demon miasma into their bodies, so we cannot underestimate them.

That's why he had the idea to gather them to meet that race, especially since they are more powerful than us, so only they can match up to those heretics. If those heretics become unchecked in this realm, it will plunge into immense chaos, causing immense suffering for countless people."
Shen Huang nodded in understanding after listening to Shen Xueyi's explanation. "I agree with you, but I doubt that those moon foxes will listen to us, let alone be willing to help us.

Even so, Zhang Fei [1] should be able to handle them with his bloodline power, but it might cause them to have different ideas about him, especially since they are no less arrogant, and they might not allow others to suppress them."

"You don't need to think about that, and I am confident that I can handle them. Even if I can't do it, I can still escape from them easily, and they will never be able to find me." Zhang Fei [1] answered confidently, especially since the moon foxes do not have the ability to teleport, and they also never trained at eight times heavier gravity. 'Buy those pills, Mei.'
Mei was momentarily surprised by Zhang Fei [1]'s request, but she immediately followed her master's request by purchasing those pills.
{You got Essence Qi Pill x2}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x2}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x2}
{You got Soul Enhancement Pill x2}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x2}
{You got Beast Body Tempering Pill x2}
{You got Beast Talent Pill x2}
{You got Beast Advancement Pill x2}
{3,700,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
{200 Lower Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance}
{100 Intermediate Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance.}
{20 Advanced Grade Beast Cores have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei [1] immediately took those pills and handed them to Shen Huang and Shen Xinya, who were surprised by his sudden decision. Even Shen Xueyi was surprised by his sudden decision, but she was aware that he did so because their strength was still far from enough to deal with those heretics.

Therefore, they needed more powerful cultivators, and the two women were the best choice, especially since they had the potential to break through to the sovereign level if they swallowed those pills.
"Why are you giving them to us now?" Shen Huang inquired in a confused manner as she received the pills.

Unlike her mother, Shen Xinya looked eager to swallow those pills, and she couldn't care less if she had to pay for them using her body. She immediately closed her eyes and swallowed them one by one, just like Shen Yu and Shen Xueyi had done before.

Instead of answering Shen Huang's question, Zhang Fei [1] shared the Yin-Yang Arts with them, and he also gave them some bottles of yang qi, which confused her further. "You guys already know my intentions for the two of you, but I will never force you to be my partner. Furthermore, we need more powerful cultivators to protect this realm from those heretics, so I purposely gave them to you guys.
The decision is in your hands, and you don't have to swallow them if you disagree."

Shen Huang felt a dilemma about swallowing those pills, especially since she was not interested in becoming Zhang Fei [1]'s partner, but Shen Xueyi immediately persuaded her grandmother. "Grandmother, I understand your thoughts, but he has already stated that he will never force you to be his partner, and he will definitely keep his word.
That's why you don't need to think about it and swallow them now, and you might be able to reach the sovereign realm right away, which will add more strength to our side."
After giving it some thought, Shen Huang agreed with her granddaughter and immediately closed her eyes, starting to swallow the pills one by one.
Shen Xueyi immediately turned to Zhang Fei [1], who was smiling to himself and staring at Shen Huang, who had swallowed the pills. 'Hey! You're more interested in my grandmother than my mother, huh?'

'Yes.' Zhang Fei [1] did not deny it because Shen Huang was indeed more interesting in his eyes compared to Shen Xinya. 'Although your grandmother wants power, she does not really submit to it, so she is different from your mother, who is willing to use any means to get it, including selling herself. That's why I am more interested in her, and I want her to be one of my harem members.'

'If you want my grandmother to be in your harem that much, then you should approach her more aggressively. Otherwise, she will never accept you, especially since her heart has long been frozen.' Zhang Fei [1] laughed at Shen Xueyi's answer, but he himself was also aware of it. 'Anyway, where are we going after this? Are we going to the Meng Clan?
Since Meng Qi is in the demon cave, only her sister, Meng Guanqiu, can make decisions in the clan.'

'After this, we'll go to the Hidden Sea Sect to pick up the Hai Twins and Ye Qianyu, and then we'll go to the Meng Clan. After all, they're a major clan in this region, so we need their help too.' Zhang Fei then remembered the other three clans. 'The Wei, Ying, and Ding Clans are only minor clans, but I think their strength is quite strong, so I think we can take them all at once.'

Shen Xueyi nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei. 'All right, we will bring the leaders of the three clans with us, but you better be careful that your relationship with Yi Na is not exposed by Wei Jiang.'
After they waited for some time, the Shen Ancestors finally finished swallowing those pills, as well as his yang qi.

As Zhang Fei [1] and Shen Xueyi expected, Shen Huang and Shen Xinya managed to break through to the sovereign realm straight away, especially since their cultivation had been stuck at the 10-Star Heaven realm for too long, so the pills and yang qi gave them the significant final push to get past the final barrier leading to that stage.

As soon as the Shen Ancestors opened their eyes, Shen Xueyi immediately congratulated them. "Congratulations! Grandmother and mother! You two have finally succeeded in reaching the sovereign realm, and you can now continue your cultivation."

Shen Xinya did not respond to her daughter's words as her eyes continued to stare at Zhang Fei [1], but she felt disappointed because his gaze was only on Shen Huang. 'Sigh! I have to think of something to make him willing to accept me, so my cultivation can increase faster to the next minor stage.'
"Thank you." Shen Huang expressed her gratitude to Zhang Fei [1], particularly because her cultivation had been stagnant for an extended period, and she was thankful for her eventual breakthrough.

paragraphs: After they had waited for quite some time, Zhang Lingxue finally came along with three old men. Apart from them, there are two women, none other than her mother and sister-in-law, Yang Yudie and Zi'er.
Unlike her usual appearance, Zi'er came wearing a purple mask covering her alluring face, which intrigued Zhang Fei, especially since he could feel a strange feeling coming from her. 'Scan her, Mei.'
Name: Zi'er
Age: 55 years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 10-Star Heaven Realm
Element: Lightning [Advanced Stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Lightning Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique: Heavenly Fragrance Physique
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Zhang Wuji
Likes: Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Wuji, Zhang Xiaoling, Zhang Lingxue
Dislikes: Pang Clan, Huo Clan

'Oh? She's a bit older than Lingxue, but her cultivation has already reached the 10-Star Heaven Realm.' Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he read Zi'er's status, but he raised his eyebrows when he read her special physique, and she was the only cultivator who had a special physique that he had ever met in the Sky Jade Realm. 'Heavenly Fragrance Physique? What kind of physique is that, Mei?'

[Master, you can feel the temptation coming from Zi'er, right?] Zhang Fei answered Mei with a slight nod, especially since he did feel tempted to approach and devour her directly. [Heavenly Fragrance Physique is related to charm, which makes her body emit an enchanting and irresistible allure aura, and other men will feel the same way as you if they see her.

Fortunately, she had her artifact mask on, which effectively suppressed her aura. Otherwise, you and these men wouldn't be able to resist the temptation of her aura, and all of you would immediately pounce on her.]

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei then looked at the men around him, and it was clear that they had to fight hard to hold themselves back from pouncing at Zi'er. 'Her special physique is that scary, huh? Why does she hate the Huo Clan? Did something happen between them?'

"Husband!" Zhang Lingxue suddenly called out Zhang Fei as he brought the two women towards him, causing the three old men to look at him in surprise, having never heard of their marriage. "They are my mother and sister-in-law, Yang Yudie and Zi'er."
'Mei, buy five sets of the pills; I remember Lingxue has a niece.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Essence Qi Pill x5}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x5}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x5}
{You got Soul Enhancement Pill x5}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x3}
{You got Yang Purifying Pill x2}
{7,750,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}

Zhang Fei gave a nod to Zhang Lingxue before retrieving the pills from the system inventory. He then handed them to Yang Yudie while speaking to her. "Mother-in-law, I'm sorry that I haven't had the chance to come to the Zhang Clan to meet and ask for your blessing to take Lingxue as my wife, but she has already become my wife now, so I hope you can bless our relationship.
In return, I give these pills as an apology gift for my impudence, and they will be beneficial to you and the others."
"Since my daughter has chosen you as her husband, I won't say anything about your relationship with her.

Moreover, she has told us quite a lot about you, so I completely trust her choice, and I hope you will be together until the end of your lives." Yang Yudie replied to Zhang Fei as she accepted the bottles, but her expression turned to shock after she opened one of them, so Zi'er peeked at the contents, which shocked her as well.
'Mother and sister-in-law, you should not say anything and accept these pills, especially since my husband only gives them to those closest to him.

Moreover, I myself have swallowed them before, so I can tell you two that their effects are truly extraordinary, and you guys will feel significant changes after you swallow them later.' Both women nodded at Zhang Lingxue, and Yang Yudie immediately put them in her storage ring. "Anyway, husband, these three men are the eldest elders of the Di, Feng, and Chang clans.
Their names are Di Xingjie, Feng Xiaogang, and Chang Liangjun."

"I'm glad that the three of you have decided to join us, seniors." Zhang Fei expressed his gratitude as he gazed at the three old men. "This way, I'm sure that we can convince the moon fox race to help us, so those heretics won't be able to reign in our realm."
They nodded at him, but Di Xingjie immediately approached Zhang Fei. "Lingxue told me that you are interested in learning formation arrays; do you want to learn it from me?

Actually, my ancestor forbade us from teaching our formation array techniques to outsiders, but you are a member of the Zhang Clan, and Zhang Long is like a blood brother to him, so I think there will be no problem if you learn them."

Zhang Fei's expression brightened upon hearing that, particularly because he had already planned to visit the Di Clan to learn about formation arrays, and now that the opportunity was in front of him, he couldn't possibly waste it.
Zhang Fei immediately cupped his hands to Di Xingjie. "Senior, if you don't mind teaching me, I am willing to learn the Di Clan's formation array techniques, and-"

"No need." Di Xingjie immediately stopped Zhang Fei. "I am willing to teach you because you are a member of the Zhang Clan, and the relationship between our two clans is like family, so you don't need to address me as your master."

After he said that, Di Xingjie immediately touched Zhang Fei's forehead and passed several types of formation arrays into his mind. However, most of them were basic formations, especially since he was just about to start his path to becoming a formation array master.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Qi Gathering Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Light Shield Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Confining Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Hundred Illusion Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array Method.]

Di Xingjie then pulled back his hand and explained each array to him. "Since you are also a member of the Chu Clan, you should have used the Qi Gathering Formation Array in their clan, right? Back then, Chu Hong purchased the Qi Gathering Formation Array from my patriarch, and since it's the most basic formation, you can begin your learning with it.

The Light Shield Formation Array is also a basic protective formation, but it is enough to withstand attacks from cultivators in the Heaven Realm, and I will teach you more powerful formations after you have successfully learned them.

The Hundred Illusion Formation and the Confining Formation array are also basic formations, but they are slightly more difficult to learn than the previous two, and you should already know their functions from their names. As for the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array, it is a formation at the entry level of the intermediate formation array, and you can't learn it for now.
However, I deliberately gave it to you first, so you can start learning it after you master the other four."

"Thank you, Senior. I will immediately study them after I return, and if I have difficulty understanding them, I will come to you in the Di Clan." Di Xingjie nodded to Zhang Fei. "Anyway, can you tell me about the stages of the formation array?"

Di Xingjie explained it to Zhang Fei right away. "Formation arrays have several levels: basic, intermediate, advanced, and master. However, each level is divided into three stages: entry, mid, and high. As for the formation array master level, it is not too difficult to remember because it is only divided from rank 1 to 10."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after listening to Di Xingjie. "I really can't wait to study them, but they are waiting for us, so we should go to the entrance to the moon fox's sub-realm now."
After Di Xingjie agreed, they rushed to that area, and Zhang Lingxue immediately asked her mother to use the token they got from the moon fox in the past.

Yang Yudie nodded in agreement and took out the token before channeling her qi into it, making a light come out of it and shoot towards the entrance to the moon fox's sub-realm. "This way, they'll notice our arrival, so we just have to wait for them to come out.
However, we shouldn't have too much hope for them, especially since they are such selfish creatures and probably won't be willing to help us."

"Ha ha ha." Feng Xiaogang laughed at Yang Yudie's words. "You shouldn't have to think about that, right, old madam? The moon foxes are indeed divine beasts, but my Feng Clan is not inferior to them, and I am confident that we will be able to convince them to help us."
Yang Yudie did not deny Feng Xiaogang's words, especially since she herself knew the background behind the real Feng Clan, and her daughter also got the fire phoenix bloodline from Feng Yao.

'Hmm?' Zhang Fei, who was curious about Feng Xiaogang's identity and the Feng Clan, immediately asked Mei to scan his status. However, the result surprised him a little, especially since he, like Zhang Lingxue, also had a fire phoenix bloodline. Even so, he is not a true phoenix, and he only has the bloodline.
'If my guess is correct, Feng Yao should be a true fire phoenix, or else she would not have been able to pass her bloodline to Lingxue.'

[I think so too, Master. However, I am confused as to why a mythical beast like the phoenix lives in the lower realm, especially since the quality and quantity of qi in this realm is not very good for it, and the upper realm should be the most suitable place for it.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. 'Forget it; Feng Yao might have a special reason for staying in this realm, and we might be able to find out about it in the future.'

Suddenly, the area glowed quite brightly before the portal to the moon fox's sub-realm finally opened. Soon, two men and two women of the race walked out of it, and a faint smile appeared on Zhang Fei's face after he saw Hu Lili among them. However, he did not show any reaction, especially since he did not want the other moon foxes to suspect him.
A female moon fox suddenly moved in front of Zhang Fei, which caused him and Hu Lili to frown slightly. The other cultivators also looked at her with puzzled looks.

The female moon fox then sniffed Zhang Fei's body again and again. "Hmm? I can smell the fox scent on your body, but I can't identify your fox bloodline. Besides, I smell the scent of serpents and various other beasts from your body, but I also smell the scent of other strange beasts on your body."

'Is this woman a fox or a dog? Why is she acting like a dog?' Hu Li suddenly sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei and told him the identity of the woman, who was none other than Hu Qiaomu, and she also had the sharpest sense of smell among the other moon foxes. "You don't have to sniff me like that, Senior.
I am indeed a fox beast, and I have several beast wives by my side, so it's natural that you can smell the scent of other beasts from my body."

People who didn't know Zhang Fei were shocked to hear his confession, and they didn't expect that he was a beast, especially since they couldn't sense the aura of a beast from his body, including Feng Xiaogang.
"Oh?" Hu Qiaomu was taken back for a moment when she heard that, and she then supported her chin with her hand. "Show me your fox form, kid."
Zhang Fei immediately transformed into his fox form, but he did not show his four tails to them, and he used a fox form with one tail.
"Eh?" Hu Qiaomu and the other two moon fox members were shocked by Zhang Fei's fox form, especially since his fox form was indeed larger than other foxes, including them.

Similar to Chu Qing and his other women, Zhang Fei's fox form, particularly his smooth and white fur, captivated Hu Qiaomu and the other women. However, the two moon fox men, who were none other than Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, suddenly moved to their friend's side, and both of them observed him seriously.
"Have you ever seen a fox as big as him before, Dahai?" Hu Peiwu questioned his friend.

"No." Hu Dahai answered with a shake of his head. "This kid only has one tail, so his figure shouldn't be this big. As far as I know, only the nine-tailed fox has a figure as big or bigger than him, but I myself have never seen a nine-tailed fox, so I can't say for sure either."

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly before returning to his human form. "Seniors, I'm not sure how my fox form can be so large, but it's true, as you've witnessed. As for my fox bloodline, I am a snow-white fox, so my fox form is so white."

"A snow fox?" The three people from the moon fox race raised their eyebrows, especially since there was no snowy area in the Sky Jade Realm, so they felt strange about Zhang Fei's existence in their realm.
As if understanding their thoughts, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to them again. "I don't know my exact origins, but I was already in this realm when I opened my eyes, so I don't know how I got here."

Zhang Lingxue, the Liu Sisters, and the people who knew Zhang Fei almost laughed after hearing him lie to the three members of the moon fox race with a straight face. Even Hu Lili was amused by his lies, especially since they knew that he was a true human, but also a true fox.

The three members of the moon fox just nodded and didn't ask further, and Hu Qiaomu directly asked them. "So what is the purpose of all of you coming to this place? Why did you come in such a large group?"

sentences.text: After they had waited for quite some time, Zhang Lingxue finally came along with three old men.
Apart from them, there are two women, none other than her mother and sister-in-law, Yang Yudie and Zi'er.
Unlike her usual appearance, Zi'er came wearing a purple mask covering her alluring face, which intrigued Zhang Fei, especially since he could feel a strange feeling coming from her. 'Scan her, Mei.'
Name: Zi'er
Age: 55 years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 10-Star Heaven Realm
Element: Lightning [Advanced Stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Lightning Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique: Heavenly Fragrance Physique
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: Zhang Wuji
Likes: Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Wuji, Zhang Xiaoling, Zhang Lingxue
Dislikes: Pang Clan, Huo Clan
'Oh?

She's a bit older than Lingxue, but her cultivation has already reached the 10-Star Heaven Realm.' Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he read Zi'er's status, but he raised his eyebrows when he read her special physique, and she was the only cultivator who had a special physique that he had ever met in the Sky Jade Realm. 'Heavenly Fragrance Physique?
What kind of physique is that, Mei?'
[Master, you can feel the temptation coming from Zi'er, right?] Zhang Fei answered Mei with a slight nod, especially since he did feel tempted to approach and devour her directly.
[Heavenly Fragrance Physique is related to charm, which makes her body emit an enchanting and irresistible allure aura, and other men will feel the same way as you if they see her.
Fortunately, she had her artifact mask on, which effectively suppressed her aura.
Otherwise, you and these men wouldn't be able to resist the temptation of her aura, and all of you would immediately pounce on her.]
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei then looked at the men around him, and it was clear that they had to fight hard to hold themselves back from pouncing at Zi'er. 'Her special physique is that scary, huh?
Why does she hate the Huo Clan?
Did something happen between them?'
"Husband!" Zhang Lingxue suddenly called out Zhang Fei as he brought the two women towards him, causing the three old men to look at him in surprise, having never heard of their marriage.
"They are my mother and sister-in-law, Yang Yudie and Zi'er."
'Mei, buy five sets of the pills; I remember Lingxue has a niece.'
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Essence Qi Pill x5}
{You got Meridian Cleansing Pill x5}
{You got Dantian Strengthening Pill x5}
{You got Soul Enhancement Pill x5}
{You got Yin Purifying Pill x3}
{You got Yang Purifying Pill x2}
{7,750,000 red jewels have been deducted from your balance.}
Zhang Fei gave a nod to Zhang Lingxue before retrieving the pills from the system inventory.
He then handed them to Yang Yudie while speaking to her.

"Mother-in-law, I'm sorry that I haven't had the chance to come to the Zhang Clan to meet and ask for your blessing to take Lingxue as my wife, but she has already become my wife now, so I hope you can bless our relationship.
In return, I give these pills as an apology gift for my impudence, and they will be beneficial to you and the others."
"Since my daughter has chosen you as her husband, I won't say anything about your relationship with her.

Moreover, she has told us quite a lot about you, so I completely trust her choice, and I hope you will be together until the end of your lives." Yang Yudie replied to Zhang Fei as she accepted the bottles, but her expression turned to shock after she opened one of them, so Zi'er peeked at the contents, which shocked her as well.
'Mother and sister-in-law, you should not say anything and accept these pills, especially since my husband only gives them to those closest to him.

Moreover, I myself have swallowed them before, so I can tell you two that their effects are truly extraordinary, and you guys will feel significant changes after you swallow them later.' Both women nodded at Zhang Lingxue, and Yang Yudie immediately put them in her storage ring.
"Anyway, husband, these three men are the eldest elders of the Di, Feng, and Chang clans.
Their names are Di Xingjie, Feng Xiaogang, and Chang Liangjun."
"I'm glad that the three of you have decided to join us, seniors." Zhang Fei expressed his gratitude as he gazed at the three old men.
"This way, I'm sure that we can convince the moon fox race to help us, so those heretics won't be able to reign in our realm."
They nodded at him, but Di Xingjie immediately approached Zhang Fei.
"Lingxue told me that you are interested in learning formation arrays; do you want to learn it from me?

Actually, my ancestor forbade us from teaching our formation array techniques to outsiders, but you are a member of the Zhang Clan, and Zhang Long is like a blood brother to him, so I think there will be no problem if you learn them."

Zhang Fei's expression brightened upon hearing that, particularly because he had already planned to visit the Di Clan to learn about formation arrays, and now that the opportunity was in front of him, he couldn't possibly waste it.
Zhang Fei immediately cupped his hands to Di Xingjie.
"Senior, if you don't mind teaching me, I am willing to learn the Di Clan's formation array techniques, and-"
"No need." Di Xingjie immediately stopped Zhang Fei.
"I am willing to teach you because you are a member of the Zhang Clan, and the relationship between our two clans is like family, so you don't need to address me as your master."
After he said that, Di Xingjie immediately touched Zhang Fei's forehead and passed several types of formation arrays into his mind.
However, most of them were basic formations, especially since he was just about to start his path to becoming a formation array master.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Qi Gathering Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Light Shield Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Confining Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Hundred Illusion Formation Array Method.]
[You obtained the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array Method.]
Di Xingjie then pulled back his hand and explained each array to him.
"Since you are also a member of the Chu Clan, you should have used the Qi Gathering Formation Array in their clan, right?
Back then, Chu Hong purchased the Qi Gathering Formation Array from my patriarch, and since it's the most basic formation, you can begin your learning with it.

The Light Shield Formation Array is also a basic protective formation, but it is enough to withstand attacks from cultivators in the Heaven Realm, and I will teach you more powerful formations after you have successfully learned them.

The Hundred Illusion Formation and the Confining Formation array are also basic formations, but they are slightly more difficult to learn than the previous two, and you should already know their functions from their names.
As for the Nine Dragons Sealing Formation Array, it is a formation at the entry level of the intermediate formation array, and you can't learn it for now.
However, I deliberately gave it to you first, so you can start learning it after you master the other four."
"Thank you, Senior.
I will immediately study them after I return, and if I have difficulty understanding them, I will come to you in the Di Clan." Di Xingjie nodded to Zhang Fei.
"Anyway, can you tell me about the stages of the formation array?"
Di Xingjie explained it to Zhang Fei right away.
"Formation arrays have several levels: basic, intermediate, advanced, and master.
However, each level is divided into three stages: entry, mid, and high.
As for the formation array master level, it is not too difficult to remember because it is only divided from rank 1 to 10."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding after listening to Di Xingjie.
"I really can't wait to study them, but they are waiting for us, so we should go to the entrance to the moon fox's sub-realm now."
After Di Xingjie agreed, they rushed to that area, and Zhang Lingxue immediately asked her mother to use the token they got from the moon fox in the past.
Yang Yudie nodded in agreement and took out the token before channeling her qi into it, making a light come out of it and shoot towards the entrance to the moon fox's sub-realm.
"This way, they'll notice our arrival, so we just have to wait for them to come out.
However, we shouldn't have too much hope for them, especially since they are such selfish creatures and probably won't be willing to help us."
"Ha ha ha." Feng Xiaogang laughed at Yang Yudie's words.
"You shouldn't have to think about that, right, old madam?
The moon foxes are indeed divine beasts, but my Feng Clan is not inferior to them, and I am confident that we will be able to convince them to help us."
Yang Yudie did not deny Feng Xiaogang's words, especially since she herself knew the background behind the real Feng Clan, and her daughter also got the fire phoenix bloodline from Feng Yao.
'Hmm?' Zhang Fei, who was curious about Feng Xiaogang's identity and the Feng Clan, immediately asked Mei to scan his status.
However, the result surprised him a little, especially since he, like Zhang Lingxue, also had a fire phoenix bloodline.
Even so, he is not a true phoenix, and he only has the bloodline.
'If my guess is correct, Feng Yao should be a true fire phoenix, or else she would not have been able to pass her bloodline to Lingxue.'
[I think so too, Master.

However, I am confused as to why a mythical beast like the phoenix lives in the lower realm, especially since the quality and quantity of qi in this realm is not very good for it, and the upper realm should be the most suitable place for it.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. 'Forget it; Feng Yao might have a special reason for staying in this realm, and we might be able to find out about it in the future.'
Suddenly, the area glowed quite brightly before the portal to the moon fox's sub-realm finally opened.
Soon, two men and two women of the race walked out of it, and a faint smile appeared on Zhang Fei's face after he saw Hu Lili among them.
However, he did not show any reaction, especially since he did not want the other moon foxes to suspect him.
A female moon fox suddenly moved in front of Zhang Fei, which caused him and Hu Lili to frown slightly.
The other cultivators also looked at her with puzzled looks.
The female moon fox then sniffed Zhang Fei's body again and again.
"Hmm?
I can smell the fox scent on your body, but I can't identify your fox bloodline.
Besides, I smell the scent of serpents and various other beasts from your body, but I also smell the scent of other strange beasts on your body."
'Is this woman a fox or a dog?

Why is she acting like a dog?' Hu Li suddenly sent a voice transmission to Zhang Fei and told him the identity of the woman, who was none other than Hu Qiaomu, and she also had the sharpest sense of smell among the other moon foxes.
"You don't have to sniff me like that, Senior.
I am indeed a fox beast, and I have several beast wives by my side, so it's natural that you can smell the scent of other beasts from my body."

People who didn't know Zhang Fei were shocked to hear his confession, and they didn't expect that he was a beast, especially since they couldn't sense the aura of a beast from his body, including Feng Xiaogang.
"Oh?" Hu Qiaomu was taken back for a moment when she heard that, and she then supported her chin with her hand.
"Show me your fox form, kid."
Zhang Fei immediately transformed into his fox form, but he did not show his four tails to them, and he used a fox form with one tail.
"Eh?" Hu Qiaomu and the other two moon fox members were shocked by Zhang Fei's fox form, especially since his fox form was indeed larger than other foxes, including them.
Similar to Chu Qing and his other women, Zhang Fei's fox form, particularly his smooth and white fur, captivated Hu Qiaomu and the other women.
However, the two moon fox men, who were none other than Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu, suddenly moved to their friend's side, and both of them observed him seriously.
"Have you ever seen a fox as big as him before, Dahai?" Hu Peiwu questioned his friend.
"No." Hu Dahai answered with a shake of his head.
"This kid only has one tail, so his figure shouldn't be this big.
As far as I know, only the nine-tailed fox has a figure as big or bigger than him, but I myself have never seen a nine-tailed fox, so I can't say for sure either."
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly before returning to his human form.
"Seniors, I'm not sure how my fox form can be so large, but it's true, as you've witnessed.
As for my fox bloodline, I am a snow-white fox, so my fox form is so white."

"A snow fox?" The three people from the moon fox race raised their eyebrows, especially since there was no snowy area in the Sky Jade Realm, so they felt strange about Zhang Fei's existence in their realm.
As if understanding their thoughts, Zhang Fei immediately spoke to them again.
"I don't know my exact origins, but I was already in this realm when I opened my eyes, so I don't know how I got here."
Zhang Lingxue, the Liu Sisters, and the people who knew Zhang Fei almost laughed after hearing him lie to the three members of the moon fox race with a straight face.
Even Hu Lili was amused by his lies, especially since they knew that he was a true human, but also a true fox.
The three members of the moon fox just nodded and didn't ask further, and Hu Qiaomu directly asked them.
"So what is the purpose of all of you coming to this place?
Why did you come in such a large group?"

chapters.title: Chapter 354 Meet Zhang Xiaoling
paragraphs: Liu Qingyu was the first to explain to the members of the moon fox race about their actions in capturing Pang Hong, which led them to obtain information about all the clans that decided to become vassals of the Pang Clan, and Zhang Lingxue supported her explanation, especially since she was the one who helped the Liu Sisters capture him.

In addition, Liu Qingyu informed them about the destruction of the Li and Mei clans, but she did not tell them that Zhang Fei did it. Rather, she conveyed to them that the demon fox group, under the leadership of Liu Hua and the Wen Twins, had decimated them, seizing control of the two clans, and she revealed the existence of the blood demon tree.

After that, Shen Xueyi represented the cultivators from the southern region to explain the situation in their region to the members of the moon fox race, including the destruction of the three clans and the first blood demon tree.

However, Hu Qiaomu and the others were shocked to hear the name of the Cai Clan, especially since they knew that the clan was an in-law of the Chang Clan, so they turned to Chang Liangjun, who immediately confirmed it. "Ancestor Wuhen and Patriarch Wentian already knew about it, and they agreed for Madam Shen and the others to destroy the Cai Clan."

Hu Qiaomu, Hu Lili, and the two old men nodded in understanding to Chang Liangjun, but they did not expect that Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian would make such a decision. Despite this, they could understand Chang Wuhen and Chang Wentian's decision, particularly considering their own willingness to act similarly if any of their clan members were to betray them.

Lian Xiang then explained to them the situation in the eastern region based on Zhang Fei's information, which included details about Pang Gui, the destruction of the clans that chose to side with the Pang Clan, and the third blood demon tree.

Luo Yigang and Dong Fuxiang were really shocked to hear Lian Xiang's explanation, especially since they only knew about the destruction of the Huan Clan, but they didn't know anything about the destruction of the Qiao clan and the others. However, they decided to save their questions for now, and they intended to ask him after they returned to their region.

"Unfortunately, we haven't managed to find the fourth blood demon tree, especially since we haven't gotten any information about where Pang De hid the tree, so we still have to be very careful about that." Yang Wudie spoke to the Moon Fox Race members. "Moreover, their overall strength is greater than the combined strength of all of our forces, so we decided to come here to meet you all.

I know you don't want to interfere with outside affairs, but you must be aware that your race will also bear the consequences if those heretics succeed in taking over our realm, let alone if they succeed in bringing those demons back to this realm, so I hope you are willing to cooperate with us."

Feng Xiaogang joined in to speak to them, but he did it through voice transmission, especially since that was one of their clan's secrets and few people knew about it. 'You guys should know the identity of the matriarch of my Feng clan, right? Even though your race is a race of divine beasts, Feng Yao is a fire phoenix, and a phoenix is a mythical beast, so her bloodline is much higher than yours.'

Unlike Hu Lili, Hu Qiaomu and the two old men immediately turned to Feng Xiaogang while frowning, but they did not deny that their bloodline was indeed inferior to a mythical beast like Feng Yao, and they had no choice but to respect her, especially since she was powerful and could suppress them easily.

Feng Xiaogang smiled slightly at their reaction, then spoke to them again. 'Feng Yao fully supports their plan, and Hu Gao should already know about these matters, so you can discuss with him to make a decision.'

Hearing that, Hu Qiaomu and the two old men turned to Hu Lili, who immediately nodded at them. "Yang Yudie is right about the consequences, and we won't be able to stay in our sub-realm forever, especially since we still need a lot of things from this place. That's why I believe joining them is the best option for us.
However, one of you should first consult with Hu Gao about this matter, given his position as our leader. If that happens, our race's future is at stake, so I'm sure he'll agree with them."
After that, Hu Qiaomu immediately contacted Hu Gao to ask for his approval, and his answer was within Hu Lili's expectations, as he immediately agreed without thinking twice.
Hu Qiaomu immediately nodded to Yang Yudie and the others. "Our leader has agreed with that, so we will join you guys, and he asked us to discuss further regarding our respective duties."

"In that case, I invite all of you to go to the Zhang Clan, where we can talk more freely." They all immediately agreed with Yang Yudie's idea, so they hurriedly went to the clan residence, and Zhang Fei also went with them.
Before long, they had arrived at the Zhang Clan, but Zhang Fei did not join in their discussion, so he decided to look around the clan residence.

However, Zhang Fei suddenly heard the sound of a flute in an area, so he immediately rushed to that area, where he saw Zhang Xiaoling seriously playing her flute. He did not disturb her and sat down on an empty bench, and he listened to her flute playing from a distance. 'So she is Zi'er's daughter, huh? Scan her, Mei.'
[Okay.]
Name: Zhang Xiaoling
Age: 35 years old.
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Star Earth Realm
Element: Wind [Intermediate Stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Wind Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: -
Likes: Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Wuji, Zi'er, Zhang Lingxue
Dislikes: Pang Clan, Huo Clan
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was surprised after he saw Zhang Xiaoling's cultivation. 'She was much younger than Qingyu and Hua'er, but her cultivation was on par with theirs.

[Master, the quality and quantity of qi in this region are much better than the other four regions. Moreover, the Zhang Clan is much stronger than the other clans, and they definitely have much better resources, so it is natural that she already has a high cultivation despite her young age.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. 'Although she is not inheriting her mother's special physique, she is still alluring, and her purple eyes are also really pretty.'
[Hehe! Are you interested in that woman, Master? In that case, you can try to approach her, and her high cultivation will be enough to help you.]

Zhang Fei's lips twitched at Mei's words, especially since the AI kept motivating him to increase the number of members in his harem. Even so, he did not deny that Zhang Xiaolong's beauty attracted his interest, but he had not yet thought of approaching her.

After some time, Zhang Xiaoling had already stopped playing her flute, but she was surprised when Zhang Fei clapped his hands from a distance. She immediately turned to him, but she was momentarily stunned by his attractive looks. However, she quickly regained her composure, and she questioned him with a frown. "Who are you? How did you enter my clan?"

"My name is Zhang Fei, and I am Lingxue's husband." Zhang Xiaoling was taken aback to learn that the man in front of her was her aunt's husband, and Zhang Fei immediately approached her. "Your flute playing is really melodious, and I can feel peace when I listen to it, Xiaoling."
Zhang Xiaoling was not surprised that Zhang Fei knew her name, and she thought that it was Zhang Lingxue who told her, and she then asked him. "Do you really like my flute playing?"
Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Xiaoling. "Not only is your flute playing melodiously, but you also have a beautiful smile."
"Humph!" Zhang Xiaoling snorted at Zhang Fei. "I heard from my aunt that you have many wives, and I am not interested in such a man, so you better not think anything of me."
"Haha ." Zhang Fei laughed while shaking his head. "I was just praising you based on the facts, and I don't have any such thoughts for you either."

"That's good! I'll castrate you right away if you dare to have such thoughts for me." Zhang Fei smiled strangely as he heard Zhang Xiaoling's threat. "Anyway, why did you suddenly come to this clan? Did you come with Aunt Lingxue?"

"Yes ." Zhang Fei replied with a nod. "Actually, we didn't come alone; we came together with many other cultivators, and they were having a discussion in the main hall. Since I was still too young, I was too lazy to join them, so I chose to look around this clan. After that, I accidentally heard you playing the flute, so I came here to listen to you."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaoling was surprised to hear that, and she used her senses to check the main hall, where she found her family was having a serious discussion with many people. "Do you want to listen to my flute playing again?"

"I really enjoyed your flute playing, so I still want to listen to it." Zhang Fei nodded without hesitation and sat down on the chair beside Zhang Xiaoling. "Moreover, we will return to the western region after they finish their discussion, and I don't know when I can come to this clan again, so I don't want to waste the opportunity to hear you play the flute."

"All right, I'll play a few songs, so you have to listen carefully." After she said that, Zhang Xiaoling immediately started playing her flute again, and Zhang Fei continued to listen to her with his eyes closed as he repeatedly patted his legs.
Zhang Xiaoling herself repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, and she was truly delighted to see her enjoying her flute playing so much, so she tried to give her best performance.

After she played a few songs, Zhang Xiaoling decided to stop playing her flute and sat down beside Zhang Fei. "All this time, only my family members have ever heard me play the flute, so you are the first outsider to hear it."
Zhang Fei was not surprised that Zhang Xiaoling still regarded him as an outsider, especially since this was their first meeting, and they still didn't know each other well.

However, Zhang Xiaoling immediately realized her mistake, and she immediately spoke to Zhang Fei. "Oh! I was wrong! I shouldn't have thought of you as an outsider, especially since you have become Aunt Lingxue's husband, so you are also my family now, and I should have addressed you as Uncle Fei instead."
"Ha ha ha ha!" Zhang Fei laughed out loud upon hearing that. "Xiaoling, I am indeed your aunt's husband, but in fact, I am much younger than you, so it would be better if you called me by my name."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaoling turned to Zhang Fei in surprise, especially since she thought that he should be the same age as Zhang Lingxue. "How old are you now?"

"I'll be 20 years old in a few days." Zhang Xiaoling's eyes widened instantly, and her jaw dropped open. She was completely shocked to learn that Zhang Fei was much younger than her, but Zhang Lingxue chose him as her husband. "Didn't your aunt tell you all about the beginning of our meeting?"

Zhang Fei's question brought Zhang Xiaoling back to her senses, and she nodded at him. "Aunt Lingxue did tell us about you, but she never told us that you were so young, and it makes me feel weird now, especially since you're almost half my age."

"Age is just a number for us cultivators, you know? After all, we can live very long as our cultivation improves, so I never thought about the age difference between us." Zhang Xiaoling nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei's words, but she still felt strange about his relationship with Zhang Lingxue. "Moreover, wine gets sweeter as it ages, and your aunt is too attractive for a woman of her age."

Zhang Xiaoling shook her head after hearing that, but she had to admit that Zhang Lingxue was indeed beautiful, especially after she received the fire phoenix bloodline from Feng Yao. "Anyway, I heard from my aunt that you came from another realm, and you were also able to subdue a divine beast while your cultivation was still in the elementary realm. Is all that true?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei immediately summoned the dragon serpent out of the beast space, which surprised Zhang Xiaoling, and she felt a little scared by the aura radiating from her body. "Her name is Boitata, and I met her at the same time I met Lingxue."
"She-"
Before Zhang Xiaoling could speak, Boitata suddenly asked Zhang Fei as she glanced at her. "Are you thinking of taking this little girl as a member of your harem, husband?"

Boitata's question made Zhang Xiaoling feel embarrassed, especially since she had no interest in Zhang Fei, and he was Zhang Lingxue's husband, so she immediately stood up from her seat and distanced herself from them.
*Slap*
"Ouch!" Boitata screamed loudly as soon as Zhang Fei slapped her buttocks. "Why did you slap my butt so hard?"

Zhang Fei then pointed at Zhang Xiaoling as he spoke to Boitata. "See that? You should stop asking such a thing when I'm with other women, especially since not all women have an interest in me, and Xiaoling is one of them. Anyway, she is Lingxue's niece, so she is our family, and you shouldn't scare her."
