Before long, they had arrived at the Zhang Clan, but Zhang Fei did not join in their discussion, so he decided to look around the clan residence.
However, Zhang Fei suddenly heard the sound of a flute in an area, so he immediately rushed to that area, where he saw Zhang Xiaoling seriously playing her flute.
He did not disturb her and sat down on an empty bench, and he listened to her flute playing from a distance. 'So she is Zi'er's daughter, huh?
Scan her, Mei.'
[Okay.]
Name: Zhang Xiaoling
Age: 35 years old.
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Star Earth Realm
Element: Wind [Intermediate Stage]
Core: Peak-Rank Wind Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique:
Special Bloodline:-
Partner: -
Likes: Zhang Long, Yang Yudie, Zhang Wuji, Zi'er, Zhang Lingxue
Dislikes: Pang Clan, Huo Clan
'Oh?' Zhang Fei was surprised after he saw Zhang Xiaoling's cultivation. 'She was much younger than Qingyu and Hua'er, but her cultivation was on par with theirs.
[Master, the quality and quantity of qi in this region are much better than the other four regions.
Moreover, the Zhang Clan is much stronger than the other clans, and they definitely have much better resources, so it is natural that she already has a high cultivation despite her young age.]
Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Mei. 'Although she is not inheriting her mother's special physique, she is still alluring, and her purple eyes are also really pretty.'
[Hehe!
Are you interested in that woman, Master?
In that case, you can try to approach her, and her high cultivation will be enough to help you.]
Zhang Fei's lips twitched at Mei's words, especially since the AI kept motivating him to increase the number of members in his harem.
Even so, he did not deny that Zhang Xiaolong's beauty attracted his interest, but he had not yet thought of approaching her.
After some time, Zhang Xiaoling had already stopped playing her flute, but she was surprised when Zhang Fei clapped his hands from a distance.
She immediately turned to him, but she was momentarily stunned by his attractive looks.
However, she quickly regained her composure, and she questioned him with a frown.
"Who are you?
How did you enter my clan?"
"My name is Zhang Fei, and I am Lingxue's husband." Zhang Xiaoling was taken aback to learn that the man in front of her was her aunt's husband, and Zhang Fei immediately approached her.
"Your flute playing is really melodious, and I can feel peace when I listen to it, Xiaoling."
Zhang Xiaoling was not surprised that Zhang Fei knew her name, and she thought that it was Zhang Lingxue who told her, and she then asked him.
"Do you really like my flute playing?"
Zhang Fei nodded to Zhang Xiaoling.
"Not only is your flute playing melodiously, but you also have a beautiful smile."
"Humph!" Zhang Xiaoling snorted at Zhang Fei.
"I heard from my aunt that you have many wives, and I am not interested in such a man, so you better not think anything of me."
"Haha ." Zhang Fei laughed while shaking his head.
"I was just praising you based on the facts, and I don't have any such thoughts for you either."
"That's good!
I'll castrate you right away if you dare to have such thoughts for me." Zhang Fei smiled strangely as he heard Zhang Xiaoling's threat.
"Anyway, why did you suddenly come to this clan?
Did you come with Aunt Lingxue?"
"Yes ." Zhang Fei replied with a nod.
"Actually, we didn't come alone; we came together with many other cultivators, and they were having a discussion in the main hall.
Since I was still too young, I was too lazy to join them, so I chose to look around this clan.
After that, I accidentally heard you playing the flute, so I came here to listen to you."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaoling was surprised to hear that, and she used her senses to check the main hall, where she found her family was having a serious discussion with many people.
"Do you want to listen to my flute playing again?"
"I really enjoyed your flute playing, so I still want to listen to it." Zhang Fei nodded without hesitation and sat down on the chair beside Zhang Xiaoling.

"Moreover, we will return to the western region after they finish their discussion, and I don't know when I can come to this clan again, so I don't want to waste the opportunity to hear you play the flute."

"All right, I'll play a few songs, so you have to listen carefully." After she said that, Zhang Xiaoling immediately started playing her flute again, and Zhang Fei continued to listen to her with his eyes closed as he repeatedly patted his legs.
Zhang Xiaoling herself repeatedly glanced at Zhang Fei, and she was truly delighted to see her enjoying her flute playing so much, so she tried to give her best performance.
After she played a few songs, Zhang Xiaoling decided to stop playing her flute and sat down beside Zhang Fei.
"All this time, only my family members have ever heard me play the flute, so you are the first outsider to hear it."
Zhang Fei was not surprised that Zhang Xiaoling still regarded him as an outsider, especially since this was their first meeting, and they still didn't know each other well.
However, Zhang Xiaoling immediately realized her mistake, and she immediately spoke to Zhang Fei.
"Oh!
I was wrong!
I shouldn't have thought of you as an outsider, especially since you have become Aunt Lingxue's husband, so you are also my family now, and I should have addressed you as Uncle Fei instead."
"Ha ha ha ha!" Zhang Fei laughed out loud upon hearing that.
"Xiaoling, I am indeed your aunt's husband, but in fact, I am much younger than you, so it would be better if you called me by my name."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaoling turned to Zhang Fei in surprise, especially since she thought that he should be the same age as Zhang Lingxue.
"How old are you now?"
"I'll be 20 years old in a few days." Zhang Xiaoling's eyes widened instantly, and her jaw dropped open.
She was completely shocked to learn that Zhang Fei was much younger than her, but Zhang Lingxue chose him as her husband.
"Didn't your aunt tell you all about the beginning of our meeting?"
Zhang Fei's question brought Zhang Xiaoling back to her senses, and she nodded at him.
"Aunt Lingxue did tell us about you, but she never told us that you were so young, and it makes me feel weird now, especially since you're almost half my age."
"Age is just a number for us cultivators, you know?

After all, we can live very long as our cultivation improves, so I never thought about the age difference between us." Zhang Xiaoling nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei's words, but she still felt strange about his relationship with Zhang Lingxue.
"Moreover, wine gets sweeter as it ages, and your aunt is too attractive for a woman of her age."
Zhang Xiaoling shook her head after hearing that, but she had to admit that Zhang Lingxue was indeed beautiful, especially after she received the fire phoenix bloodline from Feng Yao.
"Anyway, I heard from my aunt that you came from another realm, and you were also able to subdue a divine beast while your cultivation was still in the elementary realm.
Is all that true?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei immediately summoned the dragon serpent out of the beast space, which surprised Zhang Xiaoling, and she felt a little scared by the aura radiating from her body.
"Her name is Boitata, and I met her at the same time I met Lingxue."
"She-"
Before Zhang Xiaoling could speak, Boitata suddenly asked Zhang Fei as she glanced at her.
"Are you thinking of taking this little girl as a member of your harem, husband?"

Boitata's question made Zhang Xiaoling feel embarrassed, especially since she had no interest in Zhang Fei, and he was Zhang Lingxue's husband, so she immediately stood up from her seat and distanced herself from them.
*Slap*
"Ouch!" Boitata screamed loudly as soon as Zhang Fei slapped her buttocks.
"Why did you slap my butt so hard?"
Zhang Fei then pointed at Zhang Xiaoling as he spoke to Boitata.
"See that?
You should stop asking such a thing when I'm with other women, especially since not all women have an interest in me, and Xiaoling is one of them.
Anyway, she is Lingxue's niece, so she is our family, and you shouldn't scare her."

chapters.title: Chapter 355 With Zi'er - Zhang Xiaoling
paragraphs: Boitata shrugged her shoulders at Zhang Fei. "It's not a problem if she is Zhang Lingxue's niece, right? After all, Liu Hua is Chu Qing and Chu Ying's aunt, but she is also one of your wives. Not to mention, your-"

Before Boitata could continue, Zhang Fei had already sent her into the beast space, and he then turned to Zhang Xiaoling, who was looking at him in a daze. "She's right; my relationship is too messy in the eyes of others, especially since most of them are family, like Liu Hua and her two nieces. Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu are also mother and daughter, and there are still a few others."

"I've heard that dual cultivators are too crazy about looking for partners, especially since most of them have many women." Zhang Xiaoling expressed this sentiment while shaking her head. "However, I feel that you are the craziest among them, which makes me question Aunt Lingxue's decision to marry you.
Unfortunately, it's too late to stop your relationship with her, especially since she's already your wife now."

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed wryly as he rubbed his nose. "Even though I have many women, they are all very important to me, and I love them all equally. That's why you don't need to worry about your aunt because I will never push her aside, and I will continue to accompany her forever."
"I hope so." Zhang Xiaoling then looked outside and saw her mother walking towards them. "Why are you here, mom?"

"Don't you already know the reason?" Zi'er turned the question around as she let out a soft sigh. "Even though this mask can suppress my oddity, it still affects those men, and they can't keep holding themselves back if I continue to be there, which is why I decided to meet you two."

"Your physique is too terrifying." Zi'er and Zhang Xiaoling immediately turned to Zhang Fei in surprise. "I have met quite a few cultivators in this realm, but you are the only one who has a special physique, which caused men to be captivated by your alluring aura right away.
Even though I have many wives, I have a hard time resisting the urge to pounce on you, let alone those who only have one wife."

"Are you serious about that? What do you know about my physique?" Zi'er asked in a serious tone, especially since she herself did not recognize her special physique, which caused her to suffer so much for years.

Zhang Fei immediately rose from his seat to answer Zi'er. "Honestly, I don't know much about your special physique, but it's known as the Heavenly Fragrance Physique, which emits an enchanting and irresistible allure aura, and I'm sure you've experienced the consequences."

Once again, Zi'er let out a heavy sigh before responding to Zhang Fei. "My situation has made me suffer for so long, and my Zi clan was destroyed because of me. Even my husband was affected by it, and he wanted to force me to be his woman after he saved me from being chased by those people from the Huo Clan.
Fortunately, his mental strength was quite good, so he didn't do it in the end, and he proposed to me to be his wife instead, to which I agreed."

"Eh?" Zi'er's answer surprised Zhang Fei, but he also felt sympathy for hearing that her Zi clan was destroyed because of her. 'No wonder she and Xiaoling hate the Huo Clan so much. It turns out she has such a past with them.' "Does that mean you decided to accept your husband's proposal because he can protect you?"

"Yes." Zi'er did not deny Zhang Fei's question. "Back then, I was still very young, and my family members were dead, so I had no shelter or shoulder to lean on. Although I did not know or love him at the time, I immediately agreed to his proposal, especially since I needed protection to survive before I could take my revenge."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaoling laughed softly and hugged Zi'er's arm. "Fortunately, my father is a persistent and caring man, and he managed to make you fall in love with him completely. If he had failed to do so, I might never have been born into this world, so I am grateful to have such wonderful parents now."

Hearing that, Zi'er rubbed her daughter's head while smiling from behind her mask. "You're right; your father is indeed an extraordinary man. His persistence and seriousness touched my heart deeply, especially when he treated my wounds all by himself, even though he had to struggle hard to hold himself back.

He even helped me take revenge after I fully recovered, and he slaughtered everyone from the Huo Clan who was involved in the massacre of my Zi Clan. However, he didn't kill the main mastermind, and he brought him to me so I could kill him with my own hands."
Zhang Xiaoling then glanced at Zhang Fei with a proud look, which caused him to smile bitterly. However, he admitted that he could not compare to Zhang Wuji, who was so loyal to Zi'er.
"Did you really come from another realm?" Zi'er suddenly asked Zhang Fei after she remembered Zhang Lingxue's story about him.

"Yes." Zhang Fei immediately admitted it because Zhang Lingxue had already explained to him the information she had given her family about him. "My home realm is Earth, but there are no cultivators left there due to the absence of Qi. Because of luck, I was able to become a cultivator, and I also gained the ability to move realms.
Since then, I have been going back and forth between the two realms, but I have brought my family to this realm now, and we will be staying here for the next few years."
"What's your home realm like?" Zhang Xiaoling curiously asked.

"Do you two want to see my home realm?" Zhang Xiaoling and Zi'er immediately nodded to Zhang Fei, especially since they had never seen another realm, so they did not want to waste the opportunity before their eyes. In an instant, the gate leading to earth immediately opened in front of them, and he immediately led them into it.

"Ugh! The air in your realm smells bad." Zhang Xiaoling immediately complained as soon as they arrived at Zhang Chen's house, and she used her qi to envelop her body. "Phew! Fortunately, I have qi, or I would have died of suffocation from this foul air."

Unlike her, Zi'er did not use her qi to envelop her body, and she was more interested in seeing the interior of Zhang Chen's house, especially since all the things inside did not exist in the Sky Jade Realm.

"Let's go out, so you two can see my real home realm." Zhang Fei led the two women out of his grandmother's house, but they were confused when they saw the sky had already turned dark and several cars and motorcycles were passing by. "You guys can think of these two as flying artifacts, but they are not powered by Qi or jewels, and they are powered by something else.

Anyway, the flow of time in this realm is four times slower than in the Sky Jade Realm, so we can't stay here for too long. Otherwise, my mother-in-law and the others will be confused looking for us if we disappear for too long, and the moon fox race members will also be suspicious of me."

Zi'er nodded in agreement with that, and she immediately released her senses to explore the surrounding area as far as possible. However, she did not do it for long, and she quickly withdrew her senses before speaking to Zhang Fei. "Let's go back."
Once they returned to the Sky Jade Realm, Zi'er let out a sigh because the sky had changed, even though they hadn't been on earth for long. "Can you go to other realms besides your home realm?"

"I can go to the other three realms, but two of them are demon realms, so I won't take you two there, especially since the demon aura in those realms will affect you." After Zhang Fei mentioned demons, Zi'er and Zhang Xiaoling frowned.

"In fact, one of the two demon realms is the home of the demons who invaded this realm in the past, but they are too powerful for me, so I have never been there before. As for the third realm, the Tian realm is the home of the winged race, which is still connected to my home realm."
"Winged-race? What kind of creatures are they?" Two women asked in unison because there were no people from that race in the Sky Jade Realm, and they knew nothing about other realms.

Zhang Fei smiled, touched the two women's foreheads, and shared his memories of their first visit to the Tian realm, causing their expressions to shift from surprise to admiration simultaneously. "As you two can see, they are no different from humans like us, but they were born with wings.
Even if they are not cultivators, they can still fly with their wings, and some of them have more than six wings."

Zi'er suddenly realized something before asking Zhang Fei. "How can you go to one of those demon realms? Didn't you say that the demon aura there would affect us? Are you able to do that because you're a fox-beast?"

Zhang Fei was hesitant to tell Zhang Xiaoling and Zi'er the truth, especially after seeing their previous reactions when he mentioned demons. "Honestly, I wanted to tell you two the truth, and Lingxue already knows about this matter, but-"

"Hey, if you treat us as your family, then you shouldn't keep it a secret from us, and you should tell us the truth!" Zhang Xiaoling interrupted Zhang Fei with a little shout, and Zi'er nodded in agreement with her daughter, as she herself was really curious about it.

Zhang Fei sighed softly before extending both his hands to them, causing confusion for Zhang Xiaoling and Zi'er. "The sky and walls have ears, and there are many people outside our circle gathering in the main hall. I don't want them to know my secret, so I'll show it to you two while using one of my abilities."

The two women immediately grasped Zhang Fei's hand, but their eyes widened as he brought them into an invisible state. However, their expressions turned to shock when he turned into an incubus, and he was trembling from their killing intent.

Zhang Xiaoling and Zi'er immediately suppressed their killing intent, and Zhang Fei immediately explained to them about the authenticity of his three identities, which perplexed them. "When I use my human form, no one can sense my demon aura, but beast cultivators can sense my beast aura, like Hu Qiaomu before, but she couldn't recognize my beast identity if I didn't use my beast form."

Zi'er nodded in understanding and asked again. "What is your true beast identity? Previously, you told the three of them that you were a snow fox, but I am sure that you lied to them, especially since there is no snowy area in this realm."

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed and changed into his half-fox form with four tails dancing behind him, making Zhang Xiaoling's eyes sparkle, and she immediately grabbed one of the tails before rubbing it against her cheek. "My beast's identity is a mythical beast, the heavenly fox.

That's why I deliberately used my transformation technique to change my beast form, especially since they are much stronger than me, and they will probably try to get rid of me if they know my true beast identity."

"You've already done the right thing by doing that." Zi'er then also grabbed one of Zhang Fei's tails. "Those moon foxes are extremely arrogant, especially Hu Gao. They will never let a beast that can suppress them live, and they will use all means to kill you. Moreover, they are extremely strong, and all the clans that have ties with you will not be able to save you from them."

Zhang Fei then returned to his human form, making Zhang Xiaoling pout her lips in disappointment. He immediately canceled his invisibility. "So, why didn't they attack Feng Yao? Isn't she a mythical beast? If I'm not mistaken, she should be a fire phoenix, especially since Lingxue told me that she got her bloodline from her."

"Feng Yao is much stronger than you imagine, and she is actually the strongest cultivator in this realm, surpassing Chang Wuhen." Zi'er's answer surprised Zhang Fei. "She doesn't like being ostentatious, so she always suppresses her cultivation, but I don't know exactly what level her cultivation is at, and I suspect she has already reached the Saint Realm.
In fact, Hu Gao once brought some members of his race to attack her, but she defeated them handily, and even killed one of them after he used poison to attack her."

"The saint realm, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered in shock, especially since he had never met a cultivator whose cultivation was above the 1-Star Sovereign realm, and many of them even experienced heavy obstacles to break through to that stage, such as the Shen ancestors. "Has Feng Yao's cultivation really reached that stage? How did she do it?"

Zi'er shook her head at Zhang Fei. "For now, that is just my guess because I myself have never witnessed Feng Yao's true strength, but Hu Gao and those moon foxes did not dare to attack her or her Feng Clan again from then on."

'Feng Yao, huh? If there is anyone who can help me fight Hu Gao, then she is the only one. Hmm? I will ask Lingxue to introduce me to her, and I might be able to ask for her help in snatching Yue'er from Hu Gao's hands.' Zhang Fei muttered to himself before asking Zi'er once more. "Are there other true phoenixes in the Feng Clan?"

"You've already done the right thing by doing that." Zi'er then also grabbed one of Zhang Fei's tails.
"Those moon foxes are extremely arrogant, especially Hu Gao.
They will never let a beast that can suppress them live, and they will use all means to kill you.
Moreover, they are extremely strong, and all the clans that have ties with you will not be able to save you from them."
Zhang Fei then returned to his human form, making Zhang Xiaoling pout her lips in disappointment.
He immediately canceled his invisibility.
"So, why didn't they attack Feng Yao?
Isn't she a mythical beast?
If I'm not mistaken, she should be a fire phoenix, especially since Lingxue told me that she got her bloodline from her."
"Feng Yao is much stronger than you imagine, and she is actually the strongest cultivator in this realm, surpassing Chang Wuhen." Zi'er's answer surprised Zhang Fei.
"She doesn't like being ostentatious, so she always suppresses her cultivation, but I don't know exactly what level her cultivation is at, and I suspect she has already reached the Saint Realm.
In fact, Hu Gao once brought some members of his race to attack her, but she defeated them handily, and even killed one of them after he used poison to attack her."

"The saint realm, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered in shock, especially since he had never met a cultivator whose cultivation was above the 1-Star Sovereign realm, and many of them even experienced heavy obstacles to break through to that stage, such as the Shen ancestors.
"Has Feng Yao's cultivation really reached that stage?
How did she do it?"
Zi'er shook her head at Zhang Fei.
"For now, that is just my guess because I myself have never witnessed Feng Yao's true strength, but Hu Gao and those moon foxes did not dare to attack her or her Feng Clan again from then on."
'Feng Yao, huh?
If there is anyone who can help me fight Hu Gao, then she is the only one.
Hmm?
I will ask Lingxue to introduce me to her, and I might be able to ask for her help in snatching Yue'er from Hu Gao's hands.' Zhang Fei muttered to himself before asking Zi'er once more.
"Are there other true phoenixes in the Feng Clan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 356 Enter Seclusion
paragraphs: "There is no other true fire phoenix in the Feng clan, except for Feng Yao. She once informed Lingxue that she was the only one, with the rest of her clan members merely possessing the phoenix bloodline. Zi'er's answer confused Zhang Fei.

"In fact, she is the oldest living being in this realm, but everything about her has always been a mystery, especially since she never really opened herself to anyone, including Lingxue. Long before the Chang clan was crowned as the strongest clan, her clan was the strongest in this realm.
Unfortunately, her clan's main members suddenly disappeared, and no one knew how they disappeared or where they went."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows after hearing that, but he remembered Zefyr and Hu Lili's story about the heavenly fox deliberately leaving the Sky Jade Realm because their presence made the Qi in the realm continue to decline. "If your story is true, I think I know the reason they disappeared, and they should have migrated to one of the planets in the upper realms."
"Oh?" Zi'er and Zhang Xiaoling looked at Zhang Fei in surprise.

"In the past, this planet was not called the Sky Jade Realm, but the Heavenly Wilderness Realm. Moreover, this planet is not a realm in the lower realms, but in the upper realms, and only natural races live in it." Zhang Fei then narrated the story he had learned from Zefyr and Hu Lili to Zi'er and Zhang Xiaoling, omitting to mention the statue of the ten-tailed fox or the inscription on it.
"If the phoenixes did live on this planet in the past, I'm sure that they followed the heavenly foxes to the upper realms, but I don't know which planet they live on now."
"Tch! I am a human, but I despise other humans, especially since they are too greedy and think about their own ambitions." Zhang Xiaoling said this in an irritable tone.

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed at her words. "Isn't greed one of the basic traits of living creatures? Not only humans, but even beasts, are greedy and ambitious. Even we have greed within us, which makes us never satisfied with the achievements we have achieved, and it always drives us to keep moving forward."
Zhang Xiaoling did not argue with Zhang Fei, especially since she was always like that, and she never felt satisfied with everything she had achieved.
*Tap... Tap... Tap...*

Hearing the sound of many footsteps, Zhang Fei and the two women looked outside, and they saw Yang Yudie walking with several other cultivators towards them. However, they did not see the cultivators from the Central Region, including the moon fox race members, except for Hu Lili, who was still among them.
Zhang Fei asked them directly. "How did your conversation go?"
"I will represent my race to prevent those heretics from running rampant in the eastern region, so I will stay there for the time being." Hu Lili was the first to answer Zhang Fei.

Lian Xiang and the two people from the eastern region were relieved by the moon fox race's decision to send Hu Lili to their region, especially since they had no sovereign-level cultivators, so her presence would be of great help to them.

Shen Xueyi later told Zhang Fei. "People from all clans will assist my mother and grandmother in maintaining the security of the southern region, especially since they are the only ones who have reached the sovereign realm in our region."

"Sister Mei, Sister Huan'er, and I will monitor everything from our clans, but I will also ask some other people for help later." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement with Liu Qingyu. "In addition. Hua'er has ordered all members of the demon fox group to spread throughout the region, and their task is specifically to detect the presence of those heretics in our region."

Yang Yudie also spoke to Zhang Fei. "As for this central region, our four clans will send our people to all corners of it to search for the location of the fourth blood demon tree, and we will also participate in monitoring those heretics' movements."

"I think that's fine, so we can narrow down those heretics' movements. However, since we don't know their ancestors' strength, you must be careful." They nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei. "As for the northern region, I will personally oversee it. Moreover, some of my slaves have already gone to the Xie, Mo, and Gu clans.
This way, I will only have to wait for their information about those three clans, and I will make further plans against the three clans after I get information from them."

After hearing that, Yang Yudie released a soft sigh and spoke to Zhang Fei again. "Somehow, I feel that you are more thorough and well-planned than seniors like us, which makes us feel embarrassed, especially since you are still so young."

"Ha ha." Zhang Fei laughed awkwardly at her words. "Mother-in-law, I actually have no interest in getting involved in these matters, but all my wives and family live here, so I have no choice but to get involved in order to ensure their safety."

"I think that's good, and we definitely wouldn't have known about these matters if you hadn't gotten involved in them." Yang Yudie then asked Zhang Fei via voice transmission. 'I heard from Lingxue that you're going to bring them into seclusion, so how long are you all going to be in there?'

Zhang Fei shook his head slightly before answering Yang Yudie. 'I can't be sure about that yet, especially since I intend to reach the earth realm soon. Moreover, not only will we increase our cultivation, but we will also increase our abilities through our seclusion. In addition, I still have many new things to learn, so we will probably be in seclusion for several months.'
Yang Yudie was genuinely taken aback by Zhang Fei's response, particularly when he mentioned his intention to reach that stage.

However, she remembered her daughter's words that he had only cultivated for a little over two months, but he had already reached the 3-Star Soul Realm now, and he also had many women by his side, so she believed that he could reach that stage much faster compared to other cultivators.

'In that case, you all can concentrate on your seclusion, while we seniors will monitor all regions to prevent those heretics from causing trouble in any region. Anyway, I want you to bring Xiaoling with you, so she can also improve her abilities.'

'Eh?' Zhang Fei was taken aback by Yang Yudie's request, especially since they would often dual-cultivate in the training space, so Zhang Xiaoling would definitely feel uncomfortable seeing and listening to them. 'Mei, can you buy another portable mansion from the system shop?'

[Unfortunately, you can only buy one portable mansion, Master. However, there is another item that is not much different from the portable mansion, but you cannot move it to another place, so it will remain in the training space.]
'I think it's okay, so I can take the portable mansion out of the training space later.'
[All right, I'll buy it now.]
{You got Cloud Manor x1}
{10,000,000 has been deducted from your balance.}

'Cloud manor, huh? I'll take it out later, after I bring them into the training space.' Zhang Fei then replied to Yang Yudie. 'All right, I will bring Xiaoling with us, but you must inform her first.' "Since our business in this region is finished, I will send all of you back to your respective regions."

First, Zhang Fei opened a portal to the eastern region, and Lian Xiang immediately led them to enter it, including Hu Lili. After that, he opened a portal to the Chu Clan, especially since he no longer saved the location of the southern region, so they could return to that region through the portal in the clan, and Liu Qingyu immediately led them all back.
However, Shen Xueyi did not return to the southern region and waited for Zhang Fei at his new residence, especially since he wanted her to join them in seclusion.
After they all disappeared, Yang Yudie immediately spoke to her granddaughter. "Xiaoling, I want you to join your aunt and Zhang Fei in entering seclusion and train hard while you are there."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaoling was shocked by her grandmother's decision. "Grandma, they-"

"You don't have to worry about us, Xiaoling." Zhang Lingxue immediately interrupted her niece. "My husband has a special place for us to dual-cultivate, so you won't see or hear us doing it. Moreover, his training place is truly special, and your abilities will improve greatly after you train there for a long time."
"Are you serious about that, Aunt?" Zhang Xiaoling asked Zhang Lingxue doubtfully.

"Have I ever lied to you?" Zhang Lingxue turned to asked while shaking her head. "My husband has many things that other cultivators don't have, and he can even cure my old injuries that have devastated me for so many years, so you don't need to worry about that."
Zhang Xiaoling nodded to Zhang Lingxue. "If he does have such a place, then I will join you guys, and I will train hard there."

Before that, Yang Yudie took out one set of five set pills that Zhang Fei had given her before, and she handed them to Zhang Xiaoling directly. "He was the one who gave these pills to me, so you can swallow them while you are in seclusion, and I hope your abilities will improve greatly after you come out."

Zhang Xiaoling immediately looked at Zhang Fei in surprise after she saw one of the pills, but he just smiled at her and asked Mei to open the portal to the training space, which shocked the three women from the Zhang Clan. "Lingxue, you can bring her in now, and I will bring the others later to catch up with you two."
"All right." Zhang Lingxue swiftly grasped Zhang Xiaoling's hand, guiding her into the training area, while Mei promptly closed the portal.

Following that, Zhang Fei bid farewell to Yang Yudie and Zi'er before vanishing from their sight, causing them to shake their heads. They immediately returned to their respective rooms to swallow the pills.

As soon as they arrived inside, Zhang Xiaoling was immediately stunned and looked around the interior area before turning her gaze towards the portable mansion. "Who lives there, aunt? Are you going to dual-cultivate with him in there?"

"No." Zhang Lingxue shook her head at Zhang Xiaoling. "We usually dual-cultivate in this area, but my husband has prepared something so that you don't have to watch us. Anyway, his clone is dual-cultivating with his partners right now, so you shouldn't go there."
"Huh?" Zhang Xiaoling turned to Zhang Lingxue in surprise. "Does he really have clones? Does that mean his partners are also members of his harem?"

"Ha ha." That made Zhang Lingxue laugh. "In fact, my husband has three clones: one in the mansion, one in the northern region, and one in another realm. Moreover, his clones are truly unique, especially since they do not have their own personalities, and they are all one entity, so he can hear and see everything they see and hear.

As for his partners, they are not members of his harem, and only certain women he chooses to be members of his harem, including me. That's why he uses his clones to dual-cultivate with them, especially since he needs a lot of things to improve himself. Otherwise, his cultivation wouldn't be able to improve that fast in just a little over two months, right?"
"Your husband is indeed the craziest dual cultivator among them." Zhang Xiaoling expressed this by shaking her head. "Has he ever used his clones to dual-cultivate with you and the others?"

"No." Zhang Lingxue denied her question immediately. "My husband is too possessive, so he will never let other men touch us, even if they are his clones. Moreover, he himself is too strong for us, so he doesn't need help to satisfy us."
"Shameless!" Zhang Xiaoling shouted at Zhang Lingxue. "You were a shy and reserved woman before you met him, but you have become so shameless now!"
"Haha." Zhang Lingxue laughed and pulled Zhang Xiaoling to the center area. "This device is the main control of this training space, and you can start practicing using one of its features."
Instead, Zhang Xiaoling pointed at Zefyr, who was resting on the side with four other women. "Hey Aunt, who is that woman? How come her body is so small? Additionally, she is not human, right?"

"Oh, her name is Zefyr, and she is a member of the fairy race." Zhang Xiaoling was surprised for a moment to hear that, but she immediately remembered Zhang Fei's previous story. "Anyway, I'm going to activate the gravity feature now, and the gravity here will be two times heavier than outside, so you better get ready now."

Before Zhang Xiaoling could ask, Zhang Lingxue had already activated the gravity feature first, which caused her to fall to the ground. "Ugh! You should've waited for me to prepare first, Aunt Lingxue!"
"All right, stop complaining and start adapting to the weight." Zhang Lingxue then walked away from her niece.
Zhang Xiaoling was annoyed by that, but she was also surprised to see Zhang Lingxue could walk so casually under the pressure of heavy gravity. 'Tch! If Aunt Lingxue can do it, then I can do it too!'

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had arrived at his new residence, and he was satisfied to see that Ming Han and the others had become cultivators. He then explained to them about his plans, and he asked them to go to the Chu Clan often and cultivate there, which they readily agreed to.

After that, Zhang Fei gave the Wen Twins all the items he had brought from Earth and instructed them to arrange them in his shop first. Once everything was finished, he took all the women into the training space, with the exception of Zhang Chen and Xu Ling'er.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 Moon Fox Plans
paragraphs: Shen Xueyi, who was still amazed by the interior of the training space and the portable mansion, was shocked when Zhang Fei took out the cloud manor from the system inventory before placing it in another place. 'This guy is really weird! He can even take out a manor out of nowhere, and it's no less big than his mansion.'

In fact, all of Zhang Fei's women were also surprised by it, but they were already used to his secrecy. Moreover, he had promised them that he would explain everything when they grew stronger in the future, so they didn't ask him any questions and hurried to inspect the interior of the cloud manor.

Zhang Fei then hugged Shen Xueyi's waist, bringing her to the side of the central area. "Honestly, I want to dual-cultivate directly with you, but we'll be in seclusion for a long time, so we don't need to rush to do it. Furthermore, the fourth feature on the device will make the time flow in this place two times faster, giving us more time to seclude ourselves.

That's why it's best for you to train with Xiaoling and the others at two times the gravity. If you can quickly adapt to level three, your speed will significantly increase, especially since the gravity at that level will be eight times heavier.
"Are you kidding me?" Shen Xueyi screamed as she turned to face Zhang Fei. "Two times gravity is already heavy enough, so eight times gravity would be very heavy."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed at that. "All of us have adapted to level three, except for Ye Lian and Ziqin. As a senior, you mustn't be left behind by us, so you have to try harder."
"You guys really are training maniacs." Shen Xueyi said it with a soft sigh. "You're right; as a senior, I can't fall behind you guys, so I'll start training in this gravity now."

"That's good." Zhang Fei forgot that he had not yet picked up his little sister, so he immediately left the training space, went to the southern region, and then proceeded to the southern sea to pick up Zhang Lin.
Before long, Zhang Fei had arrived at the sect entrance, and he immediately contacted the Hai Twins to bring Zhang Lin to him.
However, the Hai Twins not only brought Zhang Lin, but they also brought Chu Xing with them, and Hai Dongyin inquired. "How long will you guys be in seclusion?"

"I can't say for sure yet, but I will come out after I reach the Earth Realm." Zhang Fei's answer surprised the Hai Twins. "If you need both of them, then you only need to contact my clone. That way, I will know your message immediately, and I will bring them directly back to your sect."
Both women nodded in understanding before Hai Dongxin spoke to Zhang Fei. "All right, take them; I hope they improve significantly after seclusion."
"Haha!" Chu Xing laughed at that. "Elders! I will not disappoint you two, and I will promote to an elder after I come out of my seclusion."
Zhang Lin also spoke to the Hai Twins. "I won't lose to Sister Xing, and I will definitely have reached the soul realm by then, especially since my brother will continue to help me."
The Hai Twins smiled with satisfaction at their determination in cultivation. "In that case, we will wait for the two of you to return, and we will assess your progress at that time."

"Yes!" Both women answered in unison, but Chu Xing remembered something. "Elders! I forgot to tell Wei Luan and Senior Sister Lanxin that I will be leaving for a long time, so please inform them of my departure."

However, it would be easier if you asked Yang Yudie and Zi'er to help you buy them, and you could go back to your new residence to install both of them.]
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Xiaolong answered Mei with a nod of agreement, so he immediately sent a voice transmission to Yang Yudie and asked her to help him buy those materials.
However, she told him that it would take time to purchase some items, especially since some of them were used for other things as well.

After that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately closed his eyes and began to absorb qi from the air to complete the daily quest, but he felt that his qi absorption rate increased a little faster than usual. 'Sigh!
I hope I can reach the Earth Realm sooner than I previously estimated.'

"I thought you would be gone for a long time, sister." The black Amaris immediately said this to her twin sister as soon as she appeared in their room, but then she looked at Feltia, who looked so relaxed.
"Anyway, I've tried to absorb her demon energy, but I couldn't do it.
Even so, she was able to give us her demon power directly, and it was really as strong as we had imagined before.
Even this young dryad's demon power pales in comparison to hers, so you can begin to absorb hers."
'Tch!
That's damn Oz!
Because of him, I can't say anything to my sister about this bastard!' The white Amaris cursed in her heart before answering her sister.
"You can enjoy her demon power for yourself, Sister.
I don't want to absorb her demon power, and I will only absorb this dryad's demon power."

"If you don't absorb Feltia's demon power, you will be left behind by me, and we will have a hard time fighting the other demon rulers." The black Amaris then grabbed her sister and pushed the white Amaris in Feltia's direction.
"I don't understand why you don't want to absorb her demon power, but you must do it, so we can fight them and become the next demon emperor."
Upon hearing that, the white Amaris glared at Feltia, who simply smiled back.
After that, she immediately approached her, sat on her lap, and hugged her neck. 'Tch!
If it weren't for my sister, I really wouldn't want to be near you!'
The moment the white Amaris thought so, Feltia had already hugged her waist and sealed her lips, causing her to panic, especially when her tongue invaded her mouth.
The white Amaris wanted to stop her, but Feltia suddenly squeezed her buttocks, and she also channeled her demon power into her body through their mouths. 'Ugh!
This is so disgusting!
I don't want her demon power to be in my body, but it is really powerful, and it can help me become stronger.'
In the end, the white Amaris immediately closed her eyes and began absorbing Feltia's demon power, which continued to flow into her body.
She also began to return his kiss, which gradually grew more heated.

The black Amaris shook her head as she watched her sister begin to enjoy her kiss with Feltia, but she did not disturb them and approached You Han, who still looked exhausted after the white Amaris had absorbed her demon power for quite some time.
She took turns absorbing her demon power.
The white Amaris was shocked when Feltia's hands began to fondle her breasts.

She opened her eyes and glared loudly at her, but Feltia immediately spoke to her through telepathy. 'It's useless for you to look at me like that, especially since a part of your soul has already merged with mine, and you'll definitely fall for me sooner or later.
That's why you don't need to resist it and surrender yourself completely to me, and you won't be disappointed with the pleasure I will give you next.'
'Tch!' The white Amaris felt annoyed after Feltia mentioned that, but she immediately closed her eyes again and enjoyed her demon power. 'This bastard!
If I weren't afraid of the consequences of Oz's abilities, I would have killed her right here right now.'

'Ha ha ha!' Feltia laughed triumphantly in her heart, and she began to stimulate every sensitive spot on the white Amaris' body, causing her lust to slowly start to ignite and giving her a deeper kiss.
A young man with long light-blue hair, whose appearance resembled that of a woman, was prostrating himself with his head pressed against the floor.
Despite this, his eyes kept glancing at the man sitting majestically on his throne, but his expression still looked shocked. 'Crap!
I didn't expect that he would never disappear; instead, he disguised himself as Zygoz.'
The young man was none other than Aqua the Aquarius, one of the twelve rulers of the Diyu Realm.
Although he looked quite handsome, and his body was also quite dashing, his appearance was the opposite of that, especially since he wore clothes and makeup like women in general.
"Get up, Aqua."
Hearing that, Aqua looked up at Oz before standing up, and he then asked in a feminine voice.
"Why did you disguise yourself as Zygoz, Lord?
For thousands of years, we thought you had disappeared like your predecessors, but you have always been in this realm, and none of us were aware of it."
"Hahaha!
Am I worthy of being your emperor if you guys can see through my disguise?" Oz's question made Aqua's lips twitch.
"Anyway, you should already know my reason for doing this, right?"
"Are you doing that because of the Amaris twins, Avros, Tauri, and Leo?"
"Yes." Oz nodded to Aqua.
"In the past, I didn't have any evidence of their involvement in my predecessor's disappearance, but we've found a lot of evidence now.
That's why I decided to return and meet with you all, and these three, along with Angela, have agreed to join me.
Anyway, I have started to make a move against the Amaris Twins, especially the white Amaris, because I have seen her meet an angel named Theo.
However, I didn't do it myself, and someone I trusted helped me take care of them.
Unfortunately, I haven't gotten any solid evidence of Avros, Tauri, and Leo's involvement, so I haven't made any moves against them yet."
"Eh?" Aqua was surprised to hear Oz's confession about the Amaris Twins.
"So the white Amaris is indeed in cahoots with them, huh?
In that case, why don't you kill them directly, Lord?
They betrayed the first demon lord, and they have also betrayed you, so I think they deserve to die."
"You're right, they deserve to die." Oz then told Aqua again.
"Unfortunately, that person still needs their demon power, so I haven't killed them yet, and I've left the matter of the two little girls to that person.
Moreover, I have merged the soul of the white Amaris with that person's soul, and I am sure that person will also succeed in controlling the black Amaris, so I don't need to worry about them."
Aqua raised her eyebrows after hearing that.
"Who exactly is that person, Lord?
Why do you believe that person can control the black Amaris?
She may be young, but her abilities are no less terrifying than those of us old generations, especially her ability to control illusions."
"Haha." OZ laughed at that.
"Do you think you'll entrust such a task to a weakling?
In fact, that person has abilities that even scare me, and that person has a cunning character, so I deliberately chose that person to handle them.
If you don't believe me, you can ask these three."
"Eh?" Aqua then glanced at Virgil, Aries, and Zygoz.
"Have you guys ever met that person?"
"Can your attack send me flying far?" Aqua shook his head at Aries.
"I've met that person before, and that person can send me flying very far away with just one hit."
Aqua was dumbfounded after he heard Aries' answer, and Virgil then spoke to him.
"That person is not an ordinary demon, and that person also has the light power like me, so I'm sure that the black Amaris's illusion won't affect that person."

"In addition to that, that person has the ability to create portals like mine, and that person has even brought me and Oz to the Tian Realm, so you don't need to doubt that person anymore." This time, it was Zygoz who spoke to Aqua.
The words of the three demon rulers shocked Aqua even more, especially since none of them could fight Aries except Tauri.
For years, they believed that Virgil was the only demon who possessed the light power, but suddenly, another demon appeared.
In addition, only Zygoz had the ability to create portals in their realm, not even Oz, as their emperor could not do that.
Oz then spoke to Aqua again.
"It's not that I don't trust you, but it would be better if not many people knew that person's identity.
After all, we still can't do anything about the other three, so I won't tell you about that person's identity for now, and you will meet that person in the future.
However, I can tell you that that person is the only demon who can replace me, but that person doesn't have the ambition to occupy that position."
"I see." Aqua nodded in understanding to Oz.
"Since you guys trust that person so much, then I will also choose to trust that person.
So what should we do now?"
"We don't need to do anything for now." Oz replied as he stepped down from the throne.
"For now, we just need to meet Kino, Scorpius, and Lycus.
Once the three of them agree to join us, I will immediately devise our next plan."
"So are we going to Lycus's sub-realm now?"
"Yes." Oz then led them out of the place.
"Let's go meet that lazy goat now."
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 6,300 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 63 green jewels sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Xiaolong immediately opened his eyes after the notification appeared, but he then looked at Pang Liyuan, who had just arrived, and a faint smile appeared on his face when he saw the unconscious Xie Jingxian on his shoulder.
"I thought I would have to wait longer for you to bring her to me, but you managed to do it faster than I expected.
Anyway, put her on the ground, so I can do something about her right away, or her clan members will wonder about her whereabouts."

chapters.title: Chapter 360 Xie Clan True Identity
paragraphs: [Master, you should look at Xie Jingxian's status first, and you will be surprised to see it.]
'Show her status, Mei.'
[All right.]
Name: Xie Jingxian
Age: 45 years old.
Race: Half Human - Half Demon
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 5-Star Heaven Realm
Element: Darkness [Advanced Stage]
Core: Middle-Rank Darkness Core
Physique: Human Physique
Special Physique: Shadow Demon
Special Bloodline: Shadow Demon
Partner: Pang Liyuan
Likes: Pang Liyuan, Xie Fanjing, Lai Rouyu
Dislikes: Pang De, Mo Xuanqing, all righteous cultivators
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong was surprised by Xie Jingxian's status, and he immediately asked Pang Liyuan. "Did you know that your wife is half demon?"
Instead, Pang Liyuan looked shocked by Zhang Xiaolong's question. "Is my wife really a half demon, master?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong nodded at Pang Liyuan. "Did you guys not know about it?"

"No." Pang Liyuan responded with a shake of his head. "All these years, we only knew that our ancestors had demon bloodlines, but they were all still humans, so no one knew that Jingxian was half demon."
"That's weird." Zhang Xialong then thought for a while before asking Pang Liyuan again. "Do the people of the Xie clan have demon traits in them?"

Once again, Pang Liyuan shook his head at Zhang Xiaolong. "My grandparents-in-law or parents-in-law do have shadow abilities that they got from those demons, but they don't have demon characteristics at all, so I was shocked when you said that Jingxian was a half demon, Master."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong nodded in understanding. "Did you know that your wife doesn't like your parents?"

Pang Liyuan nodded and immediately told Zhang Xiaolong about the reason behind Xie Jingxian's hatred towards Pang De and Mo Xuanqing, which was the result of their treatment of him, especially since they always put him aside and preferred his late brother. Even after his brother died at the hands of righteous cultivators, they still never treated him well, so his wife hated them so much.

Without any further questions, Zhang Xiaolong touched Xie Jingxian's chest, immediately implanting his demon slave mark into her soul and altering some of her memories to make her completely loyal to him, just like her husband and the others.
After he finished, Zhang Xiaolong immediately woke Xie Jingxian up, particularly since he had so many questions about her Xie clan.
Within a few minutes, Xie Jingxian had already opened her eyes, and she immediately sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong. "What can I do for you, master?"
"I want you to explain to me how you became a half-demon."

Xie Jingxian nodded before providing an explanation to Zhang Xiaolong. "Master, my ancestor was one of the demons that once invaded this realm, and he was attracted to a woman from this region named Xie Yuanxin. That's why he took her as his woman and impregnated her, so their children were born as half-human and half-demon.

However, my ancestor died when the righteous cultivators retaliated against them, but he had already hidden his wife in a very safe place, and he also passed on many things related to his shadow demon race, including his shadow demon bloodline. Since then, all the descendants of my Xie Clan are half-demons, but she told us to never tell anyone, so no one would know about our other identities."
"Does that mean Xie Yuanxin is still alive now?"

"No." Xie Jingxian replied by shaking her head. "Even though she got many things from her husband, including his shadow demon bloodline, she was still an ordinary human being, and she died because of old age, especially since her cultivation could not progress."

Although he was still worried about the Xie Clan, Zhang Xiaolong felt a little relieved after hearing that, especially since he originally thought that Xie Yuanxin would be powerful if she was still alive. "Doesn't that mean your clan should be stronger than the Pang Clan and the others?"

"Yes." Xie Jingxian nodded to Zhang Xiaolong. "In fact, my current ancestors are stronger than the ancestors of all those clans, but they have never shown their true strength, and they are waiting for the right time to reveal it."

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong looked briefly at Pang Liyuan, who looked shocked by Xie Jingxian's words. "If my guess is correct, your ancestors wanted to get rid of the others after they succeeded in taking over this realm, right?"

Xie Jingxian acknowledged Zhang Xiaolong's guess with a nod. "My ancestors had planned this for a long time, especially if they failed to bring the demons from that realm back here. They intended to use them as sacrifices, especially since Chang Wuhen and the others would definitely fight them back if that happened."
"Then what about your husband?" Zhang Xiaolong asked again as he pointed at Pang Liyuan.

Xie Jingxian immediately turned to Pang Liyuan before answering Zhang Xiaolong. "I never liked them, especially my parents-in-law, so I don't care if they die. However, I love my husband very much, so I have asked my parents and ancestors not to let him die, and they have agreed to my request."

"You're lucky to have a wife who loves you so much, huh?" Pang Liyuan laughed awkwardly at Zhang Xiaolong's words. "Jingxian, have your ancestors ever told you about the location of the fourth blood demon tree in the central region?"

"The tree should be on the northern edge of the central region, or more precisely, in the fallen moon cave, Master. However, my father-in-law used a camouflage artifact to disguise its location, so you might have a hard time finding it."

"The area north of the central region, huh?" Zhang Xiaolong muttered as he nodded in understanding, especially since that area was the closest to the northern region. "All right, you can return to the Xie clan, and I want you to keep me informed of your clan's plans.
As for Liyuan, I want you to go back to the Pang Clan to monitor those ancestors, and you must inform me immediately if they have come out of their seclusion."
"Yes, Master."

After the two departed, Mei immediately questioned Zhang Xiaolong. [Master, are you not going to keep Xie Jingxian by your side? Her cultivation is already at 5-Star Heaven Realm, and she is also half demon, so you can get a lot of Yin Qi and female essence from her.]

"Naturally, I want to keep Xie Jingxian by my side, Mei." Zhang Xiaolong answered Mei with a soft sigh. "However, the situation before us is still very serious, and the people from the Xie Clan will panic if she goes missing, so I don't want to make our situation worse. That's why I will use her to monitor her clan for the time being, and I will keep her by my side after everything is over."
[Well, that's true.]

After that, Zhang Xiaolong opened his map and checked the northern area of the central region for the fallen moon cave, but he couldn't find anything there, which confirmed Xie Jingxian's previous words.

However, Zhang Xiaolong suddenly frowned when he saw Pang De's name on his map, especially since he was flying towards the fallen moon cave and his flying speed was so fast, indicating that he was in a hurry. "Shit! They seem to have made other plans, and that bastard probably wants to move the tree somewhere else, so I have to get there first."
Wasting no time, Zhang Xiaolong immediately opened a portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect before jumping into it, and he immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps to go to the fallen moon cave.

In just a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong had arrived at the place, but he was amazed by the beauty of the place, especially since the cave was filled with beautiful crystals, and Mei told him that they were moon crystals, which could be used to forge equipment.

Although he was interested in getting those moon crystals, Zhang Xiaolong immediately ignored them and rushed into the fallen moon cafe. However, the place was already filled with demon miasma, but the map still can't detect the fourth blood demon tree.

"Hmm?" This cave seems really deep, and the tree must be at the end." Zhang Xiaolong muttered to himself as he continued to follow the path in the cave, and he also continued to absorb the demon miasma into his body.

Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong arrived at the end of the cave, but he didn't immediately walk forward and check whether Pang De had set a trap or not. He then took a moon crystal and threw it forward, but it didn't hit anything. "Oh? That idiot didn't even set up a formation because he was too confident that his camouflage artifact would hide this tree."

Zhang Xiaolong immediately summoned the demon extermination sword and used his light qi before approaching the fourth blood demon tree, and he immediately said so as soon as he arrived in front of it. "Hey, demon! I know you're hiding in this tree, and I've killed your other three friends, so you can come out now."

Soon, black smoke emerged from within the tree, transforming into a demon that resembled a buffalo. However, Zhang Xiaolong immediately thrust his sword, coated in light qi, towards the demon, causing it to roar in pain. Stop it! This light power is killing me!"

"Are you deaf?" Zhang Xiaolong inquired as he stabbed his sword deeper into the demon's body, then extended his left hand towards it. "I told you before that I killed your three friends, so I came here to kill you too."
"No... No... Please don't kill me!"

"I've met quite a few demons, but this is the first time I've met such a coward demon, and your three friends are much better than you." After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately used the demon absorbing ability, sucked the demon's soul into his body, and uprooted the fourth blood demon tree without delay. "Haha!
I'm sure that idiot will be furious upon discovering that this tree has disappeared. Open the gate to the Diyu Realm, Mei."

Before he went to that realm, Zhang Xiaolong first sent a message to Yang Yudie and told her that he had successfully obtained the fourth blood demon tree. In addition, he also informed Liu Qingyu about the matter, and he asked her to evacuate the Chu Clan members and his family, as he thought that Pang De might look for him in the western region.
[Alrighty.]

Like the previous three blood demon trees, Zhang Xiaolong also asked Milia to take him to the Dryad garden, and he planted it there while he absorbed the demon miasma that had filled the garden again.

After that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately disappeared from the Dryad garden, causing Milia to sigh heavily, especially since she wanted to ask him a few things. "Sigh! That human always comes and goes like a ghost, and he never stays here for long."

However, Zhang Xiaolong did not return to the Sky Jade Realm right away; he chose to go to Angela's sub-realm, especially since it was almost time for the day to change in that realm, and he had promised to meet her.

Arriving in front of the portal, Zhang Xiaolong first transformed into his demon fox form, and he immediately entered Angela's sub-realm. He was no longer surprised to see her sub-realm, which was entirely ocean, especially since she had told him about it before, and there was only one small island with a shell palace on it, which was where she lived.
"Actually, this sub-realm is more beautiful than the northern sea, but she is indeed such a kind demon, and she often visits that place just for the sake of those aquatic demon beasts."

Suddenly, a giant flying demon fish shot out from the sea towards Zhang Xiaolong, but he just shook his head and released his heavenly fox aura, which caused it to instantly cower in fear. "I came here at Angela's invitation, so you better not attack me because I don't want to hurt her subordinates."
However, Angela suddenly appeared in the middle of them and asked the giant flying demon fish to return to its place, and she then spoke to Zhang Xiaolong. "Thank you for not killing him."

"You don't need to thank me, you know?" That made Angela smile sweetly. "Anyway, I don't have anything else to do for the time being, so I decided to visit you. However, I can't stay for too long, and I have to leave again later."
"I don't think that's a problem." Angela then led Zhang Xiaolong to her clam palace. "Let's go there, so we can talk more comfortably, especially since I still have a lot of questions for you."

When they arrived there, Angela served Zhang Xiaolong a drink, but he found it strange that it was black. "It may look bad, but you can try it first. I made it from several kinds of plants in this realm, and I'm sure you'll like it, especially since it's so refreshing."
Zhang Xiaolong immediately tasted the drink, which was indeed very refreshing, so he drank it in one go without thinking twice. "You are right—this drink tastes refreshing despite its unusual color."
"Haha." Angela laughed softly upon hearing that, and she started asking Zhang Xiaolong many questions, almost all of which he answered.
Even so, there were some questions from Angela that Zhang Xiolong was reluctant to answer, making her look a little disappointed, but she did not force him to answer.
While Zhang Xiaolong was enjoying his time with Angela, time passed quite quickly in the Sky Jade Realm, and Pang De finally arrived at the fallen moon cave.

However, his expression turned panicky once he didn't see the demon miasma in that place, so he immediately rushed to the cave's inner area, and he immediately became furious after not finding the fourth blood demon tree.
*Boom*

Instantly, Pang De's aura exploded, and all the muscles on his body bulged out as his anger took over him. "Fuck! I bet it was that bastard who stole the tree from me! I must find him in the western region to take it back, or Ancestor Wachun will punish me severely!"

paragraphs: "Whatever." Pang Liyuan immediately walked away, leaving his mother, especially since Mo Xuanqing had never treated him fairly, even though his brother had been dead for so long. 'Heh! You might still be able to act like that now, but you'll regret it when my master destroys this clan, and I'll laugh at you becoming his slave, like me and Jingxian.'
Mo Xuanqing frowned at her son's behavior and wanted to stop Pang Liyuan from leaving, but she suddenly received a voice transmission, so she ignored him and rushed to meet the person.
Before long, Mo Xuanqing had arrived in front of a room and knocked on the door, and a man's hoarse voice greeted her from inside. "Come in; I have something for you."

Mo Xuanqing wasted no time and entered the room straight away, but she was shocked when she saw the old man sitting on the side of the bed, especially since he was completely naked. Even so, she didn't say anything and sat on the floor in front of him, but she lowered her red face because his dick was so close. "Since when did you come out of your seclusion, Ancestor Wachun? Why didn't I know?
that you have finished your seclusion?"

"Two days ago." Pang Wachun immediately waved his hand, and Mo Xuanqing's dress instantly shattered into pieces, so she immediately covered her two private parts with her hands. "I saw you were seriously cultivating in your room, so I didn't disturb you. Furthermore, I only left for a short period of time and returned to discuss matters with them, which is why I called you here today.
You can stand up now, and I will give you something different from what I gave your husband before."

"Eh?" Mo Xuanqing was surprised by Pang Wacun's request, but she didn't dare to disobey his order. Instead, she stood straight, and he glanced at her body from top to bottom. "What are you going to give me, Ancestor?"

"Here, you can drink it." Pang Wachun immediately handed over a cup containing black liquid. "Pang De is indeed our direct descendant, but he is too useless, and he has committed too many mistakes that have harmed this clan. Even Pang Hong and Pang Gui fell into the hands of our enemies, and Pang Zhen also met his demise at their hands, leading us to decide against giving this to him.
However, you are smarter than him, and you have always helped us in many ways, so we agreed to give it to you."
Mo Xuanqing immediately accepted the cup, but she was hesitant to drink the liquid, especially since Pang Wachun didn't explain it, and the smell was quite strong, like blood.
"Do you think that we will harm you?" Pang Wacun asked with narrowed eyes after seeing Mo Xuanqing's hesitation.

"No! I don't dare think like that, Ancestor." Mo Xuanqing replied frantically, and she immediately downed the black liquid in one gulp, causing a faint evil smile to appear on Pang Wachun's face. However, she didn't feel any reaction in her body, so she questioned him. "What exactly is the effect of this liquid, Ancestor? Why don't I feel any changes in my body?"

"That's still the first stage, so you haven't felt any changes yet." Pang Wachun then pointed his index finger upwards, and a black blood clot appeared on it. "Be prepared to undergo the second stage, and it will be very painful. After that, you'll experience significant changes in yourself, which will help your cultivation reach a sovereign level."

Mu Xuanqing's expression changed with joy after hearing that, especially since she had tried for quite a long time but never succeeded in passing the last hurdle to break through to that stage. She then exhaled and inhaled repeatedly before nodding to Pang Wacun. "I am ready, Ancestor."
*Swoosh*

The black blood clot shot straight towards Mu Xuanqing as soon as Pang Wacun flicked his finger, and it entered her body through her chest. In that instant, she fell to the ground and rolled, and her mouth kept releasing screams of pain. "Argh!"

"Hang in there! No pain, no gain, so you have to face it to become a better and stronger demon cultivator." Mu Xuanqing bit her lower lip after Pang Wacun said that, and she tried hard to endure the pain that was eating away at her body from the inside.

Unlike the process that Pang De and the others went through before, a black symbol quickly appeared on Mu Xuanqing's chest, which was shaped like a demon's head, and many black lines emerged from the symbol before spreading throughout her body.
Shortly after his body was covered by those black lines, a cocoon of darkness began to appear and envelop him, and Pang Wachun nodded in satisfaction as he witnessed that.

Suddenly, a black smoke came out of Pang Wachun's body, and it immediately moved to the side of the dark cocoon before turning into a black demon woman. "Hahaha! You're right, little guy. This woman's body is indeed suitable to be a container for my soul, so I will enter her body now."

After saying that, the demon woman figure transformed into black smoke once more and entered the dark cocoon. She immediately entered Mo Xuanqing's body, causing Pang Wacun to smile with joy. 'Ha ha ha! This will be beneficial for me, and she can help me improve my cultivation before we start carrying out our plan.'
