In addition to his identity as a heavenly fox, he is also a demon and a human, so the writing on the monument has been fulfilled, and he will be the next ten-tailed fox."

Their expressions became serious after they heard that, but they still didn't seem to believe Oliver's confession, so he touched their foreheads one by one and shared with them the image of Zhang Fei in his three forms, which he had gotten from Zefyr back then. "You guys can see him for yourselves, and he really is the man the ten-tailed fox wrote about on the monument."
They didn't answer Oliver right away, and they first saw all the images of Zhang Fei in their minds, which excited them, especially after they saw his three forms, and they finally believed him.
"Oliver, where is he now? What's his name?" A waist-length red-haired young woman with a tall and plump body inquired, her expression impatient to meet Zhang Fei.

"Ha ha." Oliver laughed at their impatience. "Sabina, you don't have to be so impatient, do you? In fact, I haven't met Zhang Fei myself, and I only know about him from my grandaughter's memories. Anyway, he is currently outside the forest, waiting for the arrival of an evil enemy.

However, that person is very strong, and Zefyr is not confident that they can defeat him, so she contacted me to ask for our help. That's why I've gathered all of you, and we will head out to help them."
Hearing that, Sabina immediately led them to fly towards the exit of their realm. "Let's go! The ten-tailed fox saved us in the past, and that kid is his successor, so we must help him."

sentences.text: Xing Mei decided to leave the Chu Clan and go to the Heavenly Sword Sect.
After all, she was not a foolish woman, and she was fully aware that she would never be able to win against Zhang Xiaolong, especially with Boitata and all the clans on his side.
[Master, I thought you would do something to that woman, especially since she seemed to want to kill you.]
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows at that.
"Do you really think I'd do that to her, Mei?
That woman is quite attractive, but I don't have that kind of interest in her."
[Haha!
You've already taken a few slaves, and now you're holding a few prisoners.
Moreover, you also did it with your mother, so I thought you would take her as your servant or something else.]
"Didn't you already know the reason I did it with my mother?

Back then, I was frustrated with her because she didn't trust me and preferred to follow Zhang Hai's decision, and my anger got the better of me when I met her again after two years, so I used my demon charm on her." Mei did not refute Zhang Xiaolong.
"However, I've more or less changed now, so I can understand Xing Mei's anger towards me, especially since Gu Zhan died at Boitata's hands.
Moreover, I would think the same as her if someone killed my son, and I would take revenge no matter what the cost."
[What are your plans for your grandmother, master?
Aren't you going to give your yang qi to her?]
"Cough...
Cough..." Mei's question caused Zhang Xiaolong to choke.
"Somehow, I feel that you are crazier than me!
I never planned such a thing for my grandmother, and she herself would feel weird swallowing my yang qi, so I never thought of giving it to her."
[Well, that's true.
However, your grandmother's cultivation is the slowest among them, so she will sooner or later fall far further behind them.
Moreover, if she swallows your yang qi, it doesn't necessarily mean she will become a member of your harem.
You can simply give it to her in a bottle, so there shouldn't be any issues.
Even though you have restored her youth, it will be difficult to increase her lifespan, and if that happens, she will die of old age, which is something you certainly don't want to happen.]
After hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong's expression turned serious, particularly because his grandmother was the most important person in his life.
She is the one who has always loved and believed in him, so he certainly didn't want Zhang Chen to die because she was out of her life span.
"Sigh!
You're right, I don't want that to happen, but I'll discuss the matter with her first, and I won't force her if she doesn't want to."
[Additionally, you can also give your yang qi to Xu Ling'er, which will greatly benefit her and accelerate her cultivation.
Even though she's still a child now, she's already expressed that she likes you very much, and she can't wait to grow up so she can marry you.
That's why it doesn't matter if you give it to her, as long as you don't engage in intimate or dual-cultivation with her, and she will surely accept it with pleasure.]

In fact, Zhang Xiaolong still felt strange about Xu Ling'er's feelings for him, especially since she was still a child, so he always thought that her feelings might change as she grew up and met many other men in the future.
"We'll discuss this later; we should deal with Pang De first."

Zhang Xiaolong then walked out of the Chu Clan's main hall before jumping to the highest place in the clan residence, and he observed the surrounding area to find the right location to confront Pang De.
After searching for some time, he found the most suitable place for it, and the location was right in front of the western forest, which was the gateway to the natural races' sub-realm.
After thinking about it, Zhang Xiaolong decided to summon Zefyr out of the training space, especially since she was a member of the natural races, so he wanted to discuss his plans with her first.
"Why did you call me out?
Do you need my help?" Zefyr immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong as soon as he flew out of the training space.
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong later told Zefyr about his plans for Pang De.
"Is it okay if I lure him there?
"I'm sure he has the demon miasma inside his body, like Pang Zhen, so I have to lure him somewhere else so that he doesn't cause people in this city to suffer."
"I think it's okay, especially since the demon miasma won't affect our sub-realm." Zefyr then looked towards the western forest.

"However, the trees in that area will likely die from the effects, so you should get rid of that person as soon as possible to reduce the impact, especially since they are the protection for the gate to our sub-realm.
If they die, humans will be able to find our sub-realm, and they will probably use various means to breach it."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong then asked Zefyr again.
"Hey, are there any dryads in the fairy forest?"
"Do you intend to move Lillea and her race to our sub-realm?" Zhang Xiaolong responded to Zefyr with a nod.
"Actually, Dryads are one of the natural races, and many of them live in the Fairy Forest.
Although they are demons, and many of them possess the darkness element, I believe they will not mind accepting them.
However, you should discuss this matter with them first, especially since it is not easy to leave our ancestral land, and they may miss their home in that realm."
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Xiaolong agreed with Zefyr, especially since he himself still continued to miss life on earth, even though he was comfortable with life in the Sky Jade Realm.
After that, he took Lillea out of the training space, and he immediately told the Dryad Queen about his desire to move her kin to the Fairy Forest, which surprised her.
"What do you think about that?
Zefyr said there are many other dryads in her sub-realm, so I don't think they would feel out of place if they moved there.
Moreover, the situation in the Diyu Realm is still unstable, and war is still looming over the realm, so I think moving to her sub-realm is the best choice for them."
Instead, Lillea turned to Zefyr.
"Is that true?
Are there really that many dryads in your sub-realm?"
"Yes." Zefyr answered Lillea with a nod.
"Apart from our races, there are still several other nature races, such as dwarfs, druids, gnomes, centaurs, and others.
Life in my sub-realm is safe and peaceful, and the Dryad leader is kind, so I'm sure she'll accept you all."
Lillea found it difficult to leave the Diyu Realm, as it was their ancestral land.
However, she was queen of the Dryads, so she had to think about the members of her race who were always oppressed by the rulers.

Moreover, their numbers had decreased a lot because of those wars, and they were constantly hunting them in the past, so she thought of moving out of that realm and going to a new place to find a better life.
Zhang Xiaolong then spoke to Lillea.
"Leaving the ancestral land is indeed not easy, and I can understand your feelings.
However, you and your race members have endured too much oppression, and you all deserve a better life.
The fairy forest is the ideal location for this, particularly because only natural races reside there.
Moreover, I can bring you back to the Diyu Realm whenever you want, so you just need to tell me if you miss that place, and I will take you there right away to relieve your longing."
After thinking about it for quite a while, Lillea immediately agreed with Zhang Xiaolong's idea.
"All right, I'll bring them into this realm, but I've got to talk to them first.
Moreover, if they move to this realm, they can also become cultivators, right?
That way, they can grow stronger, and we can take revenge on the rulers who have oppressed us for so many years."
"Haha." Instead, Zhang Xiaolong laughed at Lillea's last sentence.
"Honestly, you don't have to think about them, especially since Oz has already made his move and the Amaris Twins are already half under my control.
Moreover, several other demon rulers have agreed to join him now, so those traitors will soon be wiped out.

Even so, the situation in the Diyu Realm will not be completely safe even if they are gone, especially since people from the Tian and Xian realms continue to lurk there, and they might attack there in the near future.
That's why I want you to move them here as soon as possible, so they won't be affected if a war breaks out there.
Anyway, maybe not all of them can become cultivators, especially since we need cultivation veins to cultivate, so I have to make sure of that first."
"It's okay." Lillea answered with an understanding nod.
"Even if they can't become cultivators like us, dryads have a very long life span, especially if we live in a favorable environment.
Most of them have lived a long time and are mature, so I'm sure they'll understand."
Zefyr informed Lillea immediately.
"In fact, not all members of the nature races living in the fairy forest are cultivators, and there are many of them who can't cultivate.
However, we never differentiate between each other, and we always work together for everyone's sake, so your people won't feel disappointed even if they can't cultivate."
"That's even better." Lillea then said to Zhang Xiaolong.
"If that's the case, you can send me back to the Dryad Forest so I can talk to them directly.
However, they will probably need some time to accept my decision, so you can pick us up in two to three days."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong sent Lillea back to the Dryad Forest, but he did not send the wind fairy into the training space.
Instead, he took Zefyr to the western forest, and he prepared some things outside the forest.
"This way, I am more and more confident that we can get rid of Pang De, and he can enjoy his new life in the other realm, as long as they don't kill him directly."
"Haha!
You're really evil; do you know that?" Zefyr then waved her hand, surprising Zhang Xiaolong, especially since many trees had suddenly moved and formed a formation.
"If you look closely, all of the trees in this forest are too old, even older than Boitata, and all of them are really alive."
Zhang Xiaolong immediately asked Mei to scan the trees, and the results were as Zefyr said just now.
"Anyway, you can wait for me here, and I will return to the Chu Clan to wait for that guy."
"All right." After Zhang Xiaolong disappeared, Zefyr took out an object before whispering something to it, and it immediately shot towards the fairy forest.
"This way, they can help him fight that evil guy, and his plan's success will increase significantly."
"Hmm?" Oliver, who was sitting relaxed in front of his house, raised his eyebrows for a moment.
He then reached forward to grab the object that Zefyr had previously used, and he immediately heard a message from his granddaughter.
Oliver immediately called several people to meet him, and several leaders of the natural races quickly filled his house, one of whom was the leader of the Dryads.
"Why did you suddenly call us?" A man with a half-human and half-horse body asked Oliver, and he was the leader of the centaurs.

"Persix, I haven't told you guys about something, and I'm waiting for the right time, especially since it's related to the future of our natural races." The centaur and the others raised their eyebrows after hearing Oliver's answer.
"The heavenly fox has returned to this realm."
"What?" After hearing that, Persix and the others yelled in shock.
The leader of the dwarves, a dark red-haired, tiny old man with a muscular body, then questioned Oliver.
"Are you sure that the heavenly fox has returned?
How did you know about it?"
Oliver let out a soft sigh before answering him.
"Gravir, my grand-daughter Zefyr, accidentally met the heavenly fox in the southern region, and she is with him now.
In addition to his identity as a heavenly fox, he is also a demon and a human, so the writing on the monument has been fulfilled, and he will be the next ten-tailed fox."

Their expressions became serious after they heard that, but they still didn't seem to believe Oliver's confession, so he touched their foreheads one by one and shared with them the image of Zhang Fei in his three forms, which he had gotten from Zefyr back then.
"You guys can see him for yourselves, and he really is the man the ten-tailed fox wrote about on the monument."
They didn't answer Oliver right away, and they first saw all the images of Zhang Fei in their minds, which excited them, especially after they saw his three forms, and they finally believed him.
"Oliver, where is he now?
What's his name?" A waist-length red-haired young woman with a tall and plump body inquired, her expression impatient to meet Zhang Fei.
"Ha ha." Oliver laughed at their impatience.
"Sabina, you don't have to be so impatient, do you?
In fact, I haven't met Zhang Fei myself, and I only know about him from my grandaughter's memories.
Anyway, he is currently outside the forest, waiting for the arrival of an evil enemy.
However, that person is very strong, and Zefyr is not confident that they can defeat him, so she contacted me to ask for our help.
That's why I've gathered all of you, and we will head out to help them."
Hearing that, Sabina immediately led them to fly towards the exit of their realm.
"Let's go!
The ten-tailed fox saved us in the past, and that kid is his successor, so we must help him."

chapters.title: Chapter 365 Pang Liyuan's Death
paragraphs: "Tch! What a pathetic old guy! I have only absorbed half of his life essence, yet he appears to be on the verge of death, and if I continue to absorb a little more, he may indeed die." Mo Xuanqing grumbled in disappointment as her eyes kept looking at Pang Wacun, who looked half-dead, but she suddenly remembered something, causing an evil smile to appear on her face.
"This woman has a son, and he is still young, so his life essence must be stronger than this old man's. Hehe! It would be better if I went to see him now and absorbed his life essence cleanly."

Without getting dressed, Mo Xuanqing immediately left Pang Wacun's room and made her way to Pang Liyuan's room, causing the members of the Pang Clan, especially the men, to look at her strangely. Even so, none of them dared to think such a thing about her, especially since Pang De would immediately kill them if they dared to touch his wife.
A while later, Mo Xuanqing had arrived at his son's room, and Pang Liyuan looked at her in shock. "Are you crazy? What are you doing in my room and naked like that?"
"Haha." Mo Xuanqing just laughed in response to Pang Liyuan's questions, and she immediately moved in front of him before strangling his neck.

"Ugh!" Pang Liyuan had difficulty breathing because Mo Xuanqing was strangling his neck so tightly, and he reached for his mother's hand, but she strangled his neck even harder. "Fuck! Bitch! Let me go now!"

"Unfortunately, I am not your mother, and her soul sleeps within her soul space. However, she will never wake up again, and I will take over her body forever." Mo Xuanqing's words made Pang Liyuan instantly realize something, and she smiled at his shocked expression. "I am Heltia, the demon that was planted in the blood demon tree.
Anyway, you guys are just my lord's tools, and I will use all of you to restore my power, so I will be ready to welcome his return to this realm."

After she said that, Mo Xuanqing immediately kissed Pang Liyuan's lips, but he struggled to free himself, sensing that his mother was absorbing his life essence. Unfortunately, his mother's cultivation was much higher than his, making his struggle futile. 'Fuck! I'm going to die if he keeps absorbing it! I have to tell my master about this demon; otherwise, it will be too late for him.'

Without thinking twice, Pang Liyuan immediately sent a voice transmission to Zhang Xiaolong and told him about Heltia, who was controlling Mo Xuanqing's body. In addition, he also sent a voice transmission to Xie Jingxian to say goodbye, as his mother was absorbing his life essence faster, which was causing him to become weaker.

Fortunately, Heltia was still unfamiliar with cultivators and cultivation, so she was unaware of Pang Liyuan's actions. Instead, she looked excited as she continued to absorb his life essence, especially since it was much stronger than Pang Wachun's because of his young age.

As time passed, Pang Liyuan's face became paler and older, and the skin on his entire body had also shriveled. In the end, he met his demise after Mo Xuanqing had absorbed his life essence cleanly, and she threw his corpse onto the floor before licking her lips. "His life essence is indeed strong, but it is still not enough for me, and my strength has only recovered about ten percent.
I don't have much time left, especially since they will be out soon, and we will destroy the seal on the portal, so I have to absorb other men's life essence."

Mo Xuanqing then left Pang Liyuan's room and searched for several young men in the Pang Clan. She used her demon abilities to force them to submit, and they immediately obeyed her orders and followed her to another place, where they met their demises.

Mo Xuanqing's actions caused the situation in the Pang Clan to heat up, and many of them could not accept her actions, especially since she had killed their sons. However, she swiftly suppressed them and directly killed them by absorbing their life essences, just as she had done with their sons.

After she did all that, she immediately went to the seclusion cave to meet the other ancestors, and she also absorbed their life essences. Even so, she didn't kill them, especially since she still needed them to destroy the seal on the demon portal, so she only absorbed half of their life essences.

"Grandpa!" Zefyr exclaimed loudly as she flew towards Oliver and hugged him, but then she glanced at Sabina and the others. "Hehehe! I knew you would bring them here, so Zhang Fei's plan to fight that evil guy could go smoothly. However, you guys should not approach that evil guy, especially since he has absorbed the demon miasma into his body, which will have bad consequences for you guys."
"What do you mean by the demon miasma, little Zefyr?" A lovely woman with white, hip-length, and slightly wavy hair asked the wind fairy.
Although Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race, was quite beautiful and sexy, the woman's beauty surpassed her, and the aura that radiated from her body was much more calming.

The woman's elliptical face looked really pretty, and she had wide eyes with two distinct pupils, one blue and the other light green. She has a slender nose, thick lips, pointy ears, and a blunt chin. She donned a white dress with green and blue accents, featuring a low cleavage that showcased her smooth, pale white skin.
Her figure is really tall around 6' 11", her breasts are not that big around C-Cup, but both look perfectly round, her curves resemble an hourglass, and her hips are a little bit wide.

Zefyr immediately turned her attention to the woman, who was none other than the elf race's leader. "Aunt Elmyra, you still remember the demons who invaded this realm in the past, right? It turned out that they left some blood demon trees in the demon, and they kept releasing demon miasma that could kill all living creatures.

Fortunately, Zhang Fei has found four of them, and he has sent them to the other realm. However, there is still one tree in the northern region, specifically in the Pang Clan, and they use the demon miasma to strengthen themselves by absorbing it into their bodies. A few days ago, he fought with one of them, and that guy used the demon miasma to take him and the others down with him.
Unfortunately, he didn't know that he was also a demon, so he absorbed the demon miasma."

"I see." Elmyra nodded in understanding before extending her right arm. She immediately used her qi, causing a pure light ball of qi to appear above her palm, a sight that amazed everyone present. "Even though the demon miasma is strong and deadly, I am confident that I can protect all of us by using my light qi, so you guys don't have to worry too much about it.
However, I don't know for sure about that guy's cultivation and strength, so we must still be careful of him."

"Aunt Elmyra! Your light qi is truly pure and strong as ever." Zefyr spoke with a cry of admiration. "Anyway, Zhang Fei assumed that the guy's cultivation was at the sovereign level, but he didn't know exactly which level. Since most of you have reached the sovereign level, I thought you could help Zhang Fei stop him, so I immediately contacted my grandfather."

Elmyra immediately drew her light qi back before rubbing Zefyr's tiny head. "You've done the right thing, little girl. We must protect Zhang Fei at all costs because he is the successor of the ten-tailed fox, which means he is the hope of all living beings."
"Anyway, can he really move between realms, little girl?" Sabina asked while looking at Zefyr.

"Yes!" Zefyr answered her question with repeated nodes. "Zhang Fei really can move between realms easily, and he has been back and forth to other realms too many times. Oh, anyway, Aunt Sabina, I want to tell you something, and he needs something from you, which is very important to him."
"Oh? Have you told Zhang Fei about us? Does he need anything from me?" Sabina, the Dryad leader, asked her a curious question.

"I only told him some things about our races, but I haven't told him in detail, and I'm waiting for him to go to our sub-realm." Zefyr then told Sabina about Lillea and the others, which not only surprised her but also surprised the other nature race leaders. "They were born in a demon realm in the lower realms, so they are demon dryads.

However, they are not like other demons, and they are very kind. Their queen and princess are Zhang Fei's women, so he wants to move them to our sub-realm, especially since their realm continues to be plagued by power struggles and their numbers continue to decline because of that."
Sabina nodded at Zefyr. "Dryads are dryads, no matter whether they are demons or not, so you can tell Zhang Fei to take Lillea and her kin to our sub-realm."

Zefyr was thrilled to hear that, especially since she had spent quite a lot of time with Lillea and really liked her. "She was returning to her realm to discuss this with her kin, and Zhang Fei will pick them up in two or three days, so he will take them to our realm around that time."
"That's good." Sabina then turned her gaze to the trees surrounding them, uttering words that only Dryads could understand. When she spoke, the trees appeared excited at hearing her words.

Oliver and the others also began to prepare some things as they awaited the arrival of Zhang Fei and Pang De. Another tiny man, Tanbar, the leader of the gnome race, immediately uses his earth element to create some things underground.
On the other hand, Persix, the leader of the centaur race, hid in the forest and took out a giant bow.
After they had prepared everything, Elmyra and the others also hid somewhere else while using artifacts to suppress their presence and aura, and they all waited for Pang De's arrival.

Zhang Xiaolong, who was sitting on the roof of the Chu Clan, frowned as soon as he heard Pang Liuyan's last voice transmission. Since the situation was beyond his expectations, he immediately checked his status and found that his slave was dead. "Damn it!
I didn't expect that the demon's soul in the fifth blood demon tree could possess Mo Xuanqing, and I don't have any other spies in the Pang Clan now, so I can't monitor their ancestors."

[Master, I think that demon is not an ordinary demon, and she may have a fairly high demon rank, so you should be more careful in taking action against the Pang Clan. Your demon bloodline is useless against her, and Mo Xuanqing's cultivation has also reached the sovereign level, so she is stronger than you in all aspects.]

Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei, but he immediately let out a sigh once he received the voice transmission from Xie Jingxian, who also informed him of Pang Liyuan's death. Since he had no information about the demon, he asked her to be careful of Mo Xuanqing just in case she came to the Xie Clan. He also asked her to run away immediately if she came to the clan, which she agreed to.

In addition, Zhang Xiaolong also warned Pang Gui and Pang Hong about the demon possessing Mo Xuanqing, especially since he didn't want to lose his other spies as well, which would make it difficult for him to monitor all the clans.
However, Pang Hong immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong about the movements in the Gu Clan, especially since their ancestors, Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin, had already begun to prepare to move.

Zhang Xiaolong instructed Pang Hong to wait for Pang Gui to arrive, and he asked them to delve deeper into the Gu Clan's plans. After that, he returned his attention to the map and discovered that Pang De had entered the southern region, and he was moving really quickly towards him. "He's finally here."
[Are you going to meet Pang De directly, master?] Mei immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong, who suddenly got up from his seat.

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong answered the AI with a nod before flying away from the Chu Clan, and he also asked Zefyr to get ready because he would immediately lure Pang De to that location. However, the wind fairy had not informed him about Oliver and the others' presence, as she wanted to surprise him.

"I don't know what that guy had planned for me, and I was afraid that he would immediately release the dmeon miasma in his body, so I thought it would be better if I went to see him right away before he arrived in this city."

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong arrived in front of the heretic, causing him to immediately stop flying and glare sharply at him. However, Pang De did not immediately move and monitor the area around them, especially since he was afraid that she had prepared a trap for him.

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at seeing Pang De so worried. "You don't need to look for them, because I came here alone. However, I don't want to fight you here, so you can follow me if you have the guts."

Before Pang De could react, Zhang Xiaolong had already disappeared from his view using the Nine Cloud Steps, and his speed really shocked him, especially since his cultivation was still far below his.
However, Pang De immediately ignored this and foolishly pursued Zhang Xiaolong towards the western forest, unaware that many members of the natural races were waiting for him there.

In a moment, Zhang Xiaolong was already standing in front of the western forest, and Zefyr immediately sat on his shoulder with a relaxed smile on her face. "Hey! You don't have to be so nervous; I'm sure your plan will succeed, and that evil guy will suffer at the hands of those people."

However, she swiftly suppressed them and directly killed them by absorbing their life essences, just as she had done with their sons.
After she did all that, she immediately went to the seclusion cave to meet the other ancestors, and she also absorbed their life essences.
Even so, she didn't kill them, especially since she still needed them to destroy the seal on the demon portal, so she only absorbed half of their life essences.
"Grandpa!" Zefyr exclaimed loudly as she flew towards Oliver and hugged him, but then she glanced at Sabina and the others.
"Hehehe!
I knew you would bring them here, so Zhang Fei's plan to fight that evil guy could go smoothly.
However, you guys should not approach that evil guy, especially since he has absorbed the demon miasma into his body, which will have bad consequences for you guys."
"What do you mean by the demon miasma, little Zefyr?" A lovely woman with white, hip-length, and slightly wavy hair asked the wind fairy.
Although Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race, was quite beautiful and sexy, the woman's beauty surpassed her, and the aura that radiated from her body was much more calming.
The woman's elliptical face looked really pretty, and she had wide eyes with two distinct pupils, one blue and the other light green.
She has a slender nose, thick lips, pointy ears, and a blunt chin.
She donned a white dress with green and blue accents, featuring a low cleavage that showcased her smooth, pale white skin.
Her figure is really tall around 6' 11", her breasts are not that big around C-Cup, but both look perfectly round, her curves resemble an hourglass, and her hips are a little bit wide.
Zefyr immediately turned her attention to the woman, who was none other than the elf race's leader.
"Aunt Elmyra, you still remember the demons who invaded this realm in the past, right?
It turned out that they left some blood demon trees in the demon, and they kept releasing demon miasma that could kill all living creatures.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei has found four of them, and he has sent them to the other realm.
However, there is still one tree in the northern region, specifically in the Pang Clan, and they use the demon miasma to strengthen themselves by absorbing it into their bodies.
A few days ago, he fought with one of them, and that guy used the demon miasma to take him and the others down with him.
Unfortunately, he didn't know that he was also a demon, so he absorbed the demon miasma."
"I see." Elmyra nodded in understanding before extending her right arm.
She immediately used her qi, causing a pure light ball of qi to appear above her palm, a sight that amazed everyone present.
"Even though the demon miasma is strong and deadly, I am confident that I can protect all of us by using my light qi, so you guys don't have to worry too much about it.
However, I don't know for sure about that guy's cultivation and strength, so we must still be careful of him."
"Aunt Elmyra!
Your light qi is truly pure and strong as ever." Zefyr spoke with a cry of admiration.
"Anyway, Zhang Fei assumed that the guy's cultivation was at the sovereign level, but he didn't know exactly which level.
Since most of you have reached the sovereign level, I thought you could help Zhang Fei stop him, so I immediately contacted my grandfather."
Elmyra immediately drew her light qi back before rubbing Zefyr's tiny head.
"You've done the right thing, little girl.
We must protect Zhang Fei at all costs because he is the successor of the ten-tailed fox, which means he is the hope of all living beings."
"Anyway, can he really move between realms, little girl?" Sabina asked while looking at Zefyr.
"Yes!" Zefyr answered her question with repeated nodes.
"Zhang Fei really can move between realms easily, and he has been back and forth to other realms too many times.
Oh, anyway, Aunt Sabina, I want to tell you something, and he needs something from you, which is very important to him."
"Oh?
Have you told Zhang Fei about us?
Does he need anything from me?" Sabina, the Dryad leader, asked her a curious question.

"I only told him some things about our races, but I haven't told him in detail, and I'm waiting for him to go to our sub-realm." Zefyr then told Sabina about Lillea and the others, which not only surprised her but also surprised the other nature race leaders.
"They were born in a demon realm in the lower realms, so they are demon dryads.
However, they are not like other demons, and they are very kind.

Their queen and princess are Zhang Fei's women, so he wants to move them to our sub-realm, especially since their realm continues to be plagued by power struggles and their numbers continue to decline because of that."
Sabina nodded at Zefyr.
"Dryads are dryads, no matter whether they are demons or not, so you can tell Zhang Fei to take Lillea and her kin to our sub-realm."
Zefyr was thrilled to hear that, especially since she had spent quite a lot of time with Lillea and really liked her.
"She was returning to her realm to discuss this with her kin, and Zhang Fei will pick them up in two or three days, so he will take them to our realm around that time."
"That's good." Sabina then turned her gaze to the trees surrounding them, uttering words that only Dryads could understand.
When she spoke, the trees appeared excited at hearing her words.
Oliver and the others also began to prepare some things as they awaited the arrival of Zhang Fei and Pang De.
Another tiny man, Tanbar, the leader of the gnome race, immediately uses his earth element to create some things underground.
On the other hand, Persix, the leader of the centaur race, hid in the forest and took out a giant bow.
After they had prepared everything, Elmyra and the others also hid somewhere else while using artifacts to suppress their presence and aura, and they all waited for Pang De's arrival.
Zhang Xiaolong, who was sitting on the roof of the Chu Clan, frowned as soon as he heard Pang Liuyan's last voice transmission.
Since the situation was beyond his expectations, he immediately checked his status and found that his slave was dead.
"Damn it!
I didn't expect that the demon's soul in the fifth blood demon tree could possess Mo Xuanqing, and I don't have any other spies in the Pang Clan now, so I can't monitor their ancestors."
[Master, I think that demon is not an ordinary demon, and she may have a fairly high demon rank, so you should be more careful in taking action against the Pang Clan.
Your demon bloodline is useless against her, and Mo Xuanqing's cultivation has also reached the sovereign level, so she is stronger than you in all aspects.]
Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei, but he immediately let out a sigh once he received the voice transmission from Xie Jingxian, who also informed him of Pang Liyuan's death.
Since he had no information about the demon, he asked her to be careful of Mo Xuanqing just in case she came to the Xie Clan.
He also asked her to run away immediately if she came to the clan, which she agreed to.

In addition, Zhang Xiaolong also warned Pang Gui and Pang Hong about the demon possessing Mo Xuanqing, especially since he didn't want to lose his other spies as well, which would make it difficult for him to monitor all the clans.
However, Pang Hong immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong about the movements in the Gu Clan, especially since their ancestors, Gu Changsheng and Gu Jinglin, had already begun to prepare to move.
Zhang Xiaolong instructed Pang Hong to wait for Pang Gui to arrive, and he asked them to delve deeper into the Gu Clan's plans.
After that, he returned his attention to the map and discovered that Pang De had entered the southern region, and he was moving really quickly towards him.
"He's finally here."
[Are you going to meet Pang De directly, master?] Mei immediately asked Zhang Xiaolong, who suddenly got up from his seat.
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong answered the AI with a nod before flying away from the Chu Clan, and he also asked Zefyr to get ready because he would immediately lure Pang De to that location.
However, the wind fairy had not informed him about Oliver and the others' presence, as she wanted to surprise him.

"I don't know what that guy had planned for me, and I was afraid that he would immediately release the dmeon miasma in his body, so I thought it would be better if I went to see him right away before he arrived in this city."
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong arrived in front of the heretic, causing him to immediately stop flying and glare sharply at him.
However, Pang De did not immediately move and monitor the area around them, especially since he was afraid that she had prepared a trap for him.
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at seeing Pang De so worried.
"You don't need to look for them, because I came here alone.
However, I don't want to fight you here, so you can follow me if you have the guts."

Before Pang De could react, Zhang Xiaolong had already disappeared from his view using the Nine Cloud Steps, and his speed really shocked him, especially since his cultivation was still far below his.
However, Pang De immediately ignored this and foolishly pursued Zhang Xiaolong towards the western forest, unaware that many members of the natural races were waiting for him there.
In a moment, Zhang Xiaolong was already standing in front of the western forest, and Zefyr immediately sat on his shoulder with a relaxed smile on her face.
"Hey!
You don't have to be so nervous; I'm sure your plan will succeed, and that evil guy will suffer at the hands of those people."

chapters.title: Chapter 366 Fighting Pang De
paragraphs: "How can you be so sure about that?" Zefyr responded by sticking out her tongue at Zhang Xiaolong, causing him to shake his head, but then he looked ahead. "He's here."
*Swoosh*

In a matter of seconds, Pang De landed in front of them and began monitoring the forest area, particularly after noticing Zefyr's peculiar smile on Zhang Xiaolong's shoulder. Unfortunately, the artifacts used by the natural race leaders had extraordinary effects; not even Mei or the system map could detect their presence in the area.

"For such a young brat, I have to admit that you have a lot of guts, and you can even form relationships with those clans to ruin our plans. Moreover, you also have a powerful protector by your side, and that woman can even injure me by destroying my familiar. Unfortunately, you underestimate me too much, and I am no longer the same as before, so she won't be able to save you from me.
However, I will not kill you and torture you slowly, allowing you to watch as we destroy those clans, and I will allow my clan members to enjoy the bodies of your wives before your eyes."

"For such an old man, you talk too much, you know? Even my grandmother is much better than you, especially since she doesn't talk as much as you do." Zhang Xialong then narrowed his eyes, which had turned blood-red, as he was furious because Pang De intended to do such things to his wives, and both of them shocked him.

"In fact, you were the one who underestimated me, and I don't need Boitata's help to fight you. You may have absorbed the demon miasma into your body, like Pang Zhen, but I can tell you that it will be useless against me."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately activated his other two bloodlines, and his appearance changed to that of his cultivation soul. He has two black horns on his head, two fairly large black wings on his back, and four incubus tails behind his hips. In addition, his arms and feet changed into fox claws, and white fur adorned his body, giving him a demihuman appearance.
'What the hell with this brat? What kind of creature is he? Although his body clearly resembles that of a human, he also possesses the characteristics of a demon and a fox.

Unlike Pang De, who was shocked after seeing Zhang Xiaolong's current form, Oliver and the leaders of the natural races, who were hiding around them, became excited after his three forms merged into one.

Soon, Zhang Xiaolong's body was surrounded by four auras at once: white representing light, black representing darkness, red representing fire, and green representing wind. His actions further shocked Pang De, and he immediately summoned the demon extermination sword before bringing Zefyr into an invisible state.

'Shit!' Pang De panicked upon seeing that, and he immediately transformed into his demon form before releasing the demon miasma from his body, shocking Zhang Xiaolong and the leaders of the natural races.
Unlike Pang Zhen, Pang De did not spread the demon miasma, and he instead gathered it around his body, acting as a shield to protect himself from Zhang Xiaolong.

Pang De then used his senses to search for Zhang Xiaolong's whereabouts, but he could not sense his presence and aura as long as he was in an invisible state. 'Damn it! Who is this brat? How could he deceive my senses with his low cultivation? No wonder he was able to capture Pang Hong and Pang Gui, and he also managed to kill Pang Zhen.'

"Anyway, you may not know it yet, but I wanted to tell you that Pang Liyuan is dead." Pang De frowned after Zhang Xiaolong said that, but he still couldn't track his location. "Do you want to know how he died? Your wife, Mo Xuanqing, killed him by absorbing his life essence. Oh!
One more thing: she was possessed by a female demon named Heltia, who was none other than the demon implanted in the fifth blood demon tree, and she also wants to absorb your wife's soul."

However, Pang Hong seemed unaffected by that, and he snorted at Zhang Xiaolong instead. "Do you think you can disturb my mind by saying all of that? Moreover, my son is in a safe place, and no one knows that he has the darkness element, so you don't need to talk rubbish because I won't fall for a childish trick."

"Hahaha!" Zhang Xiaolong laughed out loud, making Pang De frown. "What a foolish old man! Didn't you send Pang Liyuan to the desolate sect to take over that clan? I visited that sect a while ago, and I met your son there. He was indeed able to hide his identity from the people in the sect, but he couldn't trick me, so I enslaved him to watch over your clan.
Unfortunately, the situation changed with the demon possessing Mo Xuanqing, and he died at the hands of his own mother."

After Zhang Xiaolong's statement, Pang De's expression turned serious, especially when a giant demon claw suddenly appeared above him, and several shadows appeared around him, convincing him that Pang Liyuan had already fallen into his hands before.

"Heh! Do you believe me now?" Zhang Xiaolong asked Pang De with a sneer. "I got the Shadow Abyss scripture and the Netherworld demon scripture from Pang Liyuan, and it's not difficult for me to master all the sub-techniques of those two techniques."
*Boom*

"Bastard!" Pang De furiously shouted as his aura exploded after he confirmed the truth of Zhang Xiaolong's words from his clan members, and they told him that not only Pang Liyuan died at Mo Xuanqing's hands, but several others also died at her hands. "Come out now! Otherwise, I will spread this demon miasma in that city, and the people there will die because of it."
However, Pang De suddenly stiffened as soon as he sensed Zhang Xiaolong's murderous aura from behind him, and he didn't even realize that.
*Thrust*
Zhang Xiaolong had already stabbed the demon extermination sword, coated in his light qi, towards Pang De before he could turn around.

"Guah!" Pang De screamed in pain as Zhang Xiaolong's sword pierced through his body from behind, and his expression was one of disbelief, especially since he couldn't see his sword. Even so, he immediately spun in place to launch a counterattack, but his attack only hit empty air.

"Guah!" Pang De once again let out a groan of pain as Zhang Xiaolong pulled his sword out of his body, and he immediately slashed it across his back, leaving a deep slash wound there. "Guah!" 'Damn it! He can disappear, and his speed is so fast too. Moreover, this demon miasma can't protect me from his attack, especially since he uses the light element to attack me.'
"Have you realized that you underestimated me too much?" Zhang Xiaolong's question inflamed Pang De's anger even more. "No matter what you do, you will never be able to defeat me."

Oliver and the leaders of the natural races, who were watching from a distance, were amazed by Zhang Xiaolong's actions. They felt that their presence was unnecessary, especially since he should have been able to handle Pang De by himself with such abilities.
"Tch!" Pang De gritted his teeth before flying into the sky, but many tree roots immediately came out of the ground and tied his hands and feet.
Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race, was equally as shocked as Pang De, particularly because she hadn't given the order for those trees to move, prompting her to initiate communication with them.

The trees' answers to her shocked Sabina even more, especially since Zhang Xiaolong was the one who moved them using the tree control ability that he mimicked from Janette. 'How could he do that? Only my Dryad race has the ability to communicate and move them, but he can also do both.'
Unfortunately, the tree roots were useless against Pang De, and he immediately destroyed them using his darkness sword, which was created from his darkness element.

Zhang Xiaolong did not stop there; he used the forest manipulation ability that he mimicked from Cassia. A small artificial forest surrounded Pang De in a matter of seconds, and the trees immediately attacked him with their trunks, branches, and roots.

As he repelled their attacks, Pang De further dispersed the demon miasma from his body and continued to slash with his darkness sword, causing the trees to die quickly. However, his expression became annoyed, especially since those trees kept regenerating, and they were truly endless. 'Fuck! This brat has so many weird techniques! He can even create a forest and regenerate these trees non-stop!
Even so, I'm sure that the amount of qi in his body is not much due to his low cultivation, and he will run out of qi if he continues to use these kinds of techniques.'
The moment Pang De thought that, Zhang Xiaolong had already moved behind him again, and he immediately touched his back before using the demon-absorbing ability.
Unfortunately, Zhang Xiaolong couldn't do it for too long, especially since Pang De had also mastered that ability, so he immediately realized his actions and used that technique on him.

Zhang Xiaolong was forced to pull his hand back before moving to another area using his teleportation, and his eyes kept looking at Pang Hong, who was still fighting with those endless trees, as he muttered to himself. 'Tch! I forgot that he also mastered that technique, so I have to find another way to weaken him first. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to force him to enter the gate.'

Zefyr suddenly pulled Zhang Xiaolong's ear and whispered to him. 'Hey! How long are you going to play around with that evil guy? It would be much better if you opened the gate now, and my reinforcements will help you send him inside.'
'Reinforcements?' Zhang Xiaolong turned to Zefyr with a confused look, especially since he had not noticed anyone else in the place before.

'Hehe.' Zefyr chuckled in response. 'We both have a contract, remember? Moreover, you have always treated me like your own family, so I can't possibly let you face that evil guy by yourself, and I've contacted my grandfather for reinforcements. That's why you can open the gate now, so I can ask them to force him to enter that gate, and we can end this pointless game.'
'Hahaha!' Zhang Xiaolong laughed and rubbed Zefyr's tiny head. 'Thank you for your help.'

Since she had been listening to their conversation, Mei immediately opened a gate, which appeared a little away from Zhang Xiaolong's location. However, he, Zefyr, and the leaders of the nature races were shocked by the Qi flow coming out of the gate, especially since it was several times stronger and denser than the Qi flow in the Sky Jade Realm.
'Contact them now, Zefyr!' Zhang Xiaolong exclaimed softly as he saw Pang De notice the gate's presence, and he tried to escape from the artificial forest.

Wasting no time, Zefyr immediately contacted them, and several earth pillars immediately emerged from the ground as Tanbar activated the trap he had previously set, which immediately formed a fairly large dome of earth around them.
Following that, Gravir, the dwarf race's leader, used his metal element to create numerous metal plates that appeared above the earth dome, strengthening it.

Sabina immediately ordered the trees in the western forest to attack Pang De, and they were stronger than the trees created by Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she used her wood element to strengthen them.

Not stopping there, Elmyra, the elf race leader, created a light bow before shooting several light arrows towards Pang De. On the other hand, Oliver summoned several wind pinwheels, and he threw them at the enemy as well.
*Swoosh*
Persix, the leader of the centaur race, swiftly shot a giant iron arrow from the western forest towards Pang De.

'What the fuck? Where did all these attacks come from? Moreover, most of these attacks are attacks from cultivators at the sovereign level!' Pang De immediately took out several artifacts and threw them around him, and they formed a layered barrier to repel the attacks from the leaders of the natural race.
*Crack*

Persix's giant iron arrow instantly shattered those barriers, prompting Pang De to swiftly avoid its impact. Unfortunately, the arrow was really fast, and it still hit his left arm and shattered it, causing him to let out a curse accompanied by pain; even his blood drenched the ground beneath him. "Argh! Fuck!"

Unfortunately, Pang De's suffering didn't stop yet, especially since the attacks from the other leaders of natural races also hit his body at the same time, and he continued to groan in pain as his body became increasingly covered in wounds.

Without thinking twice, Pang De immediately took out healing pills and several other pills to stop the bleeding. However, Zhang Xiaolong immediately moved quickly and snatched them from his hands, and that was followed by several tree roots that wrapped around almost his whole body.
"Throw him at the gate!"

Hearing Zhang Xiaolong's shout, Sabina immediately ordered those trees to throw Pang De towards the gate, and his body quickly glided towards it. Even so, he did not give up easily, unleashing his full strength and using the demon miasma to attack it in hopes of destroying it.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*
Unfortunately, a few iron arrows struck Pang De, piercing his back directly. A large green whirlwind then struck him from behind, sending him flying straight into the gate.

'Close the gate, Mei!' Instantly, the gate disappeared after the AI executed Zhang Xiaolong's command, and he immediately breathed a sigh of relief. 'Fortunately, they all helped me, or I would have had a hard time sending him to that realm.'

Since she had been listening to their conversation, Mei immediately opened a gate, which appeared a little away from Zhang Xiaolong's location.

However, he, Zefyr, and the leaders of the nature races were shocked by the Qi flow coming out of the gate, especially since it was several times stronger and denser than the Qi flow in the Sky Jade Realm.
'Contact them now, Zefyr!' Zhang Xiaolong exclaimed softly as he saw Pang De notice the gate's presence, and he tried to escape from the artificial forest.

Wasting no time, Zefyr immediately contacted them, and several earth pillars immediately emerged from the ground as Tanbar activated the trap he had previously set, which immediately formed a fairly large dome of earth around them.
Following that, Gravir, the dwarf race's leader, used his metal element to create numerous metal plates that appeared above the earth dome, strengthening it.

Sabina immediately ordered the trees in the western forest to attack Pang De, and they were stronger than the trees created by Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she used her wood element to strengthen them.
Not stopping there, Elmyra, the elf race leader, created a light bow before shooting several light arrows towards Pang De.
On the other hand, Oliver summoned several wind pinwheels, and he threw them at the enemy as well.
*Swoosh*
Persix, the leader of the centaur race, swiftly shot a giant iron arrow from the western forest towards Pang De.
'What the fuck?
Where did all these attacks come from?

Moreover, most of these attacks are attacks from cultivators at the sovereign level!' Pang De immediately took out several artifacts and threw them around him, and they formed a layered barrier to repel the attacks from the leaders of the natural race.
*Crack*
Persix's giant iron arrow instantly shattered those barriers, prompting Pang De to swiftly avoid its impact.
Unfortunately, the arrow was really fast, and it still hit his left arm and shattered it, causing him to let out a curse accompanied by pain; even his blood drenched the ground beneath him.
"Argh!
Fuck!"

Unfortunately, Pang De's suffering didn't stop yet, especially since the attacks from the other leaders of natural races also hit his body at the same time, and he continued to groan in pain as his body became increasingly covered in wounds.
Without thinking twice, Pang De immediately took out healing pills and several other pills to stop the bleeding.
However, Zhang Xiaolong immediately moved quickly and snatched them from his hands, and that was followed by several tree roots that wrapped around almost his whole body.
"Throw him at the gate!"
Hearing Zhang Xiaolong's shout, Sabina immediately ordered those trees to throw Pang De towards the gate, and his body quickly glided towards it.
Even so, he did not give up easily, unleashing his full strength and using the demon miasma to attack it in hopes of destroying it.
*Swoosh...
Swoosh...*
Unfortunately, a few iron arrows struck Pang De, piercing his back directly.
A large green whirlwind then struck him from behind, sending him flying straight into the gate.

'Close the gate, Mei!' Instantly, the gate disappeared after the AI executed Zhang Xiaolong's command, and he immediately breathed a sigh of relief. 'Fortunately, they all helped me, or I would have had a hard time sending him to that realm.'

Oliver and the leaders of the natural races immediately moved in front of Zhang Xiaolong as soon as he landed and returned to his human form, and he immediately spoke to them. "Thank you! Thanks to all of your help, I was finally able to get rid of Pang De, and his disappearance will weaken those heretics."

"No need to thank us." They responded in unison, but Sabina then questioned Zhang Xiaolong. "How can you speak and command those trees? Moreover, you can create an artificial forest in a matter of seconds, and they continue to regenerate even if that guy keeps destroying them."
'Scan their statuses, Mei.'

'Most of them are exceptional because they have broken through to the sovereign realm, especially Sabina and Elmyra. Although some of them haven't broken through to that stage, they are still as strong as Shen Xueyi.' Zhang Xiaolong then answered the Dryad's leader. "I have a special ability that allows me to mimic other demon abilities, and I get these abilities from the Dryads in other realms."

Sabina was really surprised by Zhang Xiaolong's answer, but she didn't know whether to believe him or not, especially since she didn't know much about demons, let alone their abilities. "Does that mean you can also copy our abilities?"
"Unfortunately, I can't do that, especially since you all aren't demons." Sabina nodded in understanding at Zhang Xiaolong. "Anyway, I want-"

"No need." Sabina immediately interrupted Zhang Xiaolong. "You don't need to ask me that, because Zefyr has already told me about Lillea and her kin, and I am willing to accept them in my circle, so you can bring them here once they are ready."
Sabina's answer made Zhang Xiaolong feel relieved, especially since he did not want the Dryads in the Diyu Realm to continue suffering, and he gratefully turned to Zefyr.

"How about you come with us to our sub-realm?" Oliver abruptly questioned Zhang Xiaolong, causing the other leaders of the natural races to look at him expectantly. "Honestly, we still have many questions about you, and we can discuss these in a more relaxed manner. In addition, we also want to take you to the ten-tailed fox monument, and you will surely understand the reason later."

"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong naturally would not reject them, especially since he himself was also curious about the ten-tailed fox, especially about its story. "I plan to enter seclusion after this; let's go now."

As he swallowed several healing pills and other pills to recover his injuries from the previous attacks, Pang De looked at the surrounding area with a shocked expression. The place was bright, but there were no buildings in sight, only a stretch of green fields filled with various types of plants. 'Fuck! What is this place? Could that bastard send me to another realm?

Moreover, the qi flow in this place is extraordinarily strong when compared to the Sky Jade Realm. Tch! Although I don't know anything about this place, I can take advantage of its quality and quantity of qi to increase my cultivation, and I will return to that realm after I become truly strong.'

Unfortunately, Pang De's hopes would never come true, and a powerful aura suddenly pressed down on him from above, causing his body to partially sink into the ground. 'Shit! Who owns this aura? This aura is too strong! Even the demon's aura isn't that strong!'

In a matter of seconds, countless white foxes rushed towards Pang De, surrounding him directly. Their appearance was strikingly similar to Zhang Fei's fox form, albeit with varying numbers of tails, ranging from one to eight.

'How could there be so many beast foxes in this place? Moreover, I can't sense the cultivation of most of them, which means their cultivation is much higher than mine.' Pang De muttered in shock as his eyes watched those white foxes, but his expression turned to fear once he saw the two nine-tailed white foxes flying towards him, and the look in their light-blue eyes was so fierce. 'Crap!
Those two must be their leaders! Even though they are a little far away, their aura really suffocates me, and I feel that I will die at any moment.'
Before long, the two white nine-tailed foxes had arrived above them, and their size was truly humongous, which frightened Pang De further, especially when they glared fiercely at him.
One of them then landed in front of Pang De, immediately wrapping one of its tails around his body, lifting him high, and using its other tail to touch his forehead. "Hmm?"
'What kind of information did you find in his memories, Tian Baixing?' The other white nine-tailed fox asked.

Hu Baixing immediately looked up and answered via voice transmission. 'Tian Baitian, this human is a heretic, and he came from the heaven wilderness realm. Anyway, the man who sent this guy here is called Zhang Fei, and he has characteristics like our race, but he only has four tails.
In addition, he possesses both human and demon characteristics, and he has the ability to combine all three into a new form.'

'Oh?' Tian Baitian looked surprised to hear that, but he then nodded in understanding. 'The inscription on the monument has finally come true, huh? If that is really true, Zhang Fei is destined to be our ancestor's successor, so the ten-tailed fox will return to this universe once again.'

'What do you think if we go to the heaven wilderness realm to meet Zhang Fei?' Tian Baixing asked Tian Baitian. 'If he is really destined to be our ancestor's successor, then we must kill him before he reaches our level. Otherwise, he will be a terrifying scourge for us, and he might suppress us in the future, especially since he has his demon side.'

'No need.' Tian Baitian immediately rejected Tian Baixing's idea. 'I also don't want to be pressured by anyone, but the heaven wilderness realm will be destroyed if we go there. Moreover, it won't be easy for Zhang Fei to evolve to ten-tails, and he needs a special item to achieve it, which he can only get in our realm.
Even if he can reach the nine-tails and come to our realm, he will never be able to defeat us, and we can kill him when he comes here.'

After hearing that, Tian Baixing let out a soft sigh, especially since Tian Baitian was much more arrogant than her, and he had always thought that no other beast could surpass them, so he had always looked down on them. 'How about we send some of our young generations to that realm?
That way, we can monitor Zhang Fei, and the heaven wilderness realm will not be destroyed either, especially since their cultivation is still in the ten mortal realms.'

Tian Baitian raised his eyebrows as soon as he heard that, but he then turned to look at the countless heavenly foxes below him. After considering Bai Tian Baixing's idea, he immediately opened a portal before ordering two foxes with four tails behind their hips.

"Tian Gongzhu and Tian Wangzhi, the two of you will arrive at a realm called the heaven wilderness realm after you enter the portal, and that realm is our original realm before we bring you all to this realm. Baixing will give you both a picture of a man named Zhang Fei, and I want you guys to keep a close eye on him. Do you both understand?"
"Yes, Ancestor Baitian!" Tian Gongzhu and Tian Wangzhi answered in unison, and they immediately entered the portal after Tian Baixing gave them Zhang Fei's description.
Tian Baitian then spoke to Tian Baixing. "Since Zhang Fei sent this heretic here, I think he doesn't want him to die, so you can lock him up in that place and let the light purify his darkness."
"All right." Tian Baixing directly placed a seal on Pang De's cultivation before taking him away to another place, and the countless heavenly foxes immediately dispersed.

However, Tian Baitian did not leave the place immediately as he looked towards the portal, but he then closed it before flying away. 'What exactly do you want, ancestor? Back then, you split yourself into me and Baixing, but you also restricted us, so we could never evolve into ten-tails. Instead, you left behind that inscription, and you said that another beast would be your successor.

In all these thousands of years, I never believed that it would come true, but fate said otherwise, and your future heir has appeared. Since you chose Zhang Fei over us, then I will kill him in the future, so your heir will never exist in this universe, and no other living being can suppress us.'

Tian Gongzhu and Tian Wangzhi had already arrived at the Sky Jade Realm, and they appeared right in front of the western forest. However, both of them felt regretful as soon as they arrived there, especially because the quality and quantity of qi in the realm were too awful for them, who were born in the upper realms.

They then changed into their half-fox form, which had long white hair. Tian Wangzhi became a young man in his twenties, and Tian Gongzhu became a young woman in her twenties, too. They have light blue eyes, two fox ears, and four fox tails behind their hips, similar to Zhang Fei.

"So, where should we look for that man named Zhang Fei?" Tian Gongzhu asked as she looked around their surroundings. "If I remember correctly, this forest should be the residence of our ancestor, the ten-tailed fox. How about we go inside to see his statue first?"

"No." Tian Wangzhi immediately rejected Tian Gongzhu's idea. "This realm is too disgusting, and our cultivation will slow down if we stay in it for too long. That's why it would be better if we went to the nearest city to find out information about Zhang Fei, and we would immediately report everything to Ancestor Baitian, so we could return to our realm as soon as possible."
Tian Gongzhu let out a soft sigh before nodding to Tian Wangzhi, and they immediately flew away from the western forest for the heavenly sword city.

After they arrived at the fairy forest, Oliver and the leaders of the natural races immediately took Zhang Xiaolong to the deepest area of their sub-realm, where the statue and monument of the ten-tailed fox were located.
Zhang Xiaolong immediately approached the statue and read the writing, but he could not read it, especially since the ten-tailed fox wrote it in ancient language.
Oliver then told Zhang Xiaolong about the writing on the monument, but he was no longer surprised to hear it, especially since Zefyr had told him before.

[Master, try using your fox form and channeling your light qi and heavenly fox aura into the statue.] Mei suddenly conveyed her idea to Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she detected something in it, and she was sure that it had something to do with the ten-tailed fox.

Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows for a moment before following Mei's words, and the leaders of the natural races immediately knelt on one knee as soon as he transformed into the four-tailed heavenly fox; even their expressions were full of excitement.

Zhang Xiaolong then touched the statue with his front paw, and he channeled your light qi and heavenly fox aura into it directly, which caused the area to be enveloped in strong pressure. Even the area's ground was shaking violently, and the lake's water was also jumping repeatedly.
'So it's true; the ten-tailed fox left his soul imprint in his statue, and only Zhang Fei can summon it.' The leaders of the natural races muttered in their hearts.

Soon, the giant The ten-tailed fox's soul remnant appeared in front of them, and his figure filled almost the entire area. He then looked at Zhang Xiaolong with a serious gaze, causing him to tremble, especially since he looked deep into his soul. "Hahaha! I've been waiting for you for so long, and you've finally arrived before me, young fox.
A human, a demon, and a beast fox, just like in my vision in the past."
"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong immediately changed to his half-fox form before asking. "Did you write this inscription because of a vision you had while you were still alive?"

"Yes." The ten-tailed fox nodded to Zhang Xiaolong. "In fact, after you evolve to ten-tails, you will also gain that ability, but your ability will be superior to mine. However, a vision is different from a phropecy, but I can't explain the difference to you; you'll understand it for yourself once you've evolved into ten-tails."

Zhang Xiaolong didn't think about it, especially since ten-tails were still far beyond his reach. "Anyways, why did you sacrifice yourself by splitting yourself in two? You are one of the strongest living beings in this universe, and you should be able to go to the upper or highest realms with your power, so I find your decision very strange."

chapters.title: Chapter 368 The Ten-Tailed Fox
paragraphs: "Have you ever heard the story behind my birth?" Zhang Xiaolong responded to the ten-tailed fox with a nod, especially since Hu Lili had told him about it. However, Oliver and the others looked confused about it, so Zefyr explained it to them. "I didn't expect that you were already in a relationship with those moon foxes, kid.

Anyway, that woman is right that I was born to fulfill the wishes of all the fox races, and I was born specifically to save them from the oppression of humans as well as those stronger beasts. That's why I don't have my own ambitions, and I also can't care about other things. However, these natural races are different, and their ancestors were very close to me, so I decided to save them too.

Since the fox races were free from oppression and my presence in this realm would endanger these natural races, I decided to divide myself into two, both of whom are the ancestors of the current heavenly foxes."
Zhang Xiaolong released a soft sigh. "Who are the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race? Since you can leave your soul imprint in this place, you must know something about them, right?"

"They are Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and they should still be alive now." The ten-tailed fox's answer made Zhang Xiaolong and the others raise their eyebrows. "Baitian is a male, and Baixing is a female. However, their characters are different from what I expected, especially since both of them inherited too many of my negative traits, and they will kill you if they find out about you.

Therefore, I advise you not to go to the heavenly moon realm before you evolve to the nine-tails, or you will die in their hands because of their jealousy and greed, and this universe will never be able to find peace, especially since you are destined to be the bringer of peace for them."

Zhang Xiaolong shook his head at the ten-tailed fox in response. "I am also very selfish, like you and the two ancestors of the heavenly fox race." That's why I can't care about this universe; I only care about the people in my circle, so I'm not interested in being the bringer of peace."
Zhang Xiaolong's words made Oliver and the leaders of the natural races release heavy sighs within them, but none of them interrupted his conversation with the ten-tailed fox.

The ten-tailed fox smiled at Zhang Xiaolong's words. "You remind me of my old self, because I also don't care about the fate of other living beings; I only care about the fate of the fox races. However, my meeting with the ancestors of these natural races changed several things in me, and I started to open up to them.
You may still think that way now, but you will probably meet someone important, and you will probably change someday in the future."

"Is that one of the visions you had in the past?" The ten-tailed fox did not say anything to agree with or refute Zhang Xiaolong. "Sigh! You are right; I am still like this now, but I myself do not know about my future, so I will leave everything to time and fate, and I might change one day, like you said just now."

"Kid, you must always remember that there is a great responsibility behind your power, and I have always believed in my vision, so I also believe that you will succeed in bringing peace to this universe." The ten-tailed fox suddenly touched Zhan Xiaolong's forehead with one of its tails.

"My time is running out, especially since I implanted this soul imprint in this statue after I exhausted my power. Even so, I can still help you with something, and you will be thrilled with my gift. Oh, anyway, I forgot something; you can only evolve to ten-tails by going to the heavenly moon realm, and you must obtain the hearts of both of my descendants."

Before Zhang Xiaolong could ask, a bright white aura suddenly enveloped the ten-tailed fox's body, dazzling him and the others. However, it only lasted a few seconds, and the white aura immediately disappeared, as did the ten-tailed fox's soul imprint.
[Ding]
[The host gains a small portion of the ten-tailed fox's soul power.]
[Ding]
[The host soul level increases to the early stage of the soul foundation level.]
*Crack... Crack...*
The cracking sound shocked the leaders of the natural races, and they were even more shocked to see the ten-tailed fox's statue crumble to pieces, including the monument below it.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong stood frozen in his spot, and his expression looked shocked as he thought about the last sentence of the ten-tailed fox. 'That means I have to kill both of the heavenly fox race's ancestors in order to evolve into the ten-tails, right, Mei?'
[Yes, Master.] Mei herself was also shocked by the revelation of the ten-tailed fox, and she never imagined that her master would need such conditions in order for him to evolve into the ten tails.

[Anyway, you don't need to think about that right now, especially since they live in the upper realms and are too powerful for the current you, so it would be much better if you focused on everything in front of you, master.]

'Yeah, you're right; I have to take it one step at a time.' Zhang Xiaolong then turned his attention to Oliver and the others, who were still in a daze following the destruction of the ten-tailed fox's statue, causing him to smile bitterly. "It looks like you have to rebuild both of them."

"No need." Oliver replied while standing up, as did Elmyra and the others. "We are now certain that you are the ten-tailed fox's successor, and since part of its soul has merged with yours, we no longer need its statue.

"This way, you are the leader of our natural races." Zhang Xiaolong turned to Elmyra with a raised eyebrow, so she immediately provided an explanation to him. "As the ten-tailed fox told you just now, it saved our races from extinction because humans kept hunting us in the past.
Since then, our ancestors have sworn that the ten-tailed fox's successor will be our leader, and you are its successor, so you are our leaders now."

"I can attest to the truth of Elmyra's words." Sabina said before moving in front of Zhang Xiaolong, and she immediately touched his forehead, sharing quite a lot of her memories, which she inherited from her ancestors. "You can see everything yourself, so you will know that her words are true."

Zhang Xiaolong first looked at Sabina's memories, and he didn't expect that they were memories from such a distant past, where her ancestors, as well as the other ancestors of the natural races, swore allegiance to the ten-tailed fox. "All right, I believe that. However, I have no interest in becoming a leader, so I will not accept it. Instead, all of you will be my family, like Zefyr.
Wouldn't that be better for all of us?"

"Hahaha." Zefyr suddenly laughed, floated towards Zhang Xiaolong, and sat on his shoulder as usual. "Grandpas! Aunts! He's always been like this, and he doesn't like that kind of thing. Usually, his women, like Liu Hua and Shen Xueyi, take care of things for him.
Moreover, I don't think it's a big deal whether he becomes our leader or our family; you guys can still help him, so you guys should just accept his decision."

Oliver and the others exchange glances for a moment before nodding to each other. "You're right, Zefyr. No matter what our relationship is, we will continue to support Zhang Fei, so it's not a problem for us."

Zhang Xiaolong then spoke to them. "Actually, I still want to talk to all of you, but I think we can do it another time, especially since I don't have much time right now due to those heretics constant movements. Moreover, their ancestors will probably come out soon, so I want to focus on increasing my strength, and I'll do seclusion in another region while keeping an eye on them.
As for Zefyr, I will send her to a special place to train, so she won't be back anytime soon."

"Speaking of those heretics, I'm still confused as to why Pand De is chasing you, so I hope you can tell us the truth, and we will help you as best we can." Zhang Xiaolong nodded to Elmyra and explained to them in as much detail as possible, including about the demon who possessed Mo Xuanqing.

Additionally, he informed them about their alliance with the moon fox race, which caused their expressions to become serious. "In that case, you can enter seclusion and focus on your cultivation, so you will be ready to face them, and we will go out to help you secure all four regions."

"Thank you." Zhang Xiaolong replied sincerely, especially because the power of those heretics is much stronger than they imagined, so they need more reinforcements, and the help of the natural races will be of great help to them. "I will take Zefyr away right now, and I will come back here after Lillea has managed to persuade her kin to move to this realm."
After Zhang Xiaolong brought Zefyr out of their sight, Gravir immediately asked the others. "So, who among us will go outside to secure those regions?"
"I will protect this region, especially since there are so many forests in it, so I can rely on them to monitor those heretics." Sabina was the first to volunteer herself.
Persix also volunteers himself. "This region is also my best area, so I will join Sabina to protect it."

"I will go to the eastern region, especially since most of the area is desert." Tanbar then turned to Gravir. "Don't you have a good relationship with the Jinshu Gang? How about you join me and go there now?"
"All right, I will go to that region with you." Gravir immediately agreed after hearing the name Gang Jinshu.

"Since the other leaders are still in their seclusion, I will go to the southern region by myself." Elmyra then spoke to Oliver. "You are our leader, so you should stay in our sub-realm to control the situation, and you can tell the others to help us once they finish their seclusion.
Anyway, Zuhe, the undine leader, should be coming out soon, so you can ask her to go to the central region, especially since the most powerful cultivators in that region are in the demon cave."

"All right, you guys can leave now, and I will arrange everything once they come out of their seclusion." After that, they all left the fairy forest, and Oliver looked into the distance before letting out a heavy sigh. "Fortunately, Zhang Fei is truly the ten-tailed fox's successor, and I believe that he can bring peace to all races, be they natural races, humans, demons, and beast races."

After they arrived at the Chu Clan, Zhang Xiaolong immediately sent Zefyr into the training space to continue her training, and he also contacted Liu Qingyu to tell her that he had eliminated Pang De with the help of the natural races, so they could leave the heavenly sword sect.
Mei suddenly informed Zhang Xiaolong. [Master, I detected two auras that match your beast aura, so I'm sure their owners are heavenly foxes like you.]

Zhang Xiaolong opened his map to search for the whereabouts of the two heavenly foxes, and he found that they were in a small town a little far from Heavenly Sword City, so he immediately used his Nine Cloud Steps to check on them.
Upon arriving at the city, Zhang Xiaolong immediately landed on a large tree branch before activating his invisibility, and he watched the two from a distance. 'Scan them, Mei.'
