chapters.title: Chapter 369 Disappointment
paragraphs: After he summoned the fourth clone, which he named Zhang Xiaogang, Zhang Xiaolong immediately sent him into the training space, and he immediately asked Mei to activate the comprehension feature so that he could study all the formation arrays that Di Xingjie had given him before.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong himself began to cultivate in his hiding place, and Mei continued to monitor the movements of the two heavenly foxes, as well as the movements of the heretics.

In the Diyu Realm, specifically in the Death Valley, Ashreth and the others finally reached the deepest area of the place. However, they were disappointed to find Nauvia no longer there, especially after Zhang Xiaolong helped her escape.
"Did you get the wrong information? Why isn't my daughter here?" Nadea asked Ashreth in an annoyed tone.

Ashreth shook her head at Nadea. "My information can't be wrong because some demon hunters have checked it thoroughly, and Nauvia controlled all the demons in this place to attack them. However, I don't know how she could disappear from this place, and she might have gone to another area by now."
Unlike them, Kyllia was more interested in the ancient black castle, and she immediately approached it before asking the others. "Hey, guys, do you think Nauvia entered this castle?"

"I think it's impossible." Ashreth responded to Kyllia by shaking her head, but she also approached the ancient black castle. "Even our rulers have tried to breach this barrier repeatedly, but they have never succeeded, so I am not sure that Nauvia can get in."

Nadea also moved towards the black castle before touching the barrier. "I agree with her, Kyllia. This barrier is too strong, so I'm sure my daughter isn't inside. However, I'm afraid if she dares to go to that place, especially since it's the most dangerous place in this sub-realm, and she would face great danger if she really went there."
"Do you mean the Endless Abyss?"

"Yes." Nadea nodded to Ashreth and Kyllia. "My daughter is too stubborn, and she also has a lot of courage, so I think there is a possibility that she will go to that place." After hearing that, Ashreth and Kyllia's expressions turned serious, especially since they themselves did not dare to approach the Endless Death.

If Nauvia really went there, their chances of bringing her back were zero, especially since the ancient demon beast would attack anyone who approached that place, and she would definitely die by its hands.
"Nadea, we-"

"I know." Nadea interrupted Ashreth with a heavy sigh. "Regardless, I must go to Endless Death, and I will do anything to save my daughter. She is my only daughter, so I don't want her to die at the hands of that ancient demon beast. Anyways, you guys can go back to your respective places, and I will go there by myself."
Ashreth and Kyllia exchanged frowning glances, but they could understand Nadea's feelings, and they decided to accompany her to the Endless Death.

When they were about to leave the place, a hole suddenly opened in the barrier surrounding the ancient black castle, and a black hand immediately came out from inside it before pulling the three of them into it.
The other demons who came with them were shocked after seeing that, so they moved in front of the ancient black castle and banged on the barrier repeatedly, but it didn't give any reaction.
In the end, one of them decided to leave the Death Valley, and she immediately rushed to the tower to report this matter to the Amaris Twins.
"Shit!" Ashreth immediately cursed as soon as she saw the area inside the ancient black castle. "What the heck is going on? Do you think that black hand belongs to our rulers' ancestor?"

"Yes." Kyllia responded to Ashreth as she looked at the area around them. "According to history, this ancient black castle was built by one of them, and her corpse is also buried here, so the black hand just now belongs to her.
However, I don't understand why it only reacted now, especially since our rulers have tried to breach it many times, but we have never succeeded, and it has never shown any reaction before."

After she tried to open the exit gate and failed, Nadea then turned to her two friends. "So what should we do now? We can't get out of this place, so we can only go forward. However, I'm really worried about my daughter, and it will be too late for me to save her if we're trapped here for too long."

"I can understand your feelings, but we have no other choice, right?" Kyllia then pointed forward. "For now, we can only move forward to check, and we might find a way out of this place, so it would be better if we moved now."
"Yeah, you're right."

After that, the three female demons immediately walked to the inner area of the ancient black castle, and all three had already drawn their weapons, especially since no one knew about the mystery of that place.

While Nadea and the two female demons were looking for another way out of the ancient black castle, Nauvia had already sat in front of the youngest demon ruler and explained everything to her, and Angela looked surprised after she told her that it was Zhang Xiaolong who sent her.

"Since you are a siren, I will accept you in my sub-realm, and you can live in peace here." Nauvia was relieved by Angela's answer. "Moreover, I know quite a lot about life in the Amaris Twins' tower, and the struggle to maintain their status in that place is very harsh, so it is natural that a young demon like you is uncomfortable living there."
"Thank you, Ruler Angela." Nauvia expressed gratitude.
"No need." Angela then asked Nauvia with a suspicious gaze. "Do you have any relationship with Zhang Xiaolong?"

"Eh?" Angela's question took Nauvia aback, but she immediately denied it. "No! I've only met Zhang Xiaolong twice, so I don't have any relationship with him. Honestly, I myself don't understand his reasons for saving me, but I'm really grateful that he did, or I would have gone to endless death to avoid them."

"You're crazy; do you know that?" Angela said this while shaking her head. "Even us twelve rulers dare not approach that ancient demon beast, and the black Amaris has suffered heavy injuries from it in the past. If you dare to go to that place, then you will be eaten alive by it."
"Haha." Nauvia laughed bitterly before asking Angela. "Do you have any relationship with him, my lady?"

Angela smiled in response to Nauvia's question. "I've met Zhang Xiaolong three times, and he's already come to my sub-realm. Even though we don't have such a relationship, I'm happy with his presence, especially since he likes my singing so much, and I can't wait to see him again."

'It seems that ruler Angela has been captivated by Zhang Xiaolong. Otherwise, she wouldn't say such a thing, especially since she doesn't really like non-aquatic demon beasts.' Nauvia silently pondered before posing the question once more. "Do you know about his true identity?"
"What do you mean by that?" Angela asked with a raised eyebrow.

"Zhang Xiaolong is a human." Angela abruptly stood up from her seat and stared at Nauvia in shock. "I don't know how this is possible, but he really is a human. However, he is also a demon and a fox beast, and his three forms are real."
Nauvia's explanation further shocked Angela, especially since Zhang Xiaolong never told her about his other identities. "Explain to me how you could know about it."

'Crap! Apparently, Zhang Xiaolong didn't reveal his other identities to ruler Angela, and I shouldn't have asked her about that.' Nauvia muttered to herself as she sighed regretfully. "The first time he came to the Death Valley, he used his white fox form to defeat the demons I controlled, and he had extraordinary light power, which is stronger than Virgil's ruler.
He also used his demon form, which was an incubus, and then showed me his human form."

Angela frowned after hearing all that, but she was also shocked by the fact that Zhang Xiaolong had three forms. However, she didn't say anything and immediately disappeared from Nauvia's sight, making her feel even more regretful for bringing that up. "Sigh! I hope he won't be mad at me."

Angela quickly left her sub-realm and rushed towards the Zygoz sub-realm, but she was shocked when she saw Oz and Virgil flying towards the Amaris Twin's sub-realm, so she immediately went over to them.

"How did you suddenly appear in our realm, Lord? Where have you disappeared to all this time?" Oz immediately looked at Angela and explained the truth to her behind his disappearance, and he also told her about his cooperation with Zhang Xiaolong, especially since she had already established contact with him. "Does that mean you both already know that he is human?"

"Oh?" Oz and Virgil were momentarily taken aback by Angela's question. "Yes, we already know that he is human, and he came here because Janette brought him. Moreover, he is both an incubus and a fox beast, but his beast form is not a demon beast, and he combines his demon and beast forms to meet you."
"I see." Angela looked disappointed after confirming the truth of Zhang Xiaolong's three identities.

Virgil immediately spoke to Angela. "I understand how you feel, but you shouldn't be so disappointed, and I'm sure he had no intention of deceiving you. Perhaps he was afraid that you would be hostile to him if you found out that he was a human, so he hasn't told you the truth.
Moreover, he has helped us in many ways, and he is our only hope to restore peace in our realm, so I hope you won't be hostile to him after learning everything."

"Am I that petty, Sister Virgil?" Angela asked with a shake of her head. "I won't be hostile towards him just because he's a human, but I'm disappointed that he didn't tell me the truth from the start, especially since he already knew that I was on your side."

"Haha." Instead, Oz suddenly laughed and then rubbed Angela's head. "Do you like him that much, little girl? You don't need to lie to me, because I've known you since you were little. That's why I know your feelings well enough, and you wouldn't be this disappointed if you didn't like him."
Angela did not deny Oz's question. "Yes! I like Zhang Xiaolong, and I want to continue meeting him, especially since he is the second person who likes my singing besides you."

"I see." Oz nodded in understanding before speaking to Angela again. "I understand your disappointment, but he didn't do that to deceive you. Although he has much better escape abilities than you, he is still too weak now, and those traitors are also continuously monitoring the situation in our realm, so he has to act very carefully in this realm.
Anyway, it would be better if the two of you had a heart-to-heart conversation if he came to your sub-realm again, and I'm sure that you would be able to understand his reasons."
"All right." Angela nodded to Oz before asking. "Do you two want to go to the Amaris Twin's sub-realm?"

"Yes." Oz then told Angela. "Kinos disappeared without a trace, and we can't find him anywhere. Moreover, that kid told me that the black Amaris was so exhausted, like she had used her demon power excessively, so we suspect that she did something to him. Unfortunately, that kid couldn't find him in her tower, and he thought that he was hidden in the endless death, so we thought to go there to check."
Angela was shocked again after hearing that. "Does that mean Zhang Xiaolong is in the Amaris Twin's tower?"

"Yes and no." Angela was confused by Oz's answer. "That kid's real name is Zhang Fei, and Zhang Xiaolong is one of his clones. In addition, he still has one more clone named Feltia, a succubus. He uses her to infiltrate their tower, so he can monitor their every move."

"Zhang Fei, huh?" Angela muttered softly, her expression growing increasingly disappointed, particularly since he had used his clone to approach her. "I will join you two in going to the Endless Death."
Oz nodded in agreement with Angela's wishes, and the three of them immediately entered the Amaris Twin's sub-realm before rushing towards the endless death in the black Amaris's dark area.

With their high speed, the three of them had arrived above the endless death, and they observed the dark abyss from the sky. However, they could not sense Kinos's demon aura in that place, including Oz.
"Lord, it seems that Kinos is not in this place, and the black Amaris might have hidden him somewhere else." Angela said this as she turned to face Oz.
Oz nodded and turned to Virgil. "Try using your light power to check inside."

"Are you sure about that?" Virgil doubtfully asked. "We all know that the ancient demon beast has existed since your predecessor's time, and its demon rank should have reached Emperor rank like you and Zygoz, so it might attack us if I do that."
"Hehe." Oz chuckled at that. "Even if its demon power has reached the Emperor Rank, it still won't be able to fight me, so you can do it now, and we'll leave right away if we can't find Kinos here."
"All right." Virgil then stretched her right hand forward with her palm facing down, and countless light balls immediately rained down on the area, causing the dark abyss to become extremely bright.

However, they suddenly felt a strong pressure from within the dark abyss, and black flames gushed out of it. Even so, it was no problem for Oz, who immediately countered it with his demonic magic, so the flames quickly disappeared.

An angry roar suddenly sounded from within the dark abyss, and the ancient demon beast immediately flew out from it. Oz immediately protected the two female demon rulers, especially since its demon rank had reached the Emperor rank.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 Tharnon And Ursula
paragraphs: The ancient demon had a strange and scary appearance, especially since its head was like a wild boar, two green eyes like emeralds, and two sharp fangs protruded from its mouth as they faced upwards. It has two black horns, similar to dragon horns, and two large wings, similar to bat wings.
Its humongous and black body was covered in scales like pangolin scales, but its hands and feet were similar to black phanter claws, and it also had a spiked tail that had a rounded tip like a club.

When the ancient demon beast appeared, Angela immediately hugged Virgil's arm and closed her eyes. Her expression looked frightened, especially since she herself was also a demon beast, but her race and bloodline were much weaker than it.
Although she felt frightened by the appearance of the ancient demon beast, Virgil maintained a calm expression, and she also enveloped Angela with her light power.

"Hahaha!" Oz laughed at the appearance of the ancient demon beast. "This is the second time we've met, Tharnon. Back then, I was still very young, so I lost badly to you. However, I'm not the same person I used to be, and our demon ranks are equal now, so you won't be able to toy with me like you did in the past."
"What are you doing in my place, kiddo?" Tharnon then glanced at Virgil. "A fallen winged race, huh? No wonder she has light power, and she has disturbed my rest by using her power in my nest."

"All right, you don't have to scare her. I was the one who ordered her to use her light power, so you can fight me if you can't accept that." Oz used his demonic force manipulation, causing Tharnon to frown in response. "Anyway, I didn't come here looking for trouble with you; I just wanted to look for one of my missing aides.
I suspect the black Amaris kidnapped him, and this is the only place I can think of for her to hide him."

"That little girl did bring the demon crab here, but I immediately chased her away. I don't know where she took him after that; you can meet her directly to find out about his whereabouts." After hearing that, Oz and the two female demons' expressions turned serious, but Tharnon then looked at Virgil once more with his green eyes shining brightly.
"This better be the first and last time you use your light power in my lair, or I will take you to the bottom, and you will never be able to see the light again."
*Gulp*
Tharnon's threat made Virgil gulp hard, and she immediately nodded at him. "If it weren't for necessity, I would never dare to use my light power in your lair, Senior."

"Hey! I hope you can help us, especially since this concerns the Tian and Xian realms." Tharnon immediately returned his gaze to Oz as he frowned. "Your master vanished because of the winged race, but he should still be alive now. However, I don't know about his whereabouts, and I'm still trying to find out about it."
"Are you sure that my master is still alive?" Tharnon, with doubt, asked.
"Yes." Oz nodded to Tharnon. "I heard about this from someone, and he got the information from one of the angels."

"Humph!" Tharnon snorted at that. "Those little birds can't be trusted, and they are much more evil than our demons. Naturally, I would be thrilled if my master were still alive, but you can forget about that, especially since he is just tricking you."

Oz shook his head in response to Tharnon's words. "You're mistaken; the individual who provided the information wasn't a winged race, but rather a human. Furthermore, he possessed two other forms: a lust demon and a beast fox.
Initially, he came here only to save the dryads, but I detected his presence, so I immediately met him and asked him to cooperate with me, to which he agreed, and I have confidence in him."

"I don't believe there is a living being who has three forms at once, and he must have used a special technique to disguise himself." However, Tharnon frowned as he saw the seriousness in the second demon emperor's expression, and he then asked Oz. "Where is he now? I won't believe you until I see his three forms with my own eyes, so you can call him here to meet me."

Oz then pointed towards the tower in the middle of the sub-realm. "Unfortunately, Feltia can't meet you right now, especially since she's infiltrating the Amaris Twin's tower, so you can go there to see her yourself."
"He or she?" Tharnon appeared confused by that, especially since Oz mentioned Zhang Fei as both male and female.

"Hahaha!" Oz laughed before telling Tharnon. "I forgot to tell you that Feltia is Zhang Fei's clone, and his clone is disguised as a succubus, especially since the twins don't like men. Anyway, the black Amaris still doesn't know that he is both a human and a fox beast, let alone his true identity.
Even so, the white Amaris already knows everything, but she can't say anything to her twin sister, so you have to be careful when talking to him, or you will ruin our plan."
Without saying anything, Tharnon immediately disappeared from their sight. Virgil then turned towards the tower and asked Oz a question. "Is it okay if you tell him about Zhang Fei and his clone?"

"Don't worry, everything will be fine." Oz replied with a nod. "Even though Tharnon has a scary appearance, and is also too fierce, he actually has the same character as the first demon lord, so you don't need to worry about that."

Virgil nodded in understanding to Oz, but on the other hand, Angela looked towards the tower with a feeling of anxiety, and she was afraid that something would happen to Zhang Fei's clone, which would be disastrous for him.

"You don't need to be this worried, okay?" Angela turned to Oz. "That kid isn't as weak as you think, and he has many abilities that even make me jealous of him. Because I knew he wouldn't believe us, I purposely told Tharnon about him. I hope he can convince him to help us, which will increase our chances of winning against those angels and prevent them from ever again invading our realm.
"I hope so." Angela then clasped her hands together. 'Please be careful.'
Virgil smiled faintly as she noticed that, and she rubbed Angela's hand to calm her. 'This little girl seems to really like Zhang Fei.'
[You gained 30,000 female essences from the white Amaris.]

The notification's appearance made Feltia smile in satisfaction, but she suddenly raised her eyebrows after seeing the three female demons affected by something, causing them to fall into a deep sleep.
"Are you Zhang Fei?"

Feltia frowned and turned her head towards the window, and her expression became serious once she saw Tharnon standing there. Moreover, she could feel that his demon aura was as strong as Oz's and Zygos's, which made her wary of him. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Tharnon
Age: 50,000+ years old
Gender: Male
Race: Unknown
Rank: Unknown
Elements: Darkness + Poison
Physique: Unknown
Abilities: Unknown
Strong: Darkness + Poison
Weak: Light

'What the hell? How could a demon beast like him fool the system?' Feltia was completely shocked by that, especially since the system had no problem scanning Oz and Zygos' data, but it couldn't scan Tharnon's data.
[Master, this demon beast came from the direction of the Endless Death, and Oz was in that area with Virgil and Angela, so I think that he is the ancient demon beast that lives there.]

Feltia nodded in agreement to Mei before getting out of bed, and she immediately walked towards Tharnon as she wiped the white Amaris's sticky liquid that was left on her hand. "I didn't expect an old demon like you to come to me, and you even know my true identity. Does this mean Oz has told you everything about me?"

"Oh?" Tharnon was surprised to see Feltia still able to act relaxed in front of him. "That kid didn't lie to me, and you are indeed different from those weak humans. Is your succubus form also your true form?"
"Yes." Feltia transformed into a human, a fox, and an incubus. Tharnon looked amazed to see her, but she immediately turned into a succubus again. "Why did you come here? Did you want to capture me?"

"Hahaha." Tharnon laughed at Feltia's question. "If I wanted to capture you, I would have done it a long time ago, okay? I came here just to make sure about your identities, especially since you are the only living creature who has three identities that I have ever met. Anyway, that kiddo told me that the first demon emperor is still alive; is that true?"

"Yes." Feltia nodded to Tharnon. "Back then, the white Amaris used an artifact given by Moraes to do something to the first demon emperor. However, the artifact didn't kill him but sent him to other realms randomly, so I don't know which realm he is in now."

Tharnon immediately glanced behind Feltia, specifically focusing on the white Amaris, who had fallen asleep as a result of his ability. "In the past, the first demon emperor loved them both very much, but I didn't expect that the white one would betray him by joining those weak birds. Has that kiddo done something to her?
He told me that she already knew about your true identity, but she couldn't tell anything to her twin sister, so I thought that way."

"Yeah." Feltia then directed her gaze towards the white Amaris. "Oz has fused a bit of her soul with mine, so her life is tied to mine now. He has also placed restrictions on her, rendering her unable to reveal anything to his sister."
"I see." Tharnon nodded in understanding. "Since that's the case, I won't do anything to her; you can take care of her yourself. What other information do you know, especially about those birds?"

Feltia once again turned to Tharnon, and she quickly touched his forehead, making him surprised by her speed. However, his expression changed slightly as quite a lot of memories popped out in his mind, and he looked at her in shock, especially since no demon had the ability to transfer memories like her; not even the first demon emperor could do it.

"I've shared with you all the information I have, so you can see them for yourself. Anyway, it would be better if you cooperate with Oz, and you guys can work together to face those people, especially since I don't have a lot of time to continue to help with your problems with them."
"All right." Tharnon then canceled the ability he used to put the three female demons to sleep. "They'll wake up soon."

Following that, Tharnon swiftly vanished from Feltia's view, bringing a sense of relief to her. She then looked at the three female demons, but they were still sleeping, so she decided to do something else while waiting for them to wake up.

Meanwhile, Tharon has returned to Oz and the two female demon rulers, and he immediately agreed to join them, much to the relief of the three. After they discuss some other things, the second demon lord takes the two women away to look for Kinos in other areas, and the ancient demon beast immediately returns to the dark abyss before watching Feltia's memories one by one. "Hmm?
Those birds are indeed bastards! I will definitely destroy them with my own hands in the future, especially that throne!"

Asrhreth, Kyllia, and Nadea immediately stopped in their tracks as soon as they arrived at the throne room of the black castle, and their eyes looked at the female demon sitting on the throne in shock, especially since half of her body was white and the other half was black.

Moreover, their faces and appearances were completely similar to the Amaris Twins, making the three realize that she was their ancestor. However, they did not expect that she was still alive, and she had been living locked up in the black castle for tens of thousands of years.

"Haha." The three female demons were shocked to hear her laughter, especially since her laughter was the laughter of two people. "Are you three surprised to see us? Although we appear to be one person, we are actually two people, and we live in one body. You guys are right that we are their ancestors, and our name is Ursula."
"How... how can you two still be alive?" Ashreth asked with a trembling voice. "According to history, you two died tens of thousands of years ago, but you are both still alive now."

"Ha ha." Ursula chuckled upon hearing that. "Little dark elf, you should know that the victors write history, and they can write as they please, so it is natural for you to think we are dead, even though in reality we are still alive and have been living in this place for that long."

Unlike Ashreth and Nadea, Kyllia does not seem afraid of Ursula. "Why not leave this ancient castle if you two are alive? Moreover, our twin rulers have tried to open the barrier many times, and they are your descendants, but you never let them in here."

"You're wrong about that, little gorgon." Ursula suddenly moved in front of them, making them tense. "Honestly, we have been asleep for a long time, only waking up a few days ago when we sensed the presence of an unusual man in front of our castle. However, he was already gone when we opened our eyes, so we chose to wait for him to come again.
In fact, he arrived just before you guys, and he sent that little siren away to another place."
"What?" The three female demons screamed in shock. "How could a man enter this sub-realm? Our rulers will surely detect his presence, and they will surely kill him."
Ursula shrugged at them. "We don't know them, and we don't care about them either."
"Do you know where that man sent my daughter, Ancestors?" Nadea asked Ursula.

It has two black horns, similar to dragon horns, and two large wings, similar to bat wings.
Its humongous and black body was covered in scales like pangolin scales, but its hands and feet were similar to black phanter claws, and it also had a spiked tail that had a rounded tip like a club.
When the ancient demon beast appeared, Angela immediately hugged Virgil's arm and closed her eyes.
Her expression looked frightened, especially since she herself was also a demon beast, but her race and bloodline were much weaker than it.
Although she felt frightened by the appearance of the ancient demon beast, Virgil maintained a calm expression, and she also enveloped Angela with her light power.
"Hahaha!" Oz laughed at the appearance of the ancient demon beast.
"This is the second time we've met, Tharnon.
Back then, I was still very young, so I lost badly to you.
However, I'm not the same person I used to be, and our demon ranks are equal now, so you won't be able to toy with me like you did in the past."
"What are you doing in my place, kiddo?" Tharnon then glanced at Virgil.
"A fallen winged race, huh?
No wonder she has light power, and she has disturbed my rest by using her power in my nest."
"All right, you don't have to scare her.
I was the one who ordered her to use her light power, so you can fight me if you can't accept that." Oz used his demonic force manipulation, causing Tharnon to frown in response.
"Anyway, I didn't come here looking for trouble with you; I just wanted to look for one of my missing aides.
I suspect the black Amaris kidnapped him, and this is the only place I can think of for her to hide him."
"That little girl did bring the demon crab here, but I immediately chased her away.

I don't know where she took him after that; you can meet her directly to find out about his whereabouts." After hearing that, Oz and the two female demons' expressions turned serious, but Tharnon then looked at Virgil once more with his green eyes shining brightly.
"This better be the first and last time you use your light power in my lair, or I will take you to the bottom, and you will never be able to see the light again."
*Gulp*
Tharnon's threat made Virgil gulp hard, and she immediately nodded at him.
"If it weren't for necessity, I would never dare to use my light power in your lair, Senior."
"Hey!
I hope you can help us, especially since this concerns the Tian and Xian realms." Tharnon immediately returned his gaze to Oz as he frowned.
"Your master vanished because of the winged race, but he should still be alive now.
However, I don't know about his whereabouts, and I'm still trying to find out about it."
"Are you sure that my master is still alive?" Tharnon, with doubt, asked.
"Yes." Oz nodded to Tharnon.
"I heard about this from someone, and he got the information from one of the angels."
"Humph!" Tharnon snorted at that.
"Those little birds can't be trusted, and they are much more evil than our demons.
Naturally, I would be thrilled if my master were still alive, but you can forget about that, especially since he is just tricking you."
Oz shook his head in response to Tharnon's words.
"You're mistaken; the individual who provided the information wasn't a winged race, but rather a human.
Furthermore, he possessed two other forms: a lust demon and a beast fox.
Initially, he came here only to save the dryads, but I detected his presence, so I immediately met him and asked him to cooperate with me, to which he agreed, and I have confidence in him."

"I don't believe there is a living being who has three forms at once, and he must have used a special technique to disguise himself." However, Tharnon frowned as he saw the seriousness in the second demon emperor's expression, and he then asked Oz.
"Where is he now?
I won't believe you until I see his three forms with my own eyes, so you can call him here to meet me."
Oz then pointed towards the tower in the middle of the sub-realm.
"Unfortunately, Feltia can't meet you right now, especially since she's infiltrating the Amaris Twin's tower, so you can go there to see her yourself."
"He or she?" Tharnon appeared confused by that, especially since Oz mentioned Zhang Fei as both male and female.
"Hahaha!" Oz laughed before telling Tharnon.
"I forgot to tell you that Feltia is Zhang Fei's clone, and his clone is disguised as a succubus, especially since the twins don't like men.
Anyway, the black Amaris still doesn't know that he is both a human and a fox beast, let alone his true identity.
Even so, the white Amaris already knows everything, but she can't say anything to her twin sister, so you have to be careful when talking to him, or you will ruin our plan."
Without saying anything, Tharnon immediately disappeared from their sight.
Virgil then turned towards the tower and asked Oz a question.
"Is it okay if you tell him about Zhang Fei and his clone?"
"Don't worry, everything will be fine." Oz replied with a nod.
"Even though Tharnon has a scary appearance, and is also too fierce, he actually has the same character as the first demon lord, so you don't need to worry about that."

Virgil nodded in understanding to Oz, but on the other hand, Angela looked towards the tower with a feeling of anxiety, and she was afraid that something would happen to Zhang Fei's clone, which would be disastrous for him.
"You don't need to be this worried, okay?" Angela turned to Oz.
"That kid isn't as weak as you think, and he has many abilities that even make me jealous of him.
Because I knew he wouldn't believe us, I purposely told Tharnon about him.
I hope he can convince him to help us, which will increase our chances of winning against those angels and prevent them from ever again invading our realm.
"I hope so." Angela then clasped her hands together. 'Please be careful.'
Virgil smiled faintly as she noticed that, and she rubbed Angela's hand to calm her. 'This little girl seems to really like Zhang Fei.'
[You gained 30,000 female essences from the white Amaris.]

The notification's appearance made Feltia smile in satisfaction, but she suddenly raised her eyebrows after seeing the three female demons affected by something, causing them to fall into a deep sleep.
"Are you Zhang Fei?"
Feltia frowned and turned her head towards the window, and her expression became serious once she saw Tharnon standing there.
Moreover, she could feel that his demon aura was as strong as Oz's and Zygos's, which made her wary of him. 'Scan him, Mei.'
[Yes.]
Name: Tharnon
Age: 50,000+ years old
Gender: Male
Race: Unknown
Rank: Unknown
Elements: Darkness + Poison
Physique: Unknown
Abilities: Unknown
Strong: Darkness + Poison
Weak: Light
'What the hell?
How could a demon beast like him fool the system?' Feltia was completely shocked by that, especially since the system had no problem scanning Oz and Zygos' data, but it couldn't scan Tharnon's data.
[Master, this demon beast came from the direction of the Endless Death, and Oz was in that area with Virgil and Angela, so I think that he is the ancient demon beast that lives there.]
Feltia nodded in agreement to Mei before getting out of bed, and she immediately walked towards Tharnon as she wiped the white Amaris's sticky liquid that was left on her hand.
"I didn't expect an old demon like you to come to me, and you even know my true identity.
Does this mean Oz has told you everything about me?"
"Oh?" Tharnon was surprised to see Feltia still able to act relaxed in front of him.
"That kid didn't lie to me, and you are indeed different from those weak humans.
Is your succubus form also your true form?"
"Yes." Feltia transformed into a human, a fox, and an incubus.
Tharnon looked amazed to see her, but she immediately turned into a succubus again.
"Why did you come here?
Did you want to capture me?"
"Hahaha." Tharnon laughed at Feltia's question.
"If I wanted to capture you, I would have done it a long time ago, okay?
I came here just to make sure about your identities, especially since you are the only living creature who has three identities that I have ever met.
Anyway, that kiddo told me that the first demon emperor is still alive; is that true?"
"Yes." Feltia nodded to Tharnon.
"Back then, the white Amaris used an artifact given by Moraes to do something to the first demon emperor.
However, the artifact didn't kill him but sent him to other realms randomly, so I don't know which realm he is in now."
Tharnon immediately glanced behind Feltia, specifically focusing on the white Amaris, who had fallen asleep as a result of his ability.
"In the past, the first demon emperor loved them both very much, but I didn't expect that the white one would betray him by joining those weak birds.
Has that kiddo done something to her?
He told me that she already knew about your true identity, but she couldn't tell anything to her twin sister, so I thought that way."
"Yeah." Feltia then directed her gaze towards the white Amaris.
"Oz has fused a bit of her soul with mine, so her life is tied to mine now.
He has also placed restrictions on her, rendering her unable to reveal anything to his sister."
"I see." Tharnon nodded in understanding.
"Since that's the case, I won't do anything to her; you can take care of her yourself.
What other information do you know, especially about those birds?"
Feltia once again turned to Tharnon, and she quickly touched his forehead, making him surprised by her speed.

However, his expression changed slightly as quite a lot of memories popped out in his mind, and he looked at her in shock, especially since no demon had the ability to transfer memories like her; not even the first demon emperor could do it.
"I've shared with you all the information I have, so you can see them for yourself.

Anyway, it would be better if you cooperate with Oz, and you guys can work together to face those people, especially since I don't have a lot of time to continue to help with your problems with them."
"All right." Tharnon then canceled the ability he used to put the three female demons to sleep.
"They'll wake up soon."
Following that, Tharnon swiftly vanished from Feltia's view, bringing a sense of relief to her.
She then looked at the three female demons, but they were still sleeping, so she decided to do something else while waiting for them to wake up.
Meanwhile, Tharon has returned to Oz and the two female demon rulers, and he immediately agreed to join them, much to the relief of the three.

After they discuss some other things, the second demon lord takes the two women away to look for Kinos in other areas, and the ancient demon beast immediately returns to the dark abyss before watching Feltia's memories one by one.
"Hmm?
Those birds are indeed bastards!
I will definitely destroy them with my own hands in the future, especially that throne!"

Asrhreth, Kyllia, and Nadea immediately stopped in their tracks as soon as they arrived at the throne room of the black castle, and their eyes looked at the female demon sitting on the throne in shock, especially since half of her body was white and the other half was black.
Moreover, their faces and appearances were completely similar to the Amaris Twins, making the three realize that she was their ancestor.
However, they did not expect that she was still alive, and she had been living locked up in the black castle for tens of thousands of years.
"Haha." The three female demons were shocked to hear her laughter, especially since her laughter was the laughter of two people.
"Are you three surprised to see us?
Although we appear to be one person, we are actually two people, and we live in one body.
You guys are right that we are their ancestors, and our name is Ursula."
"How... how can you two still be alive?" Ashreth asked with a trembling voice.
"According to history, you two died tens of thousands of years ago, but you are both still alive now."
"Ha ha." Ursula chuckled upon hearing that.

"Little dark elf, you should know that the victors write history, and they can write as they please, so it is natural for you to think we are dead, even though in reality we are still alive and have been living in this place for that long."
Unlike Ashreth and Nadea, Kyllia does not seem afraid of Ursula.
"Why not leave this ancient castle if you two are alive?
Moreover, our twin rulers have tried to open the barrier many times, and they are your descendants, but you never let them in here."
"You're wrong about that, little gorgon." Ursula suddenly moved in front of them, making them tense.
"Honestly, we have been asleep for a long time, only waking up a few days ago when we sensed the presence of an unusual man in front of our castle.
However, he was already gone when we opened our eyes, so we chose to wait for him to come again.
In fact, he arrived just before you guys, and he sent that little siren away to another place."
"What?" The three female demons screamed in shock.
"How could a man enter this sub-realm?
Our rulers will surely detect his presence, and they will surely kill him."
Ursula shrugged at them.
"We don't know them, and we don't care about them either."
"Do you know where that man sent my daughter, Ancestors?" Nadea asked Ursula.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 Oz And Ursula
paragraphs: Although they had heard Zhang Xiaolong's conversation with Nauvia, Ursula chose not to tell Nadea about her daughter's destination. "We don't know anything about it; we only know that he opened a portal, allowing your daughter to leave this place." (A/N: I purposefully used the pronouns 'they, we, them, or us' for Ursula, as she is two individuals in one body.)
Nadea looked disappointed after hearing Ursula's answer, but she was also relieved that Nauvia did not go to the Endless Death, so she would not have to face the dangers of the ancient demon beast.
"Why did you two suddenly call us here, Ancestors?" Kyllia asked with a look full of doubt.
"Haha." Ursula laughed softly before their black and white eyes lit up, and they immediately stretched out their hands, sending the three female demons flying into the air, panicking them.

Before they could question Ursula, a black and white aura enveloped the three female demons, and they sensed the two ancestors absorbing their demon power, causing their faces to quickly turn pale. "The two of us have been sleeping for too long, so we need additional demon energy, and we will absorb yours.
However, you guys don't need to worry because we won't kill you all, and you three will only be weakened for a while."
"Argh!" Ashreth, Nadea, and Kyllia let out groans of pain as Ursula absorbs their demon power faster, and they also absorb their demon essences at the same time.

The three women's screams only stopped some time later, and Ursula immediately let go of them after they were satisfied with absorbing everything. After that, they took Ashreth, Nadea, and Kyllia, who already looked very weak, out of the black castle.
The female demons waiting outside the castle were shocked to see the three in such conditions, but they were horrified once they saw Ursula, who was staring at them while licking her lips.

Ursula did not give them a chance to escape, and they immediately covered those female demons with their demon aura before absorbing their demon energy and essences, just as they did to Asreth and the others before.

Unlike what they did to Ashreth and the others, Ursula absorbed their demon power and essence dry, killing those female demons and leaving only their dry skeletons. "Tch! These female demons are too weak for us, so we have to look for other demons to restore our strength."
Ursula then throws Ashreth, Nadea, and Kyllia to the ground before disappearing from the death valley.

Kyllia, who was still able to maintain a bit of consciousness, immediately contacted the Amaris Twins to warn them about Ursula. However, neither of them responded to her, especially since they were still asleep due to the effects of Tharnon's ability earlier. 'Sigh! The situation would be very bad if the two ancestors were to run rampant in this sub-realm.'
After that, Urusula went to the nearest demon city in the bright area, and they immediately absorbed the demon power and essence of the female demons living in that city, killing all of them.

However, Ursula was not satisfied with that, and they proceeded to several other demon cities before continuing their actions. This led to a rapid decrease in the population of female demons in the bright area, particularly because they killed all of them.

Oz and the two female rulers who sensed Ursula's actions immediately confronted her, but Angela and Virgil were frightened after they sensed her demon rank was also at Emperor rank, like the second demon emperor and Tharnon.
"Ho?" The two ancestors were a little surprised when they saw Oz. "So you're the current demon emperor, huh? Where is your predecessor? Is he dead?"

"I didn't expect you two to still be alive, Ursula," Oz said as he glanced at Virgil and Angela, signaling them to leave. The two female demon rulers wasted no time and immediately fled at full speed.
Ursula frowned and wanted to chase after the two female demon rulers, but Oz immediately stopped them. "You two better not touch them, or I will send you to your deaths."
"Tch!" Ursula gritted their teeth in annoyance, especially since they realized that they wouldn't be able to fight Oz with their strength not yet fully restored.

"Anyway, my predecessor is still alive, but he's not in this realm right now." Oz's answer momentarily stunned the two ancestors. "Even though he's not here, it's not a big deal to me, and I can still beat you guys easily. However, I won't do that, especially since our realm is facing great danger, so I still need help from many powerful demons to fight them."
"Enemies? Great danger?" Ursula looked at Oz with a frown. "Who are the enemies that dare to invade our realm with you here?"

"The strength of the people from the Tian and Xian realms has greatly increased compared to the past, and their numbers are also very large now, so I will not be able to face them by myself." Ursula frowned at Oz's answer. "You two will also suffer if our realm falls into their hands, so I hope you guys don't kill these female demons, especially since I need my armies to fight their armies.
Anyway, Tharnon has agreed to join me, so I want you guys to join us in order to protect our realms from those guys."

"Fine! We will join you." Ursula immediately accepted Oz's offer after thinking about it. "However, we still need demon power and essence to restore our strength, so you better not hinder us from killing these female demons, or we won't be able to help you fight them."

Oz frowned for a moment after hearing that. "In that case, you guys can go to the Avros, Tauri, or Leon sub-realms, especially since the demons living in them are much stronger than these female demons. The three of them are traitors to our realm, so go ahead and kill them."
"Oh?" Oz's answer once again surprised Ursula. "If you already knew that the three of them were traitors, why didn't you immediately eliminate them?"

Oz shook his head at Ursula before telling them. "I still need them to lure out the people from the Tian Realm who are plotting with them, so I haven't killed them yet. However, after I successfully capture those three winged races, I will kill them immediately, and we might be able to find out the leader's plan from the three of them."
"I see." Ursula nodded understandingly at Oz. "We will go to Tauri's sub-realm now, and after that, we will go to the other two sub-realms."

Without waiting for Oz's answer, Ursula immediately disappeared from his sight, making him feel a little relieved. He then looked towards the Amaris Twin's tower. "Fortunately, they don't know about Feltia's presence in that tower, or they would have gone there immediately to absorb her demon power and essence. Sigh!
I've been looking everywhere for Kinos, but I still can't find him, so I hope she can help me find information about his whereabouts from the black Amaris."
After that, Oz left the Amaris Twin's sub-realm to make sure that Ursula did not go after Angela and Virgil, and he also contacted Zygoz to protect the two female demon rulers from them.
Inside a palace, there was a man with a tall and large body, and his appearance was like that of a bull standing in front of a golden portal.

Furthermore, a man from the winged race, clad in white gold armor akin to Theo, stood before him. The man was none other than Zachiel, whom Moraes had assigned to initiate contact with Tauri the Taurus.

Tauri seemed surprised after the male winged race told him about some things, so he then asked Zachiel. "How could the portal in the white Amaris's place be destroyed? There shouldn't be any other demon rulers who can destroy it, right?"

"I don't know what actually happened there because I never met the white Amaris in person, but Theo told us that another demon destroyed it, and he estimated that the demon power was on par with the second demon lord." Tauri found it difficult to believe Zachiel's last sentence, especially since he was certain that no other demon, including the other demon rulers, had the same power as Oz.
"My superior suspects that the little girl has betrayed us, so he wants you to investigate her, and you can contact me again after you find something about her."

"All right." Tauri immediately agreed with that. "I will try to investigate the white Amaris as soon as possible, so you can go back there right now." Zachiel nodded and turned to enter the portal, but he and Tauri suddenly felt the presence of a powerful demon in the sub-realm, and that demon was none other than Ursula.

Just like the other demon rulers, Tauri can also observe the entire area in his sub-realm very easily, and his expression turned to shock after he found Ursula in his sub-realm. "Crap! I didn't expect those two to still be alive!"
"Who are those two demons?"

"Ursula! They are two demons in one body, and they are the Amaris Twins' ancestors." Tauri's answer caused Zachiel's expression to turn serious. "They have been around since the time of the first demon emperor, but they were badly injured when your ancestors and the people of the Xian realm invaded this realm for the first time.

In the past, we thought they were dead inside their black castle, but we couldn't be sure about their situation, especially since their castle was covered by a powerful barrier, so I didn't know if they were still alive. Anyway, their demon rank should have reached the Emperor rank, and their powers are supposed to be on par with Oz's, so you'd better tell your higher-ups about them."
Zachiel nodded in agreement with that. "Perhaps those two were the ones who destroyed the portal in the white Amaris's area, so I'll go back now and report their presence to my higher-ups."
After Zachiel entered the golden portal, Tauri immediately went to another area, and he also activated the barrier in his palace, especially since he felt afraid of Ursula.

Even so, Tauri continued to monitor Ursula's movements, and he was completely shocked to see them killing demons in his sub-realm. "Shit! I hope this barrier is strong enough to stop old demons like them! Otherwise, I will die in their hands, and my thousands of years of hard work will be in vain.

I have to find a way to contact Avros and Leon to tell them about those old demons, but I can't do it from my sub-realm, so I have to find a way to leave this place first. However, those two old demons will definitely detect my presence, and they will probably kill me immediately."

Unfortunately, Tauri's fears were unfounded, as Ursula had no intention of attacking him, especially after their previous conversation with Oz, and they only wanted to use the demons in his sub-realm to restore their powers.

After they traveled for several days, the three female moon foxes arrived at the Heavenly Sword City, and they immediately headed to the Chu Clan to look for Zhang Fei. However, the three of them could not enter the clan, especially since Liu Qingyu had already activated the clan's barrier, and their cultivation was not enough to breach it.
They tried to call out to the clan's members, but none of them responded. Liu Qingyu, who was watching them from within the clan, was quite surprised by the arrival of the three.

After all, the moon fox race had never informed her and the others that they would send other representatives, and their cultivation level was too low to be their representatives, thus making their arrival suspicious to her.

Since Zhang Fei was in the training space, Liu Qingyu decided to contact Zhang Xiaolong and inform him about the arrival of the three female moon foxes. He asked her to monitor the three of them to ascertain their purpose in coming to the Chu Clan.
Since no one answered them, Hu Qianli then asked her two friends. "What should we do now?"

"What else?" Hu Hong then pointed to an inn, which was not far from the Chu Clan. "We can't possibly break into this clan, so we have no choice but to wait for Zhang Fei to come out of this clan on his own, and we will continue to monitor this clan from that inn."

"I'm feeling tired after flying for so long, so we can go to that inn to rest, and I hope Zhang Fei will come out soon." Hu Qianli and Hu Hong immediately walked towards the inn, but Hu Xiufu hesitated to follow them, causing the two to turn to her. "What are you going to do? Are you going to keep waiting in front of the clan?"

"You guys can go to the inn first, and I will wait in this clan for some time before catching up with you two." Hearing that, Hu Qianli and Hu Hong immediately left her, and Hu Xiufu repeatedly looked at the Chu Clan. 'Sigh! Why didn't any of them respond to us? Could it be that they are suspicious of our arrival?'

Just as she was thinking about that, Hu Xiufu suddenly felt a strong pressure on her bloodline, which came from another direction, so she tried to find the source. However, a man suddenly appeared in front of her, and before she could react, he had already taken her away from the area.

Liu Qingyu, who witnessed it, immediately moved to the barier's side, and her expression became serious, especially since she was familiar with Zhang Fei's abilities. "So that guy just now was the heavenly fox he told me about before? He also has the same teleportation ability as him."

After that, Liu Qingyu once again contacted Zhang Xiaolong and told him about Tian Wangzi's action of kidnapping Hu Xiufu. In response, he asked her not to leave the Chu Clan, particularly since it would be difficult for him to save her if she fell into his hands.

Without waiting for Oz's answer, Ursula immediately disappeared from his sight, making him feel a little relieved.
He then looked towards the Amaris Twin's tower.
"Fortunately, they don't know about Feltia's presence in that tower, or they would have gone there immediately to absorb her demon power and essence.
Sigh!
I've been looking everywhere for Kinos, but I still can't find him, so I hope she can help me find information about his whereabouts from the black Amaris."
After that, Oz left the Amaris Twin's sub-realm to make sure that Ursula did not go after Angela and Virgil, and he also contacted Zygoz to protect the two female demon rulers from them.
Inside a palace, there was a man with a tall and large body, and his appearance was like that of a bull standing in front of a golden portal.
Furthermore, a man from the winged race, clad in white gold armor akin to Theo, stood before him.
The man was none other than Zachiel, whom Moraes had assigned to initiate contact with Tauri the Taurus.
Tauri seemed surprised after the male winged race told him about some things, so he then asked Zachiel.
"How could the portal in the white Amaris's place be destroyed?
There shouldn't be any other demon rulers who can destroy it, right?"

"I don't know what actually happened there because I never met the white Amaris in person, but Theo told us that another demon destroyed it, and he estimated that the demon power was on par with the second demon lord." Tauri found it difficult to believe Zachiel's last sentence, especially since he was certain that no other demon, including the other demon rulers, had the same power as Oz.
"My superior suspects that the little girl has betrayed us, so he wants you to investigate her, and you can contact me again after you find something about her."
"All right." Tauri immediately agreed with that.

"I will try to investigate the white Amaris as soon as possible, so you can go back there right now." Zachiel nodded and turned to enter the portal, but he and Tauri suddenly felt the presence of a powerful demon in the sub-realm, and that demon was none other than Ursula.
Just like the other demon rulers, Tauri can also observe the entire area in his sub-realm very easily, and his expression turned to shock after he found Ursula in his sub-realm.
"Crap!
I didn't expect those two to still be alive!"
"Who are those two demons?"
"Ursula!
They are two demons in one body, and they are the Amaris Twins' ancestors." Tauri's answer caused Zachiel's expression to turn serious.
"They have been around since the time of the first demon emperor, but they were badly injured when your ancestors and the people of the Xian realm invaded this realm for the first time.

In the past, we thought they were dead inside their black castle, but we couldn't be sure about their situation, especially since their castle was covered by a powerful barrier, so I didn't know if they were still alive.
Anyway, their demon rank should have reached the Emperor rank, and their powers are supposed to be on par with Oz's, so you'd better tell your higher-ups about them."
Zachiel nodded in agreement with that.
"Perhaps those two were the ones who destroyed the portal in the white Amaris's area, so I'll go back now and report their presence to my higher-ups."
After Zachiel entered the golden portal, Tauri immediately went to another area, and he also activated the barrier in his palace, especially since he felt afraid of Ursula.
Even so, Tauri continued to monitor Ursula's movements, and he was completely shocked to see them killing demons in his sub-realm.
"Shit!
I hope this barrier is strong enough to stop old demons like them!
Otherwise, I will die in their hands, and my thousands of years of hard work will be in vain.
I have to find a way to contact Avros and Leon to tell them about those old demons, but I can't do it from my sub-realm, so I have to find a way to leave this place first.
However, those two old demons will definitely detect my presence, and they will probably kill me immediately."

Unfortunately, Tauri's fears were unfounded, as Ursula had no intention of attacking him, especially after their previous conversation with Oz, and they only wanted to use the demons in his sub-realm to restore their powers.
After they traveled for several days, the three female moon foxes arrived at the Heavenly Sword City, and they immediately headed to the Chu Clan to look for Zhang Fei.
However, the three of them could not enter the clan, especially since Liu Qingyu had already activated the clan's barrier, and their cultivation was not enough to breach it.
They tried to call out to the clan's members, but none of them responded.
Liu Qingyu, who was watching them from within the clan, was quite surprised by the arrival of the three.

After all, the moon fox race had never informed her and the others that they would send other representatives, and their cultivation level was too low to be their representatives, thus making their arrival suspicious to her.
Since Zhang Fei was in the training space, Liu Qingyu decided to contact Zhang Xiaolong and inform him about the arrival of the three female moon foxes.
He asked her to monitor the three of them to ascertain their purpose in coming to the Chu Clan.
Since no one answered them, Hu Qianli then asked her two friends.
"What should we do now?"
"What else?" Hu Hong then pointed to an inn, which was not far from the Chu Clan.
"We can't possibly break into this clan, so we have no choice but to wait for Zhang Fei to come out of this clan on his own, and we will continue to monitor this clan from that inn."

"I'm feeling tired after flying for so long, so we can go to that inn to rest, and I hope Zhang Fei will come out soon." Hu Qianli and Hu Hong immediately walked towards the inn, but Hu Xiufu hesitated to follow them, causing the two to turn to her.
"What are you going to do?
Are you going to keep waiting in front of the clan?"

"You guys can go to the inn first, and I will wait in this clan for some time before catching up with you two." Hearing that, Hu Qianli and Hu Hong immediately left her, and Hu Xiufu repeatedly looked at the Chu Clan. 'Sigh!
Why didn't any of them respond to us?
Could it be that they are suspicious of our arrival?'
Just as she was thinking about that, Hu Xiufu suddenly felt a strong pressure on her bloodline, which came from another direction, so she tried to find the source.
However, a man suddenly appeared in front of her, and before she could react, he had already taken her away from the area.
Liu Qingyu, who witnessed it, immediately moved to the barier's side, and her expression became serious, especially since she was familiar with Zhang Fei's abilities.
"So that guy just now was the heavenly fox he told me about before?
He also has the same teleportation ability as him."
After that, Liu Qingyu once again contacted Zhang Xiaolong and told him about Tian Wangzi's action of kidnapping Hu Xiufu.
In response, he asked her not to leave the Chu Clan, particularly since it would be difficult for him to save her if she fell into his hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 Tian Jiyuan
paragraphs: "Ahh!" Hu Xiufu screamed loudly after Tian Wangzhi threw her into the haystack, but she was stunned when she found out that he and Tian Gongzhu were fox beasts like her. However, she also realized that their bloodline and cultivation were stronger than hers, especially since their pressure on her bloodline was too strong. 'Who exactly are they? Why did they kidnap me?'

"You don't need to be afraid of us; we just want to ask you a question. We can't do it in public, especially since we don't want people to know about us, so my brother brought you here." Tian Gongzhu then approached Hu Xiufu before lifting her chin. "What is your relationship with Zhang Fei? Why are you and your two friends looking for him?"
Even though Tian Gongzhu had said that, Hu Xiufu still looked afraid of him. "I... I don't know Zhang Fei, and we came here because our elder ordered us to seduce him."

"Haha!" Tian Wangzhi laughed at Hu Xiufu's answer and then mocked her. "Your elder is truly naive and idiotic! Do you think that lowly moon foxes like the three of you can seduce a heavenly fox like Zhang Fei? Even though your race is a divine beast, it is still inferior to a mythical beast race like ours, so you guys can only dream of seducing him."
'A heavenly fox? What kind of fox race is that? Is Zhang Fei's fox race truly superior to our moon fox race? Hu Xiufu wondered in her heart as she stared at Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu in fear.
Tian Wangzhi then spoke to Tian Gongzhu. "You should use your ability to read this girl's memories now, so we can get more information about Zhang Fei."

Tian Gongzhu nodded before touching Hu Xiufu's forehead, and she immediately closed her eyes to read her memories. However, she was disappointed because she didn't know much about Zhang Fei, and she immediately opened her eyes again before telling Tian Wangzhi. "This girl has never met him, and her elder did not provide any information about him other than his image.
I believe he has a connection with that clan, particularly since she and her two friends were looking for him there, but that protective formation is too strong for us to break in."
"Tch!" Tian Wangzhi gritted his teeth in annoyance. "Where does your race live? What level of cultivation do your elders have?"

"We... we live in the central region, and our elders' cultivation has already reached the sovereign realm, with the highest among them having reached the 3-Star." Tian Wangzhi frowned after he heard Hu Xiufu's answer, especially since his cultivation and Tian Gongzhu were only in the Heaven Realm, so they wouldn't be able to fight them even if their bloodline was higher than theirs. "I...
I've already told you, so I hope you're willing to let me go now."

"Do you think we'll let you go?" Hu Xiufu became even more frightened, but her expression immediately changed, and her eyes also looked strange, especially after Tian Gongzhu used her charm ability on her. "This girl is quite pretty and attractive, and her body is also sexy, so I will bring her back to our realm to accompany me."

Tian Wangzhi could only shake his head as he listened to Tian Gongzhu, especially since she was indeed a lily. Even so, he admitted that Hu Xiufu was quite attractive, and he was also tempted to get her. "Let's go! We have to go to that city again to find out more about Zhang Fei."

Tian Gongzhu immediately brought Hu Xiufu, who looked crazy about her, to her feet, and they followed Tian Wangzhi to the Heavenly Sword City. The two heavenly foxes immediately used their transformation technique to change their appearance to human-like, but it was still midnight in that realm, so they couldn't find many people wandering around in that city.

They decided to look for the liveliest place in the city, and they finally arrived in an area not far from Hua Luo. Tian Wangzhi licked his lips as he looked at the many women standing in front of the brothel, especially since all of them had curvy bodies, and their bodies were only covered by thin dresses, leaving their breasts exposed before his eyes.
Their attention suddenly turned to two women talking on the second-floor balcony, and they were talking about Zhang Fei, so the two heavenly foxes decided to eavesdrop on their conversation.

The two women were none other than members of the demon fox group, and Liu Qingyu deliberately ordered them to talk about Zhang Fei according to his request, especially since he wanted to lure the two heavenly foxes to go to the Northern Region.
After they eavesdropped on the two women, the two heavenly foxes exchanged glances for a moment before asking Hu Xiufu. "Do you know anything about that region?"

"Yes." Hu Xiufu answered with a nod. "The northern region is a nest of heretics, and they are constantly trying to take over this realm, so I don't understand why Zhang Fei decided to go to that region, especially since my elder told us that his cultivation is still low."
"Do you know anything about the cultivation of heretics?" Tian Gongzhu asked Hu Xiufu.

Hu Xiufu shook her head in response to her question. "I don't know much about them, but I heard that they are very powerful, and our leader doesn't even dare fight them head-on, so their cultivation should be in the sovereign realm or higher.

Moreover, the demons from other realms have invaded this realm in the past, and those heretics are their minions, so you shouldn't go to that region, or you'll be in big trouble if they find out about your presence. They might capture you and use your body as a cultivation furnace, just like they did with female cultivators in the past."

Tian Gongzhu did not dare to underestimate Hu Xiufu's warning, especially since they did not have much information about the Sky Jade Realm. Naturally, she didn't want those heretics to capture her, let alone use her body as a cultivation furnace, so she immediately turned to Tian Wangzhi. "What do you think if we call one of our seniors to come here?

If those heretics' cultivation has truly reached the sovereign realm or higher, then there's no way we can go to that region, especially since it's too risky for us, and we will never be able to find Zhang Fei."

Tian Wangzhi wasn't a fool either, so he wouldn't act recklessly by going to the Northern Region with just the three of them, and he immediately nodded in agreement with Tian Gongzhu. "In that case, we must leave this city now, and I will return to our realm to report our discovery to Ancestor Baitian, so he can send one of the seniors to help us."

After the three of them disappeared from the place, the two women in the Hua Luo decided to report their plan to Liu Qingyu, who immediately informed Zhang Xiaolong. That way, he could face the worst-case scenario if the heavenly fox race sent stronger cultivators to capture him.

After they arrived on the outskirts of the city, Tian Wangzhi opened a portal to the Heavenly Moon Realm and entered it, surprising Hu Xiufu, who immediately asked Tian Gongzhu. "Sister, can you tell me about your race? Why have I never heard of the heavenly fox race before? Why did you come from another realm to specifically look for Zhang Fei?"

"Haha." Tian Gongzhu laughed before bringing Hu Xiufu to sit on a rock. "Honestly, I myself, like you, don't know anything about Zhang Fei. Our ancestors asked us to come to this realm to keep an eye on him, and we can't disobey their orders, but they didn't tell us the reasons behind their decisions."

Tian Gongzhu then told Hu Xiufu about the ten-tailed fox that used to live in the Sky Jade Realm, and she also told her that the name of the realm in the past was the Heaven Wilderness Realm, which was only inhabited by beasts and natural races.

Hu Xiufu looked shocked after hearing all that, but she was even more shocked when Tian Gongzhu told him that the ten-tailed fox split into two foxes, and those two foxes were the first two heavenly foxes to be born in their universe, so their bloodline is superior to all other fox races, including the moon fox race.
Additionally, Tian Gongzhu also told Hu Xiufu about the Heavenly Moon Realm, including the peaceful life in that realm, especially since only the heavenly fox race lived there.
Tian Gongzhu then gave Hu Xiufu a quick kiss on the lips. "I like you, so I want to take you to our realm, and your cultivation can improve faster if you stay there with me."

"Actually, I myself feel fed up with the situation in our sub-realm, especially since our leaders and seniors are too ambitious to rule this realm, and they only consider us as their tools." Tian Gongzhu didn't look surprised by that, and Hu Xiufu took the bottle containing the love potion.
"Elder Qiaomu even ordered me and my two friends to use all means to seduce Zhang Fei, including this potion and our bodies."

"Oh?" Tian Gongzhu immediately took the bottle, opened the cap, and sniffed it. "Haha! If you use this potion on other beasts or humans, they might succumb to you right away. However, heavenly foxes like Zhang Fei and us are different from them, so this potion won't affect us. Instead, if you use this potion on him, it will be you who suffers, and you will undoubtedly succumb to his influence.
"Do all heavenly foxes have such an ability, Sister?" Hu Xiufu curiously asked.

"Yes." Tian Gongzhu replied with a nod. "I don't know the extent of Zhang Fei's abilities, but I can tell you that our race has a deadly charm, and it is further strengthened by our charm ability. No one can escape our influence if we use our ability on them, and I've used it on you, so you're mine forever."

Hu Xiufu pouted her lips in response to her confession, but the effect of Tian Gongzhu's ability made her not care about it. Moreover, she had wanted to separate herself from the moon fox race for a long time, but she did not have the ability to do so, and he could help her. "In that case, I will go with you, Sister."
"That's good." Tian Gongzhu once again kissed Hu Xiufu on the lips, but a portal suddenly opened in front of them, and Tian Wangzhi had already returned with a middle-aged man.

Seeing the middle-aged man, Tian Gongzhu immediately stood up from his seat and saluted him. "Senior Tian Jiyuan, I am glad that you have come here to help us! Since your cultivation has reached the Quasi-Divine realm, it should be easy for us to look for Zhang Fei's whereabouts in the Northern Region, and those heretics won't be able to do anything to us."
"Yeah." Tian Jiyuan then raised his eyebrows as he looked at Hu Xiufu. "A moon fox, huh? Did you use your charm ability on him, Gongzhu?"
"Hehehe." Tian Gongzhu giggled as she nodded. "This girl is lovely and sexy, right? I liked her and wanted to take her with me, so I used it on her."
Tian Jiyuan did not comment on that and turned towards the northern region. "Wangzhi said that the region was inhabited by heretics who conspired with demons from another realm; is that true?"
"Yes, Senior!" Tian Gongzhu replied excitedly. "As a native of this realm, Xiufu told us about it, so it should be true."
Tian Jiyuan then glanced at Hu Xiufu, who immediately told them a few other things, especially about the demon cave, the demon portal, and the seal.

"I can't care about all that, and our focus is only on finding Zhang Fei, so we should go to the Northern Region right now." After he said that, Tian Jiyuan turned into a giant heavenly fox with six white tails dancing behind him. "You guys, get on my back now, and I'll take you directly to that region."
Tian Wangzhi was the first to jump onto their senior's back, followed by Tian Gongzhu, who brought Hu Xiufu with him, and Tian Jiyuan immediately took all of them to disappear from that place.

Shortly after they left, Sabina and Persix appeared in the area, especially since the Dryad leader had been monitoring the entire area in the western region through all the trees that lived in the region, so she could know the presence and conversations of the heavenly foxes.

"I didn't expect that several other heavenly foxes would come to this realm, and it might be because the gate Zhang Fei opened before was the gate to their realm, so they learned of his presence in this realm from Pang De. Moreover, they seem to be targeting him, and their senior is too strong with his cultivation in the quasi-divine realm, so no cultivator in this realm can defeat him."
"What do you think we should do now?" Persix asked Sabina with a serious expression.

"He is in the Northern Region now, and that heavenly fox has abilities on par with him, so we will definitely be late." Sabina immediately contacted Zhang Fei via his clone, and she warned him about Tian Jiyuan's arrival. "I've contacted him, so it all depends on him. However, I'm sure that he'll be fine, especially since he still has many other unusual abilities."

"I hope so." After that, Sabina and Persix disappeared from that place, but they also told the other leaders of the natural races about the presence of the three heavenly foxes, especially Tian Jiyuan, who was the strongest among them.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 6,500 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 65 green jewels sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Xiaolong, who had just completed the daily quest, immediately opened his eyes. He hurriedly opened his map after he heard the messages from Liu Qingyu and Sabina. "A quasi-divine realm beast, huh?"

[What are your plans now, Master? Tian Jiyuan is too powerful, and no one can help you right now. Moreover, he also has the ability to switch realms like you, so you will have a hard time escaping from him.]
