Tian Wangzhi was the first to jump onto their senior's back, followed by Tian Gongzhu, who brought Hu Xiufu with him, and Tian Jiyuan immediately took all of them to disappear from that place.

Shortly after they left, Sabina and Persix appeared in the area, especially since the Dryad leader had been monitoring the entire area in the western region through all the trees that lived in the region, so she could know the presence and conversations of the heavenly foxes.

"I didn't expect that several other heavenly foxes would come to this realm, and it might be because the gate Zhang Fei opened before was the gate to their realm, so they learned of his presence in this realm from Pang De.
Moreover, they seem to be targeting him, and their senior is too strong with his cultivation in the quasi-divine realm, so no cultivator in this realm can defeat him."
"What do you think we should do now?" Persix asked Sabina with a serious expression.

"He is in the Northern Region now, and that heavenly fox has abilities on par with him, so we will definitely be late." Sabina immediately contacted Zhang Fei via his clone, and she warned him about Tian Jiyuan's arrival.
"I've contacted him, so it all depends on him.
However, I'm sure that he'll be fine, especially since he still has many other unusual abilities."

"I hope so." After that, Sabina and Persix disappeared from that place, but they also told the other leaders of the natural races about the presence of the three heavenly foxes, especially Tian Jiyuan, who was the strongest among them.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 6,500 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 65 green jewels sent to the inventory.]
Zhang Xiaolong, who had just completed the daily quest, immediately opened his eyes.
He hurriedly opened his map after he heard the messages from Liu Qingyu and Sabina.
"A quasi-divine realm beast, huh?"
[What are your plans now, Master?
Tian Jiyuan is too powerful, and no one can help you right now.
Moreover, he also has the ability to switch realms like you, so you will have a hard time escaping from him.]

chapters.title: Chapter 373 Zhang Xiaolong's Plans
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong smiled faintly as he looked at the map. "Honestly, I still don't want to go to that place, especially since my strength is still not enough to deal with its inhabitants. However, I have no other choice now, so I will lure those heavenly foxes there, and I hope they have the guts to follow me."

[Master, I think it's not a problem for you to go to that place, especially since you have your invisibility ability and the others. However, I'm not sure if those heavenly foxes dare to follow you, especially since the aura in that place will still affect them even if they have the light element.]
"Yeah." Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei. "Before I lure them to that place, I will use them to reduce the number of those heretics, so our enemies will be even fewer."

Zhang Xiaolong then contacted Xie Jingxian, Pang Hong, and Pang Gui. He asked them to spread the news of the arrival of the three heavenly foxes to those heretic clans, especially the Pang Clan, because those ancestors went into seclusion in that clan.
[Haha! Master, you are truly evil!]

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong chuckled in response. "Naturally, I can't throw away every opportunity that comes my way, right? Since Tian Jiyuan's cultivation has reached the quasi-divine realm, and he came here to hunt me down, I have to take advantage of him, right?"

As Zhang Xiaolong ordered, his three slaves immediately moved to spread the news of the arrival of the three heavenly foxes, and those clans immediately sent some of their strong men to confront them. Even Heltia, who controlled Mo Xuanqing, was confident enough to face them by herself.
After he saw the movement of those people on his map, Zhang Xiaolong immediately left his hiding place, using his invisibility, and disappeared into the darkness of the night sky.

With his cultivation and teleportation ability, Tian Jiyuan had already arrived in the center area of the Northern Region, and the three foxes on his back immediately came down from above him, allowing him to return to his human form.

"Hmm?" Tian Jiyuan immediately frowned when he sensed the aura of many heretic cultivators heading their way, and he immediately spoke to the three of them. "Those heretics are on their way here, and the strongest among them is at the 1-Star Sovereign Realm. Moreover, I can smell the scent of a demon from that person, so you guys should be careful."
"Yes, Senior." Tian Wangzhi, Tian Gongzhu, and Hu Xiufu answered at the same time. They then took out their respective weapons and enveloped their bodies with their light element.
As for Tian Jiyuan, he stood in his spot with a relaxed manner, especially since those heretics were clearly not his match, and he could kill them whenever he wanted.

Zhang Xiaolong watched the four of them from behind the darkness of the night, but he was more interested in Hu Xiufu and Tian Gongzhu, so he thought of a way to capture them, especially since their Yin Qi and beast essence would be very useful to him.

After they waited for some time, Mo Xuanqing and the other heretics arrived at the area, but they became tense after they saw Tian Jiyuan, especially since they couldn't sense his cultivation. Before they could react, he had already released his aura and enveloped them with it, and he also exerted his pressure on them, causing them to fall to the ground instantly.

"Do you think weak cultivators like you can block my way?" Tian Jiyuan asked as he walked towards them, but he then stopped in front of Mo Xuanqing before grabbing her neck, and he lifted her up. "You are the demon who invaded this realm in the past, right? You don't need to deny it, as I have the ability to see into your soul.
Since there are two souls in this body, your soul has taken control of this woman's body."
Tian Jiyuan's words shocked Mo Xuanqing, especially since no one should be able to know about it, and she asked him with a trembling voice. "Who... who are you?"

"A lowly demon like you is not worthy to know my name." Tian Jiyuan then touched Mo Xuanqing's chest and poured his light qi into her body, causing her to scream in pain, especially since the light element was the nemesis of darkness cultivators and demons. "Let's see how long you can last under my light element torture."
"Argh!" As she continued to scream in pain, Mo Xuanqing struggled to break free from Tian Jiyuan's grip, but her efforts were in vain, with their cultivation gap three major levels apart.

The other heretic cultivators, who were still suppressed on the ground by Tian Jiyuan, were horrified by his actions against Mo Xuanqing. They believed that he would also torture them, so they directly told the members of their clans not to leave their residence, and they also asked them to activate the barrier in their clan.

In the end, Heltia decided to abandon Mo Xuanqing's body, and she turned into black smoke to escape from that place. However, Tian Jiyuan would not let her escape so easily, and he immediately threw a white net towards her, trapping her within it.

Heltia struggled to escape, but the white net actually entangled her body even tighter, and her current form couldn't get out of it. 'Damn it! What kind of net is this? How can this net lock up my soul?'

"Heh!" Tian Jiyuan snorted and threw the still unconscious Mu Xuanqing to the ground. However, he frowned at her sudden disappearance, and immediately spread his senses throughout the area to search for her.
Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu also spread their senses to investigate the area around them, but unfortunately, their efforts were in vain, especially since they could not detect anything.
"Damn it! Where did that woman go?" Tian Wangzhi wondered as he cursed.

Tian Gongzhu immediately spoke to Tian Jiyuan. "Senior brother, could it be that the person who took the woman away had the invisibility ability like our ancestor? Do you think that guy is the culprit? After all, he is the only heavenly fox living in this realm, so I am sure he is the culprit."
"Yes." Tian Jiyuan nodded in agreement with Tian Gongzhu. "I'm sure that the culprit must be him, and he must have the invisibility ability like Ancestor Baitan."

"How can Zhang Fei move that fast with his cultivation still in the soul realm, senior brother?" Tian Wangzhi asked Tian Jiyuan. "Moreover, your cultivation is in the quasi-divine realm, so your speed should be much faster than his, but you didn't even have time to react."
"Ahh!" Hu Xiufu's scream startled the three of them before Tian Jiyuan could finish his sentence, and she also vanished from that location.

"Shit!" Tian Gongzhu immediately cursed because she wanted to take Hu Xiufu with him, and she spun around on the spot while looking at the surrounding area. "Bastard! I know you're here! Return the girl to me! Otherwise, I'll make you regret it, and I'll kill everyone in the Chu Clan!"

Zhang Xiaolong was furious at Tian Gongzhu's threat, but he quickly controlled his anger, especially since there was no way he could do anything to her with Tian Jiyuan present among them. He then knocked Hu Xiufu unconscious, and he immediately sealed the cultivation of the two women before sending them into the training space.
*Bam*
The ground beneath Tian Gongzhu's feet exploded as she stomped her right leg onto the ground, and her expression was completely furious. "That bastard! I-"

"Enough." Tian Jiyuan immediately stopped Tian Gongzhu. "We are heavenly foxes, and our race is superior to humans, so you don't need to kill them. Moreover, Ancestor Baixing will find out about your actions, and she will punish you if you kill them."

Tian Gongzhu immediately swallowed her saliva as soon as Tian Jiyuan mentioned Tian Baixing's name, especially since their female ancestor could read their memories, and she didn't like it when they killed creatures that were weaker than them, especially humans.

"Since that girl has fallen into his hands, you can forget about her. Moreover, there are still two other moon foxes in the city, so you can take them with you." Tian Gongzhu looked disappointed to hear that, especially since Hu Qianli and Hu Hong were not as attractive as Hu Xiufu. However, she immediately nodded to Tian Jiyuan, who then walked over to Heltia and squatted down beside her.

"Are you curious about this net? This is a demon-suppressing net, and we purposely created it because there are so many demons trying to invade our realm. Moreover, they are much stronger than your demon race, but they can't escape from it, let alone a lowly demon like you.
Honestly, I never liked to help humans, especially since they are just stupid and greedy living beings, but I dislike demons like you even more."
"Argh!" Heltia once again let out a scream of pain, especially as Tian Jiyuan channeled his light qi into the net, and her soul quickly faded away. "Argh! Stop it! I'll die if you do this."
"Why should I care if you die?" Tian Jiyuan asked with a sneer. "Demons are the most disgusting creatures in this universe, and you all must die."
"Argh... No... I don't want to die!"

Unlike Tian Jiyuan and the two heavenly foxes, who did not care about Heltia's screams, the heretic cultivators were increasingly horrified by her screams, and they could see her soul continuing to fade as time passed.

In the end, Heltia's soul disappeared completely, so her screams were no longer heard in their ears, and Tian Jiyuan immediately stored the demon suppressing net into his storage ring. He then stood up and looked at those heretics, and he smiled faintly before shooting several light qi arrows at them, which directly penetrated their bodies and killed them from the inside.
After witnessing his actions, Tian Gongzhu pouted her lips and complained to Tian Jiyuan. "Senior brother! You forbade me to kill humans, but you killed so many humans yourself!"

"Haha." Tian Jiyuan laughed after listening to Tian Gongzhu's complaints. "Even though they are humans, they collaborated with that female demon. That's why they deserve to die, and Ancestor Baixing will not punish me for killing them."
Tian Jiyuan then looked up at the sky and calmly spoke. "I can't see you, but I'm sure that you're still here, so you should come out now, and we can talk."

However, Tian Jiyuan and the two heavenly foxes frowned as a gate appeared in the sky, and Zhang Xiaolong appeared in the middle of the gate. "Do you think I'll believe you? Although my cultivation is still below yours, I am not stupid, and I know that the three of you came to this realm to capture me, so I will not go down there.
If you really want to do it, then you can follow me, but only if you have the guts to do it."

After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong entered the gate directly, which caused them to frown even more. Without hesitation, Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu immediately rushed over and entered the gate as well, especially since they were so irritated that he looked down on them.
Moreover, they also have the ability to open gates like him, so they can leave at any time from that place if it is too dangerous for them.

Tian Jiyuan could only shake his head and sigh softly because his two juniors were too rash, especially since he could feel strong demon auras from the place behind the gate. Even so, he couldn't let them go there by themselves, so he immediately rushed into the gate, which immediately closed by itself.

Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu looked shocked as soon as they arrived in the realm, especially since there was only darkness there. Even so, they could see countless crystals in the location below them, and they provide dim lighting to the entire area.

Tian Jiyuan, who appeared behind them, immediately informed them. "I don't know why he chose this realm, but it is definitely a demon realm, so you two better cover yourselves with your light qi. Furthermore, I can sense that this realm has many powerful demons, some stronger than me, so you two must be careful. Otherwise, I won't be able to save you, and we might die in this place."

"What?" Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu exclaimed as they turned to Tian Jiyuan, and they immediately enveloped their bodies with their light qi. "Do you know where this demon realm is located, Senior Brother? Is this realm in the lower, middle, or upper realms?"

"I don't know." Tian Jiyuan answered with a shake of his head. "Anyway, we can't stay in this realm for too long, or the demon aura in this realm will affect us, and we will turn into demon beasts. That's why we must move quickly to find him, and we will leave this realm immediately after we succeed in doing so."

"But how are we going to find that bastard, senior brother?" Tian Gongzhu inquired as she surveyed their surroundings. "That bastard has an invisibility ability; even you can't sense his presence. Moreover, this realm seems to be much larger than our realm, and we will definitely have a hard time finding him."

Unlike her, Tian Wangzhi had a different opinion, and he asked Tian Jiyuan. "Do you think he is toying with us, senior brother? After all, the demon aura in this realm will also affect him, so I don't believe that he will hide here for too long, and he might have returned to the Sky Jade Realm by now."

"That possibility exists." Tian Jiyuan replied with an affirmative nod. "In that case, I want one of you to return to that realm and monitor that clan, and you can capture him directly if he appears there."
Unfortunately, they did not know that Zhang Xiaolong himself was a demon, so the demon aura in the realm would have no effect on him.
Tian Gongzhu immediately turned to Tian Wangzhi. "Brother! You must return to that realm now! I'll accompany our senior brother to look for that bastard in this realm."

After Tian Wangzhi disappeared from their sight, Tian Jiyuan and Tian Gongzhu immediately flew to look for Zhang Xiaolong, and they did so while suppressing their auras as much as possible, preventing the demons of the realm from detecting their presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 Netherworld Realm
paragraphs: [Ding]
[The host has arrived in the Netherworld Realm, and the system upgrade process begins.]
[Ding]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Netherworld Realm.]
[Ding]
[Quest: Go to one of the cities in the Netherworld Realm.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy Gift Pack x 1]
[Ding]
[Quest: Establish a relationship with a demon at Marquis rank and above.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Reward: Medium Gift Pack x 1]
[Ding]
[Quest: Explore the dead forest.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Reward: Hard Gift Pack x 1]
[Ding]
[Quest: Free the prisoner in the ancient sub-realm.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]

"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong, who was sitting relaxed on a big black tree in his incubus form, was surprised by the first notification. After all, the system had just been upgraded to level three a while ago, but it had already started the upgrade process again.

Even so, he was also excited about it, especially since he always got a new feature every time the system finished upgrading, and he was looking forward to the new feature. "Hey, Mei! It appears that the creator is really directing me to choose my demon side, especially since the system has always given me more quests while I was in the demon realm.

In the Sky Jade Realm, I never got any quests other than a daily quest, and in the Tian Realm, I only got one quest, but in this place, I got four quests. Sigh! The darkness of this realm is particularly ominous in comparison to the Diyu Realm. Anyway, what about the flow of time in this place?"

Mei herself doesn't have an answer about that because the system always runs automatically, and the creator created her specifically to monitor the system. [Master, the time flow in this realm is the same as in the Sky Jade Realm, so it is four times faster than on Earth.]
"Oh? I think that's good." Zhang Xiaolong muttered as he nodded in satisfaction.

[So what will you do now, Master? Are you going to do the quest right away? If you go to one of the cities in this realm, I'm sure those heavenly foxes won't dare to follow you. Moreover, they can't stay in this realm for too long, or the demon aura here will affect and transform them into demon beasts, and they will not be able to return to the Heavenly Moon Realm anymore.]
"Isn't that great? I have been curious for a long time about this realm, especially since the demons here are much stronger compared to Oz and the others.

That's why I was going to the nearest town to complete the first quest, but I had to wait for the system to finish scanning this realm first." Zhang Xiaolong suddenly remembered that he had not opened the three rewards from the three quests he got from the Amaris Twin's sub-realm. "Mei, open the three rewards."
[Yes, Master.]
{You got Demon Coins x1000}
{You got Nine Demon Secret Scripture x1}
{You got Moon Demon Wheel x1}
"1000 demon coins from the normal gift pack, right?"
[Yes, Master. I will show you the other two.]
[Nine Demon Secret Scripture: This technique has nine sub-techniques, and each sub-technique was created by a different demon. Requirements: Duke Rank.]
[Moon Demon Wheel: This artifact was created by the Moon Demon, and it can be used for both offense and defense at the same time. Grade: Earth Grade.]

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong raised his eyebrows after he saw the two notifications, but he ignored the nine demon secret scriptures, especially since the Duke Rank was still far from his reach. He then took out the moon demon wheel from the system inventory, and it was pitch black with several small blades on its side. "How do you think this weapon compares to the demon extermination sword, Mei?"

[Master, the demon extermination sword is a soul weapon, so it is superior if you compare it to this earth-grade demon wheel. Moreover, your sword is not yet perfect, and there are some parts missing, so it will be even stronger once you have perfected it.

Even so, this demon wheel is quite useful because it moves according to your will, so you can use it to protect your rear, especially when many enemies surround you. In addition, it has a darkness element, so you can use it to fight against winged races or cultivators with a light element.]
"Yeah, you're right." Zhang Xiaolong then tried to use the moon demon wheel, and it actually moved according to his wishes, which made him quite satisfied.
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Netherworld Realm has been completed, so the host can check the entire area via the map.]

After the notification appeared, Zhang Xiaolong immediately stored the moon demon wheel, opened the map, and searched for the location of the dead forest. The forest was not far from his current location, especially it was also located right in the middle of the realm.
As for the ancient sub-realm, the system could not detect its location, so he chose to ignore it for the time being, and he intended to find information about it from the demons in the realm.

However, Zhang Xiaolong only saw a few large cities in the Netherworld Realm, and all of them were scattered far from each other. Lust City, which was in the northeast, was the closest one to his location.

Although Lust City was the closest city, Zhang Xiaolong estimated that it would take seven to ten days to get there, especially since the realm was several times larger than the Sky Jade Realm. Even so, he was confident that he could arrive there faster as long as he continued to use his Nine Cloud Steps, but he also had to continuously swallow Qi recovery pills to be able to do so. "Sigh!
This realm is so big and vast, but there are not many cities in this realm, and the distance between each large city is so far apart."
[Are you going to Lust City now, Master?]

Zhang Xiaolong didn't answer Mei straight away, especially since he saw several red dots on the map, which indicated that they were people who were hostile to him. Moreover, four of them were gathered in Lust City, and another red dot was in Black Moon City, which was located far to the south.

"Haha!" Zhang Xiaolong laughed loudly after he saw the names of the four people in Lust City, especially since they are Zhao Yun, Huan Ning, Yu Xixuan, and Lu Xin. "I didn't expect that they were still alive, even though they had spent their time for so long in this realm, but they should have become demons by now.
Unfortunately, of all the men I sent to this realm before, there were only two of them left alive, and Yin Tong seemed to be comfortable living in Black Moon City."

Zhang Xiaolong smiled faintly when he saw Tian Jiyuan and Tian Gongzhu's names quite far away from his location, and he immediately stood up as he looked towards the northeast. "Since they were gathered there, I'll go there to finish the quest and check on those four people."
Zhang Xiaolong did not immediately use his movement technique, and he chose to fly around the outside of the dead forest to check it, especially since the second quest tasked him to explore it.

Mei suddenly informed Zhang Xiaolong of her discovery. [Master, I detected a bewildering formation in this forest, and I also detected a sign of life in the heart of this forest, so I think the formation was deliberately set up in this forest to prevent other demons from going there.]

After Mei said that, a new red dot suddenly appeared on the map, and it came from the heart of the dead forest. He then touched the red dot, but he immediately frowned because nothing appeared there. "Unknown? Why does this red dot only reveal the unknown?'
[Perhaps the living being in the heart of this forest has long been sealed, so the creator also doesn't have any information about the creature, Master.] Mei expressed her assumption.

Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei, but he could feel a faint, powerful aura coming from the heart of the dead forest, which he believed belonged to the mysterious living being. "Do you think the fourth quest has something to do with that mysterious creature, Mei?"

[That's possible, Master. However, it will be best if you don't go there for the time being, especially since the formation is too powerful, and there are so many demon beasts that are much stronger than you are there.]

"Forget it! I'll go to Lust City first, and I'll look for information about this forest and the mysterious creature from the demons living in that city." After he said that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately used the Nine Cloud Steps and rushed towards the northeast area, which was where the city was located.
Time quickly passed in the Netherworld Realm.

Tian Jiyuan and Tian Gongzhu, who were still trying to find Zhang Xiaolong, were annoyed because they still couldn't find him. Moreover, there were many flying demons trying to attack them, so they were forced to fight with them.

"Damn it! Why did that bastard have to escape into this disgusting realm?" Tian Gongzhu then killed the last demon before asking Tian Jiyuan. "What are we going to do now, senior brother? I am becoming more and more uncomfortable staying in this realm, especially since this demon aura is starting to affect me.
I'm worried that I will turn into a demon beast if we continue to stay here, so I think we should return to that realm first, and we can report this matter to Ancestor Baitian."

Tian Jiyuan nodded in agreement with that, especially since he himself began to feel the influence of the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm, so he immediately opened a portal leading to the Sky Jade Realm before bringing Tian Gongzhu to enter it.
As soon as they arrived in that realm, the two of them immediately headed to the western region, specifically the Heavenly Sword City, to meet Tian Wangzhi.
"How did it go? Did you see him in that clan?" Tian Jiyuan asked Tian Wangzhi as soon as they landed on his side.
"No." Tian Wangzhi answered with a shake of his head. "I've been waiting since earlier, but not a single member of that clan left their residence, and I didn't see him come here either."

Hearing that, Tian Gongzhu immediately expressed her idea. "Senior brother, we can't kill these humans, but we can at least interrogate them, right? That way, we can get additional information about that bastard, and we might be able to find him in other places."
After he thought about it, Tian Jiyuan agreed with Tian Gongzhu's idea, and he immediately moved towards the Chu Clan before destroying the barrier, which caused the clan's residents to panic.

Tian Jiyuan and the two heavenly foxes immediately entered the Chu Clan, but they couldn't find Liu Qingyu and Zhang Fei's family members there, especially since his other clone had already evacuated them to the training space when they chased Zhang Xiaolong to the Netherworld Realm, and he also cut off the connection from the teleportation device to the Liu Clan.
The three of them then interrogated everyone living in the Chu Clan, but none of them knew about the whereabouts of Liu Qingyu and the others. "Does Zhang Fei have any relations with other clans?"
"I don't know." The guard answered by shaking his head. "We are just guards and servants, so we don't know anything about our young master's relationship."
"Then, what about your master? Where is he now?" This time, it was Tian Wangzhi who asked the guard, as he used his aura to scare him.

Tian Wangzhi's actions caused the guard to break out in a cold sweat, and he responded with a trembling body. "Our... master has not been living in this clan for a long time, and he is currently in the northern region to help others stabilize the seal in the demon cave."
"The demon cave?" The guard nodded repeatedly to Tian Jiyuan. "Is the demon cave the origin of those demons from the other realm?"
"Yes..." The guard then told them about the invasion of the demons that came from another realm in the past, and his story was consistent with Hu Xiufu's, so they did not doubt him.

Tian Jiyuan suddenly realized something before speaking to his two juniors. "If I think about it, the aura of the female demon I killed before was the same as the previous demon realm, so the demons that invaded this realm in the past were demons from there."
"Does that mean that bastard has a relationship with those demons, senior brother?" Tian Gongzhu asked with a raised eyebrow.

However, Tian Jiyuan immediately denied Tian Gongzhu's guess with a shake of his head. "Judging by his bone age, that kid shouldn't be even twenty years old yet, so he can't possibly have any connection with those demons. However, I'm also confused as to how he managed to open the gate to that realm, especially since we can only open the gate to another realm after we go there."

Several questions suddenly appeared in Tian Wangzhi's mind. "Is it possible that that kid has been to that realm before? How could he go into that realm with his current cultivation? Could there be beasts of the same race as us in this realm, besides him?"

"That's impossible, brother!" Yun Gongzhu spoke while shaking her head. "Ancestor Baitian and Ancestor Baixin told us that they have brought all members of our race to our current realm, so there should be no members of our race left in this realm except for that bastard."

chapters.title: Chapter 375 Revisit The Death Valley
paragraphs: Since they couldn't find anyone in the Chu clan, Tian Jiyuan took the other two to leave the clan, but they didn't leave the heavenly sword city, and they continue to watch over the clan from the same inn as the two moon foxes.

Tian Gongzhu, who was still upset because Hu Xiufu fell into Zhang Fei's hands, immediately sneaked into Hu Hong and Hu Qianli's rooms. She found the two of them were in deep sleep and didn't notice her presence, so she immediately used her charm abilities on them, causing Tian Jiyuan and Tian Wangzhi to be slightly overwhelmed by her actions.
Unbeknownst to them, the leader of the dryads, Sabina, was constantly monitoring them through the trees in the city, as she wanted to ensure the safety of Zhang Fei and those close to him.

"Senior Brother, what do you think if we contact Ancestor Baixing and ask her to come to this realm?" Tian Jiyuan raised his eyebrows at Tian Wangzhi. "After all, she has the ability to read other people's memories, and I'm sure Zhang Fei has some connections with the people in this city, so she can read their memories to make it easier for us to find him."

"Do you know why Ancestor Baitian and Ancestor Baixing sent us to this realm?" Tian Wangzhi responded to Tian Jiyuan by shaking his head. "As you already know, our true anestor was the ten-tailed fox, and he separated himself into our two anestors in the past. However, he placed a restriction on them, so they couldn't come to this realm anymore.
Moreover, their cultivation had surpassed the Seven Divine Realms, and the qi in this realm would be rapidly depleted if they came here, which would only cause destruction to this realm. "
Tian Wangzhi nodded in understanding. "What about you, senior brother? Didn't you almost break into the Seven Divine Realm?"

"Haha." That made Tian Jiyuan laugh. "You are not wrong about that, but I will not break through to that stage in the near future, especially since breaking through to the Seven Divine Realm is not easy. We must face lightning tribulation to purify our body and soul, and the power of our lightning tribulation varies based on our karma.

If we have a lot of good karma, then it will not be too strong, but vice versa, it will be very strong if we have too much bad karma. That's why our ancestors always emphasized that we cannot kill indiscriminately, and we can only kill those who attack us first."
"What do you think our ancestors would do to Zhang Fei?"

"I don't know." Tian Jiyuan answered with a shake of his head. "They only ordered us to watch Zhang Fei and talk to him; they also asked us to bring him to them if possible. However, they didn't explain their real reason to me, so I have no idea about their plans for that kid."

Tian Wangzhi let out a soft sigh as he was truly curious about their ancestors' plans for Zhang Fei, especially since their decision was so sudden, but he did not dare ask Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing about it directly.
Tian Jiyuan then patted Tian Wangzhi on the shoulder. "You don't need to be too curious about their reasons, and we just need to carry out their orders well, or they will punish us."
"I know."

Inside the training space, Zhang Fei's fourth clone, Zhang Xiaogang, explained to Wang Zetian and the others about the arrival of the three heavenly foxes, and he asked them to focus on cultivating inside.

Although there was no Qi gathering formation inside the training space, it could be covered by the time flow inside, which was two times faster than the outside world, and they could also utilize other features inside to train.

Wang Zhuxian, Wang Xiaofeng, Ming Hao, and Ming Yanyu became the most enthusiastic among them, especially since they were still very young, and they had also witnessed Zhang Fei's abilities to some extent, so they were eager to train to become like him.

Older people like Wang Zetian, Dou Luotian, Ming Han, and Zhang Hanzhi felt that their physical bodies were not as strong as their younger generations, so they preferred to focus on their cultivation first, especially since the qi could help their bodies become stronger.
As for Qing Tan, she had been a cultivator a little longer than them, and she had also practiced in the training space many times before, so she joined the others to focus on her training.
After that, Zhang Chen pulled Zhang Xiaogang along with her, especially since she was worried about the safety of her grandson. "Are you sure your third clone will be okay out there?"

Zhang Xiaogang immediately explained to Zhang Chen that Zhang Xiaolong was in the Netherworld Realm, and the three heavenly foxes would never be able to chase him there, especially since the demon aura in that realm would affect them. "This way, you don't have to worry anymore, okay?"

Even so, Zhang Chen still didn't feel relieved, and she immediately reminded her grandson. "You have to take good care of yourself, and your third clone better not look for trouble in the Netherworld Realm, okay?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaogang laughed upon hearing that. "Grandma, do you think I like to find trouble with other people? Instead, people often come to me seeking trouble, but rest assured, I won't be foolish enough to meddle in other people's affairs.
Moreover, I already know that the demons in that realm are too strong for me, so I will try to avoid them, and I will always take good care of myself in that realm."

Zhang Xiaogang then took out several bottles filled with yang qi and gave them to Zhang Chen, confusing her. That's why he directly conveyed his wishes to her, but his explanation actually made her feel strange and awkward.

Zhang Xiaogang could naturally understand Zhang Chen's feelings. "Grandma, I won't force you to swallow it, and you can decide for yourself. However, you should know that we love you very much, and we want you to stay by our side forever, so please think about it."
"All right." Zhang Chen herself didn't want to be separated from her family. "I'll think about it first."

"That's good." After that, Zhang Chen went to the other side to cultivate, so Zhang Xiaogang went over to Xu Ling'er, who was busy cultivating on the other side, and he also passed a few bottles of Yang qi to her.
Unlike Zhang Chen, Xu Ling'er did not feel the slightest bit hesitant, and she immediately opened one of the bottles before gulping it down, making Zhang Xiaogang laugh wryly at her antics.
Xu Ling'er then cleaned her mouth and stored the rest of the bottle in the storage ring. "Hehehe! My mom told me that your qi is tasteless, so I was curious to taste it, and I can taste it now."

"Don't worry, my original body has prepared a lot of Yang Qi stock for all of you, so you can continue to enjoy it later, and your cultivation will definitely increase faster." Zhang Xiaogang then lifted Xu Lin'er to her feet. "It should be morning on earth, so I'll take you back there for school, and I'll accompany you."

Xu Ling'er's expression turned gloomy once Zhang Xiaogang mentioned her school. "Big brother, I really don't want to go to school anymore, and I want to focus on my cultivation. Furthermore, Big Sis Ying and the others have never been to school, but they are not stupid, so I hope you can persuade my mother to agree to let me quit school."

Zhang Xiaogang sighed softly at Xu Ling'er's request, but he himself also thought that the schools on Earth were no longer useful for cultivators like them. "All right, I will discuss your wishes with Xue'er first, but you still have to go to school before she agrees to it, so I will take you to Earth right now."
After Xu Ling'er agreed, Zhang Xiaogang immediately asked Mei to open the gate to the earth, and they immediately returned there through it.

"My lords! Something happened in Death Valley! Something suddenly pulled Nadea, Ashreth, and Kyllia into the black castle. Feltia raised her eyebrows when a female demon reported the matter from outside the room. "My lords!"
Hearing the female demon's scream, the Amaris Twin immediately opened their eyes, and the two exchanged confused glances, especially since the black castle had never shown any reaction before.

The two immediately got out of bed and got dressed before ordering the female demon to come inside, and the white Amaris immediately asked her. "What exactly happened there? How did they get pulled into the black castle?"

"My lord, we don't know what exactly happened, but they are indeed inside the black castle now, and it happened really fast. Moreover, we don't have the power to breach the barrier, so I came here immediately to report this matter to you, and the others are still waiting there now."

After they heard that, the Amaris twins frowned, and the black Amaris immediately spoke to her twin sister. "We should go to the death valley to check it out as soon as possible, or we will lose valuable subordinates."

"Can I go with you two, my lords?" The Amaris twins turned to Feltia with a frown. "I feel bored to continue living in this tower, and you both know about my fighting abilities. That's why I want to go there, and I can protect myself if you remove this collar."

The black Amaris frowned, thinking that Feltia would escape if she removed the collar from her neck, but the white Amaris immediately spoke to her. "Sister, she will never be able to escape from us, so I think it's okay if you remove the collar, and she might be able to help us do something about the black castle."

"All right." The black Amaris immediately stretched her right hand forward, and the demon suppressing collar was immediately removed from Feltia's neck. "I will torture you if you try to escape, and I dare to guarantee that you will not like it."

"Haha." Instead, Feltia chuckled upon hearing the black Amaris's threat, and she immediately moved to their side before hugging their waists. "My lord, this tower is much more comfortable than my room in Lady Ashreth's pub, and I could also have fun with you two, so I would never think of running away."

'Tch! What a liar!' The white Amaris screamed cursingly in her heart, especially since she already knew about Feltia's true identity and relationship. Unfortunately, she couldn't say anything to the black Amaris about everything, so she could only keep her annoyance to herself.
The black Amaris nodded in satisfaction at Feltia. "It's good that you realize that, and I will make your life more comfortable if you can prove your loyalty to us."
Feltia smiled when she heard that, and she immediately kissed their lips in turns. "Shall we go now? Otherwise, we will be too late to save them, and they will probably die there."
After that, the Amaris Twins immediately took Feltia away from their tower, and they rushed towards the Death Valley at full speed.

In a few moments, the three of them had arrived at the Death Valley, and they were able to enter the place without any obstacles, especially since those demons are no longer controlled by Nauvia, and the presence of the Amaris Twins also puts a lot of pressure on them.

Soon, they had arrived at the deepest area of the Death Valley, but they found the three female demons lying unconscious on the ground. However, their expressions turned serious once they saw the other female demons' dried skeletons, and they knew that they had not been dead for long.
The Amaris Twins immediately examined the skeletons, and they were able to conclude that they died because their demon powers and essences were sucked dry.

Feltia herself was also surprised to see the skeletons, especially since Oz had not told her about the two Ursulas. She then approached the black castle and touched the barrier, and Mei immediately told her that it had been activated before. "Lords, I don't know what kind of creature is inside this castle, but I'm sure it came out from inside and killed them."

"Hmm?" The black Amaris immediately moved to Feltia's side and touched the barrier, but she couldn't feel any changes. "Are you sure about that? How can you assume that? Furthermore, I've never heard of any strange creatures in this castle, and there is only our ancestor's corpse in it."

Feltia herself had heard about that from Nauvia, so she was no longer surprised by that. "If that's true, I think your ancestor isn't dead yet, and she's probably been in deep sleep for hundreds or even thousands of years. Probably something woke her up, and she must have been very hungry after sleeping for so long, so she absorbed their demon powers and essences."
"Hey! Where did you come to such a conclusion? Can you check inside the black castle?" The white Amaris asked from a distance as she tried to wake up Ashreth and the two female demons.

"Since this castle is the resting place of your ancestor, and your sister said that there has never been any other creature inside it, I came to such a conclusion. Meanwhile, Feltia stood in front of the black castle, inwardly muttering to herself. 'If my guess is correct that their ancestor is still alive, she might have reached Empress Rank like Oz and the others, and she might be very dangerous, especially since she has been asleep for too long.'

If we have a lot of good karma, then it will not be too strong, but vice versa, it will be very strong if we have too much bad karma.
That's why our ancestors always emphasized that we cannot kill indiscriminately, and we can only kill those who attack us first."
"What do you think our ancestors would do to Zhang Fei?"
"I don't know." Tian Jiyuan answered with a shake of his head.
"They only ordered us to watch Zhang Fei and talk to him; they also asked us to bring him to them if possible.

Tian Wangzhi let out a soft sigh as he was truly curious about their ancestors' plans for Zhang Fei, especially since their decision was so sudden, but he did not dare ask Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing about it directly.
Tian Jiyuan then patted Tian Wangzhi on the shoulder.
"You don't need to be too curious about their reasons, and we just need to carry out their orders well, or they will punish us."
"I know."

Wang Zhuxian, Wang Xiaofeng, Ming Hao, and Ming Yanyu became the most enthusiastic among them, especially since they were still very young, and they had also witnessed Zhang Fei's abilities to some extent, so they were eager to train to become like him.

Older people like Wang Zetian, Dou Luotian, Ming Han, and Zhang Hanzhi felt that their physical bodies were not as strong as their younger generations, so they preferred to focus on their cultivation first, especially since the qi could help their bodies become stronger.
As for Qing Tan, she had been a cultivator a little longer than them, and she had also practiced in the training space many times before, so she joined the others to focus on her training.
After that, Zhang Chen pulled Zhang Xiaogang along with her, especially since she was worried about the safety of her grandson.
"Are you sure your third clone will be okay out there?"

Zhang Xiaogang immediately explained to Zhang Chen that Zhang Xiaolong was in the Netherworld Realm, and the three heavenly foxes would never be able to chase him there, especially since the demon aura in that realm would affect them.
"This way, you don't have to worry anymore, okay?"
Even so, Zhang Chen still didn't feel relieved, and she immediately reminded her grandson.
"You have to take good care of yourself, and your third clone better not look for trouble in the Netherworld Realm, okay?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaogang laughed upon hearing that.
"Grandma, do you think I like to find trouble with other people?
Instead, people often come to me seeking trouble, but rest assured, I won't be foolish enough to meddle in other people's affairs.
Moreover, I already know that the demons in that realm are too strong for me, so I will try to avoid them, and I will always take good care of myself in that realm."
Zhang Xiaogang then took out several bottles filled with yang qi and gave them to Zhang Chen, confusing her.
That's why he directly conveyed his wishes to her, but his explanation actually made her feel strange and awkward.
Zhang Xiaogang could naturally understand Zhang Chen's feelings.
"Grandma, I won't force you to swallow it, and you can decide for yourself.
However, you should know that we love you very much, and we want you to stay by our side forever, so please think about it."
"All right." Zhang Chen herself didn't want to be separated from her family.
"I'll think about it first."

"That's good." After that, Zhang Chen went to the other side to cultivate, so Zhang Xiaogang went over to Xu Ling'er, who was busy cultivating on the other side, and he also passed a few bottles of Yang qi to her.
Unlike Zhang Chen, Xu Ling'er did not feel the slightest bit hesitant, and she immediately opened one of the bottles before gulping it down, making Zhang Xiaogang laugh wryly at her antics.
Xu Ling'er then cleaned her mouth and stored the rest of the bottle in the storage ring.
"Hehehe!
My mom told me that your qi is tasteless, so I was curious to taste it, and I can taste it now."

"Don't worry, my original body has prepared a lot of Yang Qi stock for all of you, so you can continue to enjoy it later, and your cultivation will definitely increase faster." Zhang Xiaogang then lifted Xu Lin'er to her feet.
"It should be morning on earth, so I'll take you back there for school, and I'll accompany you."
Xu Ling'er's expression turned gloomy once Zhang Xiaogang mentioned her school.
"Big brother, I really don't want to go to school anymore, and I want to focus on my cultivation.
Furthermore, Big Sis Ying and the others have never been to school, but they are not stupid, so I hope you can persuade my mother to agree to let me quit school."
Zhang Xiaogang sighed softly at Xu Ling'er's request, but he himself also thought that the schools on Earth were no longer useful for cultivators like them.
"All right, I will discuss your wishes with Xue'er first, but you still have to go to school before she agrees to it, so I will take you to Earth right now."

chapters.title: Chapter 376 Talk With Ursula
paragraphs: "My lords?" Ashreth called out softly as she looked at the Amaris Twins with a tired face, especially since her power hadn't fully recovered.

Nadea, who had just opened her eyes, was also surprised by the presence of the Amaris twins. She immediately warned them. "My lords, you two should be careful; Ursula is not dead yet, and they have just woken up from their long slumber."

The Amaris twins looked shocked when they heard the name, and they naturally recognized their ancestors. They never knew that the two were still alive, especially since they had never been able to check inside the black castle.

"My lords, Ursula absorbed our demon powers and essences, and they also killed our friends." The Amaris twins immediately turned to Kyllia. "They told us that the presence of an unusual man in this place woke them up from their sleep, but they did not tell us about his identity."

Feltia, who was listening to them from a distance, raised her eyebrows immediately. 'Ursula should be their ancestors, right? I didn't expect that my arrival here would wake them up, but I don't understand why they didn't attack me if they could sense my presence from within their castle.'

[Master, they're here.] Just as Mei warned Feltia, Ursula had already appeared in front of them, causing them to become tense. [Master, despite having a single body, this woman is actually two people, and their demon rank is at the Empress level.]
Feltia immediately became alert after hearing that, especially since Ursula was too strong, and she didn't know anything about their characters. 'Show their status, Mei.'
[Wait a second.]
Name: Ursula (Dark + Light)
Age: 50,000+ years old
Gender: Female
Race: Devourer Demon
Rank: Empress
Elements: darkness and light
Physique: transcendent physique

Abilities: Demonic magic art, light art, devouring art, eyes of truth, transcend healing, regenerative healing factor, summoning, hypnosis, possession, demonic form, demonic force manipulation, illusion creation, illusion negation, illusionary binding, absolute immortality (within illusion), illusion empowermen, and so on.
Strong: light and darkness
Weak: darkness and light
'Devourer demon?' Feltia muttered inwardly as she read the rest of Ursula's status information, Her interest was piqued by some of their abilities, particularly their devouring art.

"Haha." Ursula chuckled as they stretched their hands forward, and they immediately pulled the Amaris Twins towards her before strangling their necks. "Haha! Actually, we still didn't want to come to you two, but you guys came to us on your own, so we won't let this opportunity pass."
Ursula didn't give the Amaris twins a chance to break free, and they immediately absorbed their demon powers and essences, causing both of them to groan in pain.
"Argh! Let me go!" As they screamed in pain, the Amaris Twin repeatedly punched Ursula's hand, and they tried to use their illusion on them.
Unfortunately, Urusla's demon rank was far above the Amaris Twin's, and they also mastered illusion abilities like them, so their illusions didn't work on them at all.

Feeling that she had no other way to escape, the White Amaris immediately used her light power to attack Ursula, but her efforts were unsuccessful. 'Damn it! They also have light power, and they absorb mine!'

However, the white Amaris's action greatly shocked the black Amaris, who had no idea that her twin sister possessed light power, and she felt that she had been deceived by her for thousands of years. Even Ashreth, Nadea, and Kyllia were shocked to see that he could use light power.

"Hahaha!" Ursula laughed at the actions of the Amaris twins. "Have you both forgotten that we are your ancestors? Naturally, we have the same abilities as you two, but we also have many abilities that you did not inherit. Even so, you two don't need to worry because we will not kill you, so you guys should stop struggling and let us absorb your demon powers and essence."
The black Amaris continued to glare at her twin sister as she endured the pain from Ursula's actions, which made the white Amaris feel guilty towards her.

After they were satisfied with absorbing the Amaris Twin's demon powers and essences, Ursula immediately let the two demon rulers fall to the ground. Their faces were completely pale as they were panting heavily, and they had difficulty moving their bodies.

"Hehehe! Thanks to your demon powers and essences, my power has been recovered by eighty percent now. Unfortunately, this is still not enough, and I need to recover my power as soon as possible." Ursula then looked at Felti and moved in front of her in the blink of an eye, and they immediately grabbed her cheeks before bringing their head closer to her ear.
'You may be able to deceive my descendants, but you cannot deceive me, and I know that you are the male human who met that young siren before.'

Feltia wasn't surprised by Ursula's words, especially since they had the eyes of truth, so she wouldn't be able to fool them. Even so, they seemed to have no intention of revealing her true identity, so she had no intention of doing so either, and she spoke to them via telepathy. 'You're right, I am human, but I'm also a demon.
Anyway, you don't need to think about absorbing my demon power or essence, especially since you won't be able to do it.'

"Oh?" Ursula looked at Feltia in surprise, but they didn't believe that they couldn't do that to her. That's why they immediately tried to do it, but the result was as per her words. "Interesting! You're still so young, and your demon rank is also only at Earl Rank, but we can't absorb your demon power and essence."

Unlike the Amaris twin, who had expected this to happen, Ashreth and the two female demons were truly shocked to hear that Ursula couldn't do something like that to Feltia despite their huge difference in strength and rank.

'Anyway, I can summon Oz, Zygoz, and Tharnon at once, so you guys won't be able to do anything to me.' Ursula raised their eyebrows when they heard that, but they immediately looked at the token in Feltia's hand. 'You may not know this yet, but one of your descendants is a traitor.
The white Amaris is in cahoots with those winged races, and the second demon emperor suspected that the black Amaris kidnapped Kinos the Cancer, so he sent me to keep an eye on them.'
Hearing that, Ursula immediately looked at the white Amaris with a muderous look, especially since they really hated the winged race, causing her to tremble in fear.

'Hey! You better not do anything to the white Amaris, especially since her life is in my hands now, and I still need her to increase my demon rank.' Ursula immediately returned her attention to Feltia. 'Oz has merged a portion of her soul with mine, so she is mine now.
If you insist on doing anything to her, I will summon the three of them to stop you, and you will be the one who suffers if they come here.'

Ursula frowned after hearing Feltia's threat, especially since no other demon dared to threaten them before, except for the two demon emperors and the two men. Even so, they didn't do anything to her and pulled back their hands immediately, but they continued to look at her with irritated looks.
'Phew!' Feltia let out a sigh of relief in her heart. "Can I take them back?"

"I still need them, and I won't let them go until my strength is fully restored." Ursula immediately rejected Feltia, enveloped them all in their demon aura, and immediately led them into the black castle.
'Damn it! Why did they bring us to this horrible place again?' Ashreth, Nadea, and Kyllia grumbled in their hearts as soon as they arrived inside the black castle.

"Hey! You three must take these two little girls to one of the rooms in that area, and all of you must come to me in the master bedroom after you all recover, or I will kill you all." Ursula ordered the three female demons as they pointed their fingers in a certain direction, and she then took Feltia away with her. "Do it now!"

Feeling the pressure of Ursula's demon auras, the three female demons immediately lifted the Amaris Twins to their feet, and they laboriously carried the two of them away to that area, as their strength had yet to fully recover.
Meanwhile, Ursula had brought Feltia to her private room, and they immediately sat down at the foot of the bed before asking her. "Aren't you afraid of me?"

"Why should I be afraid of you?" Feltia asked back as she sat down on an empty chair before speaking to Ursula again. "At first, I was afraid of you because of your Empress rank, and you could kill me easily. However, I also have a unique eye ability, and I can see into your souls, so I know that you two are not as evil as I previously thought."

"Is that so?" Ursula asked again, with a faint smile. "Unfortunately, you are making a big mistake if you think that we are not evil, and we have just returned from killing countless demons in Tauri's sub-realm."

"Didn't you two do it to restore your strength?" Ursula nodded to Feltia. "Even though I am much weaker than you, I have killed so many people, whether humans or demons, so I don't think that you two are evil."

"Oh?" Seeing Ursula doubting her, Feltia immediately released her killing intent, causing them to shiver slightly. "No wonder Oz chose you to help him; it turns out that you are quite terrifying, and your killing intent is not that inferior to old demons like us."

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled at that. "Anyway, how did you two fake your deaths from them? Moreover, Oz didn't seem to know that you were still alive before, and your two descendants were the same as him."

"You're wrong about that." Ursula replied with a shake of her head. "Back then, we were hit by an attack from the Throne, so we immediately fled the battlefield and returned to this castle, and we sealed it. They probably thought we were dead because his attack was really powerful, and it hit us squarely at close range.

Fortunately, we had our abilities, and we had prepared something in this place before the war happened, so we managed to keep our lives. However, we became extremely weak, so we fell into a deep sleep at that time, and we wouldn't have woken up if you hadn't come here."
"I see." Feltia nodded in understanding. "Since they couldn't penetrate your barrier, they couldn't check your condition, so they thought that you had died from the Throne's attack."
"That's right." Ursula then took out an orb. "This orb is the key to my barrier, and it is a relic of our ancestors, so no one can break through this place, including the first demon emperor."

[Master, based on the system's scan, the orb is a heaven-grade protective artifact, and it doesn't require Qi to activate it. Unfortunately, it won't be useful in the Sky Jade Realm, especially since peak sovereign-level cultivators can destroy it.]
Feltia nodded slightly at Mei's explanation. "Does this mean that you have agreed to join Oz?"

"I don't have any other choice, right?" Ursula released a heavy sigh before continuing. "Oz is a celestial demon, and his race is much higher than devourer demons like us. In addition, our demon ranks are equal, and we demons consider strength to be the most important, so we have to admit that he is superior to us.
Furthermore, we cannot take revenge on the Throne by ourselves, and we need a lot of help to fight him, so our best choice is to join him."
"Speaking of the Throne, is that guy really that strong?" Feltia curiously asked.

"The Throne is powerful, and he is slightly superior to the first demon emperor with his ten seeds." Ursula's answer shocked Feltia, but she was even more shocked by their next words. "In fact, there is still one person who is stronger than him, and that person is the leader of the Xian Realm.

You may find it hard to believe, but that guy can corner them easily, especially if he uses his space abilities. Fortunately, that guy did not participate in the war in the past, mainly because he suffered an injury due to his own mistake, or else this Diyu realm would have disappeared long ago if he participated in that war."
"Space abilities?" Feltia looked at Ursula in surprise, especially since she had never met cultivators or demons with such abilities before.

"Yes." Ursula then told Feltia about the man's identity and some of his abilities that she knew. "I don't know if that guy has recovered from his injuries or not, but I can say for sure that this realm will have no future if he recovers and attacks us.
Oz is strong, but he does not have the ten seeds, so his strength is still inferior to that of the first demon emperor, and he will never be able to fight him."
Feltia's expression turned serious after hearing that. "Why did Oz never tell me about that man?"

"Hehe." Ursula chuckled before telling Feltia. "Oz was still a small brat at that time, and the first demon emperor never revealed anything about them, especially since that would only bring panic to this realm, so he didn't know anything about his powers. However, I, Tharnon, and some demons in our generation know about him, including Zygoz."

"Zygoz, huh?" Feltia muttered softly. "Forget it; I don't want to get involved in your business with the people of the Xian Realm, and I will leave this realm after I help Oz to stop those winged races."
"Oh? Are you going to return to the human realm?"

"Yes." Feltia nodded to Ursula. "Even though I am a demon, I never really enjoyed my time in this realm, and I came here for two reasons. First, I want to save the Dryads from your descendants and the others. Second, I need demon essence to become strong, so I have no choice but to come to this realm."
Ursula supported their chin while looking at Feltia. "How do you absorb their demon essence? Do you have the ability to devour like us?"

"All right, you don't need to be this confused, and we only need to follow his instructions to be able to do it, so you can find out for yourself the difference between ordinary demons and demon cultivators later."

After she said that, Virgil immediately grabbed Angela's hand and pulled her into the portal, but she herself had many questions about why Zhang Xiaolong was willing to teach her to be a demon cultivator, especially since he once told her that he would only teach those closest to him, and she did not have such a relationship with him.

"Do you want to join us?" Zhang Xiaolong asked as he turned to Oz. "Moreover, the flow of time in there is four times faster than in this realm, so it doesn't matter if you learn to become a cultivator first; I will immediately send you back here once you succeed in becoming one."

"All right." Oz immediately agreed to it, especially since he was fully aware of Zhang Xiaolong's abilities, and he himself was also interested in going to the Netherworld Realm, but his current strength was not enough to explore that realm. "Let's go now."

After that, Zhang Xiaolong brought Oz into the training space, where he introduced the three demons to his family. However, the three demons' presence made some of them quite scared, especially after he told them about their identities. Some others felt strange about their presence, especially Wang Zetian's family, because they are related to the winged race.

Although Liu Qingyu and some others did not like demons due to the demon invasion in the past, they still welcomed the three warmly, especially since they already knew quite a bit about Zhang Xiaolong's relationship with them.
Even so, Zhang Xiaolong still hasn't introduced them to all his wives, especially since they are still busy cultivating and dual-cultivating with his real body.
"Have you had enough fun with them?" Ursula immediately asked Feltia, who had just arrived in her room.

"Not yet." Feltia answered by shaking her head. "Oz asked me to find out the whereabouts of Kinos from the black Amaris, so I want to meet her now, and I will do something to her, so she won't be able to lie anymore."
"What are you going to do to her?" Ursula asked with a curious look.

"Hehe." Feltia chuckled and took Ursula's hand. "You two will see it later, and you guys will definitely be surprised. If the black Amaris was in her normal condition, I definitely wouldn't be able to do that to her, but your actions have already put her in her weakest state, so I will definitely succeed in doing that to her."

"Does that mean you won't hide your identity from her anymore?" Feltia nodded to Ursula. "I think that's a good idea, so you can use them to strengthen yourself, and you can help me to become stronger afterward."
After a while, they arrived at the Amaris Twins' room, and Feltia saw both of them lying weakly on the bed, especially since Ursula had been absorbing their demon powers and essences since yesterday.

The Amaris Twins immediately opened their eyes, but they were surprised to see Feltia being so intimate with Ursula, making the white Amaris grumble in her heart. 'Tch! This bastard must have seduced our ancestors! I'm sure she must have planned something against us.'

The black Amaris also got the same feeling as her twin sister, especially after she saw the strange smile on Feltia's face. 'Damn it! I shouldn't have taken off her demon-suppressing collar! She'll definitely bite me back now!'

Feltia smiled faintly before bringing Ursula to the black Amaris's side, and she immediately placed her palm on her chest. "My lady, you don't have to look at me that way because I will never hurt you, but I will help you experience something you have never felt before, and I am sure you will enjoy it very much later. However, I have to do something to you first, so you won't be able to kill me.'

After she said that, Feltia released her cultivation soul, shocking the Amaris Twins and Ursula. After that, she used the soul manipulation ability that she mimicked from Oz to pull the black Amaris's soul out of her body, and she immediately merged their souls together, causing her to enrage.

Unfortunately, the black Amaris couldn't do anything to stop Feltia, especially since she couldn't even move her fingers, which was the result of what Ursula did to her. 'Shit! This bastard! How dare he do this to me! I will torture him cruelly after my ancestors free us!'

'Tch!' The white Amaris gritted her teeth seeing that, especially since her twin sister had to suffer the same fate as her. However, she was also shocked because Feltia could use Oz's soul manipulation ability, and no demon had ever been able to do that before except for him.

Instantly, all of the black Amaris's memories flooded Feltia's mind, and she immediately looked through them all to find Kinos. However, she frowned upon learning the truth, and she immediately returned their souls to their respective bodies. 'No wonder Oz and the others couldn't find Kinos in this sub-realm; it turned out she hid him in Leo's sub-realm, and she also trapped him in her illusion.
Moreover, she sent the traitor Dryad to watch over him, so I will go there to free him, as well as to capture that traitor, and I will hand her over to Lillea to receive punishment for her betrayal.'
"How can you use Oz's ability?" Ursula suddenly asked Feltia with a frown.

However, Feltia immediately used the devouring ability to devour a little of the black Amaris's demon power and essence, causing Ursula to frown even more. "I am a lust demon, but I also have some special abilities, and I can mimic other demon abilities."
[Ding]
[You succeeded in mimicking the Illusion Negation of an Illusion Demon named the black Amaris.]
[Master, you've almost reached the limit for mimicking other demon abilities; you can only mimic six more.]

'I see.' Feltia didn't feel disappointed by that, especially since no abilities or techniques were perfect and everything had its own limits. "Anyway, I'm going to Leo's sub-realm now, especially since the black Amaris hid Kinos there, and I want to capture Rose the Dryad because she betrayed Lillea."

The black Amaris was completely shocked to hear Feltia's words, and she finally realized that she had fallen into her trap from the start, but she never realized it before it was too late. 'This bastard! I must kill her! She tricked and trapped me!'

"Leo and his subordinates are stronger than you, and his sub-realm demon beasts are stronger, so I'll go with you." Feltia naturally wouldn't refuse that, and Ursula immediately took her away from their castle.
After they disappeared, the white Amaris tried to tell her twin sister. "Sister, Feltia is actually a human—a male human, to be precise."

"Hmm?" The black Amaris turned to her twin sister with a face full of shock, but she immediately got angry at her. "Why didn't you tell me this before? If you had told me this a long time ago, I would have killed her right away, and I wouldn't have to be in such a situation."

"Sister, I've wanted to tell you the truth about Feltia too many times, but I've never been able to do so because Oz has merged a portion of my soul with hers, and he's also placed restrictions on me." The black Amaris's expression became even more shocked after she heard the name of the second demon lord, and the white Amaris sighed heavily before continuing.

"I personally didn't expect to be able to tell you this now, and it's probably because your soul has merged with hers, so I can do it. Anyway, that old man never disappeared, but he's always been watching us by disguising himself as Zygoz, and that bastard conspired with him to trap us."

The white Amaris's words left the black Amaris speechless for a long time, as she was completely shocked to hear the truth about Oz, a fact none of the demon rulers had previously realized. "Do you know their plans?"
"No." The white Amaris answered by shaking her head weakly. "That bastard never told me anything, so I don't know their plans."

"I see." The black Amaris turned furious once again after she remembered her twin sister's light power. "Where and when did you get your light power from? Why didn't you ever tell me about that? Did you collude with those birds?"
"I-" The white Amaris did not continue her words and nodded to her. "Sister, I-"

"Stop! I don't want to hear excuses from a traitor like you." The black Amaris interrupted her in a slightly high tone. "You also want to betray me, right? You clearly know that I don't like those birds, yet you colluded with them and kept everything hidden from me. I don't want to have a traitorous sister like you, so you can stop calling me your sister from now on."
The black Amaris immediately turned her face to the side, and for the first time in thousands of years, tears flowed from her black eyes as she was truly disappointed in her twin sister.
Hearing her sobs, the white Amaris wanted to say something to her twin sister, but she immediately swallowed her words back. 'I'm sorry, Sister.'
Meanwhile, Ursula has arrived in Leo's sub-realm with Feltia, so she immediately opens her map to find Kinos's location, and she doesn't have much trouble finding him.
"Over there." Feltia said as she pointed south, and she immediately grabbed Ursula's hand before leading her to the location using the Nine Cloud Steps, especially since the distance was quite far.

In just a few minutes, they had arrived at the place, and they found a blonde-haired Dryad wearing a red strapless dress in front of a building, which was where Kinos was being held, and many red roses around her body. Feltia observed her with a cold gaze, and she then spoke to Ursula. "Her name is Rose, and she betrayed the Dryad Race, making their lives so miserable for years.
Even Janette almost died because of her betrayal, so I want you to help me capture her."

"Hmm? A marchioness rank demon, huh? It's too easy for us to capture her, so we'll do it right now. However, you must remember to pay us with that thing." After she said that, Ursula immediately landed in front of the building, causing Rose to frown at her arrival. "We don't know you, but someone wants you badly, so we're going to catch you right now."
"What- Argh!" Rose immediately screamed as Ursula grabbed her neck, and they wasted no time in absorbing her demon power and essence, causing her to rapidly weaken.

After Rose was on the verge of death, Ursula immediately stopped their actions and threw her to Feltia, who immediately caught her. "Sigh! Their demon power and essence were too weak, and both were meaningless to us."

"Haha." Feltia laughed as she listened to Ursula's complaints as she landed in front of the building. "You guys don't need to think about that, right? Moreover, your condition is 90 percent now, so you will recover soon."
"Yeah." Ursula replied with a slight nod, and they immediately led Feltia into the building, where they found Kinos chained to the wall and the demon-suppressing collar attached to her neck.

Ursula immediately destroyed the chain binding Kinos and removed the demon-suppressing collar from his neck, which they gave to Feltia, who immediately put it into the system inventory, especially since it would be useful to her. "Leon must have noticed our presence, so we should go back now, and I will undo the illusion later."
