chapters.title: Chapter 381 Move The Dryads
paragraphs: Shortly after Ursula and Feltia left, Leon arrived on the scene, but a woman with long and light golden hair flowing down her back accompanied him.

The woman had a mature heart-shaped face, but her expression was too serious, and there was no smile on her face. She had light-golden and sharp eyes, thick eyebrows, a small nose, and small lips. Her figure was quite tall, approximately 7'2", yet her body was excessively slender.

She wore a revealing white dress and a loose white skirt, adorned with various gold jewelry, including a belt that encircled her slender waist. She also had a slim and long neck, a pair of breasts around D-Cup, and wide hips. The four white wings that kept flapping on her back were what made her unique, and their size was quite large.
The woman is none other than Chiel, the female angel sent by Daniella to establish communication with Leon. "Do you recognize those women?"

"I only recognize the black and white haired woman, but I don't recognize the succubus." Chiel immediately turned to Leon. "Ursula is two women in one body, and they are the ancestors of the Amaris Twins. Tauri told me that they came to his sub-realm two days ago, but we really didn't expect them to still be alive, especially since we thought they were dead thousands of years ago.
Anyway, he couldn't find the twins in their tower, so we thought they had kidnapped them both, and they probably locked them up in the black castle, especially since that castle is where they live."

"Two women in a single body, huh?" Chiel muttered softly after hearing that. "Sir Moraes has ordered Tauri to search for the Amaris Twins' whereabouts, particularly the white Amaris, because she is our main key to invading this realm again, and Lady Daniella wants you to help him.
Besides, Sir Joel has also ordered Avros through Yofil, so you guys must work together to find her as quickly as possible."

Leon nodded in agreement, but then he asked Chiel. "How about you help us search for them in the black castle? Tauri, Avros, and I don't have light power, and Ursula has a powerful dark power, so we will be overwhelmed to face them. Unfortunately, they also have light power, so I'm not sure if your light power will work against them."
"Oh?" Chiel raised her eyebrows in surprise. "Does Ursula really have light and dark power at the same time?"

"That's right." Leon replied to Chiel with a nod. "If you don't believe me, you can ask Lady Daniella or the winged races with higher status, especially the Throne, and I'm sure they have quite a bit of information about Ursula."

After hearing that, Chiel fell into deep thought, but she then asked Leon to take her back to his castle, and she immediately returned to the Tian Realm through the golden portal to ask her higher-ups about Ursula.

Within a few minutes, Chiel returned to Leon, carrying some items that had been given to her by her superiors. "I've confirmed with them about Ursula, and they've ordered me to help you capture them, so they've given me these upgraded demon-suppressing tools to capture them. Since they ordered Zachiel and Yofil to assist us, we'll wait for them in front of Death Valley."

Leon looked relieved after Chiel said that, especially since he wasn't sure that he and the other two demon rulers would be able to face Ursula since they were ancient demons, and they had also lived much longer than them. "In that case, let's go to the Amaris Twins' sub-realm now, and we will wait for the four of them there."
After that, the two of them immediately left Leon's sub-realm, and they quickly moved towards the Amaris Twins' sub-realm before they went to the Death Valley.
*Bam*

Lillea and the Dryads were shocked when Feltia threw Rose in front of them, and they turned to her with questioning looks. However, they instinctively took a few steps back as soon as they saw Ursula behind her, especially since their demon auras were too strong.

Feltia immediately explained to them about their identity, which shocked them. "Anyway, they helped me capture this traitor, so I brought her here to receive punishment for her betrayal of all of you, and it would be better if you put a traitor like her to death."

When they heard that, the dryads' expression turned ecstatic, especially since Rose's betrayal had caused them pain for years, and their numbers dropped drastically because many members of their race died.
Lillea immediately approached Feltia and asked her a question. "Do you really want us to kill her? Her demon rank is equal to mine, and her female essence will be useful to you."

"No need." Feltia immediately rejected Lillea's idea. "I admit that it would be a loss if you killed Rose, but you guys are my family, and I can understand your suffering over these years. That's why I will overlook that, and you can sentence her to death, so the members of your race who died because of her betrayal can rest in peace.
Moreover, the Amaris Twins have fallen into my hands, and their female essences are much higher than hers, so you don't need to think about that."
"All right." Lillea immediately ordered some of her race members to lift Rose, and she then led them to the graveyard, where the dead race members rested.
After they left, Ursula spoke to Feltia directly. "You care about these dryads so much, huh? You are even willing to suffer losses for their sake."

"Haha." Feltia laughed and hugged Ursula's waist. "As you already know, I'm a human, so I will always care about the people closest to me, and these Dryads are part of them. Rose has betrayed them and caused their numbers to become small, so I deliberately handed her over to them.

Anyway, I want to send you two to another place, and you guys will enjoy staying there, especially since the demon aura in that place is very strong. Not only will it be very useful for recovering your strength, but it can also make you both much stronger than now, so you guys can take revenge on the Throne with your own hands in the future."
"What kind of place is that? How can you send us there?" Ursula asked curiously, but their excited expressions couldn't be hidden, especially since they were so eager to take revenge on the Throne.

"That place is another demon realm, but it is located in a distant space." Ursula was surprised by Feltia's answer. "However, you two must be patient for a while to wait for Angela and Virgil to finish, and I will take you all there afterward."
Ursula nodded to Feltia. "All right, we're curious about that place, but we're not in a hurry, so we'll wait for the two little girls."

After they waited for some time, Lillea and the Dryads returned, and their queen spoke directly to Feltia. "We have discussed your plan to move us to the Sky Jade Realm, and they have all agreed to it, so you can send them there after they have tied up their things."

Feltia smiled in relief and then looked at the Dryads, who appeared impatient to start their new lives in the Sky Jade Realm. "You guys can get ready now, and I will take you all to meet Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race in that realm, soon."

The Dryads hurriedly scattered and returned to their respective places, making Feltia laugh at their antics, but she also felt pleased to see them so happy. She then pulled Lillea closer and spoke to her. "This way, you will no longer have to worry about your race, so it's time for you to move forward and seek your own happiness."
"Are you that impatient to eat me?" Lillea asked in a teasing tone.

Instead, Feltia asked Lillea back. "Don't you already know the answer? We've been intimate many times, and you've enjoyed our relationship so much, but I have to keep holding myself back from eating you because you are not ready for it. However, the situation has changed now, so I won't hold myself back anymore, and I want to eat you right away."

Lillea did not deny that she enjoyed their relationship, but she always rejected Zhang Fei because of her concern about the future of her race. However, he had helped them a lot in recent times, and he would soon bring the members of his race to a safer and more peaceful place, alleviating the burdens in her heart. "All right, I won't reject you anymore, and you can eat me whenever you want."

"Hahaha! That's great!" Feltia laughed loudly as she hugged Lillea. "For now, I will take them to the Sky Jade Realm first, but I have to be careful, especially since there are three powerful beasts looking for me there."

chapters.title: Chapter 382 Oz And Zygoz's Actions
paragraphs: The three winged races immediately stood up and wiped the blood from their mouths, but Zachiel then moved in front of the barrier before touching it. "What do you guys think of this barrier? The counterattack just now was really strong, but it seems like it's not the full power of this barrier, and we might die if we suffer a counterattack stronger than just now."

"Our higher-ups said that the two Ursulas are ancient demons, and they have been around since the time of the first demon emperor, so I think this barrier is also an ancient barrier." Yofil then turned to Chiel. "What do you think we should do now? Should we report this matter to our higher-ups? That way, they can send stronger angels; otherwise, we will never be able to find the white Amaris."

Chiel rejected Yofil's idea by shaking her head. "If this barrier is truly an ancient one, then none of us can destroy it, and only our leader can do it. Unfortunately, Lady Daniella told me that he is preparing something for our next invasion, and he is closing himself in on his private floor, so we can't call him for now."

"We should leave this place now, or we'll be too late if Ursula suddenly returns, and we'll die in their hands." The three-winged race immediately turned to Leon with a frown. "Even if the six of us join forces to attack them, we still won't be able to deal with ancient demons like them, especially since their rank should already be at Empress rank."
"Do you need to think about that, Leon?"

The six of them immediately turned to Zygoz, who suddenly appeared in the distance. Leon, Tauri, and Avros were completely shocked by his arrival, and they were thinking the same thing in their hearts. 'Crap! How did this old man manage to find us? Moreover, these winged race members are with us now, so we won't be able to cover everything anymore.'

Chiel, Zachiel, and Yofil also looked shocked by Zygoz's sudden appearance. Even so, they didn't seem to be afraid of his presence, and they immediately prepared the demon-suppressing tools that their higher-ups had given them earlier.

Zygoz smiled faintly at their reaction, and he immediately sealed the entire area of the place so they would not be able to escape. "I have long suspected that you three, along with the Amaris Twins, have betrayed us, but I have never had any evidence of your betrayal towards us. However, everything is clear now, so I will capture you, and the other demons will witness your trial."

The three demon rulers panicked hearing that, but they immediately took out their respective weapons, especially since Zygoz had already sealed the place, so they had no other choice but to fight him. Tauri pulled out his gigantic axe, Avros pulled out his long bow, and Leon wore lion fists on both fists.

The three winged racers were also immediately prepared to fight Zygoz, and Zachiel then said to him. "Old Demon, you are alone, and there are six of us now. Moreover, we have strong light power, so you will never win against us, and we will capture you before handing you over to our leader."

"Hahaha." Zygoz laughed at Zachiel's words. "What an ignorant brat! Even your Throne wouldn't dare say such a thing to me, yet a low-ranking bird like you dares to threaten me. Since you are so confident in your abilities, you can try to stop me."
"Zachiel!" Yofil and Chiel exclaimed as their friend suddenly floated into the air by himself, but they didn't see Zygoz do anything to him.
"Argh!" Zachiel screamed in pain as he felt something crush his body. "Attack him now!"

Yofil and Chiel exchanged glances for a moment before moving towards Zygoz, and they immediately used their light power to attack him. In addition, they intend to use their demon-suppressing tools on him.

Unfortunately, Zygoz was an old demon whose experience and power were on par with the first demon emperor, so he could easily see through their plans. He immediately used the same ability he used on Zachiel before, causing both of them to float in the air, rendering them unable to move their bodies.
'Damn it! This old demon is really strong!' Yofil and Chiel groaned in their hearts as they struggled to escape from Zygoz's ability.

Zygoz then sucked the demon-suppressing tools towards him, and he immediately grabbed them before observing them. "Oh? They have prepared themselves well for their next invasion, and these tools are much better than the ones they used in the past. Unfortunately, they only sent weak birds like you three, and I could use them to find a countermeasure to the effects."

Seeing their comrades in dire straits, the three demon rulers moved together to attack Zygoz. Tauri leaped high into the air as he swung his huge axe at him, and Leon immediately dashed towards him to attack him with his fists. On the other hand, Avros immediately took out several large arrows and fired them at him, but he responded to their attacks with a faint smile.

Zygoz made a gesture with his hand, and two portals shot towards Leon and Tauri, sending them to another area. Their attacks were in vain, as they only hit the air. He easily caught Avros's arrows and shot them back at him, catching him unprepared for the counterattack, and they pierced through his body directly. "Argh!"
'Damn it!' Leon and Tauri cursed, then moved to attack Zygoz once more.
Leon used his ability to increase his speed, which increased his speed several times, and he immediately punched Zygoz repeatedly.

Meanwhile, Tauri utilized his ability to enhance his brute strength, which resulted in a decrease in his previously slow speed. However, his attack power increased significantly. In addition, he did something useless by using his earth power, especially since Zygoz himself was an earth power possessor.
Tauri was actually aware of it, but he deliberately used it to distract and hinder Zygoz's movements, and he hoped that Leon would attack him if he did that.

While watching his two comrades attack Zygoz, Avros did not remain silent, and he struggled to use his bow. This time, he did not use many arrows; he only used one arrow, which was made of a special material.
*Swoosh*
Zygoz immediately grabbed Avros's arrow, and he also dodged all of Leon's punches, causing him to repeatedly attack the air around them. "You young demons are really rash and careless, you know?"
After he said that, Zygoz looked at Tauri, who was already near them, so he immediately shot Avros's arrow at him. However, he didn't aim it at his vital point, but rather at his giant axe.
"Shit!" Tauri tried to dodge the arrow, but it quickly penetrated the handle of his axe, breaking it into two pieces before penetrating into his right shoulder. "Argh!"
*Bam*

Tauri instantly fell to the ground on his back after he lost his balance, and Leon took advantage of that to launch his strongest punch at Zygoz. Unfortunately, the old demon immediately grabbed both of his hands and crushed his weapons, as well as his bones.
*Bam*
"Guah!" Leon spurted blood from his mouth as Zygoz slammed him to the ground very hard, and his expression also looked painful from the injuries on both of his fists. "Fuck you, old man!"
"Haha." Zygoz laughed before stomping on Leon's chest. "You three are my juniors, remember? As an old man, I must teach traitors like you guys a lesson, right?"
"I think you've toyed with them enough."

The voice made the three demon rulers freeze, and their bodies trembled violently as they saw Oz land in the distance. The three winged race members also looked shocked by the appearance of the second demon lord, causing their faces to turn deathly pale, and cold sweat quickly drenched their bodies, especially since no one of them would be able to escape from him. 'How...
how could he be in this place now? Didn't... didn't he disappear for so long?'

Oz looked at the three demon rulers with a disappointed look, but then he sighed heavily before speaking to them. "Back then, my predecessor chose your ancestors as his aides, and they fought bravely by his side to repel all enemies who tried to take over our realm.

That's why I appointed you guys as their successors after they disappeared, but I never expected that the three of you would betray my trust by plotting with those birds, and your actions have truly disappointed me.
Unfortunately, I didn't have any proof of that before, so I decided to disappear and disguise myself as Zygoz for the past years, and I've been closely monitoring your movements during this time."
After hearing that, Avros, Leon, and Tauri became even more frightened of Oz. 'Shit! He'll definitely kill us!'

"However, I've got all the evidence, so you guys have to bear the consequences of your decision to plot with them." Oz then glanced at Chiel, Zachiel, and Yofil before continuing to speak to the three demon rulers. "I can give you powers to make you worthy of being my aides, so I also have the ability to revoke your powers, and you will return to being ordinary demons."
"No... No... No..." Avros, Tauri, and Leon panicked after hearing that, and they tried to plead with Oz. "Lord! Please! Don't take our power away!
We don't—Argh!"

Oz didn't listen to their pleas at all, and he immediately absorbed the power of the three demon rulers, causing their bodies to weaken rapidly as their demon auras also diminished rapidly. Soon, the three of them had returned to their demon beast form: a bull, a lion, and a horse.

Zygoz shook his head before shifting his feet away from Leon's body. "Unlike the other demon rulers, such as Virgil and others, who attained their current rank through their own hard work, these three were able to become demon rulers because of the power you bestowed upon them, and I have also taught them as best as possible so that they can be comparable to their predecessors.
Unfortunately, their power blinded their eyes and hearts, and they also became greedy."

"Haha." Oz laughed and moved to Zygoz's side before patting his shoulder. "You don't have to blame yourself, old man. Moreover, they were too young and had too much ambition, so they made the foolish decision to collude with those birds. However, it's all over now, and they won't be able to run rampant like before.

Even so, our task is not yet finished, especially since they still want to rule our realm. Therefore, we must organize everything and prepare to ward off their attacks, and we will destroy them once and for all if they dare to try to invade our realm again."
Zygoz nodded in agreement before looking up at the sky. "Why are you still hiding there, Kid? Don't you want to do something to these three birds?"

"Old Man, your actions earlier scared me quite a bit, so I decided to hide from you." Zygoz's lips twitched at that, especially since Feltia clearly didn't seem afraid of him. "Anyway, the way you used your portal manipulation ability really surprised me, and I didn't expect you to be able to use it in such a way."

"Haha." Zygoz laughed and waved his hand, causing quite a few portals to appear around them. "As you can see, these portals are connected to each other, whether short-range or long-range. However, all abilities have their drawbacks, and it takes quite a lot of demon power to use this ability on a large scale, so I usually use it on a small scale like I did before."
Feltia nodded in understanding as she landed beside Zygoz, and she immediately tried to mimic his portal manipulation ability, but she was shocked by the notification that appeared next.
[Ding]
[The host is unable to mimic Zygoz's portal manipulation ability.]
'What the hell? Mei, why can't I mimic his portal manipulation ability?'
[I'm sorry, master. I don't have a definite answer for that, and his portal manipulation ability is probably a special ability that only belongs to him, so you can't mimic it.]

Feltia let out a sigh of disappointment, especially since he was eager to acquire Zygoz's portal manipulation ability, which he found interesting. 'Forget it; I will look for other more useful abilities in the future. Anyway, can I replace the abilities that I've mimicked before with the new one, Mei?'
[I can't say for sure, so you can try it yourself once the slots are full, master.]
Feltia then looked at Zygoz, who immediately brought the three members of the winged race to him, causing Zachiel, Yofil, and Chiel to tremble after they saw her strange smile.

Feltia immediately touched their chests in turn and implanted her demon slave mark on their souls, but she didn't change their memories at all, especially since she wanted them to feel the suffering of living as her slaves. "Starting today, the three of you are my slaves, and you guys don't bother to commit suicide, especially since it's impossible for all of you to do so."

Their faces became even paler after hearing that, but they were in shock as soon as Oz used his soul manipulation ability. He then merged Chiel's soul into Feltia's soul, especially since her rank was higher than the other two, and he hoped to get information about their higher-up plans from her memories.
"What do you get from her memories?" Oz immediately asked Feltia.

"Currently, the Throne is shutting himself on his private floor, but none of them know his purpose, so we can only investigate it slowly." Oz was disappointed with Feltia's answer, especially since such information was completely useless for them. "When you return to the Tian Realm, tell Moraes and the others that the three demon rulers are alive, but don't tell them about Ursula."
Zachiel, Yofil, and Chiel immediately left the place, especially since they couldn't refuse Feltia's order.
After Zygoz gave Feltia those demon-suppressing tools, he and Oz immediately left the Death Valley, taking the former three demon rulers with them.
Meanwhile, Feltia took the orb that Ursula gave her, and she immediately entered the black castle to meet the Amaris Twins.

The counterattack just now was really strong, but it seems like it's not the full power of this barrier, and we might die if we suffer a counterattack stronger than just now."

"Our higher-ups said that the two Ursulas are ancient demons, and they have been around since the time of the first demon emperor, so I think this barrier is also an ancient barrier." Yofil then turned to Chiel.
"What do you think we should do now?
Should we report this matter to our higher-ups?
That way, they can send stronger angels; otherwise, we will never be able to find the white Amaris."
Chiel rejected Yofil's idea by shaking her head.
"If this barrier is truly an ancient one, then none of us can destroy it, and only our leader can do it.
Unfortunately, Lady Daniella told me that he is preparing something for our next invasion, and he is closing himself in on his private floor, so we can't call him for now."
"We should leave this place now, or we'll be too late if Ursula suddenly returns, and we'll die in their hands." The three-winged race immediately turned to Leon with a frown.
"Even if the six of us join forces to attack them, we still won't be able to deal with ancient demons like them, especially since their rank should already be at Empress rank."
"Do you need to think about that, Leon?"
The six of them immediately turned to Zygoz, who suddenly appeared in the distance.
Leon, Tauri, and Avros were completely shocked by his arrival, and they were thinking the same thing in their hearts. 'Crap!
How did this old man manage to find us?
Moreover, these winged race members are with us now, so we won't be able to cover everything anymore.'
Chiel, Zachiel, and Yofil also looked shocked by Zygoz's sudden appearance.
Even so, they didn't seem to be afraid of his presence, and they immediately prepared the demon-suppressing tools that their higher-ups had given them earlier.
Zygoz smiled faintly at their reaction, and he immediately sealed the entire area of the place so they would not be able to escape.
"I have long suspected that you three, along with the Amaris Twins, have betrayed us, but I have never had any evidence of your betrayal towards us.
However, everything is clear now, so I will capture you, and the other demons will witness your trial."

The three demon rulers panicked hearing that, but they immediately took out their respective weapons, especially since Zygoz had already sealed the place, so they had no other choice but to fight him.
Tauri pulled out his gigantic axe, Avros pulled out his long bow, and Leon wore lion fists on both fists.
The three winged racers were also immediately prepared to fight Zygoz, and Zachiel then said to him.
"Old Demon, you are alone, and there are six of us now.
Moreover, we have strong light power, so you will never win against us, and we will capture you before handing you over to our leader."
"Hahaha." Zygoz laughed at Zachiel's words.
"What an ignorant brat!
Even your Throne wouldn't dare say such a thing to me, yet a low-ranking bird like you dares to threaten me.
Since you are so confident in your abilities, you can try to stop me."
"Zachiel!" Yofil and Chiel exclaimed as their friend suddenly floated into the air by himself, but they didn't see Zygoz do anything to him.
"Argh!" Zachiel screamed in pain as he felt something crush his body.
"Attack him now!"
Yofil and Chiel exchanged glances for a moment before moving towards Zygoz, and they immediately used their light power to attack him.
In addition, they intend to use their demon-suppressing tools on him.
Unfortunately, Zygoz was an old demon whose experience and power were on par with the first demon emperor, so he could easily see through their plans.
He immediately used the same ability he used on Zachiel before, causing both of them to float in the air, rendering them unable to move their bodies.
'Damn it!
This old demon is really strong!' Yofil and Chiel groaned in their hearts as they struggled to escape from Zygoz's ability.
Zygoz then sucked the demon-suppressing tools towards him, and he immediately grabbed them before observing them.
"Oh?
They have prepared themselves well for their next invasion, and these tools are much better than the ones they used in the past.
Unfortunately, they only sent weak birds like you three, and I could use them to find a countermeasure to the effects."
Seeing their comrades in dire straits, the three demon rulers moved together to attack Zygoz.
Tauri leaped high into the air as he swung his huge axe at him, and Leon immediately dashed towards him to attack him with his fists.
On the other hand, Avros immediately took out several large arrows and fired them at him, but he responded to their attacks with a faint smile.
Zygoz made a gesture with his hand, and two portals shot towards Leon and Tauri, sending them to another area.
Their attacks were in vain, as they only hit the air.
He easily caught Avros's arrows and shot them back at him, catching him unprepared for the counterattack, and they pierced through his body directly.
"Argh!"
'Damn it!' Leon and Tauri cursed, then moved to attack Zygoz once more.
Leon used his ability to increase his speed, which increased his speed several times, and he immediately punched Zygoz repeatedly.
Meanwhile, Tauri utilized his ability to enhance his brute strength, which resulted in a decrease in his previously slow speed.
However, his attack power increased significantly.
In addition, he did something useless by using his earth power, especially since Zygoz himself was an earth power possessor.
Tauri was actually aware of it, but he deliberately used it to distract and hinder Zygoz's movements, and he hoped that Leon would attack him if he did that.
While watching his two comrades attack Zygoz, Avros did not remain silent, and he struggled to use his bow.
This time, he did not use many arrows; he only used one arrow, which was made of a special material.
*Swoosh*
Zygoz immediately grabbed Avros's arrow, and he also dodged all of Leon's punches, causing him to repeatedly attack the air around them.
"You young demons are really rash and careless, you know?"
After he said that, Zygoz looked at Tauri, who was already near them, so he immediately shot Avros's arrow at him.
However, he didn't aim it at his vital point, but rather at his giant axe.
"Shit!" Tauri tried to dodge the arrow, but it quickly penetrated the handle of his axe, breaking it into two pieces before penetrating into his right shoulder.
"Argh!"
*Bam*
Tauri instantly fell to the ground on his back after he lost his balance, and Leon took advantage of that to launch his strongest punch at Zygoz.
Unfortunately, the old demon immediately grabbed both of his hands and crushed his weapons, as well as his bones.
*Bam*
"Guah!" Leon spurted blood from his mouth as Zygoz slammed him to the ground very hard, and his expression also looked painful from the injuries on both of his fists.
"Fuck you, old man!"
"Haha." Zygoz laughed before stomping on Leon's chest.
"You three are my juniors, remember?
As an old man, I must teach traitors like you guys a lesson, right?"
"I think you've toyed with them enough."
The voice made the three demon rulers freeze, and their bodies trembled violently as they saw Oz land in the distance.

The three winged race members also looked shocked by the appearance of the second demon lord, causing their faces to turn deathly pale, and cold sweat quickly drenched their bodies, especially since no one of them would be able to escape from him. 'How...
how could he be in this place now?
Didn't... didn't he disappear for so long?'
Oz looked at the three demon rulers with a disappointed look, but then he sighed heavily before speaking to them.
"Back then, my predecessor chose your ancestors as his aides, and they fought bravely by his side to repel all enemies who tried to take over our realm.

That's why I appointed you guys as their successors after they disappeared, but I never expected that the three of you would betray my trust by plotting with those birds, and your actions have truly disappointed me.
Unfortunately, I didn't have any proof of that before, so I decided to disappear and disguise myself as Zygoz for the past years, and I've been closely monitoring your movements during this time."
After hearing that, Avros, Leon, and Tauri became even more frightened of Oz. 'Shit!
He'll definitely kill us!'

"However, I've got all the evidence, so you guys have to bear the consequences of your decision to plot with them." Oz then glanced at Chiel, Zachiel, and Yofil before continuing to speak to the three demon rulers.
"I can give you powers to make you worthy of being my aides, so I also have the ability to revoke your powers, and you will return to being ordinary demons."
No...
No..." Avros, Tauri, and Leon panicked after hearing that, and they tried to plead with Oz.
"Lord!
Please!
Don't take our power away!
We don't—Argh!"
Oz didn't listen to their pleas at all, and he immediately absorbed the power of the three demon rulers, causing their bodies to weaken rapidly as their demon auras also diminished rapidly.
Soon, the three of them had returned to their demon beast form: a bull, a lion, and a horse.
Zygoz shook his head before shifting his feet away from Leon's body.

"Unlike the other demon rulers, such as Virgil and others, who attained their current rank through their own hard work, these three were able to become demon rulers because of the power you bestowed upon them, and I have also taught them as best as possible so that they can be comparable to their predecessors.
Unfortunately, their power blinded their eyes and hearts, and they also became greedy."
"Haha." Oz laughed and moved to Zygoz's side before patting his shoulder.
"You don't have to blame yourself, old man.
Moreover, they were too young and had too much ambition, so they made the foolish decision to collude with those birds.
However, it's all over now, and they won't be able to run rampant like before.
Even so, our task is not yet finished, especially since they still want to rule our realm.
Therefore, we must organize everything and prepare to ward off their attacks, and we will destroy them once and for all if they dare to try to invade our realm again."
Zygoz nodded in agreement before looking up at the sky.
"Why are you still hiding there, Kid?
Don't you want to do something to these three birds?"
"Old Man, your actions earlier scared me quite a bit, so I decided to hide from you." Zygoz's lips twitched at that, especially since Feltia clearly didn't seem afraid of him.
"Anyway, the way you used your portal manipulation ability really surprised me, and I didn't expect you to be able to use it in such a way."
"Haha." Zygoz laughed and waved his hand, causing quite a few portals to appear around them.
"As you can see, these portals are connected to each other, whether short-range or long-range.
However, all abilities have their drawbacks, and it takes quite a lot of demon power to use this ability on a large scale, so I usually use it on a small scale like I did before."
Feltia nodded in understanding as she landed beside Zygoz, and she immediately tried to mimic his portal manipulation ability, but she was shocked by the notification that appeared next.
[Ding]
[The host is unable to mimic Zygoz's portal manipulation ability.]
'What the hell?
Mei, why can't I mimic his portal manipulation ability?'
[I'm sorry, master.
I don't have a definite answer for that, and his portal manipulation ability is probably a special ability that only belongs to him, so you can't mimic it.]

Feltia let out a sigh of disappointment, especially since he was eager to acquire Zygoz's portal manipulation ability, which he found interesting. 'Forget it; I will look for other more useful abilities in the future.
Anyway, can I replace the abilities that I've mimicked before with the new one, Mei?'
[I can't say for sure, so you can try it yourself once the slots are full, master.]
Feltia then looked at Zygoz, who immediately brought the three members of the winged race to him, causing Zachiel, Yofil, and Chiel to tremble after they saw her strange smile.

Feltia immediately touched their chests in turn and implanted her demon slave mark on their souls, but she didn't change their memories at all, especially since she wanted them to feel the suffering of living as her slaves.
"Starting today, the three of you are my slaves, and you guys don't bother to commit suicide, especially since it's impossible for all of you to do so."
Their faces became even paler after hearing that, but they were in shock as soon as Oz used his soul manipulation ability.
He then merged Chiel's soul into Feltia's soul, especially since her rank was higher than the other two, and he hoped to get information about their higher-up plans from her memories.
"What do you get from her memories?" Oz immediately asked Feltia.

"Currently, the Throne is shutting himself on his private floor, but none of them know his purpose, so we can only investigate it slowly." Oz was disappointed with Feltia's answer, especially since such information was completely useless for them.
"When you return to the Tian Realm, tell Moraes and the others that the three demon rulers are alive, but don't tell them about Ursula."
Zachiel, Yofil, and Chiel immediately left the place, especially since they couldn't refuse Feltia's order.
After Zygoz gave Feltia those demon-suppressing tools, he and Oz immediately left the Death Valley, taking the former three demon rulers with them.
Meanwhile, Feltia took the orb that Ursula gave her, and she immediately entered the black castle to meet the Amaris Twins.

A while later, the Amaris Twins' expressions changed to surprise, and they looked at Feltia with a confused look, especially after the yang qi effect took effect.
"Have you two realized the effects now?" Feltia asked with a mocking smile. "This thing is very rare, so you won't be able to get it from anyone else, and I'm the only one who has it in this world."
"What exactly is that liquid?" The white Amaris asked curiously, and the black Amaris also looked at Feltia, waiting for her answer.

'Hahaha! Both of them are truly innocent, even though they have lived for thousands of years.' Feltia muttered in her heart as she laughed, and she then answered the white Amaris. "It's something special, and it can physically strengthen you both. If you guys want to drink it again, then you should prepare yourselves to serve me, and I will keep giving it to you in return."

"You two can refuse now, but you guys won't be able to continue acting like this, and you'll fall for me sooner or later." Feltia then approached Ashreth, who was still fast asleep, so she immediately grabbed his hand and channeled her demon power into his body to wake him up.

Within a few minutes, Ashreth's face was no longer as pale as before, and he immediately opened his eyes. However, she was stunned the moment she saw Feltia, making her smile. "Finally awake, sleepyhead?"

Ashreth pouted her lips before pulling Feltia's head closer and giving her a short kiss. "I fell asleep because the two ancestors kept absorbing my demon power and essence, and their actions made my body really weak. I've been thinking about you ever since I brought you to the tower, and I was always afraid of not being able to meet you again, but you are by my side now, so I am really happy."
"Haha." Feltia laughed upon hearing that, and she immediately pressed down on Ashreth. "I'm in front of you now, so you don't have to be afraid anymore, and I'll keep accompanying you from now on."

"Really?" Ashreth was naturally pleased about that, but she didn't dare to have high hopes, especially since she thought that the Amaris Twins would never let Feltia go, and they would keep her for themselves.

"Yes." Feltia replied with a nod before turning Ashreth's head to the Amaris Twins, which shocked and frightened her. However, she immediately calmed her down by telling her the truth. The Amaris Twins, who heard Feltia's words, became furious because she revealed those matters to Ashreth, but they did not respond to their subordinate's shocked gazes.
Ashreth then looked at Feltia again. "How did you know all that?"

After hearing you were one of their subordinates, I went straight to your pub to meet you, but I couldn't reveal my identity to you. However, the situation has changed now, so I don't want to lie to you anymore, and I decided to tell you the truth.
As for why Oz didn't kill the Amaris Twins, he did so in exchange for my help, specifically because I needed their demon essences to raise my demon rank."

After listening to all that, Ashreth's expression changed into a mixture of disbelief, disappointment, and anger. Even though Feltia did that to find information about the Amaris Twins, she still felt disappointed that he had lied to her, and he also took advantage of her.

Even so, Ashreth found it difficult to blame Feltia, especially since she would have captured him directly if he had revealed her true identity earlier, and she would also hand him over to the Amaris Twins to receive punishment.

Feltia then spoke to Ashreth again. "If you can accept me, then I will keep you by my side, and I will treat you better. If you can't accept me, then I will send you out of this castle, and you can continue your life as before, so the choice is yours."

Unfortunately, you were far from my reach because you were in that tower, and I always thought that I would never meet you again, so I was forced to satisfy myself by imagining you."

Even though I never liked male demons, I will try to accept your true self, so I will stay here with you, and I want to feel the pleasure for the rest of my life."

He only found a group of powerful beasts nesting there, so he questioned Angela.
"Are you sure the voice came from that area?"
"Yes." Angela answered with repeated nods.
"Can you accompany me to check that area?
The voice keeps calling me in my mind, and it's really bothersome to me, so I want to check it out."

"All right, I will accompany you to check the area." Zhang Xiaolong then contacted Ursula and Virgil via telepathy and told them that he would accompany Angela to check into the deepest area, but they decided to go with them instead, so he immediately approached the two of them and brought them all to that area.

Since he didn't know what was waiting for them there, Zhang Xiaolong decided to use his invisibility ability to prevent anything unwanted, especially since there were too many demons and demon beasts that were stronger than them in that realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 Tree Demon
paragraphs: They eventually reached the deepest part of the ghostveil forest, but no demons or beasts were there, as if they didn't dare approach.
Angela suddenly pointed to a giant banyan tree right in the middle of the area and informed them. 'Hey! The voice came from that tree, and it seems to be an old tree demon.'
Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong immediately asked Mei to scan the tree, and the AI quickly displayed its status.
Name: Arbeola
Age: 100,000+ years old
Gender: Male
Race: Banyan Tree Demon
Rank: Archduke
Elements: darkness and wood.
Physique: Elderwood demon physique.
Abilities: tree control, wood manipulation, tree generation, enhanced endurance, natural weaponry, self-sustenance, disease immunity, contaminant immunity, and so on.
Strong: darkness and wood.
Weak: light and fire.
'Holy crap! This demon is the oldest demon I've ever met, but its rank is only at Archduke rank!' Zhang Xiaolong screamed with shock in his heart.

[Master, it seems that it is more difficult for the demons in this realm to increase their rank compared to the demons in the Diyu Realm, especially since each of their ranks is three to four levels above theirs.]

'I think so too, especially since a Duke or Duchess demon in this realm has strength equal to Ursula and the others.' Zhang Xiaolong immediately informed the female demons by his side. 'This demon is a banyan tree demon named Arbeola, and his rank is Archduke rank. His strength should exceed that of the Diyu Realm's emperor or empress rank demon, so we must be careful.'
'How exactly do you know all that?' With curious looks, Ursula, Virgil, and Angela asked at the same time, especially since they themselves couldn't do such a thing.
However, Zhang Xiaolong only smiled at them, especially since he still didn't want to reveal the existence of the system and Mei to anyone, causing them to frown at his secrecy.

After ensuring the safety of the area, Zhang Xiaolong brought them to land in front of the giant banyan tree demon before undoing his invisibility. However, Ursula immediately moved in front of them, activating their light power as they stared at the tree with seriousness.

Soon, a white-bearded old man's face suddenly emerged from the tree trunk, and two hands formed from tree branches appeared on either side of it. Arbeola immediately observed Ursula, Virgil, and Angela. "As expected, a fallen winged race, a devourer demon, and a fish demon.
Moreover, all of you are not natives of this realm, and your demon rank has reached the empress and duchess ranks, but your strengths are too weak."

After Arbeola recognized the identities of the three female demons, their tension increased. Angela, who was hiding behind Zhang Xiaolong, asked him a question. "Why did you call me to come here, sir?"

"I just felt lonely in this forest, and you were the only one who didn't have the light element among them, so I called you to come here." They were dumbfounded by Arbeola's response and thought his reasoning was absurd, and he then glanced at Zhang Xiaolong. "However, you are the most interesting among them, kid.
If I'm not mistaken, you should have two other identities besides your incubus identity; you are a human and a beast, right?"

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong looked at Arbeola with a frown, especially since no one, whether human, demon, or beast, had ever recognized his three identities on their first meeting. "How did you know about that?"

"Hahaha." The leaves and twigs on Arbeola's body swayed as he laughed out loud. "I've lived for too long, and I've encountered all kinds of living creatures. Therefore, I can recognize your three identities right away, kid. Moreover, you were the one who brought these female demons into this realm, right?"

"That's right." Zhang Xiaolong did not deny that. "I did bring them to this realm to train and improve our demon powers, particularly because the quality of the demon aura in this realm is much better and stronger than it is in our home realm. Anyway, do all the old demons in this realm have the ability to recognize my identity like you do?"

"No." Arbeola then pointed in the direction of the Demon Emperor City. "You have to be careful when you go to that city, especially since most of the demons in that city have reached the archduke or archduchess rank and above, and the Demon Emperor of this realm also lives there.
They also have abilities like mine, so they will immediately recognize your identity as a human, and they will kill you on the spot."
"Thanks for your warning." Zhang Xiaolong then asked Arbeola again. "Why don't you leave this forest if you feel so lonely? That way, you can meet other demons, and you won't feel lonely anymore."

Arbeola let out a heavy sigh in response to Zhang Xiaolong's words. "I'm Arbeola, one of the oldest demons in this realm. Far in the past, the deceased fourth demon emperor tasked me with protecting this place, and he forbade me from leaving it, so I have lived here for tens of thousands of years. My roots are fused with this forest, so I cannot leave, and these tree demons are my descendants."
"The deceased fourth demon emperor?" Arbeola nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "How many demon emperors have ruled this realm before?"

Arbeola immediately told Zhang Xiaolong. "The current demon emperor is the sixth, and he is the most ambitious compared to his predecessors. His predecessors never thought of invading other realms, but he has dispatched countless of his subordinates to do so. Some of his invasions ended in victory, some ended in defeat, and countless demons from these realms have died because of his ambition.

However, he was never satisfied with his successes, and he never learned from his defeats. In fact, he is still planning to invade other realms, and I heard from the trees in the Demon Emperor City that he wants to invade a realm called the Sky Jade Realm.
After he ascended to the demon emperor, he tried to invade that realm once, but it ended in utter failure, and the portal connecting the two realms was sealed by the people of that realm."

The three female demons immediately turned to Zhang Xiaolong, especially since they already knew that he and his close people lived in the Sky Jade Realm. He simply nodded to them and asked Arbeola again. "Old Demon, could you please tell me how the demon emperor was able to create those portals to invade other realms?
In fact, that realm is my home realm as a human, and my family also lives there now."
"Oh?" Arbeola looked surprised to hear that. "Do you really live in the Sky Jade Realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong nodded to Arbeola. "The seniors in my realm have been trying to strengthen the seal on that portal, and they are doing so to prevent the demons from this realm from invading our realm again, especially since their previous invasion was our worst nightmare. However, the demon emperor left some demon remnants there, and quite a lot of evil people have chosen to side with him.

Over the years, they have tried to break the seal, but we have managed to stop many of them. I don't know him, but I felt that it was impossible for him to create those portals, and I think someone else helped him to create them."

"Whether humans or demons, many of them are too ambitious and greedy, and they are never satisfied with anything in their possession." Arbeola expressed this sentiment, shaking his head in agreement. "Actually, your guess was correct, kid. Not even his predecessors had the ability to create those portals, and the current demon emperor had the help of others to create them.
According to the information I got from the trees in that city, there was a mysterious man and a woman who suddenly came and defeated him before he could blink, so he decided to submit to them."

"Hmm?" Zhang Xiaolong was deeply shocked by this, particularly considering that the demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm should possess a strength comparable to that of a cultivator in the seven divine realms, yet they were able to deafeat him with such ease. "Did you know their identities? Are those people cultivators of the upper realms?"
"Yes." Arbeola answered with a nod. "The trees in the city didn't know their true identities, but they told me that they were cultivators, and they came from one of the realms in the upper realms.

In fact, countless cultivators from various realms often came to this realm in the past, but they never did anything like that before, so I couldn't understand their reason for pressuring the demon emperor and forcing him to help them. Moreover, those two also said that the Sky Jade Realm was their main target, and they ordered him to invade that realm once again."

After listening to Arbeola's last sentence, Zhang Xiaolong fell into deep thought, trying to connect some of the information he had obtained about the Sky Jade Realm with other things. 'Mei, do you think their plan has something to do with the ten-tailed fox? That realm was once the Heaven Wilderness Realm in the upper realms, but he moved it to the lower realms with his last strength.
Perhaps those people know about him, and they might want to get his legacy.'

[That could be one possibility, master. However, I find it strange, especially since they were able to subdue the demon emperor of this netherworld realm so easily. They should be able to attack and take over the Sky Jade Realm with ease, and those senior cultivators would not be able to stop them.]

'Yeah, I agree with you, and I myself feel strange about them. Sigh! I wanted to find out information about them, but there's no way I'd do something crazy like go to the Demon Emperor City, and that would be the same as me seeking death.' Zhang Xiaolong then ignored it, especially since it was beyond his current abilities, and there were so many people who would be sad if something happened to him.
"Anyway, old demon, do you know about the mysterious living creature sealed in the heart of the dead forest?"
"The dead forest?" The female demons looked at Zhang Xiaolong with raised eyebrows, especially since the forest's name was quite scary.

Zhang Xiaolong then pointed to the realm's central area. "The first time I went to this realm, I arrived in that area, and the dead forest was there. However, the distance was quite far, and it would take us seven to ten days to get there. Fortunately, I had my movement ability, so I could have gotten here sooner."
"How did you know about that mysterious living creature, kid?" Arbeola asked in a serious tone as he stared at Zhang Xiaolong.

I don't know how to explain it, but I can sense something unusual." Zhang Xiaolong lied with a straight face, especially since he hadn't even told his family about Mei and the system, so there was no way he could tell a stranger like Arbeola about the two.

"Anyway, I also found a bewildering formation in that forest, so I think it was built intentionally to stop other demons from approaching the area, and that mysterious living creature might be a threat to this realm."

Arbeola shook his head at Zhang Xiaolong. "I know that a mysterious living creature is sealed in the heart of the dead forest, and the demon emperor sealed it there. Unfortunately, I don't know anything about it because I can't check the place, and the trees there never answer my call either."

"I see." Zhang Xiaolong nodded in understanding as he muttered to himself. 'If an old demon like Arbeola didn't know about that mysterious creature, then a demon like Xenaya wouldn't know about it either, so I have to go to the Demon Emperor City to find out about it.
However, I won't be able to go there anytime soon, and I must first increase my demon rank as high as possible before I can go there.'

Mei immediately teased Zhang Xiaolong. [Master, the Amaris Twins are already in your hands, and Angela obviously likes you, so you can eat the three of them right away. Additionally, Xenaya has already offered herself to you, and her female essence is definitely much stronger and more abundant than theirs, so you don't need to hold back and use them to increase your demon rank.]
'Tch! What a pervert, AI! If you had a real body, I'd definitely eat you too!'
[Humph! Keep dreaming! I'm an AI that lives inside the system, so you won't be able to eat me!]
"So what are you all planning to do next? Are you guys going to continue training in this forest?" Arbeola suddenly asked them.
Ursula, Virgil, and Angela immediately pointed at Zhang Xiaolong. "We don't know anything about this realm, and he's the one who brought us here, so the decision is up to him."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong laughed at their behavior, then told Arbeola. "We do want to train in this forest for a while, but I'm going to the Lust City to meet someone later, so I hope you can help me protect them while I'm there."

"Do you want to join the Incubi Tower? I advise you not to join them, especially since that place will be hell for you." Zhang Xiaolong looked at Arbeola in confusion, especially since Xenaya had told him that the incubus were eager to join them. "Yhrer is extremely egotistical, and he will never allow another Incubus to develop.

If he finds out about your potential, he will capture you and absorb your demon power, so you will never be able to develop. Instead, you can visit Cain at the mansion north of the city, but he is arrogant and eccentric, so you will have to work hard to win him over.
Although he is only a marquis rank demon, that incubus lord does not dare fight him head-on, and I dare to guarantee that you will not regret receiving his support."

Zhang Xiaolong smiled after hearing that, especially since he himself had already thought about going to the mansion to meet Yu Xixuan and Lu Xin. "All right, thank you for your advice, and I will try to go to that mansion later. Zhang Xiaolong smiled after hearing that, especially since he himself had already thought about going to the mansion to meet Yu Xixuan and Lu Xin.
"All right, thank you for your advice, and I will try to go to that mansion later. Do you know about the three succubi duchesses?"

paragraphs: Ursula, Virgil, and Angela looked at Zhang Xiaolong strangely after he asked Arbeola about the three succubi duchesses, making them think that he wanted to get all three.

"Why are you guys looking at me like that? Those three are leading Lust City alongside Yhrer, so I'm curious about them." Zhang Xiaolong asked them with a shake of his head. "I'll be spending a few days in that city, and they're really strong. Furthermore, they are lust demons, just like me, and my abilities won't work on them, so I need to prepare something to avoid them."
"They are indeed strong, and one of them is really dangerous. Those three aren't ordinary succubi, and neither is Yhrer.

They are lust demon lords, which is a level higher than ordinary ones, and they are one step away from becoming transcendent lust demons." Zhang Xiaolong and the three female demons immediately looked at Arbeola, especially since they didn't know that succubi and incubi could evolve.

"The first is Ilsath, who possesses exceptional speed due to her supernatural dexterity and speed, making her the fastest of the three. However, she is the most indifferent among them. The second is Orith, who has very strong endurance thanks to her supernatural stamina, and she can have sex with male demons for several days in a row, but she is the kindest among them.

The third is Thish, but she is the cruelest among them, and her strength is the highest thanks to her supernatural strength and durability. She killed many demons, especially those who refused to submit and serve her, so be careful of her."
"Does that mean I will also be able to evolve into a lust demon lord like them?"

"Yes." Arbeola nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "Once your demon rank reaches the duke rank, then you will also evolve into lust demon lord, and your incubus power will be enhanced several times. As for the transcendent lust demon, you must first reach the emperor rank before being able to evolve into one."

After hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong nodded in understanding. "The transcendent lust demon is still far beyond my reach, so I won't think about it for now. As for the lust demon lord, my demon rank will increase to marquis rank soon, so it's not too far away for me, and I will try hard to reach the duke rank as fast as possible."

"Hahaha." Arbeola laughed upon hearing that. "My advice is that you should try to approach Orith first, especially since she is very kind, and she will never treat you badly. You have to work hard to satisfy her, and if you can do that, she will help you to the fullest.

Unfortunately, no demon has ever been able to do it before, especially since her stamina is extremely high, and they get exhausted before she is satisfied. Anyway, they are now in Demon Emperor City, so you can stay in Lust City and wait for them to return. You don't need to worry about Ilsath, but you must exercise caution with Thish."

"I personally wouldn't be that crazy to approach such a mad demon as Thish." Zhang Xiaolong replied with a wry smile. "As for Orith, I think I've found a way to approach her, and I just need to wait for her to come back. Anyway, we'll continue our training, Old Demon.
I don't have much time to continue staying in this realm, especially since I'm still having a lot of problems in the Sky Jade Realm, and I have to go back there to solve them."

"Wait a minute, kid." Arbeola immediately stopped them. "I just got information from the trees in some other areas, and they saw three fox beasts roam this realm. Moreover, they seem to be looking for something, and I think that they came here specifically to look for you, especially since you are a beast like them."

Zhang Xiaolong immediately opened the map to search for the whereabouts of the three heavenly foxes, and he found Tian Jiyuan around the dead forest. As for the other two, he found them near the Black River, and Tian Gongzhu was a little bit far from the Black Moon City. "You are right, old demon.

They did come to this realm to look for me, and they are very strong, especially the male fox, who is their leader. In fact, they came from a realm in the upper realms, and they discovered my existence in the Sky Jade Realm after I sent one of those heretics to their realm.
I'm not exactly sure why they were searching for me, but I know that they, especially their two ancestors, don't have good intentions towards me. Therefore, I fled to this realm to avoid them."

"Haha." Arbeola laughed before saying it to Zhang Xiaolong. "I like you, kid. That's why I'll help you do something about them, especially their leader. Those trees can't beat him, but they can do something else to him and trap him in this realm for a long time."

"Are you thinking of asking them to lure him into the heart of the dead forest?" Arbeola nodded at Zhang Xiaolong. "The bewildering formation may be powerful, but that guy has the ability to traverse realms like mine, so I'm not sure it can stop him. Still, you can ask them to do that, and I hope he'll be trapped there long enough, so he'll turn into a demon beast."

After that, Arbeola immediately contacted the trees in the dead forest to direct Tian Jiyuan to the location of the bewildering formation, and he also asked the trees in the black river and the black moon city to do something about Tian Wangzhi and Tian Gongzhu. "It's done; I just have to wait for news from them."

"Thanks, Old Demon." However, Zhang Xiaolong immediately asked Arbeola, especially since he was curious about his intentions. "Why did you choose to help me? We are intruders in this realm, and you might get a lot of things if you hand us over to the other demons, just like the humans I sent to this realm some time ago."

"Oh? Are you really the one who sent those humans to this realm?" Zhang Xiaolong confirmed Arbeola's question with a nod. "Honestly, I was surprised when I found out that so many humans suddenly appeared in this realm; it turned out that you were the one who sent them here. Unfortunately, only five of them are left now, and the others have been killed by the demons.

Moreover, one of those women is in Yhrer's possession, and she must have suffered a terrible fate there. The other two women are much luckier because Cain bought them from the slave market, and they live in his mansion now. As for the two young men, one is in the hands of the three succubi duchesses, and the other is in the hands of the wolf king, the ruler of Black Moon City."

Zhang Xiaolong was not surprised by that, especially since he already knew the fate of those four people, but he did not expect that Yin Tong was in the hands of the demon wolf race. "They are my enemies, and the woman in Yhrer's possession even tried to kill me several times, so I sent her and her son to this realm. Anyway, who is the wolf king? Is he strong?"
"Alder is the alpha of those demon wolves, but he differs from his subordinates, who are black wolves.

His true form is a giant white wolf, and his demon rank is at the King rank, so he is stronger than me or the four lust demons." Zhang Xiaolong and the female demons were shocked to hear Arbeola's explanation, especially since the King or Queen rank was only one level below the Emperor or Empress rank.

"To answer your previous question, I helped you because your three identities are very interesting to me, and I also feel lonely in this forest. Moreover, I already told you that I'm too old, so I don't have that kind of ambition, and I just want to live quietly in this forest."

Arbeola's last sentence made them laugh, and Zhang Xiaolong immediately spoke to him again. "We will continue our training now, and I will go to Lust City after we finish. If you are so lonely, I will leave them here so they can accompany you to talk."

"That's good." Arbeola was satisfied with Zhang Xiaolong's decision. "You don't need to worry about them as long as they stay here, especially since no demons or demon beasts dare approach this place while I am here."

Although they still did not trust Arbeola, the female demons preferred to stay in the forest rather than go to Lust City, particularly since they were fully aware of their strength and did not want to cause trouble by going there.
After that, Zhang Xiaolong took them back to their previous training area, where they began to fight demons and demon beasts.

On the other hand, Arbeola continued to communicate with the trees in the other three areas, especially those in the dead forest, and he did so to ensure that they successfully led Tian Jiyuan into the heart of the forest.

Tian Jiyuan was still flying around the dead forest from the air to look for Zhang Xiaolong, and he used his light element to protect himself. Naturally, he couldn't find him there, especially since their location was too far away.

Suddenly, Tian Jiyuan saw Zhang Xiaolong running quickly towards the heart of the dead forest, and he immediately chased after him, not realizing that he was just an illusion created by one of the demon trees that lived in the forest.

However, when they arrived at the heart of the dead forest, Zhang Xiaolong suddenly vanished from his sight, prompting Tian Jiyuan to stop and scan the surrounding area with his senses, but he was unable to locate him anywhere. "Damn it! How can that guy move so fast with his low cultivation?"

Tian Jiyuan then decided to go to the heart of the dead forest, but he immediately felt a little strange, especially since the demon trees and demon beasts there did not even try to attack him. "Could it be that they are afraid of my light element? Haha! I'm really lucky to have been born with a strong light element, so I don't need to worry about them."
Unfortunately, Tian Jiyuan was overconfident with himself, so he didn't realize that he had fallen into the demons' trap, and he was unaware that the area was covered by the bewildering formation.
Seeing that Tian Jiyuan had entered the area, the demon trees in the dead forest immediately informed Arbeola about it, and he told Zhang Xiaolong about their success.

However, Zhang Xiaolong still doubted that the bewildering formation could trap Tian Jiyuan for too long, and he would probably return to the Sky Jade Realm immediately once he realized his situation.

Tian Gongzhu, who was observing Black Moon City from the air, was shocked when several flying demon beasts, similar to crows and eagles, suddenly swarmed her. 'Crap! How could they sense my presence? I have suppressed my aura as much as possible, so they should not be able to detect my presence.'
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Several flying demon beasts immediately flew towards Tian Gongzhu, and they tried to attack him using their sharp beaks and claws. However, she quickly pulled out a white whip, channeled her light qi into it, and whipped it towards the flying demon beasts.
Unfortunately, the flying demon beasts had high speed, and their movements were very agile, so they managed to dodge Tian Gongzhu's attack.

Since there were quite a lot of them, Tian Gongzhu decided to take out an artifact from her storage ring, causing three light shields to appear around her in case they attacked her in a swarm. She also swung her four tails towards them before several crescent-shaped lights Qi rushed towards them, which hit several of them and killed them instantly.

"Argh!" Tian Gongzhu screamed in pain as a root that rose from the ground hit her back, leaving a deep wound there, and blood was also flowing out of the wound. She immediately cut off the root while shouting furiously. "Bastard! How dare lowly demons like you hurt me?! I will eradicate you all once and for all."

Tian Gongzhu then released all her strength, and her light qi spread around her, forcing the flying demon beasts to retreat and run away from her, especially since her light element was too terrifying for them.
Unfortunately, Tian Gongzhu had made a blunder in doing that because her actions were detected by the demon wolves in the Black Moon City, and many of them rushed to the battle area at high speed.
In a few moments, the demon wolves had arrived at that location, and they stared at Tian Gongzhu with vicious gazes, even saliva dripping from their muzzles.
'Shit!' Tian Gongzhu cursed in her heart as soon as she saw the demon wolves, especially since there were quite a few of them. She immediately contacted Tian Jiyuan and Tian Wangzhi to save her.

However, Tian Gongzhu suddenly shivered after she felt a strong aura come from behind, and a white wolf demihuman was already standing behind her. Before she could react, her vision had already become blurry, and she quickly lost consciousness.

The white wolf demihuman immediately supported Tian Gongzhu before ordering his subordinates. "Go back! I won't let you eat her! Anyone who dares touch her will face punishment from me. Do you all understand?"
The demon wolves looked disappointed after hearing that, but none of them dared to disobey him, especially since he was their king, Alder, the white wolf demon.

After his order, they immediately returned to the Black Moon City, but Alder continued to watch Tian Gongzhu's face closely. "Many humans suddenly appeared in this realm some time ago, and now this female beast has also appeared here. Moreover, she could not have come alone, and I am sure that there are several partners accompanying her here."
