chapters.title: Chapter 387 The Vampire Lord
paragraphs: Tian Wangzhi was shocked after listening to the voice transmission from Tian Gongzhu, but he himself was facing a difficult situation, and his body was covered in blood wounds, so he could not go to save her.

Several demons were ganging up on Tian Wangzhi, including several giant demon trees, which had been ordered by Arbeola earlier. Most of them were several times stronger than him, and some of them did not have the darkness element, so his light element was ineffective against them. Moreover, they were ordinary demons and not demon beasts, rendering his heavenly fox bloodline useless.
'What's really going on here? I've hidden my aura perfectly, but these lowly demons can still detect my presence.'
Those demons suddenly stopped attacking Tian Wangzhi, but they immediately cut off all his escape routes, making him think that they were planning something for him.

Tian Wangzhi secretly sent a voice transmission to Tian Jiyuan, but he still didn't know that his senior brother was trapped in the heart of the dead forest, so he did not give him a reply. 'Damn it! Where did my senior brother go? Why didn't he answer me?'

A tall and burly male demon with long black hair emerged from behind the group of demons, and his body was clad in pitch-black armor. Two black gautlets covered his arms, and black chains wrapped around them. He is quite handsome; he has two horns on his head, slanted eyes with red pupils, two black wings on his back, and a long tail with a sword tip behind his hips.
"Are you a beast-cultivator from another realm?"
"Hmm?" Tian Wangzhi was taken aback by the male demon's question.

"Haha." The male demon laughed because his guess was right on target. "It seems like you don't know anything about our realm, but you dared to infiltrate here. In fact, there were so many human cultivators and beast cultivators who had come to this realm in the past, so I could recognize your identity as a beast cultivator, and I came here specifically to capture you.
That way, I can use you as an offering to those mysterious people, and they will give me a big reward if I hand you over to them."

"Keep dreaming!" Tian Wangzhi shouted at the male demon. "I am not your opponent because you attacked me in a group, but I am not as stupid and weak as you think, and a lowly demon like you will never be able to capture me. Even if you do, my senior brother will save me, and he will slaughter you all.

Moreover, we are not just any beast race, and we have two ancestors who are greatly feared in the upper realms. If you harm me, they will undoubtedly become aware of it and immediately descend upon this realm to annihilate it; not even your demon emperor will be able to withstand their wraths."
"Do you think I'm afraid of your threats?"

Tian Wangzhi fell into complete shock as soon as he heard the male demon's voice from behind, especially since the heavenly fox was one of the fastest living creatures, but a demon could surpass his speed to the point that he couldn't see his movements.

Unfortunately, Tian Wangzhi had misunderstood the male demon, and he actually didn't have such a high speed. However, he had some abilities that could make his opponents think that way, and his opponents did not realize that they had fallen for the effects of his abilities.

The male demon then grabbed Tian Wangzhi's shoulders, brought his face close to his neck, licked his neck, and whispered into his ear. "Are you still unaware of your situation? Is there anyone who is afraid of your threats? You don't even realize that you have fallen into my hypnosis, and your mind is under my control."

Tian Wangzhi's eyes trembled after he heard that, and all the demons in front of him instantly disappeared, which shocked him greatly, especially since he didn't know when the male demon used his abilities on him.

"Haha." The male demon laughed at Tian Wangzhi's shock expression. "Do you think we would allow human and beast cultivators to roam our realm? We may not be cultivators like you, but we aren't ordinary demons either, and we have many abilities that will affect you. You are too naive and arrogant, but you don't seem to have much knowledge about us demons.

I've been using my hypnosis since I arrived at this place, but I didn't immediately make a move on you, especially since I wanted to confirm your true identity first. Anyway, my name is Elijah, and I am the vampire lord."
After he said that, Elijah immediately bit his neck before injecting his blood into his body, causing Tian Wangzhi to groan in pain.

Unfortunately, Tian Wangzhi could not do anything to stop him, especially since Elijah's hypnosis effect was so strong on him that it had taken over his mind. Gradually, his light blue hair turned black, and his light blue eyes turned red, making his appearance similar to the vampire lord.

After Tian Wangzhi completely transformed into a demon, Elijah immediately stopped his actions and released his bite from her neck. "Now that you've transformed into a vampire fox, your life is in my hands. Since you possess the light element, I think your race must hate demons like us very much, right? This way, you will never be able to return to your realm or summon your two ancestors, right?"

Tian Wangzhi's body trembled violently after Elijah said all that, and becoming a demon was the worst nightmare he had ever imagined. Just as the Vampire Lord had said, he would never be able to return to his realm after he became a demon, especially since his race and ancestors would kill him immediately.

"Hahahaha!" Elijah laughed loudly before undoing his hypnosis, bringing Tian Wangzhi back to his senses. He then spoke to the other demons. "This fox is already my subordinate, so you guys can go back to your places, and I will take him to the Demon Emperor City."

Without waiting for their answer, Elijah immediately grabbed Tian Wangzhi's shoulder, and the two of them immediately disappeared from the demons' sight, so they immediately dispersed and returned to their respective places.

However, those demon trees immediately informed Arbeola about Elijah's actions, making him worried that Tian Wangzhi would leak everything about Zhang Xiaolong to the Demon Emperor, which would endanger him, so he informed him about the matter.

Zhang Xiaolong was naturally worried about the matter, so he immediately thought of some new plans as a precaution to deal with the dangers that might come his way. Therefore, he immediately monitored Elijah's movements from the map, so he could take quick action if the Demon Emperor found out about his presence in the realm, and he also prepared some things as countermeasures.

In addition, Zhang Xiaolong also informed the female demons about the matter, and he told them that he would send them back to the Diyu Realm if his worries came true, especially since none of them could match those high-ranking demons, let alone the Demon Emperor.

Ursula, Virgil, and Angela did not dare to take Zhang Xiaolong's explanation lightly, especially since he had many things he was still keeping secret from them, so they immediately agreed with his plan to send them back to the Diyu Realm if those high-ranking demons or the Demon Emperor came to them.
"Mhmm." Tian Gongzhu, who was lying on the bed, groaned softly before slowly opening her eyes. She was shocked when she saw the room, and she immediately jumped down from the bed.

Tian Gongzhu felt relieved after carefully checking her body inside and out, especially since nothing happened to her, and she immediately went to the window side of the room to check the outside. She frowned immediately upon seeing so many wolf demons outside her room, recalling that they had surrounded her earlier. 'Is this city their nest? Was their leader the one who brought me to this place?
Why didn't that person kill me right away?'
"Finally awake?"

That question startled Tian Gongzhu, causing her to jump in shock before looking back. However, she was stunned as soon as she saw Alder's figure, especially considering that the other wolf demons were black, while he was white. Moreover, his face is quite handsome, and his body is really perfectly formed, including his abs.
In addition, she didn't smell any demon scent from his body, which confused her. "Who are you? Why did you bring me here?"

"My name is Alder, and I am the leader of the wolf demon race." Tian Gongzhu was a little surprised by his answer. "Even though I look like this, I'm still a wolf demon, but I'm different from them, so you can't smell my demon scent.

I don't know what your purpose is in coming to this realm, but it is too dangerous for you and your companions, so I advise you to contact them and leave this realm as soon as possible. Otherwise, it will be too late if the high-ranking demons become aware of your presence, and they will immediately capture you all for use as an offering to those mysterious people."

"Offering? Mysterious people?" Tian Gongzhu muttered softly while looking at Alder in confusion, but she felt relieved because he didn't seem to have any evil intentions towards her, or else he wouldn't have advised her like that.

Alder nodded to Tian Gongzhu. "This realm is completely different compared to the past, and the current Demon Emperor is too ambitious to invade other realms, including the human and beast realms. Actually, it happened after the arrival of those mysterious people, and they helped him create the portals heading to other realms.
He has planned to continue his invasion until now, and those high-ranking demons are meeting with him in the Demon Emperor City."

"I've heard about the demon invasion from this realm, but it appears they're only targeting lower realms, and one of them is the Sky Jade Realm." Alder confirmed Tian Gongzhu's words with a nod. "Aren't you also a high-ranking demon? Why don't you join them?"

"In fact, not all demons in this realm share the ambitions of the current Demon Emperor, including me, so I have no interest in joining them." Tian Gongzhu seemed confused by Alder's answer, especially since there were so many demons trying to take over her home realm, and her ancestors always emphasized to them that all demons were evil creatures.
"To tell you the truth, I am not a native demon of this realm, and I fled my home realm because my leader kept using us to fulfill his ambitions, causing so many of our race to die as a result."

"Does that mean you are a demon cultivator?" Alder did not hide it from Tian Gongzhu, especially since she was a beast cultivator, so she should be able to feel the flow of Qi in his body. "At first, I didn't realize that, and I only realized it after facing you now. Furthermore, your cultivation is not low; you should have already reached the seven divine realms, right?"

"That's right." Alder confirmed it with a nod. "My cultivation has indeed broken through the seven divine realms, so the current demon emperor can't force me to join them, and those mysterious people dare not come to me directly."
Tian Gongzhu nodded in understanding before asking Alder again. "Can you tell me about your home realm?"

"My home realm is the Blackthorn Abyss Realm, which is very far from this realm. Moreover, my home realm is very remote, so you might not know about it." Tian Gongzhu did not refute Alder because she had never heard of that realm, but she was sure that her seniors and ancestors must know something about it.

"Anyways, you have stayed in this realm for too long, and I can see that the demon aura in this realm is starting to affect you, so you should contact your friends and leave right away. Otherwise, all of you will turn into demons, which will only make you suffer."

Tian Gongzhu nodded to Alder before contacting Tian Jiyuan, but he still did not give her a response, so she contacted Tian Wangzhi to ask about his current location. However, his answer shocked her, especially since he told her that she had fallen before Elijah, and he had turned him into a demon.

"What happened to you? Why is your expression like this?" Tian Gongzhu immediately told Alder about Tian Wangzhi's reply to him, as well as Tian Jianyu's disappearance. "Since he has become a fox demon, you can't do anything to him, so you can forget about him, or your kin will kill him if he returns to your realm.

As for your senior brother, I will try to help you find him and ask him to leave this realm. However, I can't promise you that I will succeed in finding him, especially since there are countless demons and this realm is too vast."

Tian Gongzhu let out a heavy sigh because of Tian Wangzhi's fate, and that made her even more furious towards Zhang Fei, especially since he was the one who lured them into going to the Netherworld Realm. 'That bastard! If he fell into my hands, I'd chop him into pieces! Because of his actions, my brother became a demon, and my senior brother also disappeared! Sigh!
I must report this to the two ancestors, so they can send other people to help me capture him, and they can also help me find my senior brother.'
"You should stop thinking and leave right now." Alder said that because Tian Gongzhu seemed to be hesitating.
"I know." Tian Gongzhu answered Alder with a nod. "Thank you. I hope you can find my senior brother, and I will return to our home realm to report everything to our ancestors."

However, Alder immediately warned Tian Gongzhu. "I don't know about your ancestors' strengths, but you should tell them not to send any other members of your race to this realm, especially since Elijah will tell the Demon Emperor about you guys. Therefore, he will order his subordinates to monitor all areas in this realm, and those guys will definitely kill them."

Tian Gongzhu nodded in understanding before opening the gate to the Heavenly Moon Realm, and she immediately disappeared into it. Alder, on the other hand, ordered those wolf demons to search for Tian Jiyuan's whereabouts, and he himself left the Black Moon City to look for him.

sentences.text: Tian Wangzhi was shocked after listening to the voice transmission from Tian Gongzhu, but he himself was facing a difficult situation, and his body was covered in blood wounds, so he could not go to save her.
Several demons were ganging up on Tian Wangzhi, including several giant demon trees, which had been ordered by Arbeola earlier.
Most of them were several times stronger than him, and some of them did not have the darkness element, so his light element was ineffective against them.
Moreover, they were ordinary demons and not demon beasts, rendering his heavenly fox bloodline useless.
'What's really going on here?
I've hidden my aura perfectly, but these lowly demons can still detect my presence.'
Those demons suddenly stopped attacking Tian Wangzhi, but they immediately cut off all his escape routes, making him think that they were planning something for him.
Tian Wangzhi secretly sent a voice transmission to Tian Jiyuan, but he still didn't know that his senior brother was trapped in the heart of the dead forest, so he did not give him a reply. 'Damn it!
Where did my senior brother go?
Why didn't he answer me?'
A tall and burly male demon with long black hair emerged from behind the group of demons, and his body was clad in pitch-black armor.
Two black gautlets covered his arms, and black chains wrapped around them.
He is quite handsome; he has two horns on his head, slanted eyes with red pupils, two black wings on his back, and a long tail with a sword tip behind his hips.
"Are you a beast-cultivator from another realm?"
"Hmm?" Tian Wangzhi was taken aback by the male demon's question.
"Haha." The male demon laughed because his guess was right on target.
"It seems like you don't know anything about our realm, but you dared to infiltrate here.

In fact, there were so many human cultivators and beast cultivators who had come to this realm in the past, so I could recognize your identity as a beast cultivator, and I came here specifically to capture you.
That way, I can use you as an offering to those mysterious people, and they will give me a big reward if I hand you over to them."
"Keep dreaming!" Tian Wangzhi shouted at the male demon.
"I am not your opponent because you attacked me in a group, but I am not as stupid and weak as you think, and a lowly demon like you will never be able to capture me.
Even if you do, my senior brother will save me, and he will slaughter you all.
Moreover, we are not just any beast race, and we have two ancestors who are greatly feared in the upper realms.
If you harm me, they will undoubtedly become aware of it and immediately descend upon this realm to annihilate it; not even your demon emperor will be able to withstand their wraths."
"Do you think I'm afraid of your threats?"

Tian Wangzhi fell into complete shock as soon as he heard the male demon's voice from behind, especially since the heavenly fox was one of the fastest living creatures, but a demon could surpass his speed to the point that he couldn't see his movements.
Unfortunately, Tian Wangzhi had misunderstood the male demon, and he actually didn't have such a high speed.
However, he had some abilities that could make his opponents think that way, and his opponents did not realize that they had fallen for the effects of his abilities.
The male demon then grabbed Tian Wangzhi's shoulders, brought his face close to his neck, licked his neck, and whispered into his ear.
"Are you still unaware of your situation?
Is there anyone who is afraid of your threats?
You don't even realize that you have fallen into my hypnosis, and your mind is under my control."

Tian Wangzhi's eyes trembled after he heard that, and all the demons in front of him instantly disappeared, which shocked him greatly, especially since he didn't know when the male demon used his abilities on him.
"Haha." The male demon laughed at Tian Wangzhi's shock expression.
"Do you think we would allow human and beast cultivators to roam our realm?
We may not be cultivators like you, but we aren't ordinary demons either, and we have many abilities that will affect you.
You are too naive and arrogant, but you don't seem to have much knowledge about us demons.
I've been using my hypnosis since I arrived at this place, but I didn't immediately make a move on you, especially since I wanted to confirm your true identity first.
Anyway, my name is Elijah, and I am the vampire lord."
After he said that, Elijah immediately bit his neck before injecting his blood into his body, causing Tian Wangzhi to groan in pain.
Unfortunately, Tian Wangzhi could not do anything to stop him, especially since Elijah's hypnosis effect was so strong on him that it had taken over his mind.
Gradually, his light blue hair turned black, and his light blue eyes turned red, making his appearance similar to the vampire lord.
After Tian Wangzhi completely transformed into a demon, Elijah immediately stopped his actions and released his bite from her neck.
"Now that you've transformed into a vampire fox, your life is in my hands.
Since you possess the light element, I think your race must hate demons like us very much, right?
This way, you will never be able to return to your realm or summon your two ancestors, right?"
Tian Wangzhi's body trembled violently after Elijah said all that, and becoming a demon was the worst nightmare he had ever imagined.
Just as the Vampire Lord had said, he would never be able to return to his realm after he became a demon, especially since his race and ancestors would kill him immediately.
"Hahahaha!" Elijah laughed loudly before undoing his hypnosis, bringing Tian Wangzhi back to his senses.
He then spoke to the other demons.
"This fox is already my subordinate, so you guys can go back to your places, and I will take him to the Demon Emperor City."

Without waiting for their answer, Elijah immediately grabbed Tian Wangzhi's shoulder, and the two of them immediately disappeared from the demons' sight, so they immediately dispersed and returned to their respective places.

However, those demon trees immediately informed Arbeola about Elijah's actions, making him worried that Tian Wangzhi would leak everything about Zhang Xiaolong to the Demon Emperor, which would endanger him, so he informed him about the matter.
Zhang Xiaolong was naturally worried about the matter, so he immediately thought of some new plans as a precaution to deal with the dangers that might come his way.

Therefore, he immediately monitored Elijah's movements from the map, so he could take quick action if the Demon Emperor found out about his presence in the realm, and he also prepared some things as countermeasures.

In addition, Zhang Xiaolong also informed the female demons about the matter, and he told them that he would send them back to the Diyu Realm if his worries came true, especially since none of them could match those high-ranking demons, let alone the Demon Emperor.

Ursula, Virgil, and Angela did not dare to take Zhang Xiaolong's explanation lightly, especially since he had many things he was still keeping secret from them, so they immediately agreed with his plan to send them back to the Diyu Realm if those high-ranking demons or the Demon Emperor came to them.
"Mhmm." Tian Gongzhu, who was lying on the bed, groaned softly before slowly opening her eyes.
She was shocked when she saw the room, and she immediately jumped down from the bed.
Tian Gongzhu felt relieved after carefully checking her body inside and out, especially since nothing happened to her, and she immediately went to the window side of the room to check the outside.
She frowned immediately upon seeing so many wolf demons outside her room, recalling that they had surrounded her earlier. 'Is this city their nest?
Was their leader the one who brought me to this place?
Why didn't that person kill me right away?'
"Finally awake?"
That question startled Tian Gongzhu, causing her to jump in shock before looking back.
However, she was stunned as soon as she saw Alder's figure, especially considering that the other wolf demons were black, while he was white.
Moreover, his face is quite handsome, and his body is really perfectly formed, including his abs.
In addition, she didn't smell any demon scent from his body, which confused her.
"Who are you?
Why did you bring me here?"
"My name is Alder, and I am the leader of the wolf demon race." Tian Gongzhu was a little surprised by his answer.

I don't know what your purpose is in coming to this realm, but it is too dangerous for you and your companions, so I advise you to contact them and leave this realm as soon as possible.
Otherwise, it will be too late if the high-ranking demons become aware of your presence, and they will immediately capture you all for use as an offering to those mysterious people."

Mysterious people?" Tian Gongzhu muttered softly while looking at Alder in confusion, but she felt relieved because he didn't seem to have any evil intentions towards her, or else he wouldn't have advised her like that.

Actually, it happened after the arrival of those mysterious people, and they helped him create the portals heading to other realms.
He has planned to continue his invasion until now, and those high-ranking demons are meeting with him in the Demon Emperor City."

chapters.title: Chapter 388 Back Up
paragraphs: After returning to the Heavenly Moon Realm, Tian Gongzhu immediately went to see Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing, and she reported to them everything related to Zhang Fei, including the Netherworld Realm.

However, the two ancestors were not surprised to hear Tian Gongzhu's report, especially since Tian Baixing had already learned about his three identities from Pang De's memories, so it was natural that Zhang Fei could roam freely in the Netherworld Realm without being affected by the demon power in the realm.

Tian Baitian suddenly took out a fox statue, which caused Tian Gongzhu's expression to change to one of worry, especially since it belonged to Tian Wangzhi. However, she could not say anything, so she could only wait for her ancestors' decision.
"Are you really going to do it?" Tian Baixing asked as she turned to Tian Baitian.
"Tian Wangzhi has turned into a fox demon, so he is no longer part of our race.

Moreover, we do not know the identities of the mysterious people behind the demons in the Netherworld Realm, and I am worried that they will get a lot of information about us from him, so I was forced to do it." After he said that, Tian Baitian immediately smashed the fox statue into pieces, causing tears to flow from the corners of Tian Gongzhu's eyes, especially since it was the same as killing her brother.
"You can return to the Sky Jade Realm now, and I will choose some other people to meet you there later."

"Yes, Ancestor." Tian Gongzhu immediately left the place, filled with sadness and disappointment, especially since Tian Baitian had decided to kill Tian Wangzhi. 'All of this happened because of that bastard! I must try hard to find him and avenge my brother's death!'

After Tian Gongzhu left, Tian Baitian immediately asked Tian Baixing. "Do you think we should listen to that wolf demon's advice? If I remember correctly, the demon cultivators in the Blackthorn Abyss Realm are truly powerful, and all of them have reached the Seven Divine Realms; even their leader's strength is not inferior to ours."

"Yes." Tian Baixing responded by nodding. "I think we should listen to him not to send our descendants to the Netherworld Realm, or they will die in vain at the hands of the demons in that realm. Even if we send those who have broken through to the Seven Divine Realm, it will only end badly for us, especially since those demons from the other demon realms are still targeting our realm.
That's why we can't afford to lose more of our members, and we should just send a few others to the Sky Jade Realm to wait for Zhang Fei there."

"All right." Tian Baitian then ordered some of those with cultivation in the quasi-divine realm to come to him, and he immediately sent them away to the Sky Jade Realm to catch up with Tian Gongzhu. "I hope Zhang Fei doesn't die in that realm; otherwise, we won't be able to obtain our ancestor's legacy, and we will never be able to evolve to ten-tails forever."
Tian Baixing didn't say anything about it. "What about Tian Jiyuan? Are you going to kill him too?"

"Hmm?" Tian Baitian raised his eyebrows momentarily in response. "Regarding Tian Jiyuan, I'll wait for his fate first. However, I will not tolerate him turning into a fox demon, and I will also kill him if that happens."

Tian Baixing nodded in understanding. "Tian Jiyuan is one of the best of our younger generations, so I hope he will be able to escape from that realm and not turn into a fox demon, or his death will be a great loss for us."

Elijah, who was on his way to the Demon Emperor City, stopped flying immediately, mainly because Tian Wangzhi suddenly died for no apparent reason. "How could he suddenly die? Who killed him? Could it be his ancestors who killed him? How could they kill him without going into this realm?"

Unfortunately, Elijah was not a demon cultivator like Alder, so he had no knowledge of them, let alone their abilities. Feeling annoyed by that, he immediately crushed Tian Wangzhi's corpse into dust, but he still continued on his way to the Demon Emperor City. "Tch!

Even if I didn't manage to bring him as an offering to those mysterious people, I still have to report this matter to the Demon Emperor so he can seek information about the beast cultivators from them. Moroever, I'm sure that they won't stop here, and they might send other beast cultivators to this realm, so I can capture more in the future."

Zhang Xiaolong, who had been monitoring Elijah and Tian Wangzhi, was relieved by the death of the heavenly fox. That way, the Demon Emperor would not be able to obtain any information about him, and he could train in the Netherworld Realm more peacefully. Moreover, Tian Gongzhu had also left the Netherworld Realm, so the burden on his heart was slightly lessened.

As for Tian Jiyuan, he found him still in the heart of the dead forest, but his name suddenly disappeared from his map. 'As expected, he managed to escape from that bewildering formation using his gate ability, and he must have returned to the Sky Jade Realm by now.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 7,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 70 green jewels.]

The appearance of the notification made Zhang Xiaolong sigh softly, especially since the day had changed again in the Netherworld Realm and the Sky Jade Realm, but he immediately included the quest because there was no Qi there, and his fourth clone could take care of that.

Zhang Xiaolong decided to end their training, especially since they had been training for quite a while and the female demons seemed to be getting overwhelmed fighting the stronger demon beasts. He then brought Ursula, Virgil, and Angela to Arbeola's place again before leaving them there.

Zhang Xiaolong then returned to Lust City before returning to the Lust Inn, but he couldn't find Xenaya the succubus, and a maid told him that she had gone to the succubi tower to get some things. He then opened his map to look for Cain in the mansion north of the city, but he still hadn't returned there, so he went straight to his room and thought about his next plans.

[Master, that wolf king doesn't seem evil, and he even allowed Tian Gongzhu to leave, so I think you can go see him. That way, you can get a strong ally in this realm if you manage to get his support, especially since you still don't know Cain's character for sure, and he might not be willing to support you.]

Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei, but he still hadn't thought about meeting Alder, especially since the distance between Lust City and Black Moon City was simply too far, and he would need at least two weeks to arrive there.

Even if he continued to use his Nine Cloud Steps and swallow qi recovery pills, it still took him more than a week to get there, which would only be a waste of his time, so he decided to meet the wolf king in the future. "Sigh, I'll wait for Cain to come back first, and I'll meet him straight after."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong decided to rest first, and he asked Mei to monitor the situation in Lust City.

Tian Jiyuan, who had gathered with Tian Gongzhu, looked gloomy after he learned of Tian Wangzhi's fate. He was also furious after learning of his death, and he considered finding Zhang Fei as soon as possible to torture him. Unfortunately, he and his clones were still in their hiding place, so he couldn't do anything.

"What exactly happened to you, senior brother? I contacted you many times, but you didn't give me any answer." Tian Gongzhu inquired in a frustrated tone, particularly because he believed Tian Jiyuan should have been able to save Tian Wangzhi."

Tian Jiyuan let out a heavy sigh before telling Tian Gongzhu about his previous situation, causing her to frown. "It seems that those demons were intentionally helping Zhang Fei, and they intentionally lured me into the heart of the forest, where I was trapped by the bewildering formation.

Moreover, I foolishly walked into their trap, and I only realized it after so long, so I didn't get any voice transmissions from you two. Since the demon aura in that realm started to affect me, I immediately returned to this realm, or I would have the same fate as Tian Wangzhi.

However, I had no idea that cultivators from the upper realms would assist demons from that realm, and they must have been so powerful that they could control the demon emperor of that realm. Fortunately, we didn't meet them, or we would have died in their hands."

"Alder, the wolf king, did say that they were very strong, but they didn't dare to fight him." Tian Gongzhu then told Tian Jiyuan again. "Anyway, Ancestor Baitian said that he would send some people to this realm, and they might come soon."

"They're here." Tian Jiyuan said that as he looked towards the door of the room, and several heavenly foxes immediately entered the room. "I didn't expect that our ancestor would send the three of you, Tian Cheng, Tian Dan, and Tian Jianxia."

"Haha." Tian Jianxia laughed softly before sitting down beside Tian Jiyuan, placing her right arm on his shoulder while speaking to him. "Isn't this due to your failure? Ancestor Baixian sent you to help this foolish girl and her brother; however, Tian Wangzhi is dead because you foolishly led them into the demon realm.
That's why he sent the three of us to help you, but we have to move faster to find Zhang Fei, or he will run out of patience and punish us."

Tian Gongzhu was furious hearing Tian Jianxia's words, but she immediately swallowed her saliva when her senior sister glanced at her, especially since her cultivation was also in the quasi-divine realm like Tian Jiyuan. Moreover, not only her, but even her two newly arrived seniors also had cultivation equal to his.
Unlike Tian Gongzhu, Tian Jiyuan seemed indifferent to Tian Jixian's words, but Tian Dan suddenly said to him. "Explain to us all the information you have obtained regarding Zhang Fei."

Tian Jiyuan immediately explained to them all the information they had obtained about Zhang Fei, but they seemed surprised to hear that he could hide in the Netherworld Realm for so long. "We suspected that he also had a demon bloodline, so I led them to that realm to look for him.

However, I didn't expect that he had a relationship with the demons there, and some of them deliberately lured me into their trap. Tian Gongzhu was luckier than Tian Wangzhi, especially since the demon who captured her had no malicious intentions, and he actually asked her to leave there so she could come back safely."

"If Zhang Fei really has the demon bloodline in his body, then why are our ancestors so eager to get him?" They immediately turned to Tian Cheng. "We all know that the two of them hate demons so much, and they always emphasize to us that demons are evil creatures who deserve to die.
Moreover, we had never heard of him before he sent Pang De to our realm, so I am confused by their orders to bring him there."

"It's useless for us to question their reasons, right?" Tian Jianxia said so with a shake of her head. "Our ancestors' orders are absolute, and they will punish us if we question them, so we can only follow their orders to find Zhang Fei as soon as possible and bring him to our realm."

"Where can we find him?" Tian Cheng asked them all. "Jiyuan and the others have been monitoring that clan for a few days, but they still haven't found any of their members, so I think Zhang Fei has hidden them somewhere in this realm. Moreover, he himself is hiding in the Netherworld Realm, and I will not take the risk of going to that realm, or I will suffer the same fate as Tian Wangzhi."

Tian Dan then conveyed his idea to them. "There are five of us and five regions in this realm, so I think we should split up and check out other regions. Since Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox like us, I believe he also has the same arrogance as us, and he may have done something in this realm.

That's why I don't believe that people in this realm don't know anything about him, and I'm sure there are other people who may have connections with him. Perhaps he told them about us, and they may have deliberately helped him hide those clan members from us."

"I agree with you." Tian Jianxia said that while nodding. "Our ancestors forbade us from killing humans, but they didn't forbid us from doing anything else to them, right? That's why I think it would be better if we spread out to every region, and we will use all means to find Zhang Fei, including torturing humans in this realm."

Unlike them Tian Jiyuan seemed reluctant to agree with Tian Jianxia's plan, but Tian Gongzhu immediately agreed to it, especially since she really wanted to capture Zhang Fei, and they immediately spread out to each region.
As for Tian Gongzhu, she brought the two moon foxes, Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, to help him interrogate the people in the western region, especially the residents of Heavenly Sword City.

Sabina and Persix, who were overseeing the western region, immediately informed the other leaders of the natural races about the heavenly foxes' plan. That way, they could be prepared in case one of them came to them, but they had no intention of helping the humans, especially since their strength was still below that of the foxes, and they never liked humans.

In addition, Sabina decided to go back to the fairy forest to meet Lillea and Janette, and she told them to find a way to contact Zhang Fei. Unfortunately, they couldn't contact him, so they couldn't do anything but wait for him to come out on his own."

"All right." Tian Baitian then ordered some of those with cultivation in the quasi-divine realm to come to him, and he immediately sent them away to the Sky Jade Realm to catch up with Tian Gongzhu.
"I hope Zhang Fei doesn't die in that realm; otherwise, we won't be able to obtain our ancestor's legacy, and we will never be able to evolve to ten-tails forever."
Tian Baixing didn't say anything about it.
"What about Tian Jiyuan?
Are you going to kill him too?"
"Hmm?" Tian Baitian raised his eyebrows momentarily in response.
"Regarding Tian Jiyuan, I'll wait for his fate first.
However, I will not tolerate him turning into a fox demon, and I will also kill him if that happens."
Tian Baixing nodded in understanding.
"Tian Jiyuan is one of the best of our younger generations, so I hope he will be able to escape from that realm and not turn into a fox demon, or his death will be a great loss for us."
Elijah, who was on his way to the Demon Emperor City, stopped flying immediately, mainly because Tian Wangzhi suddenly died for no apparent reason.
"How could he suddenly die?
Who killed him?
Could it be his ancestors who killed him?
How could they kill him without going into this realm?"
Unfortunately, Elijah was not a demon cultivator like Alder, so he had no knowledge of them, let alone their abilities.
Feeling annoyed by that, he immediately crushed Tian Wangzhi's corpse into dust, but he still continued on his way to the Demon Emperor City.
"Tch!

Even if I didn't manage to bring him as an offering to those mysterious people, I still have to report this matter to the Demon Emperor so he can seek information about the beast cultivators from them.
Moroever, I'm sure that they won't stop here, and they might send other beast cultivators to this realm, so I can capture more in the future."
Zhang Xiaolong, who had been monitoring Elijah and Tian Wangzhi, was relieved by the death of the heavenly fox.
That way, the Demon Emperor would not be able to obtain any information about him, and he could train in the Netherworld Realm more peacefully.
Moreover, Tian Gongzhu had also left the Netherworld Realm, so the burden on his heart was slightly lessened.

As for Tian Jiyuan, he found him still in the heart of the dead forest, but his name suddenly disappeared from his map. 'As expected, he managed to escape from that bewildering formation using his gate ability, and he must have returned to the Sky Jade Realm by now.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 7,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 70 green jewels.]

The appearance of the notification made Zhang Xiaolong sigh softly, especially since the day had changed again in the Netherworld Realm and the Sky Jade Realm, but he immediately included the quest because there was no Qi there, and his fourth clone could take care of that.
Zhang Xiaolong decided to end their training, especially since they had been training for quite a while and the female demons seemed to be getting overwhelmed fighting the stronger demon beasts.
He then brought Ursula, Virgil, and Angela to Arbeola's place again before leaving them there.
Zhang Xiaolong then returned to Lust City before returning to the Lust Inn, but he couldn't find Xenaya the succubus, and a maid told him that she had gone to the succubi tower to get some things.
He then opened his map to look for Cain in the mansion north of the city, but he still hadn't returned there, so he went straight to his room and thought about his next plans.
[Master, that wolf king doesn't seem evil, and he even allowed Tian Gongzhu to leave, so I think you can go see him.
That way, you can get a strong ally in this realm if you manage to get his support, especially since you still don't know Cain's character for sure, and he might not be willing to support you.]

Zhang Xiaolong nodded in agreement with Mei, but he still hadn't thought about meeting Alder, especially since the distance between Lust City and Black Moon City was simply too far, and he would need at least two weeks to arrive there.

Even if he continued to use his Nine Cloud Steps and swallow qi recovery pills, it still took him more than a week to get there, which would only be a waste of his time, so he decided to meet the wolf king in the future.
"Sigh, I'll wait for Cain to come back first, and I'll meet him straight after."
After that, Zhang Xiaolong decided to rest first, and he asked Mei to monitor the situation in Lust City.
Tian Jiyuan, who had gathered with Tian Gongzhu, looked gloomy after he learned of Tian Wangzhi's fate.
He was also furious after learning of his death, and he considered finding Zhang Fei as soon as possible to torture him.
Unfortunately, he and his clones were still in their hiding place, so he couldn't do anything.
"What exactly happened to you, senior brother?
I contacted you many times, but you didn't give me any answer." Tian Gongzhu inquired in a frustrated tone, particularly because he believed Tian Jiyuan should have been able to save Tian Wangzhi."
Tian Jiyuan let out a heavy sigh before telling Tian Gongzhu about his previous situation, causing her to frown.
"It seems that those demons were intentionally helping Zhang Fei, and they intentionally lured me into the heart of the forest, where I was trapped by the bewildering formation.
Moreover, I foolishly walked into their trap, and I only realized it after so long, so I didn't get any voice transmissions from you two.
Since the demon aura in that realm started to affect me, I immediately returned to this realm, or I would have the same fate as Tian Wangzhi.
However, I had no idea that cultivators from the upper realms would assist demons from that realm, and they must have been so powerful that they could control the demon emperor of that realm.
Fortunately, we didn't meet them, or we would have died in their hands."
"Alder, the wolf king, did say that they were very strong, but they didn't dare to fight him." Tian Gongzhu then told Tian Jiyuan again.
"Anyway, Ancestor Baitian said that he would send some people to this realm, and they might come soon."
"They're here." Tian Jiyuan said that as he looked towards the door of the room, and several heavenly foxes immediately entered the room.
"I didn't expect that our ancestor would send the three of you, Tian Cheng, Tian Dan, and Tian Jianxia."
"Haha." Tian Jianxia laughed softly before sitting down beside Tian Jiyuan, placing her right arm on his shoulder while speaking to him.
"Isn't this due to your failure?
Ancestor Baixian sent you to help this foolish girl and her brother; however, Tian Wangzhi is dead because you foolishly led them into the demon realm.
That's why he sent the three of us to help you, but we have to move faster to find Zhang Fei, or he will run out of patience and punish us."

Tian Gongzhu was furious hearing Tian Jianxia's words, but she immediately swallowed her saliva when her senior sister glanced at her, especially since her cultivation was also in the quasi-divine realm like Tian Jiyuan.
Moreover, not only her, but even her two newly arrived seniors also had cultivation equal to his.
Unlike Tian Gongzhu, Tian Jiyuan seemed indifferent to Tian Jixian's words, but Tian Dan suddenly said to him.
"Explain to us all the information you have obtained regarding Zhang Fei."
Tian Jiyuan immediately explained to them all the information they had obtained about Zhang Fei, but they seemed surprised to hear that he could hide in the Netherworld Realm for so long.
"We suspected that he also had a demon bloodline, so I led them to that realm to look for him.
However, I didn't expect that he had a relationship with the demons there, and some of them deliberately lured me into their trap.
Tian Gongzhu was luckier than Tian Wangzhi, especially since the demon who captured her had no malicious intentions, and he actually asked her to leave there so she could come back safely."
"If Zhang Fei really has the demon bloodline in his body, then why are our ancestors so eager to get him?" They immediately turned to Tian Cheng.
"We all know that the two of them hate demons so much, and they always emphasize to us that demons are evil creatures who deserve to die.
Moreover, we had never heard of him before he sent Pang De to our realm, so I am confused by their orders to bring him there."
"It's useless for us to question their reasons, right?" Tian Jianxia said so with a shake of her head.
"Our ancestors' orders are absolute, and they will punish us if we question them, so we can only follow their orders to find Zhang Fei as soon as possible and bring him to our realm."
"Where can we find him?" Tian Cheng asked them all.
"Jiyuan and the others have been monitoring that clan for a few days, but they still haven't found any of their members, so I think Zhang Fei has hidden them somewhere in this realm.
Moreover, he himself is hiding in the Netherworld Realm, and I will not take the risk of going to that realm, or I will suffer the same fate as Tian Wangzhi."
Tian Dan then conveyed his idea to them.
"There are five of us and five regions in this realm, so I think we should split up and check out other regions.
Since Zhang Fei is a heavenly fox like us, I believe he also has the same arrogance as us, and he may have done something in this realm.
That's why I don't believe that people in this realm don't know anything about him, and I'm sure there are other people who may have connections with him.
Perhaps he told them about us, and they may have deliberately helped him hide those clan members from us."
"I agree with you." Tian Jianxia said that while nodding.
"Our ancestors forbade us from killing humans, but they didn't forbid us from doing anything else to them, right?
That's why I think it would be better if we spread out to every region, and we will use all means to find Zhang Fei, including torturing humans in this realm."

Unlike them Tian Jiyuan seemed reluctant to agree with Tian Jianxia's plan, but Tian Gongzhu immediately agreed to it, especially since she really wanted to capture Zhang Fei, and they immediately spread out to each region.
As for Tian Gongzhu, she brought the two moon foxes, Hu Hong and Hu Qianli, to help him interrogate the people in the western region, especially the residents of Heavenly Sword City.
Sabina and Persix, who were overseeing the western region, immediately informed the other leaders of the natural races about the heavenly foxes' plan.

That way, they could be prepared in case one of them came to them, but they had no intention of helping the humans, especially since their strength was still below that of the foxes, and they never liked humans.
In addition, Sabina decided to go back to the fairy forest to meet Lillea and Janette, and she told them to find a way to contact Zhang Fei.
Unfortunately, they couldn't contact him, so they couldn't do anything but wait for him to come out on his own."

chapters.title: Chapter 389 Leak Out
paragraphs: Tian Gongzhu's first destination was the Zhao Clan, especially since she heard from the townspeople that the clan was one of the major clans in the western region, but her visit was in vain since none of the main members of the clan were there. After all, Huan Ning and Zhou Yun were in the Netherworld Realm, and Zhao Ziqin was in the training space with Zhang Fei.

The clan's guards told Tian Gongzhu that Zhao Feng and Zhao Liang were in the demon cave, but they also told her that they had never seen or heard of any clan members having any relationship with Zhang Fei.

After that, Tian Gongzhu took the two moon foxes to the Ye Clan, but she did not meet Yan Huan'er there, especially since Liu Qingyu had informed her that the heavenly foxes were looking for Zhang Fei, and they seemed to have malicious intentions towards him.

Yan Huan'er decided to hide in Hua Luo, and the people from the demon fox group took her into a secret place, which was covered by a concealment formation, so that others would not detect her presence there.
Disappointed by that, Tian Gongzhu vented his wrath on the Ye Clan people, and she beat them up with the help of the two moon foxes, causing many of them to suffer serious injuries.

After that, Tian Gongzhu and the two moon foxes went to the Heavenly Sword Sect, but the gatekeepers blocked them from entering. They did it on Su Qingshi's orders because Liu Qingyu had also told her about those heavenly foxes' intentions.

Once again, Tian Gongzhu and the two moon foxes caused a riot by beating the gatekeepers black and blue, and they tried to break into the sect afterwards. However, they were blocked by the protective formation that protected the sect, and the formation's counterattack mechanism immediately activated itself, injuring Hu Hong and Hu Qianli.

Because of this, Tian Gongzhu, who was already furious, became even more furious. However, she realized that she would not be able to break into the sect by herself, so she decided to wait for her four seniors to return from other regions. She then sent the two moon foxes back to the inn before heading to the Gu Clan, the last major clan in Heavenly Sword City.
In fact, Liu Qingyu had also told Xing Mei to avoid those heavenly foxes, but she was still angry about her son's death at the hands of Boitata, so she decided to wait for one of them to come to her.
"Did you come here to look for Zhang Fei?" Xing Mei immediately asked Tian Gongzhu as soon as she appeared in front of her.

"How did you know about that?" Xing Mei provided Tian Gongzhu with information about Zhang Fei, including his relationships with all the clans, which made her overjoyed. "Why did you decide to tell me all that?"

"Zhang Fei's contract beast killed my son, but I don't have the ability to take revenge on her, especially since her cultivation has already been broken through to the Sovereign Realm, and she is also a divine beast." Tian Gongzhu was a little surprised by Xing Mei's answer.
"I need help to defeat and kill Boitata, so I give you all the information, and I hope you can help me to avenge my son's death."

"Haha." Tian Gongzhu laughed softly after hearing that. "I personally have a grudge against Zhang Fei because he caused my brother's death, so I want to kill him. As for his contract beast, I will ask my seniors to capture her and bring her to you later, so you can kill her with your own hands."
"Thank you."
After that, Tian Gongzhu immediately left the Gu Clan, and she informed her seniors about all the clans that had ties with Zhang Fei, so they rushed towards those clans.

Xing Mei smiled in relief that Tian Gongzhu was willing to help her capture Boitata, and she couldn't wait to kill her with her own hands. "I don't like this kind of method, especially since it would ruin my relationship with Qingyu and Huan'er. Unfortunately, I had no other choice, so I was forced to do it to take revenge for Zhan'er's death."
Unfortunately, Xing Mei still didn't realize that she had made a fatal mistake, and her decision today could potentially lead to a disastrous future for her.

After getting information from Tian Gongzhu, Tian Jiyuan immediately moved to the Southern Region and went directly to the Yin-Yang Pavilion. He immediately captured some members of the Shen Clan, causing a commotion in the sect. The remaining members of the clan tried to fight him, but their resistance resulted in a crushing defeat, causing all of them serious injuries.

Tian Jiyuan immediately interrogated them, but none of the Shen Clan members were willing to open their mouths, and they didn't care if he would torture them for it. Furthermore, none of them knew about Zhang Fei's training space, so they couldn't say anything about him either.

Since they kept acting like that, Tian Jiyuan really wanted to kill the members of the Shen Clan, but he remembered what his ancestors said, so he gave up his intention to kill them, and he immediately left the Yin-Yang Pavilion.

Even so, Tian Jiyuan did not leave Southern River City; he chose to wait in the city. He also kept monitoring the sect with his senses, just in case Zhang Fei suddenly appeared in the sect, so he could immediately move to capture him.

Unfortunately, Tian Jiyuan himself was unaware that there was someone else watching him from afar, and that person was none other than Elmyra, the elf race leader. 'The Heavenly Fox Race has always been arrogant, but his arrogance is in stark contrast to his actions; he even beat up people from the Shen Clan who were clearly weaker than him.'

Meanwhile, Tian Dan had arrived in the Eastern Region, and he went straight to the Desolate Sect because Xing Mei suspected that Zhang Fei also had some connection with that sect, especially since he was the one who picked them up when they had a meeting with the moon fox race.
Sensing the horror of Tian Dan's aura, the gatekeepers of the Desolate Sect invited him to enter their sect, and they led him to meet Lian Xiang, who served as the sect's caretaker.

Upon meeting her, Tian Dan immediately inquired about Zhang Fei, prompting Lian Xiang to explain their relationship to him. "We know him and have met him before, but we don't have a deep relationship. In fact, he came here because one of the Pang Clan members infiltrated our sect, and he wanted to capture him.
After he succeeded in doing so, he immediately left and returned to the western region, and our second meeting was when he invited us to meet the moon fox race."
"Pang Clan?"

"Yes." Lian Xiang nodded to Tian Dan. "Pang Clan is the arch enemy of all cultivators in this realm, particularly because they chose to become accomplices of the demons who invaded this realm in the past, causing suffering to countless people. In addition to that clan, the northern region is home to several other heretic clans, including the Xie, Mo, and Gui clans.

Over the years, they have been trying to break the seal on the demon portal in the demon cave, and they have become increasingly aggressive lately. Fortunately, we have Zhang Fei, and he has thwarted many of their plans, including destroying the clans that were defective to them.
He was also the one who came up with the idea of collaborating with the Moon Fox Race to fight those heretics, especially since they were the strongest in this realm."

"I see." Tian Dan nodded in understanding. "Actually, I was sent here to look for Zhang Fei after he sent Pang De to our place, and my ancestors wanted to meet him. Unfortunately, I couldn't find him in the western region, and all the clans there didn't know about his whereabouts.
However, I heard that he previously came to this sect, and I thought you might know something about him, so I came here to look for him."

Lian Xiang shook her head at Tian Dan. "Unfortunately, we don't know Zhang Fei's whereabouts, so we can't help you with that. Moreover, that kid always comes and goes like a ghost, so I don't know when he will come here again."

"I'll be leaving now, and I will look for Zhang Fei in another region." After he said that, Tian Dan hurriedly left the Desolate Sect and returned to the western region, especially since Tian Gongzhu had already told them that she had encountered some trouble in the Heavenly Sword Sect, so he decided to go there.

Shortly after Tian Dan left, Hu Lili appeared at that place and let out a sigh of relief, especially since she was previously worried that he would notice her presence in the sect. Fortunately, her concealment artifact can disguise her aura neatly, so she didn't notice him, and she immediately turned to Lian Xiang.

"You did the right thing by not telling that man about Shi Xi's presence in the sect; otherwise, he would have captured her and used her to force Zhang Fei out, especially since I can feel malicious intentions from him."

"We never had any problems with Zhang Fei, and he has also helped us a lot in dealing with those heretics. Moreover, Shi Xi is a good girl, but she is too weak, so I won't do such a thing, especially since that will only harm her." Lian Xiang then asked Hu Lili. "Who exactly is that guy? Why does he seem so eager to find him?"

"That man is not human but a fox-beast." Lian Xiang and Hu Lili immediately turned to the exit, and they saw Gang Jinshu leading two men, who were none other than Tanbar and Gravir, the leaders of the gnome and dwarf races.

"These two friends of mine got information from their friends in the western region about the arrival of the man and some of his friends, and one of those foxes caused a commotion in that region by beating up people from the Ye Clan."
Both women frowned after hearing that, and Lian Xiang inquired. "Why do they have to beat up innocent people? What is their real purpose in wanting to find Zhang Fei?"

"We don't know for sure what their real purpose is, but those foxes definitely have evil plans against Zhang Fei." Lian Xiang looked increasingly confused by Tanbar's answer. "Anyway, our friends got information that they previously chased him to another realm, and one of them died in that realm. They blamed him for his death, especially the female fox who made a scene in the western region."

Gravir suddenly spoke to them. "I just got news from a friend of ours in the southern region; one of them came to the Yin-Yang Sect and beat up the people from the Shen Clan. He is still in Southern River City now to monitor the sect."
"Does that mean they already know about Zhang Fei's relationship with the Shen Clan? How did they find out about it?" Lian Xiang and Hu Lili frowned as they inquired.

Gravir let out a soft sigh before telling them. "Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race, had been watching them through the trees in the city, and she overheard a woman from the Gu Clan talking to the female fox, so she must have told the other foxes about it. In addition, she also told her about Zhang Fei's relationship with the other clans, and two of them are going to the Central Region now."
"Xing Mei?" Lian Xiang and Hu Lili immediately exchanged glances in surprise, and neither of them expected that he would sell Zhang Fei's relationship to those heavenly foxes.

However, Hu Lili suddenly remembered something. "If I remember correctly, Boitata killed Xing Mei's son by swallowing him alive in front of her eyes, but she was too strong for her with her cultivation still in the earth realm, so she wanted to use those heavenly foxes to take revenge on Zhang Fei."

"I see." Lian Xiang answered with a heavy sigh. "Unfortunately, Xing Mei had already made a blunder by doing that, and Zhang Fei would definitely be furious if he found out about this matter. I don't know what he would do to her if he found out about it, but I'm sure that she won't end up well, and she will surely regret her decision for the rest of her life."

"That's true." Hu Lili nodded in agreement with Lian Xiang. "Since it has happened, we can only wait for the outcome, and Xing Mei will only regret everything once Zhang Fei finds out about her actions."

After that, Hu Lili immediately contacted Yang Yudie and Zi'er, especially since she was sure that the two heavenly foxes would go to the Zhang Clan directly, and she told them to escape immediately because the two were much stronger than them.

"Anyway, why did natural races like you two suddenly come out of the western forest? Furthermore, you all seem to be on Zhang Fei's side, which has never happened before." Lian Xiang looked at Gravir and Tanbar, her gaze filled with curiosity.
"Hahaha!" The two of them laughed upon hearing that. "We can't tell you about it, but you are right that we are on Zhang Fei's side, and we will fully support him from behind."

Their answers made Lian Xiang even more curious, and she then glanced at Gang Jinshu and Hu Lili, but both of them responded to her gaze with a shake of the head, especially since they knew nothing about Zhang Fei's relationship with the natural races.

After they received the information from Hu Lili, the two women from the Zhang Clan ordered the people from their clan to leave as soon as possible, and they immediately went to their clan's secret chamber.

While heading there, Yang Yudie immediately contacted Zhang Long to inform him of the matter. On the other hand, Zi'er immediately activated all the protective formations in their clan, but she herself was not confident that they would be able to stop the two heavenly foxes.
"Has my father-in-law given you an answer?" Zi'er asked Yang Yudie.

"Yes." Yang Yudie replied with a nod. "Your father immediately asked Feng Yao for help, and she will come here soon. However, I don't know whether she can make it in time or not, so we have to hold on for a while until she gets here."
