Shortly after Tian Dan left, Hu Lili appeared at that place and let out a sigh of relief, especially since she was previously worried that he would notice her presence in the sect.
Fortunately, her concealment artifact can disguise her aura neatly, so she didn't notice him, and she immediately turned to Lian Xiang.

"You did the right thing by not telling that man about Shi Xi's presence in the sect; otherwise, he would have captured her and used her to force Zhang Fei out, especially since I can feel malicious intentions from him."
"We never had any problems with Zhang Fei, and he has also helped us a lot in dealing with those heretics.
Moreover, Shi Xi is a good girl, but she is too weak, so I won't do such a thing, especially since that will only harm her." Lian Xiang then asked Hu Lili.
"Who exactly is that guy?
Why does he seem so eager to find him?"

"That man is not human but a fox-beast." Lian Xiang and Hu Lili immediately turned to the exit, and they saw Gang Jinshu leading two men, who were none other than Tanbar and Gravir, the leaders of the gnome and dwarf races.

"These two friends of mine got information from their friends in the western region about the arrival of the man and some of his friends, and one of those foxes caused a commotion in that region by beating up people from the Ye Clan."
Both women frowned after hearing that, and Lian Xiang inquired.
"Why do they have to beat up innocent people?
What is their real purpose in wanting to find Zhang Fei?"
"We don't know for sure what their real purpose is, but those foxes definitely have evil plans against Zhang Fei." Lian Xiang looked increasingly confused by Tanbar's answer.
"Anyway, our friends got information that they previously chased him to another realm, and one of them died in that realm.
They blamed him for his death, especially the female fox who made a scene in the western region."
Gravir suddenly spoke to them.
"I just got news from a friend of ours in the southern region; one of them came to the Yin-Yang Sect and beat up the people from the Shen Clan.
He is still in Southern River City now to monitor the sect."
"Does that mean they already know about Zhang Fei's relationship with the Shen Clan?
How did they find out about it?" Lian Xiang and Hu Lili frowned as they inquired.
Gravir let out a soft sigh before telling them.

"Sabina, the leader of the Dryad race, had been watching them through the trees in the city, and she overheard a woman from the Gu Clan talking to the female fox, so she must have told the other foxes about it.
In addition, she also told her about Zhang Fei's relationship with the other clans, and two of them are going to the Central Region now."
"Xing Mei?" Lian Xiang and Hu Lili immediately exchanged glances in surprise, and neither of them expected that he would sell Zhang Fei's relationship to those heavenly foxes.
However, Hu Lili suddenly remembered something.

"If I remember correctly, Boitata killed Xing Mei's son by swallowing him alive in front of her eyes, but she was too strong for her with her cultivation still in the earth realm, so she wanted to use those heavenly foxes to take revenge on Zhang Fei."
"I see." Lian Xiang answered with a heavy sigh.
"Unfortunately, Xing Mei had already made a blunder by doing that, and Zhang Fei would definitely be furious if he found out about this matter.
I don't know what he would do to her if he found out about it, but I'm sure that she won't end up well, and she will surely regret her decision for the rest of her life."
"That's true." Hu Lili nodded in agreement with Lian Xiang.
"Since it has happened, we can only wait for the outcome, and Xing Mei will only regret everything once Zhang Fei finds out about her actions."

After that, Hu Lili immediately contacted Yang Yudie and Zi'er, especially since she was sure that the two heavenly foxes would go to the Zhang Clan directly, and she told them to escape immediately because the two were much stronger than them.
"Anyway, why did natural races like you two suddenly come out of the western forest?
Furthermore, you all seem to be on Zhang Fei's side, which has never happened before." Lian Xiang looked at Gravir and Tanbar, her gaze filled with curiosity.
"Hahaha!" The two of them laughed upon hearing that.
"We can't tell you about it, but you are right that we are on Zhang Fei's side, and we will fully support him from behind."

Their answers made Lian Xiang even more curious, and she then glanced at Gang Jinshu and Hu Lili, but both of them responded to her gaze with a shake of the head, especially since they knew nothing about Zhang Fei's relationship with the natural races.

After they received the information from Hu Lili, the two women from the Zhang Clan ordered the people from their clan to leave as soon as possible, and they immediately went to their clan's secret chamber.
While heading there, Yang Yudie immediately contacted Zhang Long to inform him of the matter.
On the other hand, Zi'er immediately activated all the protective formations in their clan, but she herself was not confident that they would be able to stop the two heavenly foxes.
"Has my father-in-law given you an answer?" Zi'er asked Yang Yudie.
"Yes." Yang Yudie replied with a nod.
"Your father immediately asked Feng Yao for help, and she will come here soon.
However, I don't know whether she can make it in time or not, so we have to hold on for a while until she gets here."

chapters.title: Chapter 390 Feng Yao Arrives
paragraphs: Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia had already arrived at the Zhang Clan, and they unhesitatingly destroyed all of the clan's protection formations. Upon entering the clan, they immediately frowned, especially since the clan was completely empty; even the guards and servants were gone. They exchanged confused glances, but they were sure that Zhang Fei had done something to move them to a safe place.

However, Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia were confused as to how Zhang Fei managed to do it, especially since they couldn't sense the presence of another heavenly fox besides their group. "Tian Jiyuan said he had the same invisibility ability as Ancestor Baitian, so he couldn't sense his presence or aura.
I think he actually returned to this realm a long time ago, and he might be monitoring our movements in an invisible state."

"Then, why doesn't Zhang Fei move the members of the Shen Clan to a safe place?" Tian Jianxia asked in a doubtful tone. "After all, that clan is his in-law, but he allowed Jiyuan to beat them up, so I doubt that he has returned to this realm. Maybe someone else is helping him monitor our movements, but we never noticed it."

"Hmm?" After he heard that, Tian Cheng fell into thought, but he had no other guesses besides that, especially since they couldn't track Zhang Fei's whereabouts. "Do you think there are people in this realm who can monitor us without our knowledge?"

"These humans' cultivation is too low, so they won't be able to trick us." Tian Jianxia suddenly realized something. "Hey! Aren't there some natural races living in this realm? Could it be that they are helping Zhang Fei monitor us?"

Tian Cheng nodded in agreement with that. "There is a possibility, but we can't trace their aura, especially since they can disguise it by using the natural aura in this realm. However, I'm not sure that they will be willing to help him, especially since they should be sensitive to demon aura, so they will definitely know his identity as a demon."

"Isn't his identity as a demon still just a guess?" Tian Cheng frowned at Tian Jianxia. "His form does have demon characteristics, but we don't know the truth yet, especially since our ancestors didn't tell us anything."

Tian Cheng could only sigh as he looked around the Zhang Clan's residence area. "Forget it; we have to find the people from this clan first, so we can use them to force him out, and we will capture him directly."
"Let's go." As she walked to another area of the Zhang Clan to look for their members, Tian Jianxia replied. Meanwhile, Tian Cheng looked for them in other areas.

After searching the entire clan for quite some time, Tian Jianxia and Tian Cheng still couldn't find any members of the Zhang Clan, so they went to the last area, which was the location of the clan's secret chamber.

However, Tian Jianxia and Tian Cheng suddenly sensed a powerful aura moving towards them, so they immediately flew to the highest area of the clan as they took out their respective weapons, and they also released their strength because they could feel that the aura did not belong to their members.

As she held her long spear, Tian Jianxia looked towards the source of the aura, and she spoke to her brother with a frown. "The owner of this is clearly a mythical beast like us, but our ancestors never said anything about the existence of another mythical beast in this realm, and Tian Jiyuan doesn't seem to know about it either."
"Yeah, you're right." Tian Cheng nodded as he tightly held the hilt of his white sword. "This mythical beast has incredible speed, and I can feel that it has a powerful fire element."

Tian Jianxia frowned even more after hearing that. "In this universe, there are only three mythical beasts that possess a powerful fire element. They are the flame dragon, vermilion bird, and phoenix, so this mythical beast should be one of them."
"It's here."
In a few seconds, Feng Yao had arrived before them, which shocked Tian Jianxia and Tian Cheng, especially since she arrived in her beast form, the fire phoenix.

Feng Yao immediately returned to her human form and coldly inquired. "What are you two heavenly foxes doing in this realm? Isn't your race living in the Heavenly Moon Realm now? Why did you guys destroy this clan's protective formations?"

"We came to this realm specifically to look for Zhang Fei, and we heard that one of his wives is a member of this clan, so we came here to look for them." Tian Jianxia's answer made Feng Yao a little surprised. "What's your relationship with this clan? Do you know where they are now? We must find him and bring him to our realm, or our ancestors will punish us."

Feng Yao was confused about their purpose in looking for Zhang Fei. "Why are you looking for him? As far as I know, he is just an ordinary human, and his cultivation is still very low, so he can't possibly look for trouble with your race."

Instead, Tian Cheng turned to ask Feng Yao. "Do you really not know that Zhang Fei is a mythical beast like us? In fact, he is a heavenly fox like us, and our ancestors discovered his existence in this realm after he sent Pang De to our realm. That's why they sent us here to take him away to our realm, so please tell us if you know his whereabouts."

"Unfortunately, I have never met Zhang Fei, so I don't know that he is a heavenly fox like you guys." Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia looked at Feng Yao in disbelief. "It's up to you whether you want to believe me or not, but I've told you the truth. Even if I knew about his whereabouts, I still wouldn't tell you, especially since he is my sister's husband."
"What?" Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia exclaimed in shock. "Does that mean the Zhang Clan members are phoenixes like you?"

"No." Feng Yao answered by shaking her head. "Even though they aren't phoenixes like me, I gave my bloodline to Zhang Fei's wife, so she is my sister, and this clan is my family. That's why I will stop you if you want to harm them, and you better think twice if you do, or else I'll beat you up."

"Do you think we're afraid of you?" Tian Jianxia asked as she pointed her spear at Feng Yao. "We're both mythical beasts, so your bloodline will be useless against us. Moreover, your cultivation is only in the saint realm, and our cultivation is in the quasi-divine realm, so you are not our opponent."

"Haha! I don't understand why Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing sent ignorant brats like you two." Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia frowned when Feng Yao mentioned their two ancestors, but their expressions immediately turned into fear as soon as she released her aura. "Have you both realized it now? Do you two still believe that you can fight me?"

'Crap! I didn't expect that her cultivation was already in the seven divine realms!' Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia screamed in shock in their hearts, but they immediately froze in place as soon as Feng Yao disappeared from their sight, and a red sword was already pressed against their necks from behind in just a split second. 'Shit! Her speed is extremely fast!'
"If you guys don't want to die, then you two should go back to the Heavenly Moon Realm right away, and you can tell your ancestors that this realm is under the protection of my phoenix race.

Moreover, Zhang Fei is my sister's wife, so he is my brother-in-law, and I will never hesitate to kill anyone who dares to hurt my family, including you heavenly foxes." Feng Yao then spread her senses to all corners of the Sky Jade Realm before speaking to them again. "Anyways, you guys better not test my patience, and you should also bring your friends back there.
Otherwise, I will go to their place to cripple their cultivation, and I will send them back to that realm by myself."

Feng Yao's threat caused cold sweat to quickly soak Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia's bodies, and both of them swallowed their saliva hard. However, she immediately withdrew her red sword from their necks, along with her aura. "Leave!"

Without saying anything, Tian Cheng and Tian Jianxia immediately fled the Zhang Clan using their teleportation abilities, and they also contacted their friends to gather in the western region as soon as possible. Tian Jiyuan and Tian Dan seemed confused by their request, so they explained to the two about Feng Yao's presence, and they immediately rushed back to the region.

Feng Yao did not move from her spot as she monitored the movements of the heavenly foxes with her senses, but their earlier conversation about Zhang Fei caused all kinds of questions to arise in her mind. "I didn't expect that my brother-in-law was a heavenly fox like them, but he made a stupid mistake by sending Pang De to their realm.

Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing always harbored the ambition to evolve to ten-tails like the ten-tailed fox, and I believe their decision to send those brats to capture him had something to do with it. However, I don't understand why they targeted him, especially since his cultivation was too low, so he should be of no use to them."
"You're wrong about that, phoenix princess."
"Hmm?" Feng Yao immediately turned to the woman, who had just appeared by her side. "Why did you suddenly come here, Zuhe?"
"Haha." Zuhe, the undine race's leader, chuckled in response. "Oliver ordered us to help these humans monitor the movements of those heretics, and this is because of Zhang Fei."
"Oh?" Feng Yao was surprised by Zuhe's answer. "Do you know anything about Zhang Fei? Why are those heavenly foxes targeting him?"
Zuhe nodded to Feng Yao. "You have never been to the deepest area of our sub-realm, so you never knew about the ten-tailed fox's statue, let alone the writing he left on the stone monument."
"What do you mean by that? Does that writing have anything to do with Zhang Fei?" Feng Yao inquired, raising an eyebrow.

"In fact, Zhang Fei is the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Zuhe then told Feng Yao about the inscription on the stone monument, which shocked her. "Honestly, I haven't met him in person, but Oliver and the others have met him some time ago, and he indeed has the same characteristics as the inscription: a human, a heavenly fox, and a demon.

That's why they brought him there, and he managed to summon the ten-tailed fox's soul imprint. He then gave him a tiny portion of his soul before disappearing, which proves that he is indeed his successor."

Feng Yao's expression turned serious as she nodded in understanding. "No wonder Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing were so eager to get Zhang Fei, especially since they should know about the inscription on the stone monument. After all, their arrogance was too high, so they would never allow another heavenly fox to surpass them, and they want to kill him before he evolves into ten-tails."

"Yes." Zuhe then told Feng Yao again. "However, it is not easy for Zhang Fei to evolve to ten-tails, especially since he needs the hearts of both of his descendants to be able to evolve, and the next ten-tailed fox will be born if he can do so."

"I didn't expect that the condition for the return of the ten-tailed fox would be so bad, and Zhang Fei had to kill them for that to happen." Zuhe agreed with Feng Yao by nodding repeatedly. "Haha! This is really funny!
Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have always dreamed of evolving to ten-tails, but their dreams will never come true, especially since their hearts are the requirement for them to be able to do so."

Zuhe shook her head at Feng Yao. "They probably don't know that requirement yet, so they haven't done anything to each other. If they knew that requirement, the situation would change, and they might kill each other to make their dreams come true."

"Yeah, you're right." Feng Yao then looked up at the sky. "Tian Baixing might not have the heart to kill her brother, but I'm sure that Tian Baitian wouldn't hesitate to kill her if he really needed her heart to evolve into ten-tails. If he successfully evolves into ten-tails, he will definitely move immediately to attack the other mythical beasts, so I hope he never succeeds in doing so."

"Even if Tian Baitian successfully evolves into ten-tails, he won't be as strong as the original ten-tailed fox. After all, he's a pure heavenly fox, so he doesn't have three identities like Zhang Fei, and he doesn't have his soul either." Feng Yao didn't dismiss Zuhe's words, but she knew that the ten-tailed was very strong, so she couldn't underestimate him.

"Anyway, why don't you get rid of those heretics right away? Your cultivation has already reached the seven divine realms, so you should have been able to clear them out long ago, but you never made a move against them."

Feng Yao turned to Zuhe with a smile. "Like those heavenly foxes, I have my own arrogance, and I will never kill those weaker than me. Moreover, this realm will be too peaceful if I get rid of those heretics, and the cultivators in this realm will not have the ambition to become strong, which will hinder their development.

Even if they succeed in becoming strong, they will never be ready to face the higher cultivation worlds with a weak mentality. That's why I let them continue to roam freely, and I want these people to take care of them by themselves, so they will be ready to live their new life in the middle and upper realms.
However, the situation might change with Zhang Fei's presence in this realm, especially since he has done so many things against them, and those heretics began to crumble one by one because of him."

"I've heard about some of Zhang Fei's actions from Oliver." Zuhe said that while nodding. "However, he is still too young now, and his mindset is still not fully mature, so he still makes mistakes too often, including sending Pang De to the realm of the heavenly foxes."

"Well? Nothing can be achieved instantly in this world, and everyone needs a process to reach maturity. Sometimes we need a lot of sacrifices to achieve it, but not everyone can persevere through the process, and many of them fail.

Zhang Fei is still too young now, but he will continue to grow, and his mentality will become fully mature if he always learns from his mistakes." Feng Yao then looked towards the Zhang Clan. "You can do your duty, and I will go meet them before returning to the demon cave."

paragraphs: "Where have you been, Feng Yao? Those demons are getting more and more active, and they keep trying to break this seal from their realm." Chang Wuhen asked as soon as the phoenix entered the demon cave. "Fortunately, you didn't leave for too long; otherwise, it would be difficult for us to defend it from their attacks, and they would have returned to our realm."

Feng Yao immediately returned to her original position, glanced at a few people, and channeled her qi into the seal. "I just took care of something important, and the situation was too dire, so I had to leave earlier."

Feng Yao then told Zhang Long and Zhang Wuji about the situation in the Zhang Clan, which made them feel relieved, especially since their wives were fine. They then asked her about the reason for the heavenly foxes' arrival in their clan.

'They came to this realm specifically for Zhang Fei, and he is actually a heavenly fox like them.' Zhang Long and Zhang Wuji, who had previously been unaware of Zhang Fei's fox race, appeared shocked upon hearing this, and their confusion only intensified when they discovered he was a demon.

'You two don't need to think about his demon identity because he's completely different from other demons, but I can't explain it in detail until I meet him in person. He's not an ordinary kid, and you guys are lucky to have him in your clan. He even managed to gain the support of the natural races because of his fox identity, and no one could do such a thing before.'

Zhang Long and Zhang Wuji exchanged shocked glances after hearing that, but they immediately nodded slightly to Feng Yao. Even so, they had many questions about Zhang Fei, especially about his three unusual identities.
Feng Yao then spoke to the others. "When I left earlier, I had obtained some interesting information, and you guys will be surprised to hear it."
"What kind of information did you get?" Meng Qi questioned Feng Yao, while the others gazed at the phoenix with curiosity.

"Haha." Feng Yao laughed softly before telling them. "I got this information from a reliable source, so I am certain of the truth of the news. Anyway, Pang De has disappeared from our realm, and someone sent him to another realm, but no one knows which realm that person sent him to."
"What?" Some of them exclaimed in shock, and others became gloomy, especially those who were Pang Clan lackeys.
Zhang Long, Zhang Wuji, and Chu Hong immediately guessed that it was Zhang Fei who sent Pang De to another realm, especially since they already knew that he himself came from another realm.
Chang Wuhen immediately asked Feng Yao again. "Who was the person who sent Pang De to another realm? How could that person do it?"

"We don't need to think about that person's identity, right?" Feng Yao answered by shaking her head. "As long as that person is their enemy, then that person is our friend. That person's actions are good for us, especially since we are still trapped here to secure this seal, and we are always having trouble monitoring their movements."

"I agree with Feng Yao. I think we don't need to think about that person's identity, and the most important thing is that person is on our side." Ye Yuan said it with a nod. "Pang De's disappearance will weaken the strength of those heretics, especially since he is their main leader, and the situation in their circle must be chaotic now."
Shen Wanshan suddenly spoke to them. "I heard from my clan members that Pang Zhen died at Xueyi's hands, and his death further reduced the power of those heretics."
"The Cai, Du, and You Clans have also disappeared from the southern region, so the situation there is more under control now." Liu Rong also spoke to them.
However, the two people from the Chang Clan sighed heavily after hearing the name of the Cai Clan, especially since they used to be their in-laws, but they actually sided with these heretics.
"Is Cai Qiu still in your clan's hands?" Chang Wentian asked Shen Wanshan.
"Yes." Shen Wanshan answered with a nod. "Xueyi imprisoned him in the punishment hall, and she will send him to you after we return."

"The Pang Clan's strength has weakened quite a bit, but they have not completely weakened, especially since there are still some other clans beside them. The ancestors of all those clans seem to be nearing coming out of seclusion, so we should be extra vigilant.

Otherwise, our efforts to keep this seal will be in vain, and those demons will invade our realm again." All of them agreed with Hu Gao, the moon fox's leader. He then looked at Zhang Long and Zhang Wuji. "Who exactly is Zhang Fei? Where did he come from? I heard from my clansmen's report that he is actually a fox beast, and his fox bloodline is stronger than ours."

'He can't hold himself back anymore, huh?' The two men muttered in their hearts as they had been waiting for that question from Hu Gao's mouth, especially since their wives told them that Zhang Fei had initiated their meeting with the moon fox race, and they had also told them that Hu Qiaomu had managed to find out his identity as a fox beast.

Zhang Long then replied to Hu Gao. "Old Hu, you know that my son and I haven't returned to our clan for a long time, so we still haven't met Zhang Fei. Even though he is the son-in-law of my Zhang clan, our relationship is not that deep yet. Our wives had asked him several questions, but he refused to give detailed answers, only providing general information.

He told them that he came from a small village in the western region, and our wives discovered his fox identity after he revealed it to Hu Qiaomu and the others a few days ago, so they didn't know much about it."

"I personally never knew that Zhang Fei was a fox beast, especially since I only met and talked to him for a few minutes, so I was really surprised when I found out about it." Chu Hong said that to Hu Gao, as he was sure that the moon fox leader would ask him.
Ye Yuan shook his head at Hu Gao when he looked at him, especially since he and his wife still did not know much about Zhang Fei, and they had also only recently learned about his fox identity.

Their attitude made Hu Gao frown, and he felt that they were hiding it from him on purpose. However, he didn't dare force them to say it because Feng Yao kept looking at him with a strange smile on her face, and he then looked at Shen Wanshan, especially since Zhang Fei was also his son-in-law.

"Hahaha." Shen Wanshan burst out laughing when he saw Hu Gao glance at him. "Old Hu, You don't have to look at me like that, because I know nothing about Zhang Fei. Although I am one of my Shen Clan's leaders, our true leader is Shen Xueyi. She has always been secretive, so she didn't tell me anything about him.
Moreover, our clan members do not like to pry into other people's personal affairs, and they never ask anything about him."

'These bastards! Zhang Fei is their son-in-law, so they deliberately hid information about him from me!' Hu Gao grumbled angrily in his heart and did not ask them any more, but he immediately contacted the members of his race outside the sub-realm to return. He asked that person to convey his message to Hu Qiaomu and the others, and he wanted them to investigate Zhang Fei's true identity. 'Tch!

If his fox bloodline is stronger than mine, then I must eliminate him as soon as possible. Otherwise, he will coordinate all the clans related to him to oppose me, and they will become a stumbling block for me to take over this realm.'

After they got Hu Gao's message, Hu Qiaomu decided to leave their sub-realm, and she immediately contacted the three female moon foxes. However, Hu Hong and Hu Qianli were still in a state of confusion due to Tian Gongzhu's ability, and Hu Xiufu was still in Zhang Fei's training space. "What exactly happened to them? Why didn't they answer my call?"

After she thought about it and couldn't find an answer, Hu Qiaomu immediately took out her flying artifact, and she quickly flew towards the Western Region to check on the situation of the three female moon foxes.
Zhang Fei [4] decided to enter the portable mansion before going to one of the rooms, where he locked up five female prisoners: Wang Xiaoyi, Chu Youqian, Shen Shixi, Shen Xiwu, and Mo Xuanqing.

Zhang Fei [4] could see that their expressions looked extremely lewd, especially since Zhang Fei [1] continued to dual-cultivate with his partner from the Yin-Yang Pavilion non-stop, and the moans of his partners were stirring up the lust of the female prisoners.

If he wanted to, Zhang Fei [4] could easily dual-cultivate with them, but he had no interest in doing so with any of them except for Chu Youqian, because she was the only virgin among the five. Despite that, he still had no intention of doing so, especially since he could absorb her qi without having to.
Zhang Fei [4] then squatted in front of them, touched the tubes at the ends of the chains that chained them one by one, and immediately absorbed their Qi in the tubes.
[You gained 250,000 Qi.]

However, Zhang Fei [4] did not immediately absorb their Qi into his body, and he deposited it into the Qi storage instead. He intended to use their Qi to fill the limit of the Qi storage first, which still had a lot of capacity.

Mei suddenly spoke to Zhang Fei [4]. [Master, I think it would be better if you moved them to the newest space you got after the system upgraded to level four, especially since it is directly integrated with you. That way, you no longer need to manually absorb their Qi, and you can absorb it whenever you want.]
Zhang Fei [4] nodded in agreement with the AI. 'Open the portal to that space, Mei.'
Mei immediately followed his orders, causing a portal to open in the room, and Zhang Fei [4] brought the five female prisoners into it.

Unlike the training room, Zhang Fei [4] could not see anything there except for ten empty rooms around the place, plus there was a black and white tube in the middle of them. The rooms looked like prison cells, and there were glass pipes connecting them to tubes. "Hmm? Is the use of this space what I think, Mei?"

[Yes, Master. This space is called the Yin-Yang space, and its function is the same as the Yin-Yang absorber shackles. Unfortunately, you can only imprison ten people in this place, so you still need those shackles if you want to detain more people.]

"That's not a problem, right? If they're no longer useful to me, I just need to get rid of them and replace them with others." Mei was left speechless by Zhang Fei [4]'s answer, and he immediately placed the five women in different rooms.

Zhang Fei [4] then used the dream imprisonment on them to imprison their subconscious, and he removed the Yin-Yang absorber shackles from them before locking them. He did not immediately leave the space, instead focusing his attention on each of the glass pipes, where he could see their Qi flow into the tube.

Furthermore, the effects of the dream imprisonment caused their Qi to flow into the tube at a faster pace, a realization that truly satisfied him. "Hehehe! This way, my qi supply will be even greater, and my wish to reach the heaven realm can come true faster. Anyway, have you found the way to go to the middle realms?"

[Actually, that's an easy matter, master. You can use the Pandora Odyssey to leave this realm and go to the middle realm, but there is no information about the middle realm in the system. Therefore, you have to explore the middle realm yourself, and you can look for the closest realm first.
However, it would be better if you don't go there now, and you can start thinking about that after your cultivation reaches the heaven realm.]

Zhang Fei [4] agreed with that, especially since there would be many more cultivators who were much stronger than him in the middle realms, and many of them might have already reached the quasi-divine realm or even the seven divine realms there.
Moreover, they would have to start a whole new life in the middle realms, and they had no connections there, so he still had no intention of leaving the Sky Jade Realm.

Zhang Fei [4] then let out a heavy sigh as he talked to himself. "Sigh! I hope to reach the heaven realm in the next few months, so I can start preparing to leave for the middle realms afterward, and I will bring them there once everything is ready."

After that, Zhang Fei [4] returned to the training room to cultivate again, and he sat down in one corner with a satisfied smile, especially since Zhang Xiaoling and the others continued to work hard in their training. Moreover, they had already started training in level two gravity, which was four times heavier than the outside world.
'After I break through to the Earth Realm, I will start training at level four gravity, and sixteen times heavier gravity will help me be more prepared to go to the middle realms.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 7,100 Qi.]
[Reward: 71 green jewels.]
[You gained 50,000 female essences from Xenaya.]
The appearance of the first notification surprised Zhang Xiaolong [3] a bit, especially since the amount of qi he had to absorb had increased more than usual, but he didn't pay it much mind.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pulled his dick out of Xenaya's pussy because she looked overwhelmed, even though she had only orgasmed four times, and he sat down on the side of the bed afterward. 'Show my status, Mei.'
[Yes, Master.]
Cultivation:
> 5 Star Soul Realm [Qi: 343,900/761,000]
Soul Cultivation
> Foundation Soul: Early Stage
Demon Rank:
- Earl Rank [Female essence: 1.357,000/1,800,000]
Beast Rank:
5 Tails [Beast Essence: 2,150,000/10,000,000]

After reading that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in satisfaction, considering that his cultivation was already halfway to reaching the next minor stage and his demon rank was also approaching Marquis rank.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got dressed and left his room, but he had not removed the dream imprisonment ability from Xenaya because he still wanted to milk her female essence. He then went to look around the Lust City, which was still lively.
